paras.zh: - 闪电回合：Kaur 和 Dackam 分享了一些个人见解。 （12:40）

articles.title: The AAM Group Celebrates 20 Years of Total Truck Centers
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The AAM Group is celebrating the 20th anniversary of Total Truck Centers, its flagship marketing program for independent truck accessory retailers and installers. Looking back on the past two decades, The AAM Group said the need for greater support in the truck accessories aftermarket led to the creation of Total Truck Centers. Distributing large, difficult-to-ship products presented unique challenges. In 2005, four distributors—Weller’s Auto Supply, North Central Truck, Nelson Truck and Titan Equipment—joined The AAM Group. Their participation laid the foundation for a dedicated truck accessories program.
paras.zh: AAM 集团正在庆祝 Total Truck Centers 成立 20 周年，这是其针对独立卡车配件零售商和安装商的旗舰营销计划。回顾过去二十年，AAM 集团表示，卡车配件售后市场需要更大的支持，因此创建了全卡车中心。配送大型、难以运输的产品带来了独特的挑战。 2005 年，四家经销商（Weller’s Auto Supply、North Central Truck、Nelson Truck 和 Titan Equipment）加入了 AAM 集团。他们的参与为专门的卡车配件计划奠定了基础。

paras.en: Total Truck Centers officially launched in 2006 with a clear purpose: helping independent truck accessory retailers compete and grow.
paras.zh: Total Truck Centers 于 2006 年正式推出，其目标明确：帮助独立卡车配件零售商竞争和发展。

paras.en: As the truck accessories aftermarket has evolved, so have the challenges facing independent retailers. Jobbers often lack the time, staff and resources to manage their own marketing. Recognizing these challenges, The AAM Group developed four core tools to help level the playing field.
paras.zh: 随着卡车配件售后市场的发展，独立零售商面临的挑战也随之而来。兼职者往往缺乏时间、人员和资源来管理自己的营销。认识到这些挑战，AAM Group 开发了四个核心工具来帮助创造公平的竞争环境。

paras.en: Aftermarket Websites® helps retailers establish an online presence and connect with customers searching for products. ReadyPosts provides free social media content and automation to help shops stay visible without adding to their workload.
paras.zh: Aftermarket Websites® 帮助零售商建立在线形象并与搜索产品的客户建立联系。 ReadyPosts 提供免费的社交媒体内容和自动化，帮助商店保持可见性，而不增加他们的工作量。

paras.en: N-Store TV brings supplier product education into showrooms, streaming more than 3 million minutes of content each month. Meanwhile, PRO Rebates has returned thousands of dollars to participating jobbers.
paras.zh: N-Store TV 将供应商产品教育带入展厅，每月播放超过 300 万分钟的内容。与此同时，PRO Rebates 已向参与活动的工作人员返还了数千美元。

paras.en: “We started Total Truck Centers because we recognized a need to better support independent truck accessory retailers,” said Tim Oddom, president of The AAM Group. “Twenty years later, the tools have changed, but our purpose hasn’t. Everything we do comes back to helping our jobbers sell more products and grow their businesses.”
paras.zh: “我们创办 Total Truck Centers 是因为我们认识到需要更好地支持独立卡车配件零售商，”AAM 集团总裁 Tim Oddom 说道。 “二十年后，工具发生了变化，但我们的目的没有改变。我们所做的一切都是为了帮助我们的批发商销售更多产品并发展他们的业务。”

paras.en: As Total Truck Centers enters its next chapter, The AAM Group said it continues listening to its members and jobbers. The organization aims to understand their challenges and develop resources that meet their changing needs.
paras.zh: 随着 Total Truck Centers 进入新篇章，AAM 集团表示将继续倾听其会员和经销商的意见。该组织旨在了解他们的挑战并开发资源来满足他们不断变化的需求。

paras.en: “The past 20 years have been about listening to our members and jobbers and responding to their needs,” said Andy Stacy, marketing director. “That same commitment will guide us for the next 20 years. As the industry changes, we’ll continue finding ways to help independent retailers succeed.”
paras.zh: “过去 20 年我们一直在倾听我们的会员和从业者的意见并满足他们的需求，”营销总监安迪·史黛西 (Andy Stacy) 说道。 “同样的承诺将指导我们未来 20 年。随着行业的变化，我们将继续寻找帮助独立零售商取得成功的方法。”

articles.title: 'Like walking the plank': For 3,000 years, Indigenous people herded bison off a unique cliff in Texas, study reveals
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have uncovered an extremely rare example of a "bison jump" in the Texas Panhandle, where a natural geological formation allowed Indigenous people to hunt North America's largest living land mammal for 3,000 years. The discovery confirms that the prehistoric hunting technique — which involved channeling a herd of bison into a stampede off a cliff, akin to "walking the plank" — was not limited to the northern Plains like experts previously thought.
paras.zh: 考古学家在德克萨斯州狭长地带发现了极其罕见的“野牛跳跃”例子，那里的自然地质构造使原住民能够在 3000 年来猎杀北美最大的陆地哺乳动物。这一发现证实了史前狩猎技术——包括引导一群野牛从悬崖上逃跑，类似于“走木板”——并不像专家之前认为的那样仅限于北部平原。

paras.en: "Bison jumping is an iconic, uniquely North American hunting technique that yielded some of the most productive food-getting events in the history of human hunting," researchers wrote in a study published online Nov. 9 in the journal American Antiquity.
paras.zh: 研究人员在 11 月 9 日《美国古代》杂志在线发表的一项研究中写道：“野牛跳跃是一种标志性的、北美独有的狩猎技术，它产生了人类狩猎史上一些最富有成效的食物获取事件。”

paras.en: Although jump sites are well known throughout the northern Plains, only one such site had ever been found in the southern Plains. But a second bison jump called Nighthawk has now been identified in Caprock Canyons State Park in the Texas Panhandle, and researchers found that Indigenous people used the Nighthawk bison jump for millennia.
paras.zh: 尽管跳跃地点在整个北部平原都广为人知，但在南部平原却只发现过一处这样的地点。但现在在德克萨斯州狭长地带的卡普罗克峡谷州立公园发现了第二种称为“夜鹰”的野牛跳跃，研究人员发现原住民使用“夜鹰”野牛跳跃已有数千年。

paras.en: "Returning to the same place over and over again over 3,000 years shows that people had a significant connection to the Nighthawk hunting facility," study first author Gus Costa, an archaeologist at Rice University in Houston, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、休斯敦莱斯大学的考古学家古斯·科斯塔在一份声明中说：“3000多年来一次又一次回到同一个地方表明，人们与夜鹰狩猎设施有着重要的联系。”

paras.en: Nighthawk was found when bison remains began eroding from a bone bed (a place where bones naturally accumulate) underneath a roughly 65-foot-tall (20 meters) cliff spur. Archaeologists investigated and found chipped stone tools near the bones, as well as a few arrowheads. Several of the bison bones had cut marks from stone tools consistent with prehistoric butchery practices. These discoveries added up to a possible bison jump.
paras.zh: 夜鹰是在野牛遗骸开始从大约 65 英尺（20 米）高的悬崖尖刺下方的骨床（骨头自然堆积的地方）侵蚀时发现的。考古学家调查并在骨头附近发现了有缺口的石器，以及一些箭头。几块野牛骨头上有石器切割的痕迹，与史前屠宰的做法一致。这些发现加起来可能是野牛跳跃。

paras.en: "The only way bison can arrive at the site is by falling from above, as the site surface is sandwiched between two cliffs," the researchers wrote. Indigenous hunters likely used the cliff's natural spur shape to herd the bison to their deaths. "Instead of a stampede toward a surprise fall, Nighthawk could have operated more like 'walking the plank,'" according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“野牛到达该地点的唯一方法是从上方坠落，因为该地点的表面夹在两个悬崖之间。”土著猎人很可能利用悬崖的天然山刺形状来驱赶野牛直至死亡。研究人员表示：“夜鹰的行为方式可以更像是‘走木板’，而不是突然摔倒。”

paras.en: Even more surprising than the discovery of a bison jump site in the southern Plains was the length of time the jump was used.
paras.zh: 比在南部平原发现野牛跳跃点更令人惊讶的是跳跃使用的时间长度。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: A series of radiocarbon dates revealed that there were at least seven mass bison kills at Nighthawk over a span of three millennia, between roughly 1550 B.C. and A.D. 1550. One of these events, which the researcher named Kill 3, was responsible for most of the bison bones. That enormously successful hunt most likely took place around A.D. 300 to 400 and would have required an immense labor force and precise coordination.
paras.zh: 一系列放射性碳测年结果显示，从大约公元前 1550 年到公元前 1550 年之间，在三千年的时间里，夜鹰至少发生了七起大规模的野牛猎杀事件。公元 1550 年。其中一个事件被研究人员命名为“Kill 3”，大部分野牛骨头都是由它造成的。那次极其成功的狩猎很可能发生在公元 300 年至 400 年左右，需要大量的劳动力和精确的协调。

paras.en: "Bison jumping is a complicated community effort," Costa said. "Large scale bison harvests (like jumps) are exciting because they require a large group of people working together to be successful."
paras.zh: “野牛跳跃是一项复杂的社区工作，”科斯塔说。 “大规模野牛收获（如跳跃）是令人兴奋的，因为它们需要一大群人共同努力才能取得成功。”

paras.en: - The ancestors of today's Indigenous people arrived in the Americas during the coldest part of the last ice age, study suggests
paras.zh: - 研究表明，当今原住民的祖先是在上一个冰河时代最寒冷的时期抵达美洲的

paras.en: - Ancient Indigenous people in New Mexico lived through extreme climate change 23,000 years ago, study suggests
paras.zh: - 研究表明，新墨西哥州的古代原住民在 23,000 年前就经历了极端的气候变化

paras.en: - DNA study of nearly 200 Indigenous genomes reveals unknown Asian 'ghost' population contributed to American ancestry
paras.zh: - 对近 200 个土著基因组的 DNA 研究揭示了未知的亚洲“幽灵”群体对美国血统的贡献

paras.en: It is not entirely clear what the Indigenous hunters were doing with the bison killed in the hunt. In the northern Plains, archaeologists have long assumed that bison jumps were generally performed in the fall and used to provision the community for winter. Bison in the North were used to make pemmican, a shelf-stable mix of dried meat and rendered fat.
paras.zh: It is not entirely clear what the Indigenous hunters were doing with the bison killed in the hunt.在北部平原，考古学家长期以来一直认为野牛跳跃通常在秋季进行，并用于为社区提供过冬的食物。 Bison in the North were used to make pemmican, a shelf-stable mix of dried meat and rendered fat.

paras.en: But although pemmican was an extremely useful foodstuff and trade good in the North, it was likely too warm in Texas for bison fat to last more than a few weeks, the researchers wrote. This may mean that the southern Plains bison hunts were more useful for displaying power and building alliances.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，尽管肉干饼在北方是一种非常有用的食品和贸易品，但德克萨斯州的气温可能太高，野牛脂肪无法维持几周以上。这可能意味着南部平原的野牛狩猎对于展示权力和建立联盟更有用。

paras.en: All of the kill events at Nighthawk were at least a century apart, with an average of 500 years between each bison jump. That points to an infrequent use of the jump but also a clear memory of its utility.
paras.zh: 夜鹰的所有猎杀事件都至少相隔一个世纪，每次野牛跳跃之间平均相隔 500 年。这表明人们很少使用跳跃，但也清楚地记得它的用途。

paras.en: "The simplest explanation for long-lived jump facilities is that these techniques were passed down over long time spans rather than revived again and again," the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“对长寿跳跃设施的最简单解释是，这些技术是在很长一段时间内传承下来的，而不是一次又一次地复兴。”

paras.en: Costa, A. G., Houk, B. A., Lyle, A. S., Bement, L., Lintz, C., Lawrence, K. L., Frederick, C. D., & Culleton, B. J. (2026). The Nighthawk bison jump: New evidence for recurrent Late Holocene bison jumping in the Southern Plains. American Antiquity, 1–28. https://doi.org/10.1017/aaq.2026.10229
paras.zh: Costa, A. G.、Houk, B. A.、Lyle, A. S.、Bement, L.、Lintz, C.、Lawrence, K. L.、Frederick, C. D. 和 Culleton, B. J. (2026)。夜鹰野牛跳跃：全新世晚期野牛在南部平原反复跳跃的新证据。美国古代，1-28。 https://doi.org/10.1017/aaq.2026.10229

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Hoxne 'Empress' pepper pot: A 1,600-year-old silver and gold pepper shaker that a UK farmer unearthed while looking for his hammer
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Where it is from: Hoxne, Suffolk, England
paras.zh: 产地：英格兰萨福克郡霍克斯尼

paras.en: In 1992, a farmer in the village of Hoxne in southeastern England was searching for a lost hammer with a metal detector when he stumbled upon a massive hoard of more than 15,000 ancient Roman coins, jewelry and tableware. Among the artifacts in the Hoxne hoard was a silver spice container in the shape of an imperial lady.
paras.zh: 1992 年，英格兰东南部霍克斯尼村的一位农民在用金属探测器寻找一把丢失的锤子时，偶然发现了一大堆藏有 15,000 多枚古罗马硬币、珠宝和餐具的藏品。霍克斯尼宝藏中的文物中有一个皇家贵妇形状的银色香料容器。

paras.en: The artifact, named the Empress, is one of four pepper pots ("piperatoria" in Latin) discovered in the Hoxne hoard, according to the British Museum. The silver container stands about 4 inches (10 centimeters) tall and is decorated with gold around the woman's eyes, mouth, hair and accessories, including a scroll in her left hand. The woman's elaborate hairstyle helps date the creation of the pepper pot to the fourth century, but experts think the hoard may have been buried in the early fifth century, when Roman rule in Britain was ending.
paras.zh: 据大英博物馆称，这件名为“皇后”的文物是在霍克斯尼宝库中发现的四个胡椒罐（拉丁语“胡椒罐”）之一。这个银色容器高约 4 英寸（10 厘米），女人的眼睛、嘴巴、头发和配饰周围都装饰有金色，其中包括她左手拿着的卷轴。这位女士精致的发型有助于将胡椒罐的制作时间追溯到四世纪，但专家认为这些宝藏可能是在五世纪初被埋藏的，当时罗马对英国的统治即将结束。

paras.en: At the bottom of the pot, which rests on a four-legged base, there is a disc that can be set at three positions: wide open, closed and partly open. The pot would have been filled in the open position with cracked pepper and then used in the partly open position for sprinkling the spice over food.
paras.zh: 锅的底部有一个四足底座，有一个圆盘，可以设置在三个位置：全开、关闭和部分打开。锅在打开的位置装满碎胡椒，然后在部分打开的位置用于将香料撒在食物上。

paras.en: The ancient Romans were huge fans of pepper, Neil MacGregor, former director of the British Museum, wrote in "A History of the World in 100 Objects" (Penguin Books, 2010). Pepper didn't grow in the Roman Empire, so merchants procured it from India. This made it an expensive spice, and filling up the pepper pot would have been costly.
paras.zh: 大英博物馆前馆长尼尔·麦格雷戈在《100件物品中的世界历史》（企鹅出版社，2010年）中写道，古罗马人是胡椒的忠实粉丝。罗马帝国不种植胡椒，因此商人从印度采购。这使得它成为一种昂贵的香料，装满胡椒罐的成本也很高。

paras.en: A wealthy Romano-British family likely used the pepper pot as elaborate tableware, MacGregor wrote. It is unclear whom the Empress was meant to depict, but researchers don't think it features a member of the Roman imperial family. However, the fact that she holds a scroll could indicate that she was both wealthy and well educated.
paras.zh: 麦格雷戈写道，一个富裕的罗马英国家庭可能将胡椒罐用作精致的餐具。目前还不清楚皇后的形象是谁，但研究人员认为它不是罗马皇室的成员。然而，她持有卷轴这一事实可能表明她既富有又受过良好的教育。

paras.en: The ancient family who lived near Hoxne seems to have left its wealth behind during the breakdown of Roman rule in Britain, since the pepper pot was found in a chest that contained dozens of pieces of silverware, 29 pieces of gold jewelry, and more than 15,000 coins.
paras.zh: 居住在霍克斯尼附近的古老家族似乎在罗马统治英国崩溃期间留下了自己的财富，因为在一个装有数十件银器、29 件黄金首饰和 15,000 多枚硬币的箱子中发现了胡椒罐。

paras.en: "This was the mobile wealth of a rich Roman family — precisely the type of person who is in danger when the state fails," MacGregor wrote.
paras.zh: 麦格雷戈写道：“这是一个富裕的罗马家庭的流动财富——正是这种人在国家失败时处于危险之中。”

articles.title: Growing lava dome oozes ‘like toothpaste’ from superactive snow-covered volcano in Russia
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Where is it? Shiveluch volcano, Kamchatka Peninsula, Russia [56.66230841, 161.3449064]
paras.zh: 它在哪里？俄罗斯堪察加半岛什韦卢奇火山 [56.66230841, 161.3449064]

paras.en: What's in the photo? Snow melting around a growing lava dome at the volcano's summit
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？ Snow melting around a growing lava dome at the volcano's summit

paras.en: Which satellite took the photo? Landsat 9
paras.zh: 哪颗卫星拍到了这张照片？陆地卫星 9

paras.en: This striking satellite snap shows a heavy blanket of snow surrounding a growing lava dome at the summit of one of Russia's most active and unstable volcanoes.
paras.zh: 这张引人注目的卫星照片显示，俄罗斯最活跃和不稳定的火山之一的山顶上不断生长的熔岩穹顶周围覆盖着一层厚厚的积雪。

paras.en: The snow-covered peak, called Shiveluch (also spelled Shivelyuch or Sheveluch), is a 10,771-foot-tall (3,283 meters) stratovolcano. The name Shiveluch loosely translates to "smoking mountain" in the language of the region's Indigenous Itelmen people. It is the northernmost active peak in the Kamchatka Peninsula, a highly volcanic region in eastern Russia that's famous for its unusually powerful and dramatically beautiful eruptions.
paras.zh: 这座白雪覆盖的山峰被称为 Shiveluch（也拼写为 Shivyuch 或 Sheveluch），是一座高 10,771 英尺（3,283 米）的成层火山。 Shiveluch 这个名字在该地区土著伊泰尔曼人的语言中大致翻译为“冒烟的山”。它是堪察加半岛最北端的活跃山峰，堪察加半岛是俄罗斯东部的一个火山活动频繁的地区，以其异常强大和美丽的火山喷发而闻名。

paras.en: Shiveluch stands out even among its extremely active volcanic neighbors and is one of the planet's most active volcanoes, according to NASA's Earth Observatory. It has experienced at least 15 eruptions in the past 100 years, the most recent of which has been going on since 1999, according to the Smithsonian Institution's Global Volcanism Program.
paras.zh: 根据美国宇航局地球观测站的数据，什韦卢奇火山即使在其极其活跃的火山邻居中也脱颖而出，是地球上最活跃的火山之一。根据史密森学会的全球火山计划，在过去 100 年里，它至少经历了 15 次喷发，其中最近一次是自 1999 年以来发生的。

paras.en: On average, the volcano spews around 530 million cubic feet (15 million cubic meters) of lava every year — enough to fill 6,000 Olympic-size swimming pools, according to a 2007 study. As a result, its appearance constantly changes when viewed from above.
paras.zh: 根据 2007 年的一项研究，这座火山平均每年喷出约 5.3 亿立方英尺（1500 万立方米）的熔岩，足以填满 6,000 个奥林匹克规模的游泳池。因此，从上方观察时，它的外观不断变化。

paras.en: "On a near-daily basis, satellites detect new signs of activity within [Shiveluch's] horseshoe-shaped caldera, including thermal anomalies, hot avalanches and debris flows," Earth Observatory representatives wrote. The volcano is also constantly spitting out "ash deposits that darken the surrounding landscape," they added.
paras.zh: 地球观测站代表写道：“卫星几乎每天都会检测到[Shiveluch]马蹄形破火山口内的新活动迹象，包括热异常、热雪崩和泥石流。”他们补充说，这座火山还不断喷出“火山灰沉积物，使周围的景观变暗”。

paras.en: In this image, you might be able to see a particularly dark circle at the top of the volcano's caldera. This is a lava dome — a steep-sided landform that emerges when lava piles up on top of a volcanic vent — that has been growing rapidly in recent months, according to the Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 在这张图片中，您可能会在火山口的顶部看到一个特别黑的圆圈。据地球观测站称，这是一个熔岩穹丘——当熔岩堆积在火山口顶部时就会出现的陡峭地貌——近几个月来，它一直在迅速增长。

paras.en: The lava within this swelling blob is "extruded slowly and piles up into lobed, sloped, or spine-like shapes akin to those that form when toothpaste is squeezed from a tube," Earth Observatory representatives wrote.
paras.zh: 地球观测站的代表写道，这个膨胀的团块中的熔岩“缓慢地被挤出，堆积成叶状、倾斜的或脊柱状的形状，类似于从管子中挤出牙膏时形成的形状”。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Eventually, lava domes grow so large that they give way under their own weight, often causing the caldera's walls to collapse. However, it doesn't take long for the volcano to rebuild itself after these events. (It is currently unclear if the photographed lava dome subsequently collapsed after the photo was taken.)
paras.zh: 最终，熔岩穹丘变得如此之大，以至于在自身重量的作用下塌陷，常常导致火山口的墙壁倒塌。然而，这些事件发生后，火山很快就会自我重建。 （目前尚不清楚所拍摄的熔岩穹顶是否在照片拍摄后随后塌陷。）

paras.en: "Shivelyuch is an incredible volcano that has collapsed over and over again, on several scales, ranging from enormous flank collapses to more modest dome-collapse events," Janine Krippner, a volcanologist based in New Zealand, told the Earth Observatory. "It goes through cycles of collapse but then builds itself up again and again through constant volcanic activity."
paras.zh: 新西兰火山学家珍妮·克里普纳 (Janine Krippner) 告诉地球观测站：“希夫利奇火山是一座令人难以置信的火山，它一次又一次地崩塌，规模有多种，从巨大的侧翼崩塌到更温和的圆顶崩塌事件。” “它经历了崩溃的循环，但随后通过持续的火山活动一次又一次地自我建立。”

paras.en: In a zoomed-out version of the satellite image (see above), black streaks are visible at various points along the volcano's flanks, including a thick dark line emanating from the summit caldera. These are lava flows from recent months or years that have retained enough heat that any snow that lands on them soon melts away, according to Live Science's sister site Space.com.
paras.zh: 在卫星图像的缩小版本中（见上图），沿着火山侧面的各个点都可以看到黑色条纹，包括从山顶火山口发出的一条粗黑线。据Live Science 的姊妹网站Space.com 称，这些是近几个月或几年的熔岩流，它们保留了足够的热量，落在上面的雪很快就会融化。

paras.en: Krippner noted that when she previously visited Shiveluch for fieldwork, she could still feel heat coming from lava flows that were over 5 years old.
paras.zh: 克里普纳指出，当她之前前往希韦卢奇进行实地考察时，她仍然能感受到来自超过 5 年熔岩流的热量。

paras.en: Further afield, you can also see larger black streaks that look as if they have been painted onto the satellite image with rough brushstrokes. These are patches of pyroclastic ash left over from a 2023 eruption that burned down large parts of a nearby forest, according to the Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 在更远的地方，您还可以看到更大的黑色条纹，看起来就像是用粗糙的笔触画在卫星图像上一样。据地球观测站称，这些是 2023 年火山喷发留下的火山碎屑灰，当时火山喷发烧毁了附近的大部分森林。

paras.en: A 2022 astronaut photo shows a thick blanket of snow covering Yellowstone Lake, transforming the frozen body of water into a featureless white void. But below the ice lie some of Earth's hottest hydrothermal vents.
paras.zh: 2022 年宇航员拍摄的一张照片显示，黄石湖上覆盖着厚厚的积雪，将冰冻的水体变成了毫无特色的白色虚空。但冰层下面有一些地球上最热的热液喷口。

paras.en: A 2025 satellite image shows a series of ghostly ice swirls sculpted on the surface of Lake Michigan by strong winds during an extreme cold snap that covered Chicago in a blanket of snow.
paras.zh: 一张 2025 年的卫星图像显示，在一次极端寒流期间，密歇根湖表面被强风雕刻出一系列幽灵般的冰漩涡，芝加哥被白雪覆盖。

paras.en: A 2017 astronaut photo shows an unusual checkered pattern surrounding a river, just south of the Canadian border. The unique sight is the result of a forest management initiative dating to the 1800s.
paras.zh: 2017 年宇航员拍摄的一张照片显示，加拿大边境以南的一条河流周围有不寻常的方格图案。这一独特的景观是 1800 年代森林管理举措的成果。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。
