articles.title: What do other planets smell like? The answer hides in their chemistry

paras.en: Humanity has long looked up and yearned to know more about the glowing dots in the night sky. Over the past century, advances in technology have allowed us to glean amazingly good insights into both distant stars and our closest cosmic neighbors. But while high-tech probes may tell us what the atmosphere is like on Jupiter, Saturn or Mars, we still can’t directly answer one deceptively simple question: What does it smell like on other planets?
paras.zh: 人类长期以来一直仰望并渴望更多地了解夜空中的发光点。在过去的一个世纪里，技术的进步使我们能够对遥远的恒星和我们最近的宇宙邻居获得令人惊讶的良好见解。尽管高科技探测器可能会告诉我们木星、土星或火星上的大气层是什么样的，但我们仍然无法直接回答一个看似简单的问题：其他行星上的大气层闻起来像什么？

paras.en: A human may not ever make it to another planet to sniff for themselves. But scientists do have some ideas of such worlds’ odor—albeit rough ones. That’s because astronomers use tools called spectroscopes, which measure how different gases affect the wavelength of light, as well as sampling probes and models of gravity and density, to work out which elements are present on the planets. Some of those elements smell in specific ways.
paras.zh: 人类可能永远无法到达另一个星球来进行自我嗅觉。但科学家们确实对此类世界的气味有一些想法——尽管很粗糙。这是因为天文学家使用称为分光镜的工具来测量不同气体如何影响光的波长，以及采样探针和重力和密度模型，以计算出行星上存在哪些元素。其中一些元素具有特定的气味。

paras.en: But while we know those chemical signatures are there, few have given much thought to how they might translate to human senses. In that regard, Boyko Ranguelov may be unique. A physics professor at Bulgaria’s University of Mining and Geology, Ranguelov has long been interested in what he calls the planets’ “organoleptic properties,” or how the worlds would stimulate human senses.
paras.zh: 尽管我们知道这些化学特征的存在，但很少有人认真思考它们如何转化为人类的感官。在这方面，博伊科·兰格洛夫可能是独一无二的。兰格洛夫是保加利亚矿业和地质大学的物理学教授，长期以来一直对他所说的行星的“感官特性”感兴趣，或者说行星如何刺激人类的感官。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “The combination of these properties are exciting to me, as I’m interested by unusual phenomena,” he says.
paras.zh: “这些特性的结合令我兴奋，因为我对不寻常的现象很感兴趣，”他说。

paras.en: In a 2022 presentation to Bulgarian and Serbian astronomers, Ranguelov laid out his theories of what the other planets in the solar system smell like. The gas giants largely smell terrible, he says, like rotten eggs or human farts. That’s because of the dominant chemicals of hydrogen, helium, hydrogen sulfide, ammonia, phosphine, hydrogen cyanide and ammonium hydrosulfide. That terrible smell would only be amplified by the high pressures that exist lower in their atmospheres.
paras.zh: 在 2022 年向保加利亚和塞尔维亚天文学家发表的演讲中，兰格洛夫阐述了他关于太阳系其他行星气味的理论。他说，这些气态巨行星的气味非常难闻，就像臭鸡蛋或人类的屁一样。这是因为主要化学物质是氢、氦、硫化氢、氨、磷化氢、氰化氢和硫氢化铵。这种可怕的气味只会因大气层较低处的高压而放大。

paras.en: “According to our human senses, the other space bodies in our solar system are not very friendly,” Ranguelov says. “We are strongly accommodated to Earth’s smells and would be badly surprised to smell other space bodies.”
paras.zh: “根据我们人类的感觉，太阳系中的其他太空天体并不是很友好，”兰格洛夫说。 “我们非常适应地球的气味，如果闻到其他太空天体的味道，我们会感到非常惊讶。”

paras.en: Rocky planets, such as Mars or Venus, are different. Because of the amount of iron present on Mars, it likely smells similar to rust, with a hint of gunpowder, Ranguelov says.
paras.zh: 岩石行星，例如火星或金星，则不同。兰格洛夫说，由于火星上存在大量的铁，它的气味可能类似于铁锈，并带有一丝火药味。

paras.en: While there may not be any direct knowledge of planetary smells, there are a tiny handful of humans who have indirectly smelled another celestial object. Apollo astronauts who landed on the moon reported that their equipment and samples had a distinct odor.
paras.zh: 虽然可能没有任何关于行星气味的直接知识，但有一小部分人间接闻到了另一个天体的气味。登陆月球的阿波罗宇航员报告说，他们的设备和样品有明显的气味。

paras.en: “The samples smelled as safety matches immediately after they were collected,” according to Ranguelov. “Sometime later they lost the smell after the contact with the oxygen in the moon module cabin.”
paras.zh: 兰格洛夫表示：“这些样本在采集后立即闻起来有安全火柴的味道。” “过了一段时间，它们在接触登月舱舱内的氧气后就失去了气味。”

paras.en: If we ever venture beyond our solar system, humans may be pleasantly surprised at some of the aromas we’d find. There are indications, for example, that the molecular cloud Sagittarius B2 “will smell like an alcoholic cocktail of vodka and sour cherry liquor and salad of pickled cucumbers,” Ranguelov says. “But to get this smell, we’ll need a nose the size of several light-years.”
paras.zh: 如果我们冒险超越太阳系，人类可能会对我们发现的一些气味感到惊喜。例如，有迹象表明，人马座 B2 分子云“闻起来像伏特加、酸樱桃酒和腌黄瓜沙拉的酒精鸡尾酒，”兰格洛夫说。 “但是为了获得这种气味，我们需要一个几光年大小的鼻子。”

articles.title: Weirdly accelerating space rock keeps puzzling astronomers

paras.en: On November 16 officials from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) announced that their Hayabusa2 spacecraft will no longer visit a small, rapidly rotating and mysteriously accelerating space rock called 1998 KY26. Operating well past its nominal lifetime, the probe is now in an “extended mission.” But as a result of problems with its engines, it couldn’t reach this object for an intended rendezvous in 2031. Instead Hayabusa2 will now visit a different target, the near-Earth asteroid 2015 BM510, in 2028.
paras.zh: 11 月 16 日，日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 的官员宣布，他们的隼鸟 2 号航天器将不再访问一颗名为 1998 KY26 的小型、快速旋转且神秘加速的太空岩石。该探测器的运行时间已超过其标称使用寿命，目前正处于“延长任务”状态。但由于发动机出现问题，它无法在 2031 年到达这个目标。相反，隼鸟 2 号现在将在 2028 年访问另一个目标，即近地小行星 2015 BM510。

paras.en: In recent years, 1998 KY26 has certainly attracted an inordinate amount of attention from space scientists and the interested public alike because of its mysterious nongravitationalacceleration—that is, an acceleration that couldn’t be explained by the gravitational influence of other objects in the solar system and must have been driven by something else. I led a team that identified this object’s odd motion in 2022. Some have speculated that this anomalous movement could be a clue that 1998 KY26 isn’t a space rock at all but rather some sort of technological artifact—perhaps even the long-lost Soviet spacecraft Phobos 1.
paras.zh: 近年来，1998 KY26无疑吸引了太空科学家和感兴趣的公众的过度关注，因为它具有神秘的非重力加速度——也就是说，这种加速度无法用太阳系中其他物体的重力影响来解释，并且一定是由其他东西驱动的。我领导的团队在 2022 年识别出了这个物体的奇怪运动。一些人推测，这种异常运动可能是一个线索，表明 1998 KY26 根本不是一块太空岩石，而是某种技术制品，甚至可能是失踪已久的苏联航天器火卫一号。

paras.en: There’s a lot to unpack here, but the gist is that 1998 KY26 is indeed challenging our understanding of comets and asteroids—and has been for several years.
paras.zh: 这里有很多东西需要解开，但要点是 1998 KY26 确实挑战了我们对彗星和小行星的理解——而且已经持续了好几年了。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: A nongravitational acceleration alone isn’t necessarily cause for invoking a spacecraft; we routinely measure such effects on comets and asteroids alike. When comets get close to the sun, ices heat up and sublimate from their surfaces as vapor, producing a rocketlike (and distinctly nongravitational) recoil. The escaping vapor also usually lofts sunlight-reflecting dust along with it, creating the beautiful tails we associate with comets.
paras.zh: 非重力加速度本身并不一定是调用航天器的原因；我们经常测量彗星和小行星上的这种影响。当彗星接近太阳时，冰会升温并以蒸气的形式从其表面升华，产生火箭般的（并且明显是非重力的）反冲力。逸出的蒸气通常还会伴随着反射阳光的尘埃，形成我们与彗星联系在一起的美丽尾巴。

paras.en: Asteroids don’t have tails and presumably don’t have much ice, but we do measure similar, albeit weaker, accelerations on them, too. These are a consequence of subtler effects that all boil down to sunlight either pushing on them or unevenly heating their surfaces.
paras.zh: 小行星没有尾巴，大概也没有太多冰，但我们也测量到了类似的加速度，尽管较弱。这些都是微妙影响的结果，这些影响都归结为阳光照射在它们上或不均匀地加热它们的表面。

paras.en: But as is so often the case in nature, not all so-called minor bodies comfortably fit in our tidy, simple “comet or asteroid” categorization. In fact, in recent years Davide Farnocchia of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory and I led three papers reporting the discovery of almost 20 objects in our solar system that blur this line in a new way. These “dark comets” have properties from both comets and asteroids; they have nongravitational accelerations stronger than those of typical asteroids but exhibit no tails—or rather they showed no tails when we first detected their mysterious movements.
paras.zh: 但正如自然界中经常发生的情况一样，并非所有所谓的小天体都适合我们整洁、简单的“彗星或小行星”分类。事实上，近年来，我和 NASA 喷气推进实验室的 Davide Farnocchia 领导了三篇论文，报告了在太阳系中发现了近 20 个天体，这些天体以新的方式模糊了这条界限。这些“暗彗星”具有彗星和小行星的特性；它们的非重力加速度比典型的小行星更强，但没有尾巴——或者更确切地说，当我们第一次探测到它们神秘的运动时，它们没有尾巴。

paras.en: The more of these dark comets that we find, the clearer we see a telltale trend. In 2024 I led a paper that showed that they seem to be divided into two different populations: outer and inner dark comets (shown in the red and gray orbits, respectively, in the image above). The outer ones are much larger and have more elliptical orbits, while the inner ones are smaller and closer to Earth, with more circular orbits. The latter include 1998 KY26, and its relative proximity to our planet was one of the reasons it became a target for Hayabusa2; for a time, it seemed like that mission would eventually be what solved the mystery of dark comets.
paras.zh: 我们发现的暗彗星越多，我们就越清楚地看到一个明显的趋势。 2024 年，我领导了一篇论文，表明它们似乎分为两个不同的种群：外部暗彗星和内部暗彗星（分别在上图中的红色和灰色轨道中显示）。外层的卫星更大，轨道更多为椭圆形，而内层的轨道更小，更靠近地球，轨道更多为圆形。后者包括 1998 KY26，它与地球的相对距离是它成为隼鸟 2 号目标的原因之一；有一段时间，这项任务似乎最终将解开黑暗彗星之谜。

paras.en: Now, of course, the situation is more complicated.
paras.zh: 当然，现在的情况更加复杂了。

paras.en: Within the last year, we finally snapped images of cometary tails on two of the known outer dark comets, confirming that cometary venting was causing their mysterious motion. Meanwhile telescope data have revealed that 1998 KY26 is significantly smaller than previously thought, and Farnocchia led a study that showed how, given this smaller size, the effects of sunlight alone could explain 1998 KY26’s motion. And a couple of weeks ago Korbin Hansen and Masatoshi Hirabayashi, both at the Georgia Institute of Technology, published another study showing that 1998 KY26 is probably too warm to sustain ice, lending more credence to the updated radiation model from Farnocchia and his colleagues.
paras.zh: Within the last year, we finally snapped images of cometary tails on two of the known outer dark comets, confirming that cometary venting was causing their mysterious motion. Meanwhile telescope data have revealed that 1998 KY26 is significantly smaller than previously thought, and Farnocchia led a study that showed how, given this smaller size, the effects of sunlight alone could explain 1998 KY26’s motion.几周前，佐治亚理工学院的 Korbin Hansen 和 Masatoshi Hirabayashi 发表了另一项研究，表明 1998 年 KY26 可能太温暖，无法维持冰，这为 Farnocchia 和他的同事更新的辐射模型提供了更多可信度。

paras.en: None of this proves that 1998 KY26 isn’t some derelict spacecraft. On the contrary, given that cometlike venting of vapor probably doesn’t explain the motion of 1998 KY26, it could be argued that, by extension, this weakens that explanation for other inner dark comets, too. Then again, in the past some researchers have argued that other dark comets were defunct spacecraft as well, but these claims were quickly shown to be incorrect. While it would be a remarkable development if some of the dark comets turned out to be spacecraft, we have plausible explanations for all of their motions.
paras.zh: 所有这些都不能证明 1998 KY26 不是一些废弃的航天器。 On the contrary, given that cometlike venting of vapor probably doesn’t explain the motion of 1998 KY26, it could be argued that, by extension, this weakens that explanation for other inner dark comets, too.话又说回来，过去一些研究人员认为其他暗彗星也是报废的航天器，但这些说法很快就被证明是不正确的。如果一些暗彗星被证明是航天器，那将是一个了不起的发展，但我们对它们的所有运动都有合理的解释。

paras.en: It is disappointing that Hayabusa2 won’t be visiting 1998 KY26, but the reasons for this have nothing to do with this object being anything besides an admittedly weird space rock. The reality is that the updated radiation-force model tracks with the best available measurements that indicate 1998 KY26’s reduced size, potentially obviating the need for more off-beat interpretations.
paras.zh: 令人失望的是隼鸟 2 号不会访问 1998 KY26，但其原因与该物体除了是一块公认的奇怪的太空岩石之外没有任何关系。现实情况是，更新后的辐射力模型跟踪了最佳可用测量结果，表明 1998 KY26 尺寸减小，从而可能消除对更多异常解释的需要。

paras.en: And still a beguiling mystery remains: the emerging picture in this rapidly developing field is that dark comets really are divided into two distinct populations. These outer objects seem to be covert comets disguising themselves as innocuous asteroids, while the inner ones are something else entirely, forcing us to rethink how radiation forces work in the solar system’s asteroids. The solar system—and the dark comets it contains—keeps presenting us with new puzzles.
paras.zh: 仍然存在一个令人迷惑的谜团：在这个快速发展的领域中出现的情况是，暗彗星实际上分为两个不同的种群。这些外部天体似乎是隐藏的彗星，伪装成无害的小行星，而内部天体则完全是另一回事，迫使我们重新思考辐射力在太阳系小行星中的作用。太阳系及其所包含的黑暗彗星不断向我们提出新的谜题。

paras.en: This is an opinion and analysis article, and the views expressed by the author or authors are not necessarily those of Scientific American.
paras.zh: 这是一篇观点和分析文章，作者表达的观点并不一定代表《科学美国人》的观点。

articles.title: What helps land recover after fire? This ecologist looks to the past
articles.author: Anna Mattson

paras.en: This is a human-written story voiced by AI. Got feedback?
paras.zh: 这是一个由人工智能配音的人类书写的故事。有反馈吗？

paras.en: In an increasingly fire-prone western North America, Jennifer Grenz, an ecologist and member of the Lytton First Nation, looks at fire with a holistic eye. She considers her work with landscapes recovering from catastrophic wildfire to be “deliberately unfocused,” spanning soil microbial ecology, restoration ecology, invasion biology and historical biology.
paras.zh: 在越来越容易发生火灾的北美西部，生态学家兼利顿原住民成员詹妮弗·格伦茨 (Jennifer Grenz) 以整体的眼光看待火灾。她认为她对从灾难性野火中恢复的景观的研究“故意没有重点”，涵盖土壤微生物生态学、恢复生态学、入侵生物学和历史生物学。

paras.en: Grenz analyzes historical ecological records, like how Indigenous people have shaped and cared for ecosystems over time, to paint a comprehensive picture. “I’m interested in how those histories leave ecological legacies and hints of the stewardship of the past,” says Grenz, who leads the Indigenous Ecology Lab at the University of British Columbia in Canada. “What changed on the land that made it more vulnerable?”
paras.zh: 格伦茨分析了历史生态记录，例如土著人民如何随着时间的推移塑造和照顾生态系统，以描绘出一幅全面的图景。 “我对这些历史如何留下生态遗产和过去管理的暗示感兴趣，”加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚大学土著生态实验室的负责人格伦茨说。 “这片土地发生了什么变化，使其变得更加脆弱？”

paras.en: Grenz spends time with many kinds of specialists, such as archaeologists, anthropologists and Indigenous elders who provide oral histories.
paras.zh: 格伦茨与许多类型的专家共度时光，例如考古学家、人类学家和提供口述历史的土著长者。

paras.en: Moving forward, her lab will examine ecology below ground, including soil, microbial communities and root networks. The goal is to understand the role of underground ecology in critical topics like carbon sequestration, climate change, biodiversity and sustainable management.
paras.zh: 展望未来，她的实验室将研究地下生态，包括土壤、微生物群落和根系网络。目标是了解地下生态在碳封存、气候变化、生物多样性和可持续管理等关键主题中的作用。

paras.en: “My motivation is in our interior Salish Territories in the southern interior of British Columbia, where my ancestors rest and where my people are,” Grenz says. “The responsibility I feel to them and to our Tmícw, which means our lands, [is] to not take us back to the past, but to show that we have the deep knowledge to help us move forward.”
paras.zh: “我的动机是在不列颠哥伦比亚省南部内陆的萨利什​​领地，那里是我的祖先安息的地方，也是我的人民居住的地方，”格伦茨说。 “我对他们和我们的 Tmícw（这意味着我们的土地）感到的责任是不要让我们回到过去，而是要表明我们拥有深厚的知识来帮助我们前进。”

articles.title: This scientist proves which problems computers can’t solve quickly
articles.author: Anna Mattson

paras.en: Dor Minzer remembers sitting in an undergraduate computation class at Tel Aviv University. He was intrigued by his professor and soon found himself pulled into a new world: the mystifying intersection of math and computation, first laid out by Alan Turing during World War II. Working with the professor, Minzer became deeply interested in the limitations of what computers can and can’t do.
paras.zh: 多尔·明泽 (Dor Minzer) 记得参加特拉维夫大学的本科生计算课程。他对教授很感兴趣，很快就发现自己被带入了一个新世界：数学与计算的神秘交叉点，这是阿兰·图灵在二战期间首次提出的。与教授一起工作，明泽对计算机能做什么和不能做什么的局限性产生了浓厚的兴趣。

paras.en: “My part is actually to prove not only do I not know how to do it, but I can prove that it’s impossible,” Minzer says. “You have to really be curious.”
paras.zh: “我的职责实际上是证明我不仅不知道如何做到这一点，而且我可以证明这是不可能的，”明泽说。 “你必须真正感到好奇。”

paras.en: Minzer’s hard work has paid off. In 2018, he proved a theoretical computer science problem called the 2-to-2 games conjecture. It asks whether computers can efficiently distinguish games where almost all rules can be satisfied from those where almost none can be satisfied, when the rules have a strict structure.
paras.zh: 明泽的努力得到了回报。 2018年，他证明了一个名为“2对2博弈猜想”的计算机科学理论问题。它询问当规则具有严格的结构时，计算机是否能够有效区分几乎所有规则都可以满足的游戏和几乎没有规则可以满足的游戏。

paras.en: In September, Minzer and his two graduate students at MIT posted a 95-page milestone paper on the unique games conjecture, which builds off the 2-to-2 conjecture. The paper wasn’t quite ready, but they published to get ahead of a press release from OpenAI, describing its proof for the same problem, slated for only days later. It’s a situation that many mathematicians have found themselves in this year as AI companies flood the field with findings at lightning speed.
paras.zh: 9 月份，明泽和他在麻省理工学院的两名研究生发表了一篇长达 95 页的里程碑式论文，内容涉及独特的游戏猜想，该猜想建立在 2-2 猜想的基础上。这篇论文还没有完全准备好，但他们在 OpenAI 发布新闻稿之前发表，描述了同一问题的证明，该新闻稿定于几天后发布。今年，随着人工智能公司以闪电般的速度向该领域涌入大量研究成果，许多数学家都遇到了这种情况。

paras.en: Minzer says it’s critical to remember that math, and all the research and contemplation behind it, is very human. “It’s a human activity,” he says. “Research is sort of a living organism, a living body.”
paras.zh: 明泽说，重要的是要记住，数学及其背后的所有研究和思考都是非常人性化的。 “这是一项人类活动，”他说。 “研究是一个活的有机体，一个活的身体。”

paras.en: Minzer teaches his own students now. Some days, he talks to his class and gets the sense that nobody is paying attention. But other days, he gets a few students that participate. They have ideas, they’re excited, and they remind him of his own days as a graduate student.
paras.zh: 明泽现在教自己的学生。有时，他在班上讲话时，感觉没有人注意。但其他时候，他也会有一些学生参加。他们有想法，他们很兴奋，他们让他想起自己作为研究生的日子。

paras.en: “I feel like now I feel like I’m passing the torch,” he says. “Before you have a Ph.D. adviser, you’re like a new person in a dark room. There are infinite places to go. Your Ph.D. adviser is the person that holds your hand and says, ‘Okay, let’s walk here.’”
paras.zh: “我觉得现在我正在传递火炬，”他说。 “在没有博士生导师之前，你就像一个黑屋子里的新人。有无数个地方可以去。你的博士生导师就是那个握着你的手说：‘好吧，我们走到这里’的人。”

articles.title: Astronomer Isabel Angelo hunts for odd signals in telescope data
articles.author: Anna Mattson

paras.en: This is a human-written story voiced by AI. Got feedback?
paras.zh: 这是一个由人工智能配音的人类书写的故事。有反馈吗？

paras.en: Isabel Angelo spends her days searching the cosmos for exoplanets and signs of extraterrestrial intelligence. But Angelo’s head isn’t in the stars. It’s buried under mountains of 0s and 1s — data from space telescopes old and new.
paras.zh: 伊莎贝尔·安吉洛（Isabel Angelo）整天在宇宙中寻找系外行星和外星智慧生物的迹象。但安吉洛的头脑并不在星星上。它被埋在堆积如山的 0 和 1 之下——来自新旧太空望远镜的数据。

paras.en: To piece together a fuller picture of what’s out there (alien megastructures around nearby stars, perhaps?), Angelo and her colleagues at the SETI Institute in Mountain View, Calif., are turning to machine learning models. These tools are analyzing the troves of telescope data for anomalies — things that look “weird” in space that we don’t know how to explain yet.
paras.zh: 为了更全面地了解那里的情况（也许是附近恒星周围的外星巨型结构？），安吉洛和她在加利福尼亚州山景城 SETI 研究所的同事们正在转向机器学习模型。这些工具正在分析大量望远镜数据中的异常现象——那些在太空中看起来“奇怪”但我们还不知道如何解释的东西。

paras.en: Most of the space weirdos will probably turn out to be total normies — a comet, a newborn star or a star surrounded by lots of gas and dust. “These are things that I would expect [the models] to find,” Angelo says. “But the goal is to find something that’s not even in any of these categories.”
paras.zh: 大多数太空怪人可能都是完全正常的——一颗彗星、一颗新生恒星或一颗被大量气体和尘埃包围的恒星。 “这些是我期望[模型]找到的东西，”安吉洛说。 “但我们的目标是找到一些不属于这些类别的东西。”

paras.en: In the meantime, Angelo keeps her whimsy and wonder for space alive by remembering historic moments, like the reveal of the first portrait of a black hole in 2019. The scientists “put all of these telescopes all over the Earth. They wait for the Earth to rotate. They do all this math to construct this one image,” Angelo says. “I can’t believe how creative and innovative we have to be to learn about space. It’s such a specific and really fun challenge.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，安杰洛通过记住历史时刻，比如 2019 年第一张黑洞肖像的揭晓，来保持她对太空的奇思妙想和好奇心。科学家们“将所有这些望远镜放在地球各地。他们等待地球自转。他们进行所有这些数学计算来构建这幅图像，”安杰洛说。 “我不敢相信我们需要多么有创意和创新才能了解太空。这是一个非常具体且非常有趣的挑战。”

articles.title: Giant Study Finds Ice Baths Can Relieve Sore Muscles – But There's a Hidden Cost
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: Cold water can do some amazing things to the human body, and the fitness world has taken notice.
paras.zh: 冷水对人体有一些神奇的作用，健身界已经注意到了这一点。

paras.en: Ice baths – also known as cold water immersion – have been a popular fitness and wellness trend in recent years, with many athletes and enthusiasts embracing cold plunging, in the belief that it can accelerate muscle recovery and boost athletic performance.
paras.zh: 冰浴（也称为冷水浸泡）近年来已成为一种流行的健身和健康趋势，许多运动员和爱好者都喜欢冷水浴，因为相信它可以加速肌肉恢复并提高运动表现。

paras.en: A giant new review in Sports Medicine – Open might well be the most comprehensive assessment of cold water immersion to date, and it suggests cold plunging does have health benefits for athletes – but those benefits come with some caveats too.
paras.zh: 运动医学领域的一篇新的大型评论——开放式很​​可能是迄今为止对冷水浸泡最全面的评估，它表明冷水浸泡确实对运动员的健康有益——但这些好处也伴随着一些警告。

paras.en: "Cold-water immersion is not a one-size-fits-all recovery tool," says lead author and exercise researcher Erfan Berjisian from Edith Cowan University (ECU) in Australia.
paras.zh: “冷水浸泡并不是一种万能的恢复工具，”澳大利亚埃迪斯科文大学 (ECU) 的主要作者兼运动研究员 Erfan Berjisian 说道。

paras.en: "Its benefits depend heavily on the athlete's goals, the type of exercise completed, and when the next performance session is scheduled."
paras.zh: “它的好处在很大程度上取决于运动员的目标、完成的锻炼类型以及下一次表现训练的时间安排。”

paras.en: In the study, Berjisian and fellow researchers undertook an umbrella review of scientific literature on ice baths, examining 15 published reviews and meta-analyses, which covered 161 individual studies and 3,210 participants.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，Berjisian 和其他研究人员对有关冰浴的科学文献进行了全面审查，检查了 15 篇已发表的评论和荟萃分析，其中涵盖了 161 项个人研究和 3,210 名参与者。

paras.en: While that huge body of research measured lots of different things in lots of different ways – and not all of the studies were of necessarily equal quality – in broad terms, the evidence consistently suggests that post-exercise cold water immersion reduces muscle soreness.
paras.zh: 虽然大量研究以多种不同的方式测量了许多不同的事物，而且并非所有的研究都具有相同的质量，但从广义上讲，证据一致表明，运动后冷水浸泡可以减轻肌肉酸痛。

paras.en: Ice baths can provide relief from soreness after exercise for up to four days, the findings suggest, with the greatest benefits after high-intensity exercise.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，冰浴可以缓解运动后长达四天的酸痛，在高强度运动后效果最大。

paras.en: But the benefits go beyond how your muscles feel.
paras.zh: 但好处不仅仅是肌肉的感觉。

paras.en: The researchers also found that cold-water immersion reduces levels of creatine kinase in the bloodstream, which is a marker of muscle damage, with the effects evident from about 24 hours to 72 hours.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，冷水浸泡会降低血液中肌酸激酶的水平，肌酸激酶是肌肉损伤的标志，在大约 24 小时到 72 小时内效果明显。

paras.en: Ice baths also appear to help the nervous system return to its resting state more quickly after exercise, with cold-water immersion producing improvements in heart-rate variability, although the researchers found no consistent reductions in two key markers of inflammation.
paras.zh: 冰浴似乎还可以帮助神经系统在运动后更快地恢复到休息状态，冷水浸泡可以改善心率变异性，尽管研究人员发现两个关键炎症标志物没有持续减少。

paras.en: As for actual athletic performance, the benefits are more complicated, and depend largely on timing.
paras.zh: 至于实际的运动表现，其好处更为复杂，并且很大程度上取决于时机。

paras.en: Cold-water immersion appears to temporarily improve endurance performance, but only if athletes do exercise straight away – within the first hour after immersion – with the benefits generally disappearing after that.
paras.zh: 冷水浸泡似乎可以暂时提高耐力表现，但前提是运动员立即进行锻炼——浸泡后的第一个小时内——而这种好处通常会在那之后消失。

paras.en: For some athletes, that tight timeframe might be advantageous though.
paras.zh: 对于一些运动员来说，紧张的时间可能是有利的。

paras.en: "Cold-water immersion appears especially useful when recovery time is limited, such as during tournaments, congested competition schedules or repeated high-intensity training sessions," Berjisian says.
paras.zh: “当恢复时间有限时，例如在锦标赛期间、拥挤的比赛日程或重复的高强度训练期间，冷水浸泡显得特别有用，”贝尔吉西安说。

paras.en: Benefits to muscular power and jumping performance, however, could be seen 24 to 72 hours after exercise, suggesting ice baths might help athletes recover between demanding workouts.
paras.zh: 然而，运动后 24 至 72 小时即可看到对肌肉力量和跳跃表现的好处，这表明冰浴可能有助于运动员在高强度训练之间恢复。

paras.en: There's a catch, though. In the first few hours after immersion, explosive performance actually seems to get worse, possibly because cooling temporarily reduces the ability of muscles to generate force.
paras.zh: 不过，有一个问题。在浸泡后的最初几个小时内，爆发力实际上似乎变得更差，可能是因为冷却暂时降低了肌肉产生力量的能力。

paras.en: "If athletes need to perform high-speed or explosive movements soon after cooling, cold-water immersion may be counterproductive unless sufficient re-warming occurs," says co-author and ECU exercise scientist Kristina Kendall.
paras.zh: “如果运动员需要在冷却后立即进行高速或爆发性运动，除非充分重新升温，否则冷水浸泡可能会适得其反，”合著者兼 ECU 运动科学家克里斯蒂娜·肯德尔 (Kristina Kendall) 说。

paras.en: But there's an even bigger downside for those trying to build muscle, with research suggesting that ice baths after resistance training can blunt hypertrophy, resulting in smaller gains in muscle size and strength over time.
paras.zh: 但对于那些试图增强肌肉的人来说，还有一个更大的缺点，研究表明，阻力训练后的冰浴可能会削弱肌肉肥大，导致随着时间的推移，肌肉尺寸和力量的增长会更小。

paras.en: "Cold water immersion attenuates gains in maximal strength, strength endurance, and ballistic performance when applied repeatedly after strength training," the researchers write in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“在力量训练后反复进行冷水浸泡会削弱最大力量、力量耐力和弹道表现的提高。”

paras.en: "These outcomes align with mechanistic evidence of reduced muscle protein synthesis and dampened anabolic and ribosomal signaling and satellite cell activity when cold water immersion follows resistance exercise."
paras.zh: “这些结果与抗阻运动后冷水浸泡时肌肉蛋白质合成减少、合成代谢和核糖体信号传导以及卫星细胞活动减弱的机制证据相一致。”

paras.en: Because of these limitations, the researchers suggest that while ice baths can provide benefits for athletes, the practice needs to be matched to the individual needs of each athlete at a given point in time, and cold water immersion should "not be viewed as an inherently beneficial or harmful intervention".
paras.zh: 由于这些限制，研究人员建议，虽然冰浴可以为运动员带来好处，但这种做法需要与每个运动员在特定时间点的个人需求相匹配，并且冷水浸泡“不应被视为本质上有益或有害的干预措施”。

paras.en: If you've read the terms and conditions and still want to take the plunge, the team recommends 10–15 minutes in water at 10–15 °C (50–59 °F) for optimal results, or a colder 5–10 °C (41–50 °F) to help reduce muscle damage and improve jump recovery.
paras.zh: 如果您已阅读条款和条件，但仍想尝试一下，团队建议您在 10–15 °C (50–59 °F) 的水中浸泡 10–15 分钟以获得最佳效果，或者在较冷的 5–10 °C (41–50 °F) 水中浸泡 10–15 分钟，以帮助减少肌肉损伤并改善跳跃恢复。

paras.en: The findings are reported in Sports Medicine – Open.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《运动医学 – 开放》杂志上。

articles.title: NASA Spots Bizarrely Neat Rows of Boulders on Mars. Scientists Can't Explain Them.
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: If there is one thing Mars has in abundance, it is rocks.
paras.zh: 如果说火星有一种丰富的东西的话，那就是岩石。

paras.en: Big ones, small ones, yellow ones, scaly ones; rocks with zebra stripes and rocks with leopard spots, and rocks that look like bones.
paras.zh: 大的、小的、黄的、有鳞的；有斑马纹的岩石，有豹纹的岩石，还有看起来像骨头的岩石。

paras.en: They lie scattered across the red planet's surface, like dice thrown by a careless giant.
paras.zh: 它们散布在这颗红色星球的表面，就像一个粗心的巨人扔出的骰子。

paras.en: But in one particularly peculiar corner of Mars, the rocks seem to have abandoned their usual disregard for order.
paras.zh: 但在火星的一个特别奇特的角落，岩石似乎已经放弃了它们通常对秩序的漠视。

paras.en: Instead, boulders are arranged in mesmerizingly neat rows – as though that careless giant had suddenly discovered a taste for zen gardening.
paras.zh: 相反，巨石排列成令人着迷的整齐行——就好像那个粗心的巨人突然发现了禅宗园艺的品味。

paras.en: And the best part is that scientists don't know how they got that way.
paras.zh: 最棒的是，科学家们不知道他们是如何做到这一点的。

paras.en: The place is Daedalia Planum, in the highlands of the volcanic region of Tharsis near the Martian equator.
paras.zh: 这个地方是代达利亚平原，位于火星赤道附近塔尔西斯火山区的高地。

paras.en: Orbital images obtained in 2002 suggested it was a relatively bland and topographically featureless region, but in August 2024, new images obtained by the HiRISE camera aboard NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter revealed how very incorrect it would be to assume anything about Mars is bland.
paras.zh: 2002 年获得的轨道图像表明，这是一个相对平淡且地形无特征的区域，但在 2024 年 8 月，美国宇航局火星勘测轨道飞行器上的 HiRISE 相机获得的新图像表明，假设火星上的任何事物都是平淡无奇的，这是多么错误。

paras.en: Zooming in on a swath of ground roughly 5 by 15 kilometers (3 by 9 miles) reveals an intricate arrangement of gracefully curving lines.
paras.zh: 放大大约 5 x 15 公里（3 x 9 英里）长的土地，可以看到错综复杂的优雅曲线。

paras.en: "Bright boulders are arranged into long curving rows separated by 5 to 10 meters (16 to 33 ft), producing a pattern that resembles a fingerprint," the late planetary scientist Paul Geissler of the US Geological Survey wrote in October 2024.
paras.zh: 美国地质调查局已故行星科学家保罗·盖斯勒 (Paul Geissler) 在 2024 年 10 月写道：“明亮的巨石排列成长而弯曲的行，间​​隔 5 至 10 米（16 至 33 英尺），形成类似于指纹的图案。”

paras.en: He also notes that patterns like it have not been seen anywhere else on Mars – and that scientists aren't sure how the terrain formed.
paras.zh: 他还指出，类似的图案在火星其他任何地方都没有出现过，而且科学家们不确定地形是如何形成的。

paras.en: Even as strange as they look, though, naturally occurring arrangements of stones are not unheard of.
paras.zh: 尽管看起来很奇怪，但自然形成的石头排列并非闻所未闻。

paras.en: On Earth, a phenomenon known as sorted patterned ground can produce remarkably orderly stripes, circles, and polygons, particularly in cold environments where repeated cycles of freezing and thawing gradually separate larger rocks from finer soil.
paras.zh: 在地球上，一种被称为排序图案地面的现象可以产生非常有序的条纹、圆形和多边形，特别是在寒冷的环境中，反复的冻融循环逐渐将较大的岩石与较细的土壤分开。

paras.en: It is possible that the highlands of Daedalia Planum – sitting at a Mars altitude of 5,455 meters (17,900 feet) – are subject to their own cycles of freezing and thawing, but we can't assume that this is the case.
paras.zh: 位于火星海拔 5,455 米（17,900 英尺）的代达利亚平原高地可能会受到自身冰冻和融化循环的影响，但我们不能假设情况确实如此。

paras.en: And there is another possibility – the seismic rumbling that we know Mars is capable of.
paras.zh: 还有另一种可能性——我们知道火星能够发出地震隆隆声。

paras.en: Shaking can result in something known as the Brazil nut effect. Throw a bunch of differently sized nuts in a container, shake it to billy-o, and the Brazil nuts – the biggest ones – will rise to the top while the smaller ones sink to the bottom.
paras.zh: 摇晃可能会导致巴西坚果效应。将一堆不同大小的坚果扔进一个容器中，摇动它，然后巴西坚果（最大的坚果）会升到顶部，而较小的坚果会沉到底部。

paras.en: A similar sorting can happen with boulders when the ground shakes beneath them.
paras.zh: 当巨石下方的地面震动时，也会发生类似的分类。

paras.en: But there are still questions: Can seismic shaking produce such orderly rows of rocks? And is there enough seismic activity beneath Tharsis to explain them?
paras.zh: 但仍然存在疑问：地震震动能否产生如此有序的岩石排？塔尔西斯地下是否有足够的地震活动来解释它们？

paras.en: It's tempting to look at a rock on Mars and dream of all the ways it may not be a rock.
paras.zh: 人们很容易看到火星上的一块岩石，并梦想着它可能不是一块岩石。

paras.en: But the red planet repeatedly shows that rocks do not require a mistaken identity to be interesting. Even when they are just sitting there being humble minerals, they continue to find ways to confound and beguile.
paras.zh: 但这颗红色星球一再表明，岩石并不需要错误的身份才能变得有趣。即使它们只是作为不起眼的矿物坐在那里，它们也会继续寻找迷惑和欺骗的方法。

articles.title: These Babies Grew Up With Strict Sugar Limits. Decades Later, The Health Results Are Dramatic.
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: It was January 1940, and the United Kingdom had a serious problem.
paras.zh: 那是 1940 年 1 月，英国遇到了严重的问题。

paras.en: German attacks on import ships were threatening to trigger extreme food shortages, effectively starving the nation into submission.
paras.zh: 德国对进口船只的袭击有可能引发极端的粮食短缺，实际上使该国挨饿而屈服。

paras.en: Overnight, strict food rationing went into effect, limiting the amount of certain foods people could buy, including common staples like sugar.
paras.zh: 一夜之间，严格的食物配给开始生效，限制了人们可以购买的某些食物的数量，包括糖等常见主食。

paras.en: Decades and entire lifetimes later, the long-tail effect of that enforced sugar reduction, which continued into the 1950s, appears to have dramatically boosted the health of an entire generation of postwar babies, research suggests.
paras.zh: 研究表明，几十年乃至一生之后，强制减糖的长尾效应一直持续到 20 世纪 50 年代，似乎极大地促进了战后整整一代婴儿的健康。

paras.en: In a paper published in PNAS, researchers analyzed health data from 64,761 people who were born in the UK between 1951 and 1956, sourcing their information from the UK Biobank study.
paras.zh: 在《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一篇论文中，研究人员分析了 1951 年至 1956 年间在英国出生的 64,761 人的健康数据，这些信息来自英国生物银行的研究。

paras.en: Sugar rationing, already loosened earlier that year, ended in September 1953, after which average consumption levels quickly doubled.
paras.zh: 当年早些时候已经放松的食糖配给制于 1953 年 9 月结束，此后平均消费水平迅速翻了一番。

paras.en: By focusing on the 1951–1956 period straddling the cut-off, the researchers were able to compare the adult health of babies who spent their first 1,000 days (from conception to the age of two) under sugar rationing with babies who were born directly after and did not experience the limits.
paras.zh: 通过关注 1951 年至 1956 年跨越界限的时期，研究人员能够比较在糖配给下度过最初 1000 天（从受孕到两岁）的婴儿与随后出生且没有经历糖配给限制的婴儿的成年健康状况。

paras.en: They also compared the relative exposure of babies who experienced more of the sugar-rationing period to those born a little later, but still before restrictions lifted.
paras.zh: 他们还将经历过更长时间糖定量配给期的婴儿与稍晚出生（但仍是在限制措施解除之前出生）的婴儿的相对暴露情况进行了比较。

paras.en: It's not the first time researchers have turned to this historical event and the unique scientific data it provides.
paras.zh: 这并不是研究人员第一次关注这一历史事件及其提供的独特科学数据。

paras.en: Previous studies have shown that the sugar-rationed babies face lower chronic disease risks, along with lower chances of developing Alzheimer's, and they seem to enjoy better cardiovascular health.
paras.zh: 此前的研究表明，吃糖的婴儿患慢性病的风险较低，患阿尔茨海默氏症的几率也较低，而且他们的心血管健康似乎也更好。

paras.en: "Excess sugar consumption is implicated in multiple cancers through insulin resistance, chronic inflammation, and metabolic reprogramming," write health economists Chen Zhu from China Agricultural University and Weilong Zhang from the University of Cambridge.
paras.zh: 中国农业大学的健康经济学家朱晨和剑桥大学的张伟龙写道：“过量的糖摄入通过胰岛素抵抗、慢性炎症和代谢重编程与多种癌症有关。”

paras.en: "Yet whether early-life sugar exposure causally shapes long-term cancer risk remains an open question."
paras.zh: “然而，生命早期的糖暴露是否会影响长期癌症风险仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。”

paras.en: Their research answers that question, showing significant reductions in cancer incidence for babies whose sugar intake was limited in early life.
paras.zh: 他们的研究回答了这个问题，表明生命早期糖摄入量有限的婴儿的癌症发病率显着降低。

paras.en: Though these babies and their parents didn't have to contend with modern-day advertising and stacked supermarket shelves enticing them with increasingly sweet foods, the findings are a window into how sugar (or lack thereof) impacts health.
paras.zh: 尽管这些婴儿和他们的父母不必面对现代广告和堆积如山的超市货架上越来越甜的食物诱惑他们，但这些发现是了解糖（或缺乏糖）如何影响健康的一个窗口。

paras.en: Compared with the babies who didn't experience sugar rationing, the babies who were sugar-rationed for their first 1,000 days were 69 percent less likely to develop liver cancer in their adult lives.
paras.zh: 与没有经历过糖配给的婴儿相比，在出生后 1000 天内进行糖配给的婴儿在成年后患肝癌的可能性降低了 69%。

paras.en: They also saw reduced incidence of prostate cancer (52 percent lower), lung cancer (41 percent lower), rectal cancer (40 percent lower), and breast cancer (36 percent lower).
paras.zh: 他们还发现前列腺癌（降低 52%）、肺癌（降低 41%）、直肠癌（降低 40%）和乳腺癌（降低 36%）的发病率。

paras.en: The sugar-rationed babies also tended to show longer telomeres – the caps at the ends of chromosomes that protect our genetic material, which are linked to longevity.
paras.zh: 糖配给的婴儿也往往表现出更长的端粒——染色体末端的帽子，保护我们的遗传物质，这与长寿有关。

paras.en: According to the researchers, the telomere length of the sugar-rationed babies equated to about 2.2 years less biological aging, suggesting they aged more slowly throughout their lives, enjoying better overall health than the non-sugar-rationed participants.
paras.zh: 研究人员称，吃糖配给的婴儿的端粒长度相当于生物衰老时间缩短了约 2.2 年，这表明他们一生中衰老得更慢，整体健康状况比不吃糖的婴儿要好。

paras.en: Another interesting finding was that the sugar-rationed babies appeared to show persistent dietary habits that lasted into adulthood, compared to their non-rationed peers.
paras.zh: 另一个有趣的发现是，与未配给糖的同龄人相比，配给糖的婴儿似乎表现出持续到成年的持续饮食习惯。

paras.en: "Rationed cohorts consume less sugar, eat smaller food quantities, and maintain healthier, more diverse diets five decades after the policy ended," the researchers write in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“在政策结束五年后，配给人群消耗更少的糖，吃更少的食物，并保持更健康、更多样化的饮食。”

paras.en: While we can't be entirely sure why that is, the researchers have some ideas.
paras.zh: 虽然我们不能完全确定这是为什么，但研究人员有一些想法。

paras.en: "The level of sweetness people are exposed to very early in life may shape their taste preferences for a long time," Zhang explained in The Conversation.
paras.zh: “人们在生命早期接触到的甜味水平可能会在很长一段时间内影响他们的口味偏好，”张在对话中解释道。

paras.en: "There appear to be two mechanisms at work. One is biological – early nutrition may shape how the metabolism, organs and immune system develop. The other is behavioral – a taste for less sweetness, formed early, seems to stick."
paras.zh: “似乎有两种机制在起作用。一种是生物机制——早期营养可能会影响新陈代谢、器官和免疫系统的发育。另一种是行为机制——早期形成的少甜口味似乎会持续下去。”

paras.en: The findings are intriguing: In the years after World War II, a generation of children was forced to restrict their sugar intake to levels comparable to what the World Health Organization recommends for everybody today.
paras.zh: 研究结果很有趣：在第二次世界大战后的几年里，一代儿童被迫将糖摄入量限制在与世界卫生组织今天为每个人建议的水平相当的水平。

paras.en: And what do you know? They were healthier.
paras.zh: 你知道吗？他们更健康。

paras.en: While this was only an observational study, the researchers claim the experiment-like conditions of the sugar-rationing cut-off (which divided the participants into two discrete groups) produce a kind of "causal evidence" linking sugar intake to adult cancer risk.
paras.zh: 虽然这只是一项观察性研究，但研究人员声称，类似实验的糖配给截止条件（将参与者分为两个独立的组）产生了一种将糖摄入量与成人癌症风险联系起来的“因果证据”。

paras.en: Not everyone agrees with the 'causal' interpretation. In a letter published in PNAS, medical scientist Nicola Cirillo from the University of Foggia in Italy argues that historical records undercut the idea that rationed infants got little or no sugar.
paras.zh: 并非所有人都同意“因果”解释。在《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一封信中，意大利福贾大学的医学家尼古拉·西里洛 (Nicola Cirillo) 认为，历史记录削弱了配给婴儿很少或根本不吃糖的观点。

paras.en: "The Welfare Foods Service, published during the study period… confirms provision of National Dried Milk specifically for children under two, which required 1½ teaspoons of sugar per feed," Cirillo notes.
paras.zh: “研究期间发布的福利食品服务局……证实专门为两岁以下儿童提供国家干奶，每次喂食需要 1.5 茶匙糖，”Cirillo 指出。

paras.en: That makes it hard to tie the results to a specific sugar dose during development.
paras.zh: 这使得在开发过程中很难将结果与特定的糖剂量联系起来。

paras.en: Zhu and Zhang replied that their findings reflect exposure to the rationing regime as a whole, not a measured amount of sugar. They did agree that their description of infants' sugar allowances "was too strong".
paras.zh: 朱和张回答说，他们的发现反映了整个配给制度的影响，而不是测得的糖量。他们确实同意他们对婴儿糖摄入量的描述“过于强烈”。

paras.en: Overall, the results should be interpreted with caution.
paras.zh: 总体而言，应谨慎解释结果。

paras.en: "This does not mean that children should not eat sugar at all," Zhang wrote, "and it certainly does not mean that postwar sugar rationing is a desirable policy."
paras.zh: “这并不意味着孩子们根本不应该吃糖，”张写道，“这当然也不意味着战后的糖配给是一项可取的政策。”

articles.title: Archaeologists reveal a powerful Iron Age king may have been a woman

paras.en: Archaeologists reveal a powerful Iron Age king may have been a woman
paras.zh: 考古学家揭示铁器时代一位强大的国王可能是一位女性

paras.en: Archaeologists have uncovered evidence that Verica, the Iron Age ruler whose exile helped trigger Romeâs invasion of Britain in AD 43, was actually a woman. The discovery challenges centuries of historical assumptions and suggests that a largely forgotten female leader may have changed the course of British history.
paras.zh: 考古学家发现的证据表明，铁器时代的统治者维丽卡实际上是一名女性，她的流放引发了罗马在公元 43 年对英国的入侵。这一发现挑战了几个世纪以来的历史假设，并表明一位基本上被遗忘的女性领导人可能改变了英国历史的进程。

paras.en: New archaeological research from Bournemouth University (BU) suggests that an influential Iron Age British ruler, long believed to have been a man, was actually a woman. The ruler, known as Verica, played a pivotal role in events leading to the Roman invasion of Britain in AD 43. The findings challenge longstanding assumptions about early British history and the political influence of women during this period.
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯大学 (BU) 的最新考古研究表明，长期被认为是一位有影响力的铁器时代英国统治者实际上是一位女性。这位名叫维里卡的统治者在导致公元 43 年罗马入侵英国的事件中发挥了关键作用。这些发现挑战了长期以来关于英国早期历史和这一时期女性政治影响力的假设。

paras.en: Verica ruled the Atrebates, a powerful tribe whose lands extended across much of what is now Hampshire and West Sussex. Around AD 40, Verica was forced from power and escaped to Rome, where the exiled ruler sought assistance from Emperor Claudius.
paras.zh: 维丽卡统治着阿特雷巴特斯，这是一个强大的部落，其领土横跨现在的汉普郡和西萨塞克斯郡的大部分地区。公元 40 年左右，维里卡被迫下台并逃往罗马，这位流亡统治者在那里向克劳狄乌斯皇帝寻求援助。

paras.en: The Roman historian Cassius Dio claimed that Verica's appeal was the reason Claudius decided to invade Britain. If this account is accurate, Verica's actions may have helped set in motion one of the most consequential events in British history.
paras.zh: 罗马历史学家卡西乌斯·迪奥声称，维丽卡的上诉是克劳迪乌斯决定入侵英国的原因。如果这个说法是准确的，维丽卡的行为可能有助于引发英国历史上最重要的事件之一。

paras.en: Ancient Evidence Challenges an Iron Age King's Identity
paras.zh: 古代证据挑战铁器时代国王的身份

paras.en: Dr. Miles Russell, Director of Archaeological Fieldwork at Bournemouth University, led the research and argues that earlier historians incorrectly identified Verica as male.
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯大学考古实地考察主任迈尔斯·拉塞尔博士领导了这项研究，他认为早期的历史学家错误地将维丽卡认定为男性。

paras.en: "Verica is assumed to have been male because of the patriarchal mindset of 19th-century classical historians. Verica was not only critical to the special relationship between Britain and Rome in the early first century AD but was indisputably female."
paras.zh: “由于 19 世纪古典历史学家的父权观念，维丽卡被认为是男性。维丽卡不仅对公元一世纪初英国和罗马之间的特殊关系持批评态度，而且无可争议地是女性。”

paras.en: Russell points to several pieces of evidence supporting this interpretation. One is the name Verica itself, which ends in the letter "a," a feature common among female names of the time. Other prominent examples include Cartimandua, who ruled the Brigantes (in Yorkshire), and Boudica, leader of the Iceni (in Norfolk).
paras.zh: 罗素指出了支持这一解释的几项证据。其中一个是Verica这个名字本身，它以字母“a”结尾，这是当时女性名字中常见的特征。其他著名的例子包括统治布里甘特人（约克郡）的卡蒂曼杜亚（Cartimandua）和艾西尼人（诺福克郡）的领导人布迪卡（Boudica）。

paras.en: All three rulers lived during roughly the same period. Boudica is the best known because of her rebellion against Roman rule in AD 60. However, Russell argues that Verica may have held even greater political power and influence.
paras.zh: 这三位统治者生活在大致同一时期。布迪卡因其在公元 60 年反抗罗马统治而闻名。然而，罗素认为维丽卡可能拥有更大的政治权力和影响力。

paras.en: Another important clue comes from coins issued under Verica's rule. These coins bear the Latin title "rex," traditionally translated as "king," which has contributed to the assumption that Verica was male. Russell explains that the title was not necessarily restricted to men.
paras.zh: 另一个重要线索来自维丽卡统治下发行的硬币。这些硬币上刻有拉丁文标题“rex”，传统上翻译为“国王”，这有助于人们假设维丽卡是男性。拉塞尔解释说，这个头衔不一定限于男性。

paras.en: "People also assume she was a 'he' because of the term 'rex' on coins, but rex is a non-gender-specific title; both male and female kings were recognized by Rome, Cleopatra of Egypt being the most famous."
paras.zh: “人们还因为硬币上的‘雷克斯’一词而认为她是‘他’，但雷克斯是一个不分性别的头衔；男性和女性国王都受到罗马的承认，埃及克利奥帕特拉是最著名的。”

paras.en: He continued: "The use of the Latin title rex on coins shows that Verica ruled with the full authorization of the emperor."
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“硬币上使用拉丁文标题雷克斯表明维丽卡的统治得到了皇帝的完全授权。”

paras.en: The artwork on Verica's coins provides another intriguing clue. Rather than depicting the masculine warriors commonly featured on coins produced by other British Iron Age rulers, Verica's coins show a figure with distinctly feminine characteristics.
paras.zh: 维丽卡硬币上的艺术品提供了另一个有趣的线索。维丽卡的硬币并没有描绘其他英国铁器时代统治者生产的硬币上常见的男性战士，而是展示了具有明显女性特征的人物。

paras.en: "Whilst other coin-producing British Iron Age leaders portray obviously male warriors, Verica is depicted as a slender, feminine, bare-breasted figure riding on horseback."
paras.zh: “虽然其他生产硬币的英国铁器时代领导人明显描绘的是男性战士，但维丽卡被描绘成骑在马背上的苗条、女性化、裸胸的人物。”

paras.en: The Forgotten Ruler Behind Rome's Invasion of Britain
paras.zh: 罗马入侵英国背后被遗忘的统治者

paras.en: Russell believes Verica's importance extended far beyond the ruler's identity. He argues that Verica may have been instrumental in helping Claudius successfully invade Britain.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔相信维丽卡的重要性远远超出了统治者的身份。他认为维丽卡可能在帮助克劳狄斯成功入侵英国方面发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: Ancient Roman writers frequently portrayed Claudius as an ineffective emperor who was easily influenced by women and formerly enslaved people who had gained their freedom. This reputation may have shaped how historians described Verica's role in persuading him to invade.
paras.zh: 古罗马作家经常将克劳狄乌斯描绘成一个无能的皇帝，他很容易受到妇女和获得自由的前奴隶的影响。这种声誉可能影响了历史学家如何描述维丽卡在说服他入侵方面所扮演的角色。

paras.en: Russell suggests that Cassius Dio's account reinforced this negative portrayal by presenting the invasion as a decision made under the influence of a woman. In reality, he argues, Verica may have been a valuable political and military ally who supplied the Romans with intelligence and practical assistance.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔认为，卡西乌斯·迪奥的叙述将入侵描述为在女性影响下做出的决定，从而强化了这种负面描述。他认为，事实上，维里卡可能是一个宝贵的政治和军事盟友，为罗马人提供了情报和实际援助。

paras.en: "The story of Claudius committing to something only because a woman told him to fits the trope of this emperor as being submissive and henpecked. In effect, Dio was saying that the campaign was undertaken solely because of the whisperings of a barbarian femme fatale. Verica's role was rather more central to the British expedition. Having her on board ensured the project was a success, as she provided tactical information and support on the ground.
paras.zh: “克劳迪斯之所以承诺某件事，只是因为一个女人告诉他，这符合这位皇帝顺从和怕老婆的比喻。实际上，迪奥是在说，这次行动只是因为一个野蛮蛇蝎美人的私语而进行。维丽卡的角色对英国远征来说更为核心。让她加入确保了该项目的成功，因为她提供了战术信息和实地支持。

paras.en: "The invasion was Claudius' great triumph -- it being the only chance he had to prove he was a successful military leader. Verica provided the excuse for regime change, and the emperor seized it."
paras.zh: “这次入侵是克劳狄斯的伟大胜利——这是他证明自己是一位成功的军事领袖的唯一机会。维里卡为政权更迭提供了借口，皇帝抓住了这个机会。”

paras.en: For Claudius, the conquest of Britain offered an opportunity to establish his reputation as a successful military commander. Verica's removal from power gave him a political justification for intervening, while the exiled ruler's knowledge of Britain may have helped the Roman forces achieve their objectives.
paras.zh: 对于克劳狄斯来说，征服不列颠提供了一个建立他作为成功军事指挥官的声誉的机会。维里卡的下台给了他干预的政治理由，而这位流亡统治者对英国的了解可能帮助罗马军队实现了他们的目标。

paras.en: Could Rome's Conquest of Britain Have Been Avoided?
paras.zh: 罗马对不列颠的征服可以避免吗？

paras.en: Although Verica was an important political figure in late Iron Age Britain, the ruler's influence has received relatively little attention compared with that of other prominent leaders.
paras.zh: 尽管维里卡是英国铁器时代晚期的重要政治人物，但与其他杰出领导人相比，这位统治者的影响力受到的关注相对较少。

paras.en: Russell believes the archaeological evidence supports recognizing Verica as one of Britain's earliest and most significant female rulers. He also raises the possibility that the Roman invasion might never have occurred without Verica's exile and subsequent appeal to Claudius.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔认为，考古证据支持维丽卡是英国最早、最重要的女性统治者之一。他还提出了一种可能性，如果没有维丽卡的流放以及随后向克劳迪斯的上诉，罗马入侵可能永远不会发生。

paras.en: "We should take the archaeological evidence at face value" says Russell "and remember Verica as a female-king and one of the earliest and most important of British female leaders. Had she not been deposed, fleeing to Claudius for military support, Rome may never have invaded Britain in the first place."
paras.zh: 罗素说：“我们应该从表​​面上看考古证据，并记住维丽卡是一位女国王，也是英国最早、最重要的女性领导人之一。如果她没有被废黜，逃到克劳狄斯那里寻求军事支持，罗马可能永远不会入侵英国。”

paras.en: New Insights Into Women in Iron Age Britain
paras.zh: 对英国铁器时代女性的新见解

paras.en: The findings build on earlier Bournemouth University research exploring the position of women in ancient British society.
paras.zh: 这些发现建立在伯恩茅斯大学早期研究的基础上，该研究探索了古代英国社会中女性的地位。

paras.en: Last year, a study involving Russell and other BU researchers uncovered evidence of a matriarchal society in Iron Age Britain. The research indicated that husbands moved into their wives' communities after marriage, suggesting that women occupied a central position in the social structure.
paras.zh: 去年，罗素和波士顿大学其他研究人员参与的一项研究发现了铁器时代英国母系社会的证据。研究表明，丈夫在婚后搬入妻子的社区，这表明妇女在社会结构中占据了中心地位。

paras.en: Together, these discoveries are prompting researchers to reconsider the influence women may have exercised in Iron Age Britain, both within their communities and in the political decisions that shaped the region's future.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现促使研究人员重新考虑女性在铁器时代的英国可能发挥的影响力，无论是在她们的社区内还是在塑造该地区未来的政治决策中。

paras.en: Russell's research on Verica is presented in the new book Caratacus: Great king of Britain, published by Bloomsbury in January (ISBN 9781350477902). The findings are also discussed in the latest edition of Current Archaeology.
paras.zh: 罗素对维莉卡的研究发表在 Bloomsbury 一月份出版的新书《卡拉塔库斯：伟大的不列颠国王》中（ISBN 9781350477902）。最新一期的《当代考古学》也讨论了这些发现。

paras.en: Materials provided by Bournemouth University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由伯恩茅斯大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Scientists discover that leukemia can begin developing 50 years before diagnosis

paras.en: Scientists discover that leukemia can begin developing 50 years before diagnosis
paras.zh: 科学家发现白血病可能在诊断前 50 年就开始发展

paras.en: A groundbreaking study reveals that acute myeloid leukemia (AML), an aggressive blood cancer, can begin developing more than 50 years before diagnosis, with the first cancer-driving mutation appearing before age 20 in two-thirds of cases. Scientists discovered that these mutated cells grow in surprisingly predictable patterns, accelerating dramatically as additional mutations accumulate.
paras.zh: 一项开创性的研究表明，急性髓系白血病 (AML) 是一种侵袭性血癌，可能在诊断前 50 多年就开始发展，其中三分之二的病例中，第一个癌症驱动突变出现在 20 岁之前。科学家发现，这些突变细胞以令人惊讶的可预测模式生长，并且随着额外突变的积累而急剧加速。

paras.en: A deadly form of blood cancer may begin taking shape more than 50 years before a person is diagnosed, according to new research revealing the surprisingly long and predictable path to leukemia.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，一种致命的血癌可能在一个人被诊断之前 50 多年就开始形成，该研究揭示了白血病的漫长且可预测的路径。

paras.en: Scientists have reconstructed how acute myeloid leukemia (AML) develops over a lifetime, discovering that in two-thirds of the cases studied, the first genetic mutation that helped drive the cancer appeared before age 20. These early changes could remain largely unnoticed for decades before eventually contributing to the disease.
paras.zh: 科学家们重建了急性髓系白血病 (AML) 在一生中的发展过程，发现在三分之二的研究病例中，导致癌症的第一个基因突变出现在 20 岁之前。这些早期变化在最终导致这种疾病之前可能几十年内基本上未被注意到。

paras.en: The findings suggest that doctors may one day be able to identify people at risk of developing leukemia years or even decades before symptoms appear. They also raise the possibility of preventing the cancer by slowing the growth of abnormal blood cells long before the disease takes hold.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，有一天，医生可能能够在症状出现前数年甚至数十年识别出有患白血病风险的人。他们还提高了通过在疾病发生之前减缓异常血细胞的生长来预防癌症的可能性。

paras.en: Blood Samples Reveal Leukemia's Hidden History
paras.zh: 血液样本揭示白血病的隐藏历史

paras.en: Published in Nature, the study was conducted by researchers at the University of Cambridge and University College London (UCL). By examining blood samples collected over many years, including some obtained as long as 15 years before diagnosis, the team pieced together a detailed history of how leukemia develops.
paras.zh: 该研究由剑桥大学和伦敦大学学院（UCL）的研究人员进行，发表在《自然》杂志上。通过检查多年来收集的血液样本（其中一些是在诊断前长达 15 年获得的），研究小组拼凑出了白血病发展过程的详细历史。

paras.en: The scientists treated these stored samples as a kind of genetic fossil record. Using highly sensitive DNA sequencing and mathematical models, they worked backward to estimate when cancer-related mutations first appeared, how quickly the affected cells multiplied, and how they competed with other blood cells as the disease approached.
paras.zh: 科学家们将这些储存的样本视为一种遗传化石记录。他们利用高度灵敏的 DNA 测序和数学模型，逆向估计癌症相关突变首次出现的时间、受影响细胞的繁殖速度，以及随着疾病的临近，它们如何与其他血细胞竞争。

paras.en: AML is an aggressive blood cancer that affects approximately 2,700 people in the UK annually. Its outlook is often poor, with only about one in six patients surviving at least five years after diagnosis.
paras.zh: AML 是一种侵袭性血癌，每年影响英国约 2,700 人。它的前景往往很差，只有大约六分之一的患者在诊断后至少存活五年。

paras.en: Scientists have long known that many otherwise healthy older adults carry blood cells with mutations associated with leukemia. This condition, called clonal hematopoiesis, does not necessarily lead to cancer. In fact, most people with these mutations never develop AML. Until now, researchers have struggled to understand why some individuals progress to leukemia while others do not, partly because they lacked a detailed record of the genetic changes occurring in the years before diagnosis.
paras.zh: 科学家们早就知道，许多其他方面健康的老年人携带带有与白血病相关的突变的血细胞。这种称为克隆造血的情况并不一定会导致癌症。事实上，大多数携带这些突变的人从未患上 AML。到目前为止，研究人员一直在努力理解为什么有些人会发展为白血病，而另一些人则不会，部分原因是他们缺乏诊断前几年发生的基因变化的详细记录。

paras.en: To investigate, the team turned to samples from the UK Collaborative Trial of Ovarian Cancer Screening (UKCTOCS). That project involved approximately 50,000 women who provided blood samples annually for as long as 11 years.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究小组转向了英国卵巢癌筛查合作试验（UKCTOCS）的样本。该项目涉及约 50,000 名女性，她们每​​年提供血液样本，持续长达 11 年。

paras.en: For the new analysis, researchers examined samples from 47 women who eventually developed AML, with an average age at diagnosis of 72. They compared these findings with samples from 46 similar women who remained free of blood cancer.
paras.zh: 在新的分析中，研究人员检查了 47 名最终患上 AML 的女性的样本，诊断时的平均年龄为 72 岁。他们将这些结果与 46 名未患血癌的类似女性的样本进行了比较。

paras.en: Cancer Mutations Can Remain Hidden for Decades
paras.zh: 癌症突变可能隐藏数十年

paras.en: The results revealed an extraordinary timeline. In two-thirds of the women who developed AML, the earliest mutation contributing to the disease was estimated to have occurred before their 20th birthday.
paras.zh: 结果揭示了一个非凡的时间表。在三分之二患有 AML 的女性中，导致该疾病的最早突变估计发生在她们 20 岁生日之前。

paras.en: At first, the altered blood cells multiplied extremely slowly, sometimes taking several years just to double in number. But as additional cancer-driving mutations accumulated, their growth accelerated dramatically.
paras.zh: 起初，改变后的血细胞增殖极其缓慢，有时需要几年时间才能数量增加一倍。但随着额外的癌症驱动突变的积累，它们的生长急剧加速。

paras.en: Each new mutation typically increased the rate of growth by roughly two to three times. By the time cells had acquired four mutations capable of driving cancer, their populations could double within weeks instead of years.
paras.zh: 每个新的突变通常都会使生长速度提高大约两到三倍。当细胞获得四种能够导致癌症的突变时，它们的数量可能会在几周内而不是几年内翻倍。

paras.en: Perhaps even more surprising was how consistently these populations behaved.
paras.zh: 也许更令人惊讶的是这些人群的行为如此一致。

paras.en: Researchers found that groups of genetically related blood cells, known as clones, generally expanded at predictable rates once they became established. Their growth tended to slow only when they faced limited space or competition from another clone that was multiplying more quickly.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，基因相关的血细胞群（称为克隆）一旦建立，通常会以可预测的速度扩张。只有当它们面临有限的空间或来自另一个繁殖速度更快的克隆的竞争时，它们的生长才会放缓。

paras.en: This consistency could have important medical implications. By measuring the growth of a particular clone using just a few blood samples, scientists may be able to estimate how large that population will become many years into the future, potentially even decades later.
paras.zh: 这种一致性可能具有重要的医学意义。通过仅使用少量血液样本来测量特定克隆的生长，科学家们也许能够估计出未来许多年，甚至可能几十年后该种群的规模。

paras.en: The researchers also identified a striking pattern that appeared in some patients well before leukemia was diagnosed.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现了一些在白血病确诊之前很久就出现在某些患者身上的惊人模式。

paras.en: In at least one-third of AML cases, a single population of mutated blood cells had grown so extensively that it dominated the blood years before diagnosis. Scientists call this process a "somatic sweep."
paras.zh: 在至少三分之一的 AML 病例中，单一突变血细胞群已经广泛生长，以至于在诊断前数年就在血液中占据主导地位。科学家将这个过程称为“体细胞扫描”。

paras.en: None of the women in the comparison group who remained free of blood cancer showed the same pattern.
paras.zh: 对照组中没有患血癌的女性没有表现出相同的模式。

paras.en: The researchers then examined data from the UK Biobank and confirmed that people showing evidence of these sweeps faced a substantially greater risk of developing AML.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后检查了英国生物银行的数据，并证实，出示这些扫描证据的人患 AML 的风险要大得多。

paras.en: This finding suggests that somatic sweeps could serve as an important early warning sign. However, conventional genetic testing can miss them because the mutations involved are sometimes incorrectly classified as inherited genetic variations.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明体细胞扫描可以作为重要的早期预警信号。然而，传统的基因测试可能会错过它们，因为所涉及的突变有时被错误地归类为遗传性基因变异。

paras.en: Professor Jamie Blundell, who led the research at the University of Cambridge's Early Cancer Institute, explained how the team reconstructed the disease's history.
paras.zh: 剑桥大学早期癌症研究所这项研究的领导者 Jamie Blundell 教授解释了该团队如何重建该疾病的历史。

paras.en: "Serial blood samples are a fossil record of the blood's evolution. They let us go back in time and reconstruct when each mutation arose and how fast it grew. What surprised us most is how predictable the growth of these clones is. Once a clone is established, its growth rate today tells you where it will be years, even decades, from now."
paras.zh: “连续血液样本是血液进化的化石记录。它们让我们回到过去并重建每个突变何时出现以及它的生长速度。最令我们惊讶的是这些克隆的生长是多么可预测。克隆一旦建立，它今天的生长速度就会告诉你几年后甚至几十年后的情况。”

paras.en: He added: "Because the growth is exponential, even modestly slowing a high-risk clone over the decade or more before diagnosis could substantially reduce the chance it becomes leukemia. This opens up strategies we can exploit to prevent these clones ever becoming leukemia."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“由于生长呈指数级增长，即使在诊断前十年或更长时间内适度放慢高风险克隆的速度，也可以大大降低其成为白血病的机会。这开辟了我们可以利用的策略来防止这些克隆成为白血病。”

paras.en: Could Leukemia Be Prevented Before It Develops?
paras.zh: 白血病可以在发病前预防吗？

paras.en: The discovery could change how doctors approach a disease that often appears to develop with little warning.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能会改变医生治疗这种疾病的方式，这种疾病通常在没有任何预警的情况下发生。

paras.en: Dr. Caroline Watson, the study's first author and a researcher at the Early Cancer Institute, emphasized the contrast between the sudden impact of a leukemia diagnosis and the decades of biological changes that may precede it.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、早期癌症研究所的研究员卡罗琳·沃森博士强调了白血病诊断的突然影响与在此之前可能发生的数十年的生物学变化之间的对比。

paras.en: "As a hematologist, I've seen how suddenly AML can change someone's life. This study shows that the changes leading to AML can build over decades, with the affected cells growing in surprisingly predictable ways."
paras.zh: “作为一名血液学家，我亲眼目睹了 AML 如何突然改变一个人的生活。这项研究表明，导致 AML 的变化可能会持续数十年，受影响的细胞以令人惊讶的可预测方式生长。”

paras.en: Watson is also an Honorary Consultant Haematologist who treats patients at the Cambridge Clonal Haematopoiesis Clinic at Addenbrooke's Hospital. The clinic is the first in Europe dedicated to leukemia prevention and already monitors people whose blood cell mutations place them at increased risk of developing the disease.
paras.zh: 沃森还是一名荣誉血液学家顾问，在阿登布鲁克医院的剑桥克隆造血诊所治疗患者。该诊所是欧洲第一家致力于白血病预防的诊所，并且已经对那些血细胞突变导致其患上这种疾病的风险增加的人进行了监测。

paras.en: She added: "At our clinic, we already assess and monitor people who carry blood-cell mutations that increase their risk of leukemia. Today's findings give us real hope of improving how we identify which of them are at greatest risk and point to a window in which prevention could one day be possible."
paras.zh: 她补充说：“在我们的诊所，我们已经评估和监测那些携带血细胞突变的人，这些突变会增加他们患白血病的风险。今天的研究结果给了我们真正的希望，可以改善我们识别哪些人面临最大风险的方式，并指出有一天可以进行预防的窗口。”

paras.en: Years of Blood Samples Unlock New Cancer Clues
paras.zh: 多年的血液样本揭示了新的癌症线索

paras.en: A major reason the researchers could reconstruct leukemia's development was the availability of blood samples collected repeatedly from the same individuals over many years.
paras.zh: 研究人员能够重建白血病发展的一个主要原因是多年来从同一个人重复采集的血液样本的可用性。

paras.en: Professor Usha Menon of the UCL Institute of Clinical Trials and Methodology, who led the original UKCTOCS project, highlighted the unexpected scientific value of those samples.
paras.zh: 伦敦大学学院临床试验和方法学研究所的 Usha Menon 教授领导了最初的 UKCTOCS 项目，他强调了这些样本意想不到的科学价值。

paras.en: "While UKCTOCS was designed to assess ovarian cancer screening, a key outcome was the establishment of a unique bioresource of serial serum samples. This resource has provided unprecedented opportunities to study how cancers develop over time and to discover and validate biomarkers for earlier detection. We owe an enormous debt of gratitude to the participants whose willingness to contribute their samples and data over many years made this possible. Their generosity is the foundation of this achievement."
paras.zh: “虽然 UKCTOCS 旨在评估卵巢癌筛查，但一个关键成果是建立了独特的连续血清样本生物资源。该资源为研究癌症如何随时间发展以及发现和验证早期检测的生物标志物提供了前所未有的机会。我们非常感谢参与者，他们多年来愿意贡献自己的样本和数据，使这一切成为可能。他们的慷慨是这一成就的基础。”

paras.en: The women who developed AML received their diagnoses between ages 53 and 83. Because the researchers did not have blood samples taken at the time of diagnosis, they could not directly examine the final stage of the disease's development in those patients.
paras.zh: 患有 AML 的女性在 53 岁至 83 岁之间被诊断出来。由于研究人员在诊断时没有采集血液样本，因此他们无法直接检查这些患者疾病发展的最后阶段。

paras.en: The findings also showed that not every case followed the same extended timeline of detectable changes. In approximately one in five cases, growing populations of mutated blood cells became detectable only one to two years before diagnosis. This suggests that some patients may have a much shorter opportunity for early intervention.
paras.zh: 研究结果还表明，并非每个病例都遵循相同的可检测变化的延长时间表。在大约五分之一的病例中，仅在诊断前一到两年就可以检测到不断增长的突变血细胞群。这表明一些患者接受早期干预的机会可能要短得多。

paras.en: Despite these limitations, the results offer an encouraging possibility: leukemia risk might be reduced by intervening long before the disease develops.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性，但结果提供了令人鼓舞的可能性：在疾病发生之前进行干预可能会降低白血病风险。

paras.en: According to the researchers' mathematical models, even a modest reduction in the growth of high-risk blood cell clones could have a substantial effect over time. Because these cells multiply exponentially, slowing their expansion across the ten or more years between a second cancer-driving mutation and diagnosis could significantly reduce the likelihood that they eventually progress to leukemia.
paras.zh: 根据研究人员的数学模型，即使高风险血细胞克隆的生长适度减少，随着时间的推移也可能产生重大影响。由于这些细胞呈指数倍数繁殖，因此在第二次癌症驱动突变和诊断之间的十年或更长时间内减缓它们的扩张可能会显着降低它们最终发展为白血病的可能性。

paras.en: This raises the prospect of preventive treatments designed to restrain dangerous cell populations rather than waiting until they have developed into cancer.
paras.zh: 这提出了旨在抑制危险细胞群而不是等到它们发展成癌症的预防性治疗的前景。

paras.en: The next challenge is determining whether such an approach can be used safely and effectively in people identified as having an elevated risk of AML. Although the research provides a promising framework for earlier detection and prevention, clinical studies will be needed to establish whether slowing these abnormal cells actually prevents leukemia in humans.
paras.zh: 下一个挑战是确定这种方法是否可以安全有效地用于被确定患有 AML 风险较高的人群。尽管这项研究为早期检测和预防提供了一个有希望的框架，但仍需要进行临床研究来确定减缓这些异常细胞的速度是否真的可以预防人类白血病。

paras.en: The research was primarily supported by UK Research & Innovation and Cancer Research UK.
paras.zh: 该研究主要得到英国研究与创新和英国癌症研究中心的支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Cambridge. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由剑桥大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

Fonseca, Sophia Apostolidou, Aristi Damaskou, Christopher Boniface, Samuel Hackett, Aleksandra Gentry-Maharaj, Usha Menon, Jamie R. Blundell. Evolutionary dynamics in the years preceding acute myeloid leukaemia. Nature, 2026; DOI: 10.1038/s41586-026-11269-x
