articles.title: NASA Seeks Partners to Design First Nuclear Reactor for the Moon
articles.author: David Lam

paras.en: NASA is seeking industry partners to develop and test the first nuclear reactor designed to provide electricity on the Moon, a major step toward establishing a sustained human presence on the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在寻找行业合作伙伴来开发和测试第一个旨在为月球提供电力的核反应堆，这是人类在月球表面建立持续存在的重要一步。

paras.en: Lunar Reactor-1 (LR-1) will be a small fission power system that will generate 20 kilowatts of electricity, enough to power approximately 16 average U.S. households annually on Earth. For NASA’s plans for a Moon Base, that energy could support future habitats, communications systems, rovers, scientific instruments, and other essential infrastructure.
paras.zh: 月球反应堆-1 (LR-1) 将是一个小型裂变发电系统，将产生 20 千瓦的电力，足以每年为地球上大约 16 个美国普通家庭供电。对于美国宇航局的月球基地计划来说，这些能源可以支持未来的栖息地、通信系统、漫游车、科学仪器和其他重要基础设施。

paras.en: NASA aims to have a launch-ready system by 2030 and operate it on the Moon for at least five years after deployment.
paras.zh: NASA 的目标是到 2030 年拥有一个可随时发射的系统，并在部署后在月球上运行至少五年。

paras.en: Unlike solar power, which depends on sunlight, a nuclear reactor can generate electricity continuously, including during the Moon’s approximately two-week-long nights. This capability will enable future lunar operations, particularly in locations where sunlight is limited or unavailable.
paras.zh: 与依赖阳光的太阳能不同，核反应堆可以持续发电，包括在月球大约两周的夜晚期间。这种能力将使未来的月球操作成为可能，特别是在阳光有限或不可用的地方。

paras.en: “This request for proposals represents an important step forward as NASA partners with industry to establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface,” said Brian Giblin, NASA’s Lunar Reactor-1 program manager. “A reliable source of safe and abundant energy will be vital to future exploration of the lunar and Martian surface. Space nuclear systems will provide continuous power to NASA assets in any environment without dependency on sunlight.”
paras.zh: NASA 的 Lunar Reactor-1 项目经理布莱恩·吉布林 (Brian Giblin) 表示：“这项征求建议书代表着 NASA 与工业界合作迈出了重要的一步，以在月球表面建立持久的人类存在。” “可靠、安全和丰富的能源来源对于未来月球和火星表面的探索至关重要。太空核系统将为任何环境下的 NASA 资产提供持续的电力，而无需依赖阳光。”

paras.en: NASA’s Space Power and Reactor Capabilities Request for Proposals incorporates feedback received after the agency released a draft proposal in August and hosted an industry day in September at the Ohio Aerospace Institute in Cleveland. The solicitation requires that the reactor must meet Department of Energy (DOE) safety standards for nuclear operations.
paras.zh: NASA 的太空动力和反应堆能力提案征集包含了该机构在 8 月发布提案草案并于 9 月在克利夫兰俄亥俄州航空航天研究所举办行业日后收到的反馈。招标要求反应堆必须符合能源部（DOE）的核运行安全标准。

paras.en: While the primary purpose of the Request for Proposals is to advance the technology, testing, and flight design of LR-1, NASA may issue additional task orders to support the development of other space nuclear power systems. Proposals are due by Dec. 21.
paras.zh: 虽然征求建议书的主要目的是推进 LR-1 的技术、测试和飞行设计，但 NASA 可能会发布额外的任务订单来支持其他空间核动力系统的开发。提案截止日期为 12 月 21 日。

paras.en: Nuclear power will be increasingly important to NASA’s space exploration ambitions. Lunar nights last about 14 Earth days, while dust storms on Mars can block sunlight for months. Farther from the Sun, solar power becomes progressively less effective. Nuclear systems offer a reliable source of electricity in these challenging environments.
paras.zh: 核电对于美国宇航局的太空探索雄心将变得越来越重要。月夜大约持续 14 个地球日，而火星上的沙尘暴可以阻挡阳光数月。距离太阳越远，太阳能的效率就会逐渐降低。核系统在这些充满挑战的环境中提供了可靠的电力来源。

paras.en: LR-1 is managed by the agency’s Space Reactors Division in partnership with the Department of Energy. The division is also responsible for the development of NASA’s Space Reactor‑1 (SR-1) Freedom. Scheduled to launch in 2028, SR-1 Freedom will deliver three SkyFall helicopters to Mars and demonstrate nuclear electric propulsion, which uses electricity generated by a nuclear reactor to power spacecraft propulsion systems. This technology could enable future spacecraft to travel farther and undertake deep space missions that aren’t possible using conventional propulsion.
paras.zh: LR-1 由该机构的空间反应堆部门与能源部合作管理。该部门还负责 NASA 的 Space Reactor-1 (SR-1) Freedom 的开发。 SR-1 Freedom 计划于 2028 年发射，将向火星运送三架 SkyFall 直升机并演示核电推进，即使用核反应堆产生的电力为航天器推进系统提供动力。这项技术可以使未来的航天器飞得更远，并执行使用传统推进力无法完成的深空任务。

paras.en: Together, LR-1 and SR-1 Freedom are advancing nuclear power and propulsion technologies to enable a new era of space exploration. By investing in these technologies, NASA and DOE are helping secure America’s leadership in space for decades to come.
paras.zh: LR-1 和 SR-1 Freedom 共同推进核能和推进技术的发展，以实现太空探索的新时代。通过投资这些技术，美国宇航局和能源部正在帮助确保美国在未来几十年在太空领域的领导地位。

articles.title: NASA Awards Contract for NOAA’s Near Earth Orbit Network Program
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: NASA, on behalf of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), has awarded a contract to Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation for the Sounder for Microwave-Based Applications (SMBA) instruments on NOAA’s Near Earth Orbit Network (NEON) satellites.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 代表国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 向诺斯罗普·格鲁曼系统公司授予了一份合同，为 NOAA 近地轨道网络 (NEON) 卫星上的微波应用探测仪 (SMBA) 仪器提供服务。

paras.en: The cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price, and time-and-materials hybrid contract has a value of $290.6 million. The period of performance runs from Nov. 23 through April 1, 2042. The work will take place at the awardee’s facility.
paras.zh: 成本加固定费用、固定价格以及时间和材料的混合合同价值 2.906 亿美元。表演时间为2042年11月23日至4月1日。作品将在获奖者的工厂进行。

paras.en: Under the contract, Northrop Grumman will provide the design, development, production, testing, and mission support for three SMBA instruments, the next generation of low Earth orbit microwave sounders. NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland, is managing the acquisition, and NOAA will own and operate the instruments and deliver the data to users worldwide. Microwave sounders provide critical measurements of temperature and moisture in the atmosphere, which significantly influence weather patterns. The SMBA instruments could improve the medium-range forecasts for NOAA’s National Weather Service.
paras.zh: 根据合同，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司将为三台 SMBA 仪器（下一代近地轨道微波探测仪）提供设计、开发、生产、测试​​和任务支持。美国宇航局位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的戈达德太空飞行中心正在管理此次收购，美国国家海洋和大气管理局将拥有和运营这些仪器，并将数据提供给世界各地的用户。微波探测器可对大气中的温度和湿度进行关键测量，这对天气模式有显着影响。 SMBA 仪器可以改善 NOAA 国家气象局的中期预报。

paras.en: The NEON mission is a collaboration between NASA and NOAA. The mission is led by NOAA, which provides funding, technical requirements, and postlaunch operations. NASA will manage the development of the NEON satellites and launch them for NOAA. NASA and NOAA will work with commercial partners to design and build the NEON spacecraft and instruments.
paras.zh: NEON 任务是 NASA 和 NOAA 之间的合作。该任务由 NOAA 领导，提供资金、技术要求和发射后运营。 NASA 将管理 NEON 卫星的开发并为 NOAA 发射它们。 NASA 和 NOAA 将与商业伙伴合作设计和建造 NEON 航天器和仪器。

paras.en: For information about NASA and agency programs, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 和机构项目的信息，请访问：

paras.en: Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt, Md.
paras.zh: 戈达德太空飞行中心，马里兰州格林贝尔特

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Winter attacks on Ukraine's power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies

paras.en: Security Council LIVE: Winter attacks on Ukraine's power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies
paras.zh: 安理会直播：乌克兰电网和黑海航运的冬季袭击威胁生命和全球粮食供应

paras.en: As winter sets in, the Security Council held a high stakes meeting Monday to discuss how Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy grid are leaving civilians without heat, power and water. It will also look at how strikes on Black Sea shipping threaten grain supplies to import-dependent countries far from the war’s frontline.
paras.zh: 随着冬季的到来，安理会周一召开了一次高风险会议，讨论俄罗斯对乌克兰能源网的袭击如何导致平民失去供暖、电力和水。它还将研究黑海航运的袭击如何威胁远离战争前线的依赖进口国家的粮食供应。

paras.en: - Russian strikes at the weekend killed at least 15 people in the Kyiv region, according to Ukrainian authorities, including in a residential building in Dymer
paras.zh: - 据乌克兰当局称，俄罗斯周末发动的袭击造成基辅地区至少 15 人死亡，其中包括戴默的一栋住宅楼

paras.en: - Ukraine says its naval drones sank a Russian corvette at Libya's Benghazi naval base on Sunday and hit a Russian cargo ship. The UN mission in Libya (UNSMIL) has called for an independent investigation
paras.zh: - 乌克兰表示，其海军无人机周日在利比亚班加西海军基地击沉了一艘俄罗斯护卫舰，并击中了一艘俄罗斯货船。联合国利比亚特派团（联利支助团）呼吁进行独立调查

paras.en: - On Saturday, a Russian cargo ship bound for Kaliningrad was hit by a drone in the Gulf of Finland. Finland's defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind it
paras.zh: - 周六，一艘开往加里宁格勒的俄罗斯货船在芬兰湾被一架无人机击中。芬兰国防部称乌克兰可能是幕后黑手

paras.en: - UN human rights monitors recorded 372 civilians killed in Ukraine in October, with civilian casualties up 95 per cent on a year earlier
paras.zh: - 联合国人权监测员记录10月份乌克兰有372名平民被杀，平民伤亡人数较上年同期增加95%

paras.en: - Ships flagged to Greece, Liberia and Somalia were hit in the Black Sea in mid-November. Two sank, one of them carrying wheat
paras.zh: - 11月中旬，悬挂希腊、利比里亚和索马里国旗的船只在黑海遭到袭击。两艘沉没，其中一艘载有小麦

articles.title: UN chief urges talks on global AI safety framework, warns of historic shift in power

paras.en: UN chief urges talks on global AI safety framework, warns of historic shift in power
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长敦促就全球人工智能安全框架进行谈判，警告权力的历史性转变

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres on Monday called on Member States to begin discussions on a multilateral framework for managing the risks of artificial intelligence (AI), warning that the technology is driving “the biggest transfer of power in the history of humankind”.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周一呼吁会员国开始讨论管理人工智能（AI）风险的多边框架，并警告说，该技术正在推动“人类历史上最大规模的权力转移”。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters at the close of the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety in Barbados, Mr. Guterres – who leaves office at the end of December – said protections against AI risks remain fragmented and too often, governments “are playing catch-up”.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯于 12 月底离任，在巴巴多斯举行的布里奇敦人工智能安全特别峰会结束时对记者表示，针对人工智能风险的保护措施仍然支离破碎，而且政府往往“在追赶”。

paras.en: “That is why today we are issuing a call from Bridgetown for Member States to begin discussions on a multilateral AI Risk Management Framework,” he said.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么今天我们从布里奇敦发出呼吁，呼吁成员国开始讨论多边人工智能风险管理框架，”他说。

paras.en: “Put simply, we need a common foundation for AI safety.”
paras.zh: “简单来说，我们需要一个人工智能安全的共同基础。”

paras.en: - independent evaluation and oversight of advanced AI models
paras.zh: - 先进人工智能模型的独立评估和监督

paras.en: - support so that every country can put them into practice
paras.zh: - 支持每个国家都能将其付诸实践

paras.en: The summit co-hosted by the UN and Barbados, comes as some of the leading AI developers are themselves sounding the alarm about increasingly powerful systems, Mr. Guterres said.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯表示，这次由联合国和巴巴多斯共同主办的峰会召开之际，一些领先的人工智能开发商本身也对日益强大的系统发出了警报。

paras.en: Recent technological outages and cyberattacks have exposed the vulnerabilities of the digital systems the world increasingly depends on, he warned, and AI is amplifying the threats, with systems behaving in ways “even their developers did not always anticipate”.
paras.zh: 他警告说，最近的技术中断和网络攻击暴露了世界日益依赖的数字系统的漏洞，而人工智能正在放大威胁，系统的行为方式“甚至连开发人员也没有总是预料到”。

paras.en: “We have a responsibility to take those warnings seriously. Not to stop innovation or spread fear. But to ensure that our capacity to manage this technology keeps pace with the technology itself,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们有责任认真对待这些警告。不是为了阻止创新或传播恐惧。而是为了确保我们管理这项技术的能力与技术本身保持同步，”他说。

paras.en: Opening the summit, he stated that the promise of AI is real, from strengthening health systems to accelerating scientific discovery, but the risks of unchecked digital technology “are growing just as fast”.
paras.zh: 他在峰会开幕式上表示，人工智能的前景是真实的，从加强卫生系统到加速科学发现，但不受控制的数字技术的风险“也在快速增长”。

paras.en: He described the dangers as: “Technology without accountability. Capability without safeguards. And power without responsibility.”
paras.zh: 他将危险描述为：“没有责任的技术。没有保障的能力。没有责任的权力。”

paras.en: During a fireside conversation with Barbadian Prime Minister Mia Mottley, Mr. Guterres said that while power once shifted among countries, it is now moving “from States, from governing institutions to a small number of companies and persons”; a shift for which institutions created after the Second World War, including the UN, are “today not adequately equipped”.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯在与巴巴多斯总理米娅·莫特利的炉边谈话中表示，虽然权力曾经在国家之间转移，但现在正在“从国家、从管理机构转移到少数公司和个人”；包括联合国在内的二战后创建的机构“如今还没有足够的能力”应对这种转变。

paras.en: He called for a deep reform of global governance, while insisting that the UN – the only body where the whole world is represented – has the legitimacy to lead.
paras.zh: 他呼吁对全球治理进行深入改革，同时坚称联合国——代表全世界的唯一机构——拥有领导的合法性。

paras.en: At the first Global Dialogue on AI Governance in July, 111 of the participating countries had never taken part in any discussion on AI, he noted.
paras.zh: 他指出，在 7 月份的首届人工智能治理全球对话中，111 个与会国家从未参加过任何有关人工智能的讨论。

paras.en: Autonomous weapons ‘absolutely unacceptable’
paras.zh: 自主武器“绝对不可接受”

paras.en: Mr. Guterres warned that the capacity to weaponise AI is concentrated in two countries and a limited number of companies. Calling it “an extremely dangerous development”, he reiterated his support for banning autonomous weapons.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯警告说，人工智能武器化的能力集中在两个国家和数量有限的公司。他称这是“极其危险的发展”，并重申了对禁止自主武器的支持。

paras.en: “The idea that a machine can kill people, choosing who to kill, where to kill, and the reasons to do so is absolutely unacceptable,” he said.
paras.zh: “机器可以杀人、选择杀谁、杀哪里以及这样做的理由的想法是绝对不可接受的，”他说。

paras.en: Prime Minister Mia Mottley said small States “often do not have the opportunity to share perspective in the rules that affect them”.
paras.zh: 总理米娅·莫特利表示，小国“通常没有机会就影响它们的规则分享观点”。

paras.en: Asked whether a frontier AI lab should have to pay if one of its AI agents hacked a bank in Barbados, and whether her Government should have a “kill switch” to cut off access to its models in an emergency, she replied in the affirmative.
paras.zh: 当被问及如果前沿人工智能实验室的一名人工智能特工入侵了巴巴多斯的一家银行，该实验室是否应该支付费用，以及巴巴多斯政府是否应该有一个“终止开关”来在紧急情况下切断对其模型的访问时，她给出了肯定的回答。

paras.en: “It has to be a condition of the sale that what I’m buying from you, I’m capable of saying, that’s it. No more,” she said.
paras.zh: “销售的一个条件是，我从你那里购买的东西，我能够说，就是这样。仅此而已，”她说。

paras.en: Ms. Mottley also warned that “the horse has already bolted from the stables”, and that only governments willing to regulate and legislate can rein in the concentration of power.
paras.zh: 莫特利还警告说，“马已经跑出了马厩”，只有愿意监管和立法的政府才能遏制权力集中。

paras.en: In a video message, French President Emmanuel Macron said the Paris Call for AI Security had been signed by 18 Heads of State and government and 11 AI leaders, and argued that agreeing to its principles should be a condition for access to markets.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 在视频致辞中表示，《巴黎人工智能安全呼吁》已由 18 位国家元首和政府首脑以及 11 位人工智能领导人签署，并认为同意其原则应成为进入市场的条件。

paras.en: Microsoft Vice Chair and President Brad Smith, also speaking by video, said that in some ways AI was “moving faster than the speed of safety”, but that AI diffusion, especially in the global South, needed to speed up.
paras.zh: 微软副主席兼总裁布拉德·史密斯（Brad Smith）也在视频中表示，在某些方面，人工智能“的发展速度快于安全的速度”，但人工智能的扩散，特别是在全球南方，需要加快。

paras.en: Asked what people should take away from the summit, Mr. Guterres said firstly that evolution of AI models “cannot go faster than the capacity to control their safety,” and AI must help reduce, not increase, the inequalities growing in today’s world.
paras.zh: 当被问及人们应该从这次峰会中得到什么时，古特雷斯先生首先表示，人工智能模型的发展“不能快于控制自身安全的能力”，人工智能必须帮助减少而不是加剧当今世界日益加剧的不平等现象。

paras.en: The ability of countries to manage AI risks “remains deeply unequal”, he said in his opening remarks. “We cannot allow AI to replicate and deepen global inequalities. Solutions must be as borderless as the risks we face.”
paras.zh: 他在开场白中表示，各国管理人工智能风险的能力“仍然严重不平等”。 “我们不能允许人工智能复制并加深全球不平等。解决方案必须像我们面临的风险一样无国界。”

paras.en: To narrow that gap, he has proposed a Global Fund for AI Capacity-Building, and said the summit could help strengthen every country’s capacity to test whether AI systems work safely in local contexts.
paras.zh: 为了缩小这一差距，他提议设立全球人工智能能力建设基金，并表示此次峰会可以帮助加强每个国家测试人工智能系统在当地环境下是否安全运行的能力。

paras.en: He pointed to a new thematic brief from the UN-backed Independent International Scientific Panel on AI, released on Sunday, which highlights the value of countries testing AI systems in their own languages to show where “they fall short or are unsafe”.
paras.zh: 他指出，联合国支持的人工智能国际独立科学小组周日发布了一份新的主题简报，该简报强调了各国用自己的语言测试人工智能系统的价值，以显示“它们的不足之处或不安全之处”。

paras.en: “AI models still perform far worse and can be less safe across a wide range of tongues, from African languages to Caribbean creoles. Yet over 1,000 of them already have the foundations needed to close that gap,” said panel member Vukosi Marivate, of the University of Pretoria.
paras.zh: “人工智能模型的表现仍然要差得多，而且在从非洲语言到加勒比克里奥尔语等多种语言中都不太安全。然而，其中 1000 多个模型已经具备了缩小这一差距所需的基础，”比勒陀利亚大学的小组成员 Vukosi Marivate 说。

paras.en: “Let’s ensure that artificial intelligence is shaped by humanity, with humanity, and for all humanity,” Mr. Guterres said.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯表示：“让我们确保人工智能是由人类、与人类共同塑造、并为全人类服务的。”

articles.title: Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development, UN warns

paras.en: Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development, UN warns
paras.zh: 联合国警告加沙战争毁掉了77年的人类发展

paras.en: The UN deputy chief urged renewed international support for a two-State solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict on Monday, warning that Palestinians continue to face violence, displacement and dire living conditions despite the October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza.
paras.zh: 联合国副秘书长周一敦促国际社会重新支持以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突的两国解决方案，并警告说，尽管加沙于 2025 年 10 月实现停火，巴勒斯坦人仍面临暴力、流离失所和恶劣的生活条件。

paras.en: Speaking ahead of the International Day of Solidarity with the Palestinian People next Sunday on behalf of the Secretary-General, Amina Mohammed stressed their “right to dignity, justice, and self-determination.”
paras.zh: 阿米娜·穆罕默德在下周日声援巴勒斯坦人民国际日之前代表秘书长发表讲话，强调他们“享有尊严、正义和自决的权利”。

paras.en: “We have clearly condemned the abhorrent terror attacks by Hamas on 7 October 2023. Nothing can justify those acts. And nothing can justify the collective punishment of the Palestinian people,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们明确谴责哈马斯于 2023 年 10 月 7 日发动的令人发指的恐怖袭击。没有任何理由可以证明这些行为是正当的。也没有任何理由可以证明对巴勒斯坦人民进行集体惩罚，”她说。

paras.en: Tens of thousands have been killed in Gaza, while settler violence in the West Bank is driving families from their homes at record rates, she warned.
paras.zh: 她警告说，加沙已有数万人被杀，而约旦河西岸的定居者暴力事件正以创纪录的速度迫使许多家庭逃离家园。

paras.en: Ms. Mohammed called for unhindered humanitarian access to Gaza and protection for aid workers.
paras.zh: 穆罕默德女士呼吁人道主义援助不受阻碍地进入加沙并保护援助人员。

paras.en: “Aid must never be obstructed, diverted, or used as a bargaining chip,” she stressed.
paras.zh: “援助绝不能被阻碍、转移或用作讨价还价的筹码，”她强调。

paras.en: She also urged political and financial support for UNRWA, the UN agency for Palestine refugees, which provides essential services, protection and emergency assistance.
paras.zh: 她还敦促向联合国巴勒斯坦难民机构近东救济工程处提供政治和财政支持，该机构提供基本服务、保护和紧急援助。

paras.en: Ms. Mohammed discussed Palestinian recovery and stressed that it must be led by the Palestinians themselves – which includes ensuring that women and youth play a “meaningful role” in the process.
paras.zh: 穆罕默德女士讨论了巴勒斯坦的复兴，并强调这必须由巴勒斯坦人自己领导——其中包括确保妇女和青年在这一进程中发挥“有意义的作用”。

paras.en: She also stressed that recovery must go beyond rebuilding homes, infrastructure and access to clean water, healthcare, education, and livelihoods.
paras.zh: 她还强调，复苏必须不仅仅是重建家园、基础设施以及获得清洁水、医疗保健、教育和生计。

paras.en: The war between Hamas and Israel in Gaza has undone 77 years of human development, according to a joint assessment by the UN and the World Bank, and recovery also requires repairing “the social fabric” alongside healing and communities, said the deputy UN chief.
paras.zh: 联合国副秘书长表示，根据联合国和世界银行的联合评估，哈马斯和以色列在加沙的战争毁掉了 77 年的人类发展，恢复还需要在治愈和社区的同时修复“社会结构”。

paras.en: Importantly, though, reconstruction cannot be a substitute for a political solution: “The Occupied Palestinian Territory must remain politically, economically, and territorially integrated – and united under a single, legitimate, sovereign, democratic Palestinian Government,” she stressed.
paras.zh: 但重要的是，重建不能取代政治解决方案：“巴勒斯坦被占领土必须保持政治、经济和领土一体化，并团结在一个合法、主权、民主的巴勒斯坦政府之下，”她强调。

paras.en: She reaffirmed the UN's support for two independent, sovereign states – Israel and Palestine – living side by side along pre-1967 lines, describing this as “the only vital path forward.”
paras.zh: 她重申联合国支持两个独立的主权国家——以色列和巴勒斯坦——沿着 1967 年之前的路线毗邻共存，并称这是“唯一重要的前进道路”。

paras.en: “There is no time to waste. No excuse for inaction. And no place for impunity,” she said.
paras.zh: “没有时间可以浪费。没有理由不采取行动。也没有可以逍遥法外的地方，”她说。

articles.title: Patten ends Grand Slam-winning doubles pairing to partner fellow Brit Skupski

paras.en: Henry Patten ends partnership with Harri Heliovaara to team up with fellow Briton Neal Skupski
paras.zh: 亨利·帕滕 (Henry Patten) 结束与哈里·赫利奥瓦拉 (Harri Heliovaara) 的合作关系，转而与英国同胞尼尔·斯库普斯基 (Neal Skupski) 合作

paras.en: Henry Patten and Harri Heliovaara were crowned the best men's doubles team of the year at last week's ATP Finals after winning Wimbledon for a second time in July; the pair have won three Grand Slam doubles titles together but will go their separate ways in 2027
paras.zh: 亨利·帕滕 (Henry Patten) 和哈里·赫利奥瓦拉 (Harri Heliovaara) 在 7 月第二次赢得温布尔登网球公开赛冠军后，在上周的 ATP 总决赛中荣获年度最佳男双组合；两人一起赢得了三个大满贯双打冠军，但将在 2027 年分道扬镳

paras.en: Henry Patten has ended his world No 1 doubles partnership with Harri Heliovaara in shock fashion in favour of teaming up with British compatriot Neal Skupski for 2027.
paras.zh: 亨利·帕滕以令人震惊的方式结束了他与哈里·赫利奥瓦拉的世界第一双打合作伙伴关系，转而与英国同胞尼尔·斯库普斯基在 2027 年合作。

paras.en: Patten and Heliovaara celebrated being crowned the best men's doubles team of the year at last week's ATP Finals after they claimed a second Wimbledon success together back in July.
paras.zh: 帕滕和赫利奥瓦拉在上周的 ATP 总决赛上庆祝荣获年度最佳男双组合，此前他们在 7 月份联手第二次夺得温布尔登网球公开赛冠军。

paras.en: However, in a post on Heliovaara's blog, the Finnish player revealed Patten phoned him on Friday to say their three-time Grand Slam-winning partnership was over - despite a previous agreement they would continue.
paras.zh: 然而，在赫利奥瓦拉博客上的一篇文章中，这位芬兰球员透露，彭定康周五打电话给他，表示他们三届大满贯冠军的合作关系已经结束——尽管之前达成协议，他们将继续合作。

paras.en: "After the trip to Turin, I didn't even have time to get into the holiday mood when the weekend took a rather unexpected turn," Heliovaara said on his own blog website. "Henry completely unexpectedly announced that he had changed his mind about next year.
paras.zh: “都灵之行结束后，我什至没有时间进入假期心情，周末就发生了意想不到的转变，”赫利奥瓦拉在自己的博客网站上说道。 “亨利完全出乎意料地宣布他对明年改变了主意。

paras.en: "I picked up the kids from daycare on Friday afternoon and we were just opening presents when I got a call from Henry. Without going into too much detail, the message was clear.
paras.zh: “周五下午，我从托儿所接孩子们，我们正要打开礼物，就接到了亨利的电话。无需透露太多细节，信息就很明确了。

paras.en: "He didn't want to play together again next year, even though we had agreed to do so during the fall. The announcement came as completely as it could come and I couldn't help but listen with my mouth open in horror and say that I don't agree at all.
paras.zh: “他不想明年再一起打球，尽管我们在秋天已经同意这样做了。这个消息已经尽其所能地宣布了，我忍不住惊恐地张着嘴听着，说我根本不同意。

paras.en: "I'm unlikely to ever fully understand what and why this ultimately happened.
paras.zh: “我不太可能完全理解这最终发生的事情和原因。

paras.en: "The emotional scale in my head was quite violent at first, a shocking situation in any case.
paras.zh: “一开始我脑子里的情绪非常剧烈，无论如何，这是一个令人震惊的情况。

paras.en: "The two-and-a-half years with Henry have been by far the best time of my career, for which I am eternally grateful to him, but now the main feeling was heavy disappointment and even anger."
paras.zh: “和亨利在一起的两年半是我职业生涯迄今为止最好的时光，对此我永远感激他，但现在主要的感受是深深的失望，甚至愤怒。”

paras.en: Heliovaara confirmed in his blog that he would team up with another British player Julian Cash, while Patten is set to partner Skupski in 2027.
paras.zh: Heliovaara 在他的博客中证实，他将与另一位英国选手 Julian Cash 搭档，而 Patten 则将于 2027 年与 Skupski 搭档。

paras.en: Megha Ganne won the 2026 LPGA Q-Series final qualifying stage as 27 tour cards were claimed for the 2027 season, with five-time USA Solheim Cup team member Megan Khang among those successful.
paras.zh: 梅加·甘尼 (Megha Ganne) 赢得了 2026 年 LPGA Q 系列资格赛最后阶段的冠军，并获得了 2027 年赛季的 27 张巡回赛卡，其中五届美国索尔海姆杯队成员梅根·康 (Megan Khang) 也获得了成功。

paras.en: Khang - part of Team USA for the past five Solheim Cups - is returning to the LPGA Tour, on which she's made 259 starts since 2016, winning the 2023 CPKC Women's Open.
paras.zh: 康是过去五届索尔海姆杯美国队的一员，她将重返 LPGA 巡回赛，自 2016 年以来她已参加 259 场比赛，并赢得了 2023 年 CPKC 女子公开赛。

paras.en: The top-25 finishers and ties at the conclusion of the 2026 LPGA Q-Series final qualifying were awarded LPGA Tour status for next year.
paras.zh: 2026 年 LPGA Q 系列决赛资格赛结束时排名前 25 名的选手和并列选手将被授予明年的 LPGA 巡回赛资格。

paras.en: American Ganne won the final stage outright on 23 under, one shot clear of Shannon Tan and Julia Gregg in a tie for second. Min Sun7 Kim was fourth on 21 under and Xiaowen Yin one further back in fifth.
paras.zh: 美国·甘尼 (American Ganne) 以低于标准杆 23 杆的成绩直接赢得了最后赛段，领先香农·谭 (Shannon Tan) 和朱莉娅·格雷格 (Julia Gregg) 并列第二。 Min Sun7 Kim 以低于标准杆 21 杆的成绩排名第四，尹晓文 (Xiaowen Yin) 落后一杆，排名第五。

paras.en: Ganne, the 2025 US Amateur champion, had actually already secured her 2027 LPGA Tour status by entering the week by finishing 11-15 on the Epson Tour.
paras.zh: 2025 年美国业余锦标赛冠军甘妮实际上已经获得了 2027 年 LPGA 巡回赛的参赛资格，她在爱普生巡回赛上以 11-15 的成绩进入本周。

paras.en: Gregg, who finished in a share of second, has never previously had a start on the LPGA Tour.
paras.zh: 格雷格获得并列第二名，此前他从未参加过 LPGA 巡回赛。

paras.en: "It feels unreal," the 25-year-old American said after clinching her place. "It's been my dream since I was four years old to play on the LPGA and now that I finally did it."
paras.zh: “这感觉很不真实，”这位 25 岁的美国人在获得席位后说道。 “从我四岁起，参加 LPGA 比赛就是我的梦想，现在我终于实现了。”

articles.title: Crowd evacuated from American rapper Don Toliver’s concert after ‘unknown substance’ released
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: MANCHESTER, England — Thousands of people attending a concert of American rapper Don Toliver were evacuated from a major British arena Sunday evening, police said, after an “unknown substance” was released into the crowd.
paras.zh: 英国曼彻斯特——周日晚上，警方表示，在一种“不明物质”被释放到人群中后，数千名观看美国说唱歌手唐·托利弗 (Don Toliver) 演唱会的人从英国一个主要舞台撤离。

paras.en: About 12,000 concertgoers were evacuated by emergency workers just after 10 p.m. local time (5 p.m. ET) from Toliver’s show at the Co-op Live venue in the northern English city of Manchester.
paras.zh: 晚上 10 点刚过，大约 12,000 名音乐会观众被紧急救援人员疏散。当地时间（美国东部时间下午 5 点），托利弗 (Toliver) 在英国北部城市曼彻斯特的 Co-op Live 场地演出。

paras.en: The North West Ambulance Service declared a major incident and said the substance was “believed to be tear gas” and was understood to have been released toward the end of the show.
paras.zh: 西北救护车服务中心宣布发生重大事件，并表示该物质“据信是催泪瓦斯”，据了解是在节目结束时释放的。

paras.en: “We deployed several emergency crews, including our Hazardous Area Response Team, to support the safe assessment and treatment of people at the scene,” it said in a statement, adding that one person had been hospitalized.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份声明中表示：“我们部署了几名应急人员，包括我们的危险区域响应小组，以支持现场人员的安全评估和治疗。”并补充说，其中一人已住院。

paras.en: “More than 80 people were assessed by our clinicians, with some reporting eye and respiratory symptoms. Decontamination was carried out as a precaution,” the ambulance service said Monday.
paras.zh: “我们的临床医生对 80 多人进行了评估，其中一些人报告了眼睛和呼吸道症状。作为预防措施，进行了净化处理，”救护车服务部门周一表示。

paras.en: People in the crowd were suffering effects “from an unknown substance,” Greater Manchester police said in its latest statement Monday. “Enquiries are underway into what the substance is and what caused the incident,” police added.
paras.zh: 大曼彻斯特警方在周一的最新声明中表示，人群中的人们受到“一种未知物质”的影响。警方补充说：“正在调查该物质是什么以及导致事件发生的原因。”

paras.en: The venue, in the center of the busy city, was hosting Grammy Award-nominated R&B rapper-singer Toliver, whose real name is Caleb Zackery Toliver, as part of his Nitrous tour.
paras.zh: 该场地位于繁忙城市的中心，作为他的 Nitrous 巡演的一部分，格莱美奖提名的 R&B 说唱歌手托利弗 (Toliver，他的真名是 Caleb Zackery Toliver) 正在这里举办。

paras.en: The Houston-based rapper is best known for hits “No idea” and “After Party,” and features on the soundtrack to the new “Grand Theft Auto VI” blockbuster game.
paras.zh: 这位来自休斯顿的说唱歌手以歌曲《No idea》和《After Party》而闻名，并为新的大片游戏《侠盗猎车手 VI》配乐。

paras.en: In a statement posted to Instagram, Toliver said he was “very sad” to announce that he would have to cancel his London show on Monday “due to the incident in Manchester” and would instead perform on Dec. 15.
paras.zh: 托利弗在 Instagram 上发布的一份声明中表示，他“非常悲伤”地宣布，“由于曼彻斯特发生的事件”，他将不得不取消周一的伦敦演出，并将于 12 月 15 日演出。

paras.en: “I Just Wanna Make Sure Everyone is Safe and the next Show goes on properly. My Heart and prayers are with with everyone that was injured last night,” he added.
paras.zh: “我只是想确保每个人都安全，并且下一场演出正常进行。我的心和祈祷与昨晚受伤的每个人同在，”他补充道。

paras.en: Manchester was left shaken in 2017 after a bombing at a nearby venue during an Ariana Grande concert left 22 people dead and made global headlines.
paras.zh: 2017 年，阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 演唱会期间，附近一个场地发生爆炸事件，导致 22 人死亡，并成为全球头条新闻，曼彻斯特震动不已。

paras.en: “We understand the concern that this incident will have raised,” Assistant Chief Constable Steph Parker said Monday. “We will now begin to fully understand what this substance was and how this incident came about.”
paras.zh: “我们理解这起事件会引起的担忧，”助理警长斯蒂芬·帕克周一表示。 “我们现在将开始充分了解这种物质是什么以及这起事件是如何发生的。”

paras.en: “Several people were treated on site, and one has been taken to hospital at this time. Anyone who has left the event and since become unwell is advised to attend their local hospital,” Parker added.
paras.zh: 帕克补充说：“有几人在现场接受治疗，其中一人已被送往医院。任何离开活动并出现不适的人都应前往当地医院。”

paras.en: Concertgoer Joey Howe, 22, told BBC Radio Manchester the lights came on and Toliver appeared to have been “rushed off stage.”
paras.zh: 22 岁的音乐会常客乔伊·豪 (Joey Howe) 告诉 BBC 曼彻斯特广播电台，灯光亮了，托利弗似乎“被赶下了舞台”。

paras.en: “I saw a lot of people streaming out and you go into this panic mode and you see a lot of people running out of the venue,” Howe said. He said people were “choking” and there was a “horrible smell” in the arena.
paras.zh: 豪说：“我看到很多人涌出，你进入这种恐慌模式，你会看到很多人跑出会场。”他说人们“窒息”，竞技场里有“可怕的气味”。

paras.en: “It was just really distressing scenes and not something you want to see,” he added.
paras.zh: “这真是令人痛苦的场景，不是你想看到的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Another fan, Ben Stevenson, told the Manchester Evening News that he was in the standing section of the arena when he “started coughing and (my) eyes were kind of itchy.”
paras.zh: 另一位球迷本·史蒂文森告诉《曼彻斯特晚报》，他当时正在球场的站立区，“开始咳嗽，（我的）眼睛有点痒”。

paras.en: A spokesman for Prime Minister Andy Burnham, a former mayor of Manchester, called the incident “deeply worrying” and said the police would conduct a full investigation.
paras.zh: 曼彻斯特前市长、首相安迪·伯纳姆的发言人称这一事件“令人深感担忧”，并表示警方将进行全面调查。

paras.en: The venue, which opened in 2024, is due to host American singer Phoebe Bridgers on Thursday.
paras.zh: 该场馆于 2024 年开业，将于周四接待美国歌手菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers)。

paras.en: It said in a statement on X that it was “working closely with Greater Manchester Police to identify the cause and action appropriately. Our priority remains the safety and security of all visitors to Co-op Live, and we will provide more information once we have an update.”
paras.zh: 该公司在 X 的一份声明中表示，“正在与大曼彻斯特警方密切合作，以查明原因并采取适当行动。我们的首要任务仍然是 Co-op Live 所有访客的安全，一旦有最新消息，我们将提供更多信息。”

articles.title: Ukraine sinks Russian warship off Libya in latest expansion of the war
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Ukraine has taken its fight against Russia to the shores of North Africa, claiming to have sunk a warship off the coast of Libya in its latest expansion of the war.
paras.zh: 乌克兰已将与俄罗斯的战斗转移到北非海岸，声称在其最新的战争扩张中击沉了利比亚海岸附近的一艘军舰。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday that Ukrainian naval drones had been used in the attack in the Mediterranean a day earlier, which came after Moscow said another of its ships was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea.
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基周一表示，乌克兰海军无人机在一天前的地中海袭击中被使用，此前莫斯科称其另一艘船只在波罗的海被无人机击中。

paras.en: Zelenskyy shared footage of the attacks in a post on X, showing drones approaching several vessels followed by massive fireballs.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在 X 上的一篇帖子中分享了袭击的镜头，显示无人机接近几艘船只，随后出现了巨大的火球。

paras.en: He said his forces deployed seven Ukrainian-made naval drones to sink the Russian corvette, Merkury, and hit a transport ship, the Angara, in an “exemplary Ukrainian operation.”
paras.zh: 他说，他的部队部署了七架乌克兰制造的海军无人机击沉了俄罗斯护卫舰“水星号”，并击中了一艘运输船“安加拉号”，这是“乌克兰行动的典范”。

paras.en: Later, in a separate post on the social media site, he said Ukraine responded “to Russia’s strikes the way it should be done, the way that is effective,” adding: “It is also important that without these ships in those waters, it will be harder for Russia to fuel conflicts and instability in that region as well.”
paras.zh: 后来，他在社交媒体网站上的另一篇帖子中表示，乌克兰“以应该、有效的方式回应俄罗斯的袭击”，并补充道：“同样重要的是，如果这些船只没有进入这些水域，俄罗斯将更难助长该地区的冲突和不稳定。”

paras.en: Ukraine’s Security Service, SBU, said the attacks took place near the Libyan port of Benghazi, some 1,500 miles from the established front lines of the conflict.
paras.zh: 乌克兰安全局 (SBU) 表示，袭击发生在利比亚班加西港附近，距离冲突既定前线约 1,500 英里。

paras.en: It said the corvette “regularly escorted enemy naval convoys” and in particular guarded the Angara cargo ship that was used to move weapons. “Both vessels were legitimate military targets for Ukraine, as they worked directly for Russia’s military capabilities,” the SBU said in a statement on Telegram.
paras.zh: 声明称，这艘护卫舰“定期护送敌方海军船队”，特别是守卫用于运输武器的安加拉货船。 SBU 在 Telegram 上的一份声明中表示：“这两艘船都是乌克兰的合法军事目标，因为它们直接为俄罗斯的军事能力服务。”

paras.en: Ukrainian uncrewed boats were delivered to a designated location and launched into the water from a so-called “mother ship,” the SBU said, reaching their targets despite “enemy’s attempts to destroy the Ukrainian drones from the air.” It said the Ka-27 multi-purpose helicopter was on board the corvette and was also sunk.
paras.zh: SBU表示，乌克兰无人船被运送到指定地点，并从一艘所谓的“母船”下水，尽管“敌人试图从空中摧毁乌克兰无人机”，但仍到达了目标。据称，护卫舰上有一架Ka-27多用途直升机，也被击沉。

paras.en: “The Defence Forces of Ukraine have once again shown that the Russian navy and its logistics have no safe routes, even far beyond the Black Sea,” the SBU added.
paras.zh: SBU补充说：“乌克兰国防军再次表明，俄罗斯海军及其后勤保障没有安全路线，甚至远离黑海。”

paras.en: Ukraine noted that the ship was one of Russia’s newest, commissioned only in 2023.
paras.zh: 乌克兰指出，这艘船是俄罗斯最新的一艘，于 2023 年才投入使用。

paras.en: Moscow has noted Zelenskyy’s “statement on this matter,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters Monday when asked about the attacks. He deferred to the Russian Defense Ministry, which was yet to comment.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周一在被问及袭击事件时告诉记者，莫斯科已经注意到泽连斯基“关于此事的声明”。他听取了俄罗斯国防部的意见，但俄罗斯国防部尚未发表评论。

paras.en: It’s the latest example of Kyiv launching surprise attacks to hit back against the Kremlin.
paras.zh: 这是基辅发动突然袭击反击克里姆林宫的最新例证。

paras.en: But the weekend attack caused fallout in Libya, where local authorities expressed outrage and the United Nations called for an independent probe.
paras.zh: 但周末的袭击事件在利比亚引起了轩然大波，当地政府表达了愤怒，联合国呼吁进行独立调查。

paras.en: The eastern Libya-based government said Sunday that an explosion took place aboard a Russian vessel docked at the Benghazi naval base. It said the vessel was en route back to Russia and had stopped at the port to refuel and take on supplies.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部政府周日表示，停靠在班加西海军基地的一艘俄罗斯船只发生爆炸。据称，该船正在返回俄罗斯的途中，已在港口停下来加油和接收补给。

paras.en: A comprehensive investigation into the attack will be launched, it said, in coordination with Russian authorities.
paras.zh: 声明称，将与俄罗斯当局协调，对此次袭击事件展开全面调查。

paras.en: “The Government views the targeting of a vessel within a Libyan port as a serious assault on national sovereignty and a blatant violation of port security and the safety of maritime navigation,” the statement added, without calling out Kyiv directly but adding that Libya was not a party to the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“政府认为针对利比亚港口内的一艘船只的袭击是对国家主权的严重侵犯，是对港口安全和海上航行安全的公然侵犯。”声明没有直接点名基辅，但补充说利比亚不是乌克兰战争的一方。

paras.en: Libya has been divided since an uprising toppled longtime dictator Moammar Gadhafi in 2011. A U.N.-supported government is based in Tripoli and a rival administration with ties to Russia is located in the east of the oil-rich nation.
paras.zh: 自2011年起义推翻长期独裁者卡扎菲以来，利比亚一直处于分裂状态。联合国支持的政府设在的黎波里，而与俄罗斯有联系的敌对政府则位于这个石油资源丰富的国家的东部。

paras.en: The eastern Libya-based government has cooperation agreements and maritime facility arrangements with Russia, but Ukrainian forces also operate in the country’s west under a deal believed to be endorsed by Kyiv’s global allies.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部政府与俄罗斯签订了合作协议和海上设施安排，但乌克兰军队也在该国西部根据一项据信得到基辅全球盟友认可的协议开展行动。

paras.en: The U.N. Support Mission in Libya called for “an immediate, independent and transparent investigation” into the ship attack.
paras.zh: 联合国利比亚支持团呼吁对船只袭击事件进行“立即、独立和透明的调查”。

paras.en: The western Libya government expressed concerns about “dragging Libyan ports and civilian facilities into external conflicts,” in an apparent reference to Russia’s war in Ukraine. “The government reaffirms its categorical rejection of turning Libya into an arena for international conflicts or a theater for external powers to settle scores,” it said in a statement.
paras.zh: 利比亚西部政府对“将利比亚港口和民用设施拖入外部冲突”表示担忧，这显然是指俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。 “政府重申坚决反对将利比亚变成国际冲突的竞技场或外部势力算账的舞台，”声明中表示。

paras.en: It’s not the first attack linked to the Ukraine war in the Mediterranean this year.
paras.zh: 这并不是今年第一次与乌克兰地中海战争有关的袭击。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces operating in western Libya struck a Russian tanker in a suspected sea drone attack near Maltese waters, Libyan officials said in March.
paras.zh: 利比亚官员三月份表示，在利比亚西部活动的乌克兰军队在马耳他水域附近疑似海上无人机袭击中击中了一艘俄罗斯油轮。

paras.en: The latest attack off the coast of North Africa come just a day after a Russian-owned cargo ship was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea.
paras.zh: 就在北非海岸发生的最新袭击事件发生前一天，一艘俄罗斯货船在波罗的海被无人机袭击。

paras.en: The Finnish military said the strike on the Sparta II on Saturday was likely carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters, raising fears that the conflict is increasingly spilling over.
paras.zh: 芬兰军方表示，周六对斯巴达二号的袭击很可能是乌克兰所为，该船后来漂入芬兰水域，引发了人们对冲突日益蔓延的担忧。

paras.en: Kyiv has not claimed responsibility, and the Ukrainian Defense Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: 基辅尚未声称对此事负责，乌克兰国防部也没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: Peskov called the attack on Sparta II “a very dangerous trend of expanding terrorist activity in the Baltic region” Monday.
paras.zh: 佩斯科夫周一称对斯巴达二号的袭击是“波罗的海地区恐怖活动扩大的非常危险的趋势”。

paras.en: The escalation in international waters comes just days after the three-way summit between the leaders of Russia, China and the U.S., during which President Donald Trump called Russian President Vladimir Putin his “friend” and said Putin wanted to end his war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 就在国际水域局势升级的几天前，俄罗斯、中国和美国领导人举行了三方峰会，峰会期间，唐纳德·特朗普总统称俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京为他的“朋友”，并表示普京希望结束乌克兰战争。

paras.en: Zelenskyy told NBC News ahead of the Shenzhen summit that he saw no signs Putin was ready for peace.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在深圳峰会前告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他没有看到普京准备好和平的迹象。

articles.title: Israel's bombardment has turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland'
articles.author: Caitlin Kelly

paras.en: A new report by NGO Oxfam says more than 99 per cent of the Gaza Strip shows signs of contamination from Israeli attacks.
paras.zh: 非政府组织乐施会的一份新报告称，加沙地带 99% 以上的地区都显示出受到以色列袭击污染的迹象。

paras.en: The report details that Israel's destruction of buildings and the environment has led to widespread contamination from chemicals, heavy metals and explosive residues.
paras.zh: 报告详细说明，以色列对建筑物和环境的破坏导致化学品、重金属和爆炸物残留物造成广泛污染。

paras.en: The Israeli military has said the Oxfam report "presents a biased and misleading picture of the situation in Gaza".
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，乐施会的报告“对加沙局势提出了有偏见和误导性的描述”。

paras.en: New research suggests more than 99 per cent of the Gaza Strip shows signs of contamination from Israeli attacks.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，加沙地带 99% 以上的地区都显示出受到以色列袭击污染的迹象。

paras.en: According to a report published by the NGO Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory, chemicals entering the air, soil, foo, and water supply pose a huge public health risk for "generations to come".
paras.zh: 根据非政府组织乐施会和冲突与环境观察站发布的一份报告，进入空气、土壤、食物和供水系统的化学物质对“子孙后代”构成巨大的公共卫生风险。

paras.en: The report details how Israel's destruction of buildings and the environment in Gaza has led to widespread contamination.
paras.zh: 该报告详细介绍了以色列对加沙建筑物和环境的破坏如何导致大范围污染。

paras.en: Heavy metals, explosive residues and asbestos from destroyed buildings are among the hazardous materials now threatening Palestinians, potentially for decades to come.
paras.zh: 被毁建筑物中的重金属、爆炸物残留物和石棉是目前威胁巴勒斯坦人的危险材料，而且可能在未来几十年内威胁到这些危险材料。

paras.en: Chemicals from fires, heavy bombardment, rubble, destroyed household items and untreated sewage are a risk to Palestinians through air, water and food.
paras.zh: 火灾、猛烈轰炸、瓦砾、被毁的家居用品和未经处理的污水产生的化学物质通过空气、水和食物对巴勒斯坦人构成威胁。

paras.en: The report uses satellite imagery, remote sensing, scientific analysis and open-source data to conclude what it describes as "environmental war crimes".
paras.zh: 该报告利用卫星图像、遥感、科学分析和开源数据来得出所谓的“环境战争罪”的结论。

paras.en: International humanitarian law prohibits methods of warfare that cause widespread, long-term and severe damage to the natural environment.
paras.zh: 国际人道法禁止对自然环境造成广泛、长期和严重损害的战争方法。

paras.en: The research found the scale and intensity of the Israeli military's campaign has affected approximately 78 per cent of Gaza's land area.
paras.zh: 研究发现，以色列军事行动的规模和强度影响了加沙约 78% 的土地面积。

paras.en: The highest levels of potential overall contamination are concentrated in Gaza City, Khan Younis, Rafah, Jabalia and the main Salah al-Din Road.
paras.zh: 潜在总体污染水平最高的地区集中在加沙城、汗尤尼斯、拉法、贾巴利亚和主要的萨拉丁路。

paras.en: According to the UN, of the 61 million tonnes of debris generated by Israel's military operations in the enclave, about 15 per cent potentially carries a high risk of hazardous materials.
paras.zh: 据联合国称，以色列在该飞地的军事行动产生了 6100 万吨碎片，其中约 15% 可能含有高风险的危险物质。

paras.en: The report suggests 85 per cent of Gaza's water infrastructure has been damaged or destroyed.
paras.zh: 报告显示，加沙 85% 的供水基础设施已遭到破坏或摧毁。

paras.en: Desalination plants, water wells and pipelines used to supply water to the people of Gaza have been destroyed or damaged by Israeli strikes, according to Oxfam.
paras.zh: 据乐施会称，用于向加沙人民供水的海水淡化厂、水井和管道已被以色列的袭击摧毁或损坏。

paras.en: The sanitation system has mostly collapsed in the enclave, with major wastewater treatment plants and desalination out of action.
paras.zh: 该飞地的卫生系统大部分崩溃，主要废水处理厂和海水淡化厂停止运转。

paras.en: In recent days, Gaza's health authority warned that the rapid resurgence of meningitis threatened to trigger an epidemic, particularly among children.
paras.zh: 最近几天，加沙卫生当局警告说，脑膜炎的迅速复发有可能引发流行病，特别是在儿童中。

paras.en: Officials blamed the worsening health on the environmental crisis.
paras.zh: 官员们将健康状况恶化归咎于环境危机。

paras.en: The ABC has previously reported that the destruction of Gaza's water and sanitation facilities had led to a surge in infectious diseases, with polio re-emerging and skin infections spreading rapidly.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司此前报道称，加沙供水和卫生设施遭到破坏，导致传染病激增，脊髓灰质炎重新出现，皮肤感染迅速蔓延。

paras.en: Oxfam called for a full assessment of the contaminants present and the risks they posed.
paras.zh: 乐施会呼吁对存在的污染物及其构成的风险进行全面评估。

paras.en: The organisation's executive director, Amitabh Behar, has accused Israel of environmental war crimes.
paras.zh: 该组织的执行主任阿米塔布·贝哈尔指责以色列犯有环境战争罪。

paras.en: "Israel's ongoing genocide in Gaza includes military assaults on its environment, which are environmental war crimes threatening life now and for generations to come," he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“以色列在加沙正在进行的种族灭绝包括对其环境的军事攻击，这是威胁现在和子孙后代生命的环境战争罪行。”

paras.en: "The destruction and contamination of Gaza will have fundamentally degraded the environmental conditions necessary for human safety and survival.
paras.zh: “加沙的破坏和污染将从根本上降低人类安全和生存所必需的环境条件。

paras.en: "This would breach Israel's legal obligations under international humanitarian and human rights law."
paras.zh: “这将违反以色列根据国际人道主义法和人权法承担的法律义务。”

paras.en: In a statement to the ABC, the Israeli military said the Oxfam report "presents a biased and misleading picture of the situation in Gaza, ignoring the operational complexity and Israel's ongoing efforts to mitigate harm to the civilian population and civilian infrastructure during hostilities".
paras.zh: 以色列军方在给美国广播公司的一份声明中表示，乐施会的报告“对加沙局势进行了有偏见和误导性的描述，忽视了行动的复杂性以及以色列为减轻敌对行动期间对平民和民用基础设施造成的伤害所做的持续努力”。

paras.en: The IDF maintained it was "mitigating harm to the civilian population and its surroundings to the greatest extent possible" and said it "works to maintain the water supply and the upkeep of infrastructure in Gaza".
paras.zh: 以色列国防军坚称，它正在“最大程度地减轻对平民及其周围环境的伤害”，并表示它“致力于维持加沙的供水和基础设施的维护”。

paras.en: Since October 7, 2023, more than 74,000 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip.
paras.zh: 自2023年10月7日以来，已有超过74,000名巴勒斯坦人在以色列对加沙地带的袭击中丧生。

paras.en: The war began in response to Hamas-led terror attacks that killed 1,200 in southern Israel, by Israeli tallies, and took 251 hostages.
paras.zh: 这场战争是为了回应哈马斯领导的恐怖袭击，据以色列统计，这次袭击在以色列南部造成 1,200 人死亡，并劫持了 251 名人质。

articles.title: Live: One Nation has 'no desire' for coalition with Liberals, Nationals in Vic

paras.en: Victorian election live: One Nation has 'no desire' for coalition with Liberals and Nationals
paras.zh: 维多利亚州选举直播：一国党“无意”与自由党和国民党结盟

paras.en: There are just four days until polling day in Victoria, with political parties ramping up their campaigns around the state in a last-minute bid to sway undecided voters.
paras.zh: 距离维多利亚州投票日只剩下四天了，各政党在该州各地加大了竞选力度，以期影响尚未做出决定的选民。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: When asked about polling that shows Labor trailing badly, Carbines says most voters will pay little attention.
paras.zh: 当被问及工党严重落后的民意调查时，卡宾斯表示，大多数选民不会关注。

paras.en: "I really don't think that people get as hung up on polls as much as those who are more engaged," he says.
paras.zh: “我真的不认为人们像那些更积极参与的人那样对民意调查那么着迷，”他说。

paras.en: "I think all that really matters is that people are expecting us to put our best foot forward."
paras.zh: “我认为真正重要的是人们期待我们尽最大努力。”

paras.en: Carbines addresses election race in Ivanhoe
paras.zh: 卡宾斯在艾芬豪的竞选中发表讲话

paras.en: Ivanhoe MP Anthony Carbines is up to talk his local election race, and says Labor has made a significant investment in schools in the electorate.
paras.zh: 艾芬豪议员安东尼·卡宾斯即将谈论他的地方选举竞选，并表示工党已对选民的学校进行了大量投资。

paras.en: He also takes the Coalition to task for a lack of promises for his local electorate.
paras.zh: 他还指责联盟党缺乏对当地选民的承诺。

paras.en: "Families in my electorate are concerned how the opposition, when they're cutting $40 billion, are going to invest in the Ivanhoe electorate when they've given us donuts," he says.
paras.zh: 他说：“我选区的家庭担心反对派在削减 400 亿美元的同时，还给我们甜甜圈，他们将如何投资艾芬豪选区。”

paras.en: "They don't live here, they don't about our community, they're not committed to the specific issues."
paras.zh: “他们不住在这里，他们不关心我们的社区，他们不致力于解决具体问题。”

paras.en: Carroll accuses Jess Wilson of 'misleading Victorians'
paras.zh: 卡罗尔指责杰西·威尔逊“误导维多利亚人”

paras.en: Premier Ben Carroll says Liberal leader Jess Wilson is "misleading Victorians" with her promise to institute a hiring freeze across the state's public service.
paras.zh: 州长本·卡罗尔表示，自由党领袖杰西·威尔逊承诺冻结全州公共服务部门的招聘，这是“误导维州人”。

paras.en: The Coalition says it will save taxpayers $22 billion across the next decade by implementing the hiring freeze for back-office public sector roles.
paras.zh: 该联盟表示，通过冻结公共部门后台职位的招聘，未来十年将为纳税人节省 220 亿美元。

paras.en: The premier refers to costings done by the Department of Treasury and Finance released yesterday, which show there were no savings to be made from instituting a public service hiring cap.
paras.zh: 总理提到了财政部昨天公布的成本核算结果，该成本核算显示，实行公共服务招聘上限并不能节省成本。

paras.en: "Jess Wilson's costings are completely dodgy," Carroll says.
paras.zh: “杰西·威尔逊的成本计算完全不可靠，”卡罗尔说。

paras.en: "Public service numbers are declining and her costings don't stack up, they never have."
paras.zh: “公共服务人数正在下降，而她的成本却没有增加，从来没有增加过。”

paras.en: Reporters point out to the premier that the costing he is referring to is a cap, not a freeze as proposed by the Coalition.
paras.zh: 记者向总理指出，他所指的成本计算是一个上限，而不是联盟党提议的冻结。

paras.en: But Carroll says neither a freeze or a cap on hiring will save the $22 billion promised, calling it "Jess-onomics".
paras.zh: 但卡罗尔表示，冻结招聘或限制招聘都无法节省承诺的 220 亿美元，并称其为“杰斯经济学”。

paras.en: Why unions are backing away from Labor this election
paras.zh: 为什么工会在这次选举中放弃工党

paras.en: If Labor does somehow pull an electoral rabbit out of its hat at the Victorian election on November 28, it won't be thanks to the support of the state's trade unions.
paras.zh: 如果工党确实能在 11 月 28 日的维多利亚州选举中变出选举兔子，那也不会归功于该州工会的支持。

paras.en: In recent months, several unions have been either backing quietly away from supporting Labor, or just outright urging members to vote for someone else.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，一些工会要么悄悄放弃支持工党，要么直接敦促成员投票给其他人。

paras.en: The ABC's Tim Callanan explores the ongoing emnity between the Carroll government and several unions, and the impact it could have come election day, in his story below:
paras.zh: 美国广播公司 (ABC) 的蒂姆·卡拉南 (Tim Callanan) 在下面的故事中探讨了卡罗尔政府与几个工会之间持续存在的敌意，以及这种敌意在选举日可能产生的影响：

paras.en: Premier responds to federal Labor no-show
paras.zh: 总理回应联邦工党缺席

paras.en: A topic of discussion during the election campaign has been the relative lack of support shown for the Carroll government by its federal colleagues.
paras.zh: 竞选期间讨论的一个话题是联邦同僚对卡罗尔政府相对缺乏支持。

paras.en: But the premier told ABC Statewide Drive yesterday afternoon he was not disappointed Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had not given much time to bolster his campaign.
paras.zh: 但昨天下午，州长告诉美国广播公司全州大道，他对安东尼·阿尔巴内斯总理没有花太多时间支持他的竞选活动并不感到失望。

paras.en: "He is busy. I'm out there every day fighting for Victorians," Carroll said.
paras.zh: “他很忙。我每天都在为维多利亚人而战，”卡罗尔说。

paras.en: "I know I've got a prime minister that knows where Victoria is, I'm grateful for that and I will fight every day for working people."
paras.zh: “我知道我的首相知道维多利亚在哪里，我对此表示感激，我将每天为工薪阶层而战。”

paras.en: But questions have been raised about whether federal Labor is insulating itself from a potential rout at the election.
paras.zh: 但有人质疑联邦工党是否正在避免选举中可能的溃败。

paras.en: The ABC's Raf Epstein and state political reporter Richard Willingham believe federal MPs are keeping Victorian Labor at arm's length.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司 (ABC) 的拉夫·爱泼斯坦 (Raf Epstein) 和州政治记者理查德·威林厄姆 (Richard Willingham) 认为，联邦议员正在与维多利亚工党保持一定距离。

paras.en: Carroll says Labor will continue work started with medically supervised injecting room
paras.zh: 卡罗尔表示工党将继续从医疗监督注射室开始的工作

paras.en: The premier is asked about Richmond's medically supervised injecting room, and whether he thinks the initiative has been a success.
paras.zh: 州长被问及里士满医疗监督注射室的情况，以及他认为该举措是否成功。

paras.en: The facility opened in June 2018 in an attempt to arrest the rising number of overdoses surrounding Victoria Street, but has remained a sore point for local residents and businesses.
paras.zh: 该设施于 2018 年 6 月开业，旨在遏制维多利亚街周围不断增加的吸毒过量事件，但仍然是当地居民和企业的痛处。

paras.en: Carroll says the medically supervised injecting room is helping vulnerable Victorians.
paras.zh: 卡罗尔说，受医疗监督的注射室正在帮助弱势的维多利亚人。

paras.en: "It's established, it's working and I know it's saving lives," he says.
paras.zh: “它已经建立，正在发挥作用，我知道它正在拯救生命，”他说。

paras.en: "That is why we will continue to invest, not just in those types of facilities, but pill testing, helping the vulnerable. That's the Labor way."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我们将继续投资，不仅投资于这些类型的设施，而且投资于药物测试，帮助弱势群体。这就是工党的方式。”

paras.en: Labor also makes a stop in Ivanhoe on campaign trail
paras.zh: 工党也在艾芬豪竞选活动中停留

paras.en: The morning's campaigning has firmly been focused in Melbourne's north. Earlier this morning, the Liberal campaign bus pulled into an early voting centre in Heidelberg, with Jess Wilson handing out how-to-vote cards and chatting to voters.
paras.zh: 上午的竞选活动主要集中在墨尔本北部。今天早些时候，自由党竞选巴士驶入海德堡的一个提前投票中心，杰西·威尔逊分发了如何投票的卡片并与选民聊天。

paras.en: Across the road at the Austin Hospital, Ben Carroll pulled in with local MP Anthony Carbines for his own campaign stop.
paras.zh: 在奥斯汀医院的马路对面，本·卡罗尔 (Ben Carroll) 与当地议员安东尼·卡宾斯 (Anthony Carbines) 一起停下来参加他自己的竞选活动。

paras.en: Carroll says the election is a referendum on health care.
paras.zh: 卡罗尔表示，这次选举是一次关于医疗保健的公投。

paras.en: "Labor built 12 hospitals, Liberals closed 12," Carroll says.
paras.zh: “工党建造了 12 家医院，自由党关闭了 12 家，”卡罗尔说。

paras.en: "This is personal for Anthony and I, because [the Liberals] closed the Essendon Hospital near my electorate and also the Preston and Northcote Community Hospital in Minister Carbines' community."
paras.zh: “这对安东尼和我来说是个人问题，因为（自由党）关闭了我选区附近的埃森登医院，以及卡宾斯部长社区的普雷斯顿和诺斯科特社区医院。”

paras.en: The premier says the Coalition will continue to cut health care if elected.
paras.zh: 总理表示，如果当选，联盟党将继续削减医疗保健费用。

paras.en: Ivanhoe voter Susan says she feels the election result is "inevitable", but that she wanted to make sure she helped to stop One Nation getting over the line.
paras.zh: 艾芬豪选民苏珊表示，她认为选举结果是“不可避免的”，但她想确保自己帮助阻止一国党越界。

paras.en: Susan: I think Labor's just got to get over itself and start again, in due course.
paras.zh: 苏珊：我认为工党必须克服自我，在适当的时候重新开始。

paras.en: Susan: I think so, not sure we've got anyone to do it but let's see.
paras.zh: 苏珊：我想是的，不确定我们是否有人来做这件事，但让我们看看。

paras.en: Undecided voter in Ivanhoe not thrilled with any of the parties
paras.zh: 艾芬豪尚未决定的选民对任何政党都不感兴趣

paras.en: Greens candidate Nina Crawley said she has spoken to many Labor voters who are turning away from the party.
paras.zh: 绿党候选人尼娜·克劳利表示，她已经与许多放弃该党的工党选民进行了交谈。

paras.en: It's certainly the experience Richard Willingham had as he spoke to people waiting to vote in Ivanhoe.
paras.zh: 这当然是理查德·威林厄姆在艾芬豪与等待投票的人们交谈时的经历。

paras.en: Local voter Joel Bornstein says he found it very difficult to find any good options in this coming election.
paras.zh: 当地选民乔尔·伯恩斯坦表示，他发现在即将到来的选举中很难找到任何好的选择。

paras.en: "The opposition have been a disaster for the past 14 years and the current government are so much on the nose that they're unelectable in my opinion," he says.
paras.zh: 他说：“过去 14 年里，反对派一直是一场灾难，而现任政府却如此机警，在我看来，他们不可能当选。”

paras.en: "Unfortunately the other main/minor parties are worse, so I'm not sure yet."
paras.zh: “不幸的是，其他主要/次要政党的情况更糟，所以我还不确定。”

paras.en: Even standing outside the early voting centre in Heidelberg this morning, Joel says he hadn't decided.
paras.zh: 即使今天早上站在海德堡提前投票中心外，乔尔也表示他还没有做出决定。

paras.en: Joel: Uh, three times this morning, each time different.
paras.zh: 乔尔：呃，今天早上三次，每次都不一样。

paras.en: But Joel says he is certain he won't vote to re-elect the Carroll government, describing its failure to be accountable for corruption on Big Build sites as "a monumental f*** up".
paras.zh: 但乔尔表示，他确信自己不会投票支持卡罗尔政府连任，并称该政府未能对大型建筑工地的腐败行为负责是“一个巨大的错误”。

paras.en: "I just can't vote for Labor, which is unfortunate because I've never voted for anyone else," he says.
paras.zh: “我就是不能投票给工党，这很不幸，因为我从来没有投票给过其他人，”他说。

paras.en: ABC state political reporter Richard Willingham is in Ivanhoe today, where the Liberal bus (nicknamed the Jess Express) has pulled in for a campaign stop.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司 (ABC) 州政治记者理查德·威林厄姆 (Richard Willingham) 今天在艾芬豪 (Ivanhoe)，自由党巴士（绰号为杰斯快车 (Jess Express)）已在此停靠，准备进行竞选活动。

paras.en: The seat in Melbourne's north sits on the western banks of the Yarra River and also includes suburbs like Heidelberg, Rosanna and Bellfield.
paras.zh: 墨尔本北部的席位位于亚拉河西岸，还包括海德堡、罗萨纳和贝尔菲尔德等郊区。

paras.en: Ivanhoe is a traditional Labor seat, and is currently held by cabinet minister Anthony Carbines.
paras.zh: 艾芬豪是传统的工党席位，目前由内阁部长安东尼·卡宾斯担任。

paras.en: Carbines has turned Ivanhoe into a very safe seat for Labor, going into this election with a margin of more than 12 per cent.
paras.zh: 卡宾枪使艾芬豪成为工党一个非常安全的席位，在这次选举中工党的优势超过 12%。

paras.en: But its an election where the Greens believe they can make major in-roads.
paras.zh: 但绿党相信他们能够在这次选举中取得重大进展。

paras.en: Greens candidate for Ivanhoe Nina Crawley says the response she has seen from voters has been "unlike anything I've seen before".
paras.zh: 艾芬豪绿党候选人尼娜·克劳利 (Nina Crawley) 表示，她从选民那里看到的反应“与我以前看到的不同”。

paras.en: "I had a woman in her 70s pull me out of the line and tell me she’s voting Greens for the first time ever this year," Crawley says.
paras.zh: “一位 70 多岁的女士把我拉出了队伍，告诉我她今年第一次投票给绿党，”克劳利说。

paras.en: "Lifelong Labor voters, they are just looking for an alternative."
paras.zh: “终身工党选民，他们只是在寻找替代方案。”

paras.en: The former high school teacher and unionist says voters were looking for politicians who stood by their values and principles.
paras.zh: 这位前高中教师和工会成员表示，选民正在寻找坚持自己价值观和原则的政客。

paras.en: She says the few days of pre-polling the party had seen made it "entirely possible" the seat could now be a contest between Liberals and Greens.
paras.zh: 她表示，经过几天的预投票，该党“完全有可能”在自由党和绿党之间争夺席位。

paras.en: Outside of the Labor landslides of 2002 and 2018, Nepean has been a safe Liberal seat. Its many retired, Australian and British-born, and land-owning residents are exactly the kinds of voters the Liberals have traditionally been able to rely on.
paras.zh: 除了2002年和2018年工党的压倒性胜利之外，内皮恩一直是自由党的一个安全席位。许多澳大利亚和英国出生的退休居民以及拥有土地的居民正是自由党传统上可以依赖的选民。

paras.en: In 2018, Labor narrowly won the seat after the retirement of long-term member Martin Dixon, who was education minister in the Baillieu and Napthine governments. The Liberals then regained the seat in 2022 with former tennis player Sam Groth as their candidate. Groth went on to become deputy leader of the Liberal Party in 2024, but in early 2026 he resigned from parliament after settling a defamation case he brought against the Herald Sun newspaper. When he resigned he singled out what he described as "pressure" that he alleged had been put on his family from within the Liberal Party.
paras.zh: 2018年，在Baillieu和Napthine政府担任教育部长的长期成员马丁·迪克森(Martin Dixon)退休后，工党以微弱优势赢得了席位。自由党随后于 2022 年重新获得席位，前网球运动员萨姆·格罗斯 (Sam Groth) 作为候选人。格罗斯于 2024 年成为自由党副党魁，但在解决了针对《先驱太阳报》提起的诽谤案后，于 2026 年初辞去议会职务。当他辞职时，他特别指出了他所说的自由党内部对他的家人施加的“压力”。

paras.en: His resignation triggered a late-term by-election in May 2026 that was won by Mayor Anthony Marsh. Marsh had joined the Liberal Party just weeks before his preselection. Labor decided not to run a candidate and the contest became a three-cornered fight between Marsh, independent Tracee Hutchison and One Nation.
paras.zh: 他的辞职引发了 2026 年 5 月的后期补选，市长安东尼·马什 (Anthony Marsh) 获胜。马什在预选前几周加入了自由党。工党决定不竞选候选人，这场竞争变成了马什、独立党特雷西·哈奇森和一国党之间的三角逐。

paras.en: There was speculation that One Nation could seriously challenge the Liberals due to the seat's high proportion of retirees and the party's success at the South Australian state election barely two months earlier. But although they topped the poll in some of the more working-class parts of the electorate, Marsh ultimately safely retained the seat and the independent Hutchison finished in second.
paras.zh: 有人猜测，一国党可能会严重挑战自由党，因为该席位退休人员比例很高，而且该党在两个月前的南澳大利亚州选举中取得了成功。不过，尽管他们在一些工人阶级选民中名列前茅，但马什最终安全地保住了席位，而独立的和记黄埔公司排名第二。

paras.en: With Hutchison not running in this election, Darren Hercus returning as the One Nation candidate, and more time to grow the party statewide, One Nation may be hoping they can win the seat. But the by-election result suggests it is a tough ask for One Nation to gain this kind of asset-rich, older seat from the Liberals.
paras.zh: 由于和记黄埔没有参加这次选举，达伦·赫克斯（Darren Hercus）作为一国党候选人回归，并且有更多时间在全州范围内发展该党，一国党可能希望他们能够赢得席位。但补选结果表明，一国党从自由党手中获得这种资产丰富、年龄较大的席位是一项艰难的要求。

paras.en: We want to know what's shaping your vote in this election and why.
paras.zh: 我们想知道是什么因素影响了您在这次选举中的投票以及原因。

paras.en: Whether it's the cost of living, housing affordability, crime, regional roads, health care or jobs, let us know in our form below.
paras.zh: 无论是生活成本、住房负担能力、犯罪、区域道路、医疗保健还是就业，请通过下面的表格告诉我们。

paras.en: You can also ask the election questions you want answered from candidates, parties or the ABC.
paras.zh: 您还可以向候选人、政党或 ABC 询问您想要回答的选举问题。

paras.en: All submissions will be reviewed by a journalist, and we may be in touch if we need more information.
paras.zh: 所有提交的内容都将由记者审核，如果我们需要更多信息，我们可能会与您联系。

paras.en: One Nation has 'no desire' to form coalition with other parties
paras.zh: 一国党“无意”与其他政党结成联盟

paras.en: One Nation's Victorian leader Warren Pickering spoke to ABC Ballarat this morning to discuss the state's polling ahead of the election.
paras.zh: 一国党维多利亚州领导人沃伦·皮克林今天早上接受美国广播公司巴拉瑞特采访，讨论选举前该州的民意调查。

paras.en: "I don't believe we are going to know the full outcome on Saturday night," Pickering said on breakfast radio.
paras.zh: “我不相信我们会在周六晚上知道全部结果，”皮克林在早餐广播中说。

paras.en: "I think this is an unprecedented election. We have genuine, three-way contests in up to 30-odd seats … as far as my predictions are concerned, the sentiment on the ground is that people just want change."
paras.zh: “我认为这是一场史无前例的选举。我们在多达 30 多个席位上进行了真正的三方竞争……就我的预测而言，当地的情绪是人们只是想要改变。”

paras.en: Pickering said at a minimum the party hoped to find a "balance of power scenario", but One Nation had "no desire" to form a coalition with the Liberal and National parties.
paras.zh: 皮克林表示，该党至少希望找到“权力平衡方案”，但一国党“无意”与自由党和国家党组成联盟。

paras.en: He said there was "an enormous difference" in the priorities of metropolitan and regional voters.
paras.zh: 他说，大都市和地区选民的优先事项存在“巨大差异”。

paras.en: "In our regions, which has been neglected and forgotten about, we’ve seen a lot of this net-zero associated … infrastructure, damaging our farmlands and farmers’ rights," Pickering said.
paras.zh: 皮克林说：“在我们被忽视和遗忘的地区，我们看到了很多与净零相关的……基础设施，损害了我们的农田和农民的权利。”

paras.en: He said the cost of living and the "deteriorating" road networks were also concerns for those in the regions.
paras.zh: 他说，生活成本和“恶化”的道路网络也是该地区人们的担忧。

paras.en: Good morning and welcome to our coverage of the Victorian state election campaign.
paras.zh: 早上好，欢迎收看我们对维多利亚州竞选活动的报道。

paras.en: The major parties will be out campaigning today, with just four days to go before election day.
paras.zh: 主要政党将于今天开始竞选活动，距离选举日仅剩四天。

paras.en: We'll bring you all the major moments from their campaign stops on the road, plus more analysis on the key seats in play on November 28.
paras.zh: 我们将为您带来他们在客场比赛中的所有重要时刻，以及 11 月 28 日比赛关键席位的更多分析。

articles.title: Underworld killer to be released on parole
articles.author: James Wakelin

paras.en: An underworld killer who murdered four people, including three members of the same family, is set to be released from a South Australian prison after almost four decades behind bars.
paras.zh: 一名谋杀了四人（其中包括同一家庭的三名成员）的黑社会杀手在入狱近四十年后即将从南澳大利亚监狱释放。

paras.en: Alistair Farquhar MacRae, who once told a court he should never be set free, will be released on parole after a commissioner's review upheld the Parole Board's original decision to grant parole.
paras.zh: 阿利斯泰尔·法夸尔·麦克雷 (Alistair Farquhar MacRae) 曾告诉法庭，他永远不应该被释放。在专员审查维持假释委员会最初的假释决定后，他将被假释。

paras.en: The 77-year-old was granted parole in June but Attorney-General Kyam Maher applied to have the original decision set aside.
paras.zh: 这位 77 岁的老人于 6 月获得假释，但总检察长凯姆·马赫 (Kyam Maher) 申请搁置最初的决定。

paras.en: But Parole Administrative Review Commissioner David Lovell KC said he "affirmed" the Parole Board's decision.
paras.zh: 但假释行政审查专员 David Lovell KC 表示，他“确认”假释委员会的决定。

paras.en: "I find that the Attorney-General has failed to establish that cogent reasons exist to set aside the Parole Board decision," Commissioner Lovell said.
paras.zh: “我发现总检察长未能证明存在令人信服的理由来搁置假释委员会的决定，”洛弗尔专员说。

paras.en: "I therefore dismiss the Attorney-General's application for review and affirm the Parole Board's decision."
paras.zh: “因此，我驳回总检察长的审查申请并确认假释委员会的决定。”

paras.en: Commissioner Lovell said the Attorney-General had argued the Parole Board did not fully consider "the relative level of risk that Mr MacRae poses to the community".
paras.zh: 洛弗尔专员表示，总检察长辩称假释委员会没有充分考虑“麦克雷先生给社区带来的相对风险程度”。

paras.en: But, Commissioner Lovell rejected that assertion.
paras.zh: 但是，洛弗尔专员拒绝了这一说法。

paras.en: "The Parole Board considered that Mr MacRae had undertaken all relevant rehabilitation programs in prison and had fulfilled the required criteria for release on parole," he said.
paras.zh: “假释委员会认为麦克雷先生已在监狱中实施了所有相关的康复计划，并满足了假释所需的标准，”他说。

paras.en: "MacRae also stated that he 'looked forward to living a quiet life'.
paras.zh: “麦克雷还表示，他‘期待过平静的生活’。

paras.en: "He expressed that he wanted to engage in volunteer work."
paras.zh: “他表示想从事志愿者工作。”

paras.en: MacRae shot and killed Dominic Marafiote in July 1985, before he buried the 42-year-old father of four under a chicken shed in a pre-dug grave at his rural property at Merbein, near Mildura.
paras.zh: 1985 年 7 月，麦克雷枪杀了多米尼克·马拉菲奥特 (Dominic Marafiote)，随后他将这位 42 岁的四个孩子的父亲埋葬在他位于米尔杜拉 (Merdura) 附近默宾 (Merbein) 乡村庄园的一个预先挖好的坟墓里的鸡棚下。

paras.en: MacRae then drove to Adelaide and killed the Mildura green grocer's parents, Rosa and Carmelo Marafiote, at their Woodville North home.
paras.zh: 麦克雷随后开车前往阿德莱德，在米尔杜拉绿色杂货商的父母罗莎·马拉菲奥特和卡梅洛·马拉菲奥特位于伍德维尔北的家中杀害了他们。

paras.en: The career criminal, who worked in Melbourne's underworld for years, also committed a fourth murder.
paras.zh: 这位在墨尔本黑社会工作多年的职业罪犯还犯下了第四起谋杀案。

paras.en: MacRae killed Albert O'Hara in Victoria, six months before the Marafiote murders.
paras.zh: 麦克雷在马拉菲奥特谋杀案发生前六个月在维多利亚杀害了阿尔伯特·奥哈拉。

paras.en: Mr O'Hara, like Dominic Marafiote, was lured to MacRae's property as part of marijuana deals, before he was shot dead and buried on the property.
paras.zh: 奥哈拉先生和多米尼克·马拉菲奥特一样，作为大麻交易的一部分被引诱到麦克雷的房产，然后被枪杀并埋在该房产内。

paras.en: MacRae, who was handed four life sentences with a non-parole period of 36 years, has been in jail in Victoria, then South Australia, since his arrest in December 1987.
paras.zh: 麦克雷被判处四项无期徒刑，且不得假释，期限为 36 年。自 1987 年 12 月被捕以来，他一直被关押在维多利亚州和南澳大利亚州的监狱中。

paras.en: He had been eligible to apply for parole since December 2023.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 12 月起，他就有资格申请假释。

articles.title: Rights group details 'surge' in violent attacks on Palestinian health-care workers
articles.author: Yasmine Hassan

paras.en: Rights group details 'surge' in violent attacks on Palestinian health-care workers
paras.zh: 人权组织详细介绍了针对巴勒斯坦医护人员的暴力袭击“激增”

paras.en: Violence jumped 350% from 2022-2024, Physicians for Human Rights Israel says
paras.zh: 以色列人权医生组织表示，从 2022 年到 2024 年，暴力事件增加了 350%

paras.en: For Yousef Dihir, a paramedic since 2008 in the West Bank, treating his fellow Palestinians has become a daily — sometimes lethal — risk.
paras.zh: 对于自 2008 年起在约旦河西岸担任护理人员的尤瑟夫·迪希尔 (Yousef Dihir) 来说，治疗他的巴勒斯坦同胞已经成为每天面临的风险，有时甚至是致命的风险。

paras.en: Leaning against his ambulance in Ramallah, Palestine, earlier this month, he told CBC News about one of the many incidents of settler violence he's faced after receiving a distress call. On this particular occasion, three years ago, his son had come along as a volunteer paramedic.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，他在巴勒斯坦拉马拉靠在救护车上，向加拿大广播公司新闻讲述了他在接到求救信号后遇到的众多定居者暴力事件之一。三年前的这个特殊时刻，他的儿子作为一名志愿护理人员来到了这里。

paras.en: "My son was injured, we were hit with glass in our faces when the gunshots broke out on the ambulance," he said. "They shot at the rear glass and the front glass."
paras.zh: “我的儿子受伤了，救护车上响起枪声时，我们的脸被玻璃击中，”他说。 “他们朝后玻璃和前玻璃开枪。”

paras.en: In a report published this week, Physicians for Human Rights Israel (PHRI) says settler violence affecting health-care workers "surged 350 per cent" between 2022 and 2024 in the West Bank, from 93 violent encounters to 422.
paras.zh: 以色列人权医生协会 (PHRI) 在本周发布的一份报告中表示，2022 年至 2024 年间，约旦河西岸影响医护人员的定居者暴力事件“激增 350%”，从 93 起暴力事件增加到 422 起。

paras.en: PHRI documented instances of violence against health-care workers through interviews with 25 paramedics, medics and emergency response workers, Dihir included, as well by accompanying paramedics and ambulance drivers during their shifts to see first-hand how they navigated checkpoints to get to patients.
paras.zh: PHRI 通过采访包括 Dihir 在内的 25 名护理人员、医务人员和应急响应人员，并在轮班期间陪同护理人员和救护车司机，亲眼目睹他们如何通过检查站到达患者身边，记录了针对医护人员的暴力事件。

paras.en: PHRI says the uptick in violence has been particularly notable since the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attacks that killed 1,200 people, saw 251 taken hostage and sparked a devastating war in Gaza that has left much of the territory in ruins and its two million people living in dire conditions.
paras.zh: PHRI 表示，自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击造成 1,200 人死亡、251 人被扣为人质并引发加沙毁灭性战争以来，暴力事件的增加尤为显着，导致加沙大部分地区成为废墟，200 万人生活在悲惨境地。

paras.en: Since then, PHRI says, "restrictions on medical care under the violent occupation have increasingly given way to direct attacks by Israeli forces and settlers on emergency medical services."
paras.zh: PHRI 表示，从那时起，“暴力占领下对医疗服务的限制越来越多地让位于以色列军队和定居者对紧急医疗服务的直接攻击。”

paras.en: They say it's clear that the health-care workers were targeted in particular through "broader policies sustaining Israel's unlawful occupation of the West Bank."
paras.zh: 他们表示，很明显，医护人员特别成为“支持以色列非法占领西岸的更广泛政策”的目标。

paras.en: - Gaza is slowly moving beyond survival mode — 3 years after the war began
paras.zh: - 加沙正在慢慢超越生存模式——战争开始三年后

paras.en: - UN commission says Israel has continued to commit genocide in Gaza since truce
paras.zh: - 联合国委员会表示，自停战以来，以色列继续在加沙实施种族灭绝

paras.en: The number of obstacles blocking movement around the West Bank has also increased, from 642 in June 2023 to 925 in December 2025.
paras.zh: 西岸周围阻碍行动的障碍物数量也有所增加，从 2023 年 6 月的 642 个增加到 2025 年 12 月的 925 个。

paras.en: "Reaching patients, evacuating the wounded and transferring patients between medical facilities all depend on Israeli military approval," the report says.
paras.zh: 报告称：“救治病人、疏散伤员以及在医疗机构之间转移病人都取决于以色列军方的批准。”

paras.en: "Interviewees describe physical assaults, threats at gunpoint, verbal abuse, humiliating searches and being prevented from reaching wounded or seriously ill patients."
paras.zh: “受访者描述了人身攻击、枪口威胁、辱骂、羞辱性搜查以及被阻止接近受伤或重病患者的情况。”

paras.en: The report notes an uptick in violent altercations between settlers and paramedics in the West Bank since Oct. 7, 2023. (Bashar Qaryuti/PHRI)
paras.zh: 报告指出，自 2023 年 10 月 7 日以来，西岸定居者和护理人员之间的暴力争执有所增加。（Bashar Qaryuti/PHRI）

paras.en: In 2025, the World Health Organization recorded a total of 233 attacks on health-care workers in the West Bank. And 38 attacks were recorded between January and April 2026, "35 of which involved obstruction of health care."
paras.zh: 2025年，世界卫生组织记录西岸共发生233起针对医护人员的袭击事件。 2026 年 1 月至 4 月期间记录了 38 起袭击事件，“其中 35 起涉及阻碍医疗保健”。

paras.en: It is a violation of international law, said Milena Ansari, director of the Occupied West Bank at PHRI, at a news conference on Nov. 16.
paras.zh: PHRI 约旦河西岸被占地区主任米莱娜·安萨里 (Milena Ansari) 在 11 月 16 日的新闻发布会上表示，这违反了国际法。

paras.en: Citing the Fourth Geneva Convention, which guarantees protection of civilians during armed conflict, Ansari said Israel has a responsibility to ensure medical services and public health access to "the occupied population."
paras.zh: 安萨里援引保证在武装冲突期间保护平民的《日内瓦第四公约》表示，以色列有责任确保“被占领人口”获得医疗服务和公共卫生服务。

paras.en: "And this explicitly extends to Palestinian paramedics, ambulances and emergency medical teams."
paras.zh: “这明确延伸到巴勒斯坦护理人员、救护车和紧急医疗队。”

paras.en: IDF denies claims, condemns 'acts of violence'
paras.zh: 以色列国防军否认这一说法，谴责“暴力行为”

paras.en: The Israel Defence Forces (IDF) denied claims that their security forces were stopping medical teams from doing their work and "condemned all acts of violence against medical teams and ambulances," in a statement to CBC News.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军 (IDF) 在给 CBC 新闻的一份声明中否认了有关其安全部队阻止医疗队开展工作的说法，并“谴责所有针对医疗队和救护车的暴力行为”。

paras.en: "The IDF enables freedom of movement for medical teams through Judea and Samaria and coordinates the movement of Palestinian ambulances with relevant authorities in advance," the statement says.
paras.zh: 声明称：“以色列国防军允许医疗队在朱迪亚和撒马利亚自由行动，并提前与有关当局协调巴勒斯坦救护车的行动。”

paras.en: - Israeli settler violence at unprecedented levels during Palestinian olive harvest
paras.zh: - 巴勒斯坦橄榄收获期间以色列定居者的暴力达到前所未有的程度

paras.en: - Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, including surgeon, health authorities say
paras.zh: - 卫生当局称，以色列对加沙一家医院的袭击造成包括外科医生在内的 6 人死亡

paras.en: "We should be setting a high standard of removing all checkpoints, removing all barriers that are between Palestinian communities and Palestinian territories," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们应该制定取消所有检查站、消除巴勒斯坦社区和巴勒斯坦领土之间所有障碍的高标准。”

paras.en: In one case, a paramedic described being kept away from an injured man. "I was standing close to the wounded man. I could have reached him easily, but the soldiers stopped me. He lay there bleeding until he died. Only then did they leave, and we were able to reach him," the paramedic recounted to PHRI.
paras.zh: 在一个案例中，一名护理人员描述自己被远离一名受伤男子。 “我站在伤者旁边。我本可以轻松地接近他，但士兵们阻止了我。他躺在那里流血不止，直到去世。直到那时他们才离开，我们才能够接近他，”护理人员向 PHRI 回忆道。

paras.en: The United Nations Office for Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs said the highest number of violent attacks in the West Bank has been recorded in 2026 to date with over 2,000 attacks against Palestinians resulting in death or property damage.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义事务协调厅表示，2026 年是西岸暴力袭击数量最多的一年，针对巴勒斯坦人的袭击超过 2000 起，造成死亡或财产损失。

paras.en: Paramedics 'constantly on edge,' report says
paras.zh: 报告称护理人员“始终处于紧张状态”

paras.en: PHRI is calling on Israel to end all violence against medical workers in the West Bank and ensure the unhindered passage of ambulances through checkpoints, gates and closed areas.
paras.zh: PHRI 呼吁以色列停止在西岸针对医务人员的一切暴力行为，并确保救护车畅通无阻地通过检查站、大门和禁区。

paras.en: They are also calling on the government to investigate settler violence and prosecute all attacks against medical workers.
paras.zh: 他们还呼吁政府调查定居者的暴力行为，并起诉所有针对医务人员的袭击事件。

paras.en: The PHRI report also documents the "severe psychological toll on emergency workers," with many noting feelings of distress, anxiety and sleep disturbances.
paras.zh: PHRI 的报告还记录了“紧急救援人员遭受的严重心理损失”，其中许多人指出了痛苦、焦虑和睡眠障碍的感觉。

paras.en: "All 25 described being constantly on edge, fearing they could be stopped, attacked or prevented from reaching patients," it says.
paras.zh: 报告称：“所有 25 人都表示一直处于紧张状态，担心自己可能会被阻止、攻击或无法接触患者。”

paras.en: Dihir said one of his colleagues died in April 2023 during an altercation with settlers.
paras.zh: 迪希尔说，他的一名同事于 2023 年 4 月在与定居者的争吵中死亡。

paras.en: "He was shot in the head but he refused to stop," he said. "He was afraid for the lives of the injured." His patients survived the attack.
paras.zh: “他头部中弹，但他拒绝停下来，”他说。 “他担心伤者的生命安全。”他的病人在袭击中幸存下来。

paras.en: While Dihir admits he doesn't want to die, he says he's not scared.
paras.zh: 虽然Dihir承认自己不想死，但他表示自己并不害怕。

paras.en: "I don't care about religion, race, ethnicity or anything else. ... I only care that a person needs humanitarian help and I can do that."
paras.zh: “我不关心宗教、种族、民族或其他任何东西……我只关心一个人需要人道主义帮助，而我可以做到。”

paras.en: With files from Crystal Goomansingh and The Associated Press
paras.zh: 来自 Crystal Goomansingh 和美联社的文件

articles.title: 'I'm not a hero,' says Arizona man who found lost toddler alone in the desert
articles.author: Sheena Goodyear

paras.en: 'I'm not a hero,' says Arizona man who found lost toddler alone in the desert
paras.zh: “我不是英雄”，亚利桑那州一名男子在沙漠中发现了走失的幼儿

paras.en: Police, dogs and drones scoured area for 2-year-old to no avail. Then Jay Stewart found her in a bush
paras.zh: 警察、警犬和无人机在该地区搜寻了 2 岁的孩子，但一无所获。然后杰·斯图尔特在灌木丛中发现了她

paras.en: Jay Stewart has a lot of precious memories, but he says nothing compares to the moment he found two-year-old Vella Campillo alone in the cold, dark Arizona desert, wearing nothing but a diaper.
paras.zh: 杰伊·斯图尔特 (Jay Stewart) 有很多珍贵的回忆，但他说，没有什么比他在寒冷、黑暗的亚利桑那州沙漠中发现两岁的维拉·坎皮略 (Vella Campillo) 独自一人、只穿着尿布的那一刻更重要的了。

paras.en: Police are hailing Stewart as a hero after he found the missing toddler who wandered away from her backyard last week, sparking a massive search-and-rescue operation in the rural community of Eloy, Ariz.
paras.zh: 上周，斯图尔特发现了从自家后院溜走的失踪幼儿，警方称斯图尔特为英雄，引发了亚利桑那州埃洛伊乡村社区的大规模搜救行动。

paras.en: "I am so grateful to have experienced that life event, because there's no other feeling like it in the world," Stewart told As It Happens host Nil Köksal.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特告诉《发生的事》节目主持人尼尔·科克萨尔：“我非常感激能够经历这一人生大事，因为世界上没有其他类似的感觉。”

paras.en: "That's No. 1 in my life, the most emotional moment I've ever had."
paras.zh: “这是我生命中的第一个时刻，也是我经历过的最激动人心的时刻。”

paras.en: Vella was unharmed and has been safely reunited with her parents, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，维拉没有受伤，并已安全与父母团聚。

paras.en: Vella was reported missing around 6 p.m., local time, on Nov. 17, according to the Pinal County Sheriff's Office.
paras.zh: 据皮纳尔县警长办公室称，当地时间 11 月 17 日下午 6 点左右，维拉据报失踪。

paras.en: Her parents, Joseph Campillo and Deanna Fritz, told Fox News affiliate KSAZ that she'd been playing in the backyard with her siblings under the care of another family member when she wandered off.
paras.zh: 她的父母约瑟夫·坎皮略（Joseph Campillo）和迪安娜·弗里茨（Deanna Fritz）告诉福克斯新闻附属公司 KSAZ，当她走开时，她正在后院和她的兄弟姐妹在另一位家庭成员的照顾下玩耍。

paras.en: Officials from several police and fire departments spent hours scouring the area along with dozens of volunteers, two helicopters, K-9 units and heat-detecting drones, all to no avail.
paras.zh: 多个警察和消防部门的官员与数十名志愿者、两架直升机、K-9 装置和热探测无人机一起在该地区进行了数小时的搜寻，但毫无结果。

paras.en: Then, just after midnight, Stewart called Vella's name and saw her pop out of a tiny patch of plants in the desert.
paras.zh: 然后，午夜过后，斯图尔特喊出了维拉的名字，看到她从沙漠中的一小片植物中跳了出来。

paras.en: "I spun around, and she jumped back down into this little bush … the size of, like, four dinner plates put together," he said. "She almost looked like she was swimming. Her little arms were moving around like she was treading water."
paras.zh: “我转了一圈，她跳回了这个小灌木丛……大小就像四个餐盘放在一起一样，”他说。 “她看上去就像是在游泳。她的小手臂在四处移动，就像在踩水一样。”

paras.en: Stewart and his wife had been looking for Vella ever since the emergency alert hit their phones notifying people of a missing child in their area.
paras.zh: 自从斯图尔特和他的妻子手机接到紧急警报，通知人们他们所在地区有一名儿童失踪后，他们就一直在寻找维拉。

paras.en: They spent two hours searching along the side of the road, he says, before heading home to check the news and bundle up in warmer clothes as the sun went down and the cold set in.
paras.zh: 他说，他们花了两个小时沿着路边寻找，然后回家查看新闻，并在太阳落山和寒冷袭来时穿上更暖和的衣服。

paras.en: "The desert is kind of like being in a mine. It could be pitch black where you can't see anything. And that's what it was like," he said.
paras.zh: “沙漠有点像在矿井里。那里可能一片漆黑，你什么也看不见。事情就是这样，”他说。

paras.en: On their second try, they drove into the desert behind Vella's home on their ATV.
paras.zh: 第二次尝试时，他们开着全地形车驶入维拉家后面的沙漠。

paras.en: "I've lived out there 20 years and I fly over it all the time in our helicopter. So I know it like the back of my hand," he said. "It's my backyard."
paras.zh: “我在那里生活了 20 年，一直乘坐直升机飞越那里。所以我对它了如指掌，”他说。 “这是我的后院。”

paras.en: Pinal County Sheriff Ross Teeple, right, awarded Stewart a plaque and a badge the day after he found a missing toddler near Eloy, Ariz. (Pinal County Sheriff’s Office)
paras.zh: 皮纳尔县治安官罗斯·蒂普尔（右）在斯图尔特在亚利桑那州埃洛伊附近发现一名失踪幼儿的第二天，向斯图尔特颁发了一块牌匾和一枚徽章。（皮纳尔县治安官办公室）

paras.en: Stewart says he'd separated from his wife as he wandered about a mile down a ditch calling Vella's name. He heard a yell, then saw her pop up and back down again.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特说，当他沿着一条沟渠漫步一英里，呼喊维拉的名字时，他与妻子分居了。他听到一声叫喊，然后看到她弹起又落下。

paras.en: He reached down, plucked her into his arms, unzipped his jacket and tucked her inside.
paras.zh: 他弯下腰​​，将她拉进怀里，拉开外套拉链，将她塞进怀里。

paras.en: "She whimpered for about 15 seconds when I picked her up, and then once I snuggled her to me and got her, she seemed pretty happy," he said. "She warmed up pretty quick."
paras.zh: “当我抱起她时，她呜咽了大约 15 秒，然后当我依偎着她并抱住她时，她看起来很高兴，”他说。 “她热身得很快。”

paras.en: Stewart says she didn't make a peep until he dropped his phone while talking to a 911 dispatcher.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特说，直到他在与 911 调度员通话时手机掉在地上，她才发出一声窥视。

paras.en: "And she went, 'Phone!' I started laughing. And I'm like, 'Yeah, baby, phone!' " he said. "It chokes me up. I can hear that little voice."
paras.zh: “然后她说，‘电话！’我开始笑。我说，‘是的，宝贝，电话！’ “他说。 “这让我窒息。我能听到那个小声音。”

paras.en: - Indiana woman crashes car into ditch, survives on creek water for 6 days
paras.zh: - 印第安纳州一名妇女将汽车撞入沟渠，在溪水中存活了 6 天

paras.en: - This 77-year-old spent a night alone on a mountain. He raised over $30K for his rescuers
paras.zh: - 这位 77 岁的老人独自在山上度过了一夜。他为救援人员筹集了超过 3 万美元

paras.en: Within 10 minutes, he says, police and other searchers were on the scene.
paras.zh: 他说，10 分钟内，警察和其他搜索人员就到达了现场。

paras.en: Body cam footage released by the Pinal County Sheriff's Office shows Stewart holding the toddler on his hip. By that point, she was wrapped in a blanket provided by another searcher and chattering away happily in baby talk.
paras.zh: 皮纳尔县治安官办公室发布的随身摄像机镜头显示，斯图尔特将幼儿抱在臀部上。那时，她已经裹在另一名搜寻者提供的毯子里，开心地用儿语说话。
