paras.zh: 我们是黄金法则的坚定信徒，这就是为什么编辑意见仅属于我们，并且之前没有经过所包含的广告商的审查、批准或认可。 Motley Fool Money 并不涵盖市场上的所有优惠。 Motley Fool Money 由 The Motley Fool 100% 拥有和经营。我们知识渊博的个人理财编辑和分析师团队受聘于 The Motley Fool，并遵守相同的出版标准和编辑诚信，同时与其他 Motley Fool 品牌的分析师和编辑保持专业分离。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它拥有市场上最长的 0% 年利率优惠期之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.en: Wells Fargo is an advertising partner of Motley Fool Money. Joel O'Leary has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy.
paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

paras.en: The Motley Fool owns shares of and recommends Visa.
paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Florida State will make its move with Glenn Schumann, but nostalgia alone won’t pay for championship roster

paras.en: Florida State spent the past few weeks zeroing in on one candidate to replace Mike Norvell. On Monday afternoon, the Seminoles landed their guy, reaching an agreement with Georgia defensive coordinator Glenn Schumann.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州过去几周一直在寻找一位候选人来接替迈克·诺维尔。周一下午，塞米诺尔人找到了他们的球员，并与佐治亚州防守协调员格伦·舒曼达成协议。

paras.en: Both sides agreed to terms, with an expected announcement over the next 24 hours once everything is official.
paras.zh: 双方就条款达成一致，预计一切正式确定后将在未来 24 小时内发布公告。

paras.en: Does the FSU brand still carry the same amount of weight that it did just a decade ago? No, but that doesn’t mean the Seminoles couldn’t attract one of the top names within the coaching circles over the past two seasons.
paras.zh: FSU 品牌的影响力还和十年前一样吗？不，但这并不意味着塞米诺尔队在过去两个赛季无法吸引教练界的顶级人物之一。

paras.en: The Seminoles agreed to a five-year deal with the Georgia defensive coordinator, who is expected to stay on with the Bulldogs through the remainder of the 2026 season. ESPN first reported this news.
paras.zh: 塞米诺尔队同意与佐治亚州防守协调员签订一份为期五年的合同，预计他将在 2026 年赛季剩余时间内继续留在斗牛犬队。 ESPN最先报道了这一消息。

paras.en: That part will obviously be tested over the next few weeks, as he tries to juggle the two jobs.
paras.zh: 这部分显然将在接下来的几周内受到考验，因为他试图兼顾这两项工作。

paras.en: Hiring a 36-year-old coordinator with no head coaching experience might raise eyebrows among those who haven’t followed Schumann’s career.
paras.zh: 聘请一位没有主教练经验的 36 岁协调员可能会让那些没有关注舒曼职业生涯的人感到惊讶。

paras.en: But when you’ve spent years helping run Georgia’s defense and collecting national championships as an assistant at multiple schools, eventually someone is going to hand you the keys.
paras.zh: 但当你花了数年时间帮助佐治亚州的防守并作为多所学校的助理获得全国冠军时，最终会有人把钥匙交给你。

paras.en: Glenn Schumann was a viable candidate for the North Carolina opening two years ago, before the Tar Heels board of directors decided that the Bill Belichick experience would be the better option.
paras.zh: 两年前，格伦·舒曼 (Glenn Schumann) 是北卡罗来纳州开业的可行候选人，之后焦油跟鞋董事会决定比尔·贝利切克 (Bill Belichick) 的经历将是更好的选择。

paras.en: That debacle in Chapel Hill looks worse by the day. For Schumann, it meant staying on Georgia’s sideline and waiting for the next opportunity.
paras.zh: 教堂山的惨案看起来一天比一天严重。对于舒曼来说，这意味着留在佐治亚州的场边等待下一个机会。

paras.en: Now, the former graduate assistant under Nick Saban gets his shot at leading a program that still has one of the most recognizable names in college football.
paras.zh: 现在，尼克·萨班手下的前研究生助理有机会领导一个项目，该项目仍然是大学橄榄球界最知名的名字之一。

paras.en: How highly does Kirby Smart think of Schumann? Bringing him to Athens was a priority when Smart took over at Georgia in 2016.
paras.zh: Kirby Smart 对舒曼的评价有多高？ 2016年斯玛特接手格鲁吉亚队时，把他带到雅典是当务之急。

paras.en: Florida State is now following a path similar to Oregon’s when the Ducks hired Dan Lanning away from Georgia.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州现在正在走与俄勒冈州相似的道路，当时鸭子队从佐治亚州聘请了丹·兰宁。

paras.en: Similar fire. Similar pedigree. Now comes the challenge of proving he can run the whole operation.
paras.zh: 类似的火。相似的血统。现在的挑战是证明他能够管理整个业务。

paras.en: It also helped that Florida State athletic director Jeff Purinton knew Schumann from their time together at Alabama under Saban.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州体育总监杰夫·普林顿（Jeff Purinton）在萨班领导下的阿拉巴马州共事时就认识了舒曼，这也有帮助。

paras.en: Can Florida State start winning again under Schumann?
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州立大学能否在舒曼的带领下再次获胜？

paras.en: If the Seminoles could put together a financial package that would get them back near the top of the spending chart around college football, the coaching would take care of itself under the Georgia defensive coordinator.
paras.zh: 如果塞米诺尔队能够制定一个财务方案，使他们重新回到大学橄榄球支出表的顶端，那么教练将在佐治亚州防守协调员的领导下自行解决。

paras.en: The problem is that Florida State has struggled over the past few years since going 13-1 and being locked out of the College Football Playoff due to an injury to quarterback Jordan Travis.
paras.zh: 问题是，佛罗里达州立大学在过去的几年里一直在苦苦挣扎，因为他们取得了 13 胜 1 负的战绩，并且由于四分卫乔丹·特拉维斯 (Jordan Travis) 的受伤而被排除在大学橄榄球季后赛之外。

paras.en: And, a lot of that comes down to how much money the Seminoles are prepared to spend in hopes of competing for ACC and CFP titles once again. The brand no longer sells itself alone, which is the obvious case around college football over the past five years.
paras.zh: 而且，这在很大程度上取决于塞米诺尔人准备花多少钱来再次争夺 ACC 和 CFP 冠军头衔。该品牌不再单独销售自己，这是过去五年大学橄榄球的明显例子。

paras.en: Multiple sources told OutKick that this was a main point of emphasis for the Georgia defensive coordinator when deciding on whether to accept the job. After meeting with Florida State officials on Sunday, Schumann needed assurances that the Seminoles were ready to provide him with enough money to attack the transfer portal and load up his roster with enough talent to win immediately.
paras.zh: 多位消息人士告诉 OutKick，这是佐治亚州防守协调员在决定是否接受这份工作时的一个主要重点。在周日与佛罗里达州官员会面后，舒曼需要保证塞米诺尔人准备好为他提供足够的资金来攻击转会门户，并为他的阵容配备足够的人才以立即获胜。

paras.en: Those assurances were given by athletic director Jeff Purinton, and Glenn Schumann will be tasked with putting together a coaching staff that can also make sure that expensive talent is not wasted.
paras.zh: 这些保证是由体育总监杰夫·普林顿（Jeff Purinton）做出的，格伦·舒曼（Glenn Schumann）将负责组建一支教练组，以确保昂贵的人才不会被浪费。

paras.en: A team has to be willing to spend money to accrue enough talent through the transfer portal to at least on paper compete for a title. But, there are always risks when it comes to forking up $35 to $45 million for a roster.
paras.zh: 一支球队必须愿意花钱通过转会门户培养足够的人才，至少在纸面上争夺冠军头衔。但是，为阵容支付 35 至 4500 万美元总是存在风险。

paras.en: Look no further than LSU, Texas A&M, Michigan, Ohio State and the countless others who are not in contention for the College Football Playoff this season, but have a roster that's worth over $40 million.
paras.zh: 看看路易斯安那州立大学、德克萨斯农工大学、密歇根州立大学、俄亥俄州立大学以及无数其他本赛季未参加大学橄榄球季后赛但拥有价值超过 4000 万美元的球员名单的其他大学。

paras.en: But, if the Seminoles are going to get back into the fight under Glenn Schumann, they're going to have to spend.
paras.zh: 但是，如果塞米诺尔人想要在格伦·舒曼的带领下重新投入战斗，他们将不得不花钱。

paras.en: A very important time for Florida State football
paras.zh: 对于佛罗里达州橄榄球来说这是一个非常重要的时刻

paras.en: With the College Football Playoff expanding to 24 teams and the business of college athletics constantly shifting, Florida State needs to start winning again.
paras.zh: 随着大学橄榄球季后赛扩大到 24 支球队以及大学体育事业的不断变化，佛罗里达州需要再次开始获胜。

paras.en: The discussions about ACC schools potentially leaving for richer conferences over the next five or six years aren’t going away.
paras.zh: 关于 ACC 学校可能在未来五六年内参加更丰富的会议的讨论不会消失。

paras.en: If the Seminoles want to command more money — whether from another conference or through a future arrangement within the ACC — they need a football program that gives them leverage.
paras.zh: 如果塞米诺尔人想要获得更多资金——无论是来自其他会议还是通过 ACC 内部的未来安排——他们需要一个能够赋予他们影响力的足球计划。

paras.en: Television deals with networks like ESPN and Fox will be heavily discussed within conferences looking to extract additional funds for their future spending. So, if you're going to take part in those conversations, a school had better be in a spot of leverage when it comes to football.
paras.zh: 与 ESPN 和 Fox 等网络的电视交易将在会议上得到广泛讨论，寻求为未来的支出筹集更多资金。因此，如果你要参与这些对话，学校最好在足球方面处于有利地位。

paras.en: Right now, at this moment, FSU does not have the upper hand.
paras.zh: 现在，此时此刻，FSU并不占上风。

paras.en: But that doesn’t mean they can't reignite the flame.
paras.zh: 但这并不意味着他们不能重燃火焰。

paras.en: There is an obvious risk in handing a job this demanding to someone who has never been a head coach. Florida State needs a turnaround, and the pressure to deliver will arrive long before Schumann coaches his first game.
paras.zh: 将如此高要求的工作交给从未担任过主教练的人显然存在风险。佛罗里达州立大学需要扭转局面，而在舒曼执教他的第一场比赛之前，交付的压力就会到来。

paras.en: But there aren’t many candidates who can list Saban and Smart as immediate references.
paras.zh: 但能够将萨班和斯玛特列为直接推荐人的候选人并不多。

paras.en: The Seminoles have made their bet. Now they need to back it with the money, support and patience required to give it a chance.
paras.zh: 塞米诺尔人已经下了赌注。现在他们需要提供资金、支持和耐心来支持它，以给它一个机会。

paras.en: Florida State wants back into the national conversation. Schumann gets the headset — and the responsibility of making people care again.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州希望重返全国对话。舒曼得到了耳机——以及让人们再次关心的责任。

articles.title: NATO warns Putin could strike before European army responds, points to US as military model

paras.en: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte warned Monday that creating a separate European army could undermine the alliance’s ability to respond quickly to a Russian attack, as Moscow continues to ramp up its military capabilities during the ongoing war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特周一警告称，随着莫斯科在乌克兰持续战争期间继续增强其军事能力，建立一支独立的欧洲军队可能会削弱该联盟对俄罗斯袭击做出快速反应的能力。

paras.en: Speaking at the 72nd annual session of the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin, Rutte cautioned that competing military command structures could hold up decisions in a crisis, warning that Russia’s "war machine" is running at full throttle and could also pose a threat to Europe long after the war ends.
paras.zh: 吕特在柏林举行的第 72 届北约议会年度会议上发表讲话时警告说，相互竞争的军事指挥结构可能会阻碍危机中的决策，并警告说，俄罗斯的“战争机器”正在全速运转，也可能在战争结束很久之后对欧洲构成威胁。

paras.en: "What I would counsel against is having all the nations with their own militaries working together in NATO and then on top of that having a big European structure, because then if Putin attacks, we will first need two or three weeks to agree who will do what, and then he will probably end up in Rotterdam before we have decided. So that has been my argument," Rutte said, according to Ukrainska Pravda.
paras.zh: 据《乌克兰真理报》报道，吕特说：“我建议反对的是让所有拥有自己军队的国家在北约中合作，然后再建立一个大型欧洲结构，因为如果普京发动攻击，我们首先需要两到三周的时间来商定谁将做什么，然后他可能会在我们做出决定之前就到达鹿特丹。这就是我的观点。”

paras.en: Rutte pointed to the United States as a model for an integrated military, arguing that European countries would also need to move beyond separate national forces to establish a unified army.
paras.zh: 吕特指出，美国是一体化军队的典范，他认为欧洲国家也需要超越各自独立的国家军队，建立一支统一的军队。

paras.en: "My point has always been that if you have a European military, you cannot also have national militaries. The United States has one military."
paras.zh: “我的观点一直是，如果你有一支欧洲军队，你就不可能同时拥有国家军队。美国只有一支军队。”

paras.en: "There is not a specific army or navy for the state of New York or for the state of California. It is an integrated United States military. If Europe is able to pull that off, fine," Rutte said.
paras.zh: “纽约州或加利福尼亚州没有专门的陆军或海军。这是一支一体化的美国军队。如果欧洲能够做到这一点，那就好，”吕特说。

paras.en: Rutte said it was Russia's expanding military production and cooperation with China, Iran and North Korea that pose a long-term threat to NATO, regardless of how the war in Ukraine ends.
paras.zh: 吕特表示，无论乌克兰战争如何结束，俄罗斯不断扩大的军事生产以及与中国、伊朗和朝鲜的合作对北约构成了长期威胁。

paras.en: "We face great dangers coming from Russia and the fact that Russia works so closely together with Iran, China, and North Korea, we know that Russia's war machine at the moment is running at full speed," Rutte also said at the assembly in Berlin.
paras.zh: “我们面临来自俄罗斯的巨大危险，事实上，俄罗斯与伊朗、中国和朝鲜合作如此密切，我们知道俄罗斯的战争机器目前正在全速运转，”吕特还在柏林的集会上表示。

paras.en: "Its war economy keeps growing, and it won't stand still when the war against Ukraine hopefully will end one day. That whole machine is there and will continue."
paras.zh: “它的战时经济持续增长，当对乌克兰的战争有望有一天结束时，它不会停滞不前。整个机器就在那里并将继续下去。”

paras.en: Rutte also rejected the idea that only countries bordering Russia or Ukraine face a direct military threat, warning that Moscow's long-range missiles put capitals across Europe within striking distance.
paras.zh: 吕特还否认了只有与俄罗斯或乌克兰接壤的国家面临直接军事威胁的观点，并警告称莫斯科的远程导弹将欧洲各地的首都置于打击距离之内。

paras.en: "Let me say once again to everyone here who is not on the eastern flank: I have news for you. You are on the eastern flank too. These latest Russian missiles need only five minutes longer to reach Lisbon, Rome or The Hague, my hometown, than to reach Tallinn, Warsaw or Helsinki," Rutte said.
paras.zh: 吕特说：“让我再次对不在东翼的所有人说：我有消息要告诉你们。你们也在东翼。这些最新的俄罗斯导弹只需五分钟就能到达里斯本、罗马或我的家乡海牙，比到达塔林、华沙或赫尔辛基要多五分钟。”

paras.en: "So we are all on the eastern flank here. Let's put an end to this discussion about whether or not you are on the eastern flank. We are all on the eastern flank."
paras.zh: “所以我们都在东翼。让我们结束关于你是否在东翼的讨论。我们都在东翼。”

paras.en: The NATO chief's remarks came amid plans to deploy an early-warning aircraft to Poland after Polish prosecutors said three Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles landed on Polish territory Friday during strikes against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 北约主席发表上述言论之际，波兰检察官表示，周五在对乌克兰的袭击中，三枚俄罗斯Kh-101巡航导弹落在波兰领土上，计划向波兰部署一架预警机。

paras.en: Polish Deputy Defense Minister Pawel Zalewski said that NATO would deploy an Airborne Warning and Control System, or AWACS, aircraft to strengthen surveillance along the alliance's eastern flank, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，波兰国防部副部长帕维尔·扎勒夫斯基表示，北约将部署机载预警和控制系统飞机，以加强对联盟东翼的监视。

paras.en: "This is a very good system that gives us even deeper... operational awareness which allows us to respond better to this kind of threat," Zalewski told reporters following a NATO meeting in Brussels.
paras.zh: 扎莱夫斯基在布鲁塞尔举行的北约会议后对记者表示：“这是一个非常好的系统，它使我们拥有更深入的……作战意识，使我们能够更好地应对这种威胁。”

paras.en: The aircraft can monitor large areas of airspace and provide allied forces with a shared picture of potential aerial threats, improving NATO's ability to detect and respond to missile and aircraft activity.
paras.zh: 该飞机可以监视大片空域，并向盟军提供潜在空中威胁的共享信息，从而提高北约检测和应对导弹和飞机活动的能力。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also warned Monday night that intelligence indicated Moscow was preparing a new wave of strikes against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基周一晚间也警告称，情报显示莫斯科正在准备对乌克兰发动新一波袭击。

paras.en: Beyond Russia's ongoing military threats, Rutte said that Europe's interconnected infrastructure, including energy networks and communications systems, is vulnerable.
paras.zh: 吕特表示，除了俄罗斯持续的军事威胁之外，欧洲互联的基础设施，包括能源网络和通信系统，也很脆弱。

paras.en: "We are all targeted, that we are all affected when it comes to our pipelines, our cables, our energy grids, and our economies."
paras.zh: “我们都是目标，当涉及到我们的管道、电缆、能源网和经济时，我们都受到影响。”

paras.en: "They are all interconnected, and that means that we are all in this for the long term. And therefore, we must step up to the plate to ensure that we stay ahead of danger."
paras.zh: “它们都是相互关联的，这意味着我们都将长期参与其中。因此，我们必须挺身而出，确保我们领先于危险。”

paras.en: Rutte said defending NATO countries demands civilian preparedness, pointing to northern European nations that have begun teaching residents about their responsibilities in the event of war.
paras.zh: 吕特表示，保卫北约国家需要平民做好准备，并指出北欧国家已经开始向居民传授他们在发生战争时的责任。

paras.en: "This really takes the whole of society," he said.
paras.zh: “这确实需要整个社会的努力，”他说。

paras.en: "And that's in the end, I think, still Norway and Sweden, and Denmark and Finland, and maybe one or two others who are really ahead of the pack here, and having made clear to their citizens what they need to do in case war breaks out, at least not to get in the way of the military, but to be helpful and also how they make sure that the police and the ambulance services and fire, the fire fighting departments work together, supporting the military wherever possible."
paras.zh: “我认为，最终还是挪威、瑞典、丹麦和芬兰，或许还有其他一两个国家真正处于领先地位，并向其公民明确了一旦战争爆发他们需要做什么，至少不要妨碍军队，而是提供帮助，以及他们如何确保警察、救护车服务以及消防、消防部门合作，尽可能支持军队。”

paras.en: Rutte's warnings come amid uncertainty over Ukraine's long-term security arrangements and whether Western allies will offer guarantees resembling NATO's Article 5 collective defense commitment as part of a future peace agreement.
paras.zh: 吕特发出警告之际，乌克兰的长期安全安排存在不确定性，西方盟国是否会提供类似于北约第五条集体防御承诺的保证，作为未来和平协议的一部分。

paras.en: U.S. special envoy Jared Kushner said Sunday that President Donald Trump was willing to consider Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine as part of a broader postwar security arrangement for Europe.
paras.zh: 美国特使贾里德·库什纳周日表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统愿意考虑将针对乌克兰的第五条式安全保证作为更广泛的欧洲战后安全安排的一部分。

articles.title: Venezuelan illegal immigrant arrested in Utah after soliciting assassination of Trump, DHS says

paras.en: An illegal immigrant was arrested in Utah last month after an investigation linked him to the distribution of images encouraging the assassination of President Donald Trump, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announced Monday.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部 (DHS) 周一宣布，一名非法移民上个月在犹他州被捕，调查显示他涉嫌传播鼓励暗杀唐纳德·特朗普总统的图片。

paras.en: Hector Alejandro Mujica-Hernandez, a Venezuelan national living in the U. S. illegally, was taken into custody in Provo.
paras.zh: 非法居住在美国的委内瑞拉国民赫克托·亚历杭德罗·穆吉卡-埃尔南德斯 (Hector Alejandro Mujica-Hernandez) 在普罗沃被拘留。

paras.en: Authorities said the arrest followed a tip from the FBI regarding online assassination threats against Trump that were traced back to Mujica-Hernandez's activity.
paras.zh: 当局表示，逮捕行动是在联邦调查局接到有关针对特朗普的网上暗杀威胁的举报后进行的，这些威胁可追溯到穆希卡-埃尔南德斯的活动。

paras.en: "This illegal alien not only broke our laws by illegally overstaying his visa, but threatened the life of the President of the United States," Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin said in a statement. "The Department of Homeland Security will not tolerate death threats of any kind."
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林在一份声明中表示：“这名非法移民不仅非法逾期居留，违反了我们的法律，还威胁到了美国总统的生命。” “国土安全部不会容忍任何形式的死亡威胁。”

paras.en: According to DHS, the investigation centered on stickers distributed during a meeting of a group called "People of Provo Against ICE" (POPAI). The stickers featured rhetoric supporting Trump's assassination, including the phrase: "Shoot Trump, be a hero, become unforgettable."
paras.zh: 据国土安全部称，调查的重点是一个名为“普罗沃反对 ICE 人民”(POPAI) 的组织在一次会议上分发的贴纸。这些贴纸上有支持暗杀特朗普的言论，其中包括这样一句话：“射杀特朗普，成为英雄，变得令人难忘。”

paras.en: DHS noted that the letter "A" on the stickers was stylized as an upside-down anarchist symbol commonly associated with Antifa and anarchist groups.
paras.zh: 国土安全部指出，贴纸上的字母“A”被风格化为颠倒的无政府主义符号，通常与 Antifa 和无政府主义团体相关。

paras.en: Trump has been the subject of several assassination plots, while U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers have faced an uptick in attacks amid the administration's immigration enforcement agenda.
paras.zh: 特朗普已成为多起暗杀阴谋的目标，而美国移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 官员在政府移民执法议程中面临的袭击有所增加。

paras.en: "The media and the far-left must stop vilifying ICE law enforcement officers and President Trump," said Mullin, casting blame on both for threats and attacks against ICE and Trump.
paras.zh: 穆林表示：“媒体和极左派必须停止诽谤 ICE 执法人员和特朗普总统。”他将针对 ICE 和特朗普的威胁和攻击归咎于这两个人。

paras.en: Officials said Mujica-Hernandez originally entered the United States legally in July 2016, but remained in the country unlawfully after overstaying his visa.
paras.zh: 官员称，穆希卡-埃尔南德斯最初于 2016 年 7 月合法进入美国，但在签证逾期后非法留在美国。

articles.title: 'Biggest U-turn in economic history': Experts react to Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia

paras.en: 'Biggest U-turn in economic history': Experts react to Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
paras.zh: “经济史上最大的转变”：专家对黄仁勋重返英伟达的反应

paras.en: Nvidia's board members have announced that they unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as the company's boss "effective immediately" - capping a remarkable U-turn in the technology firm's fortunes.
paras.zh: 英伟达 (Nvidia) 董事会成员宣布，他们一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的公司老板职务，“立即生效”，结束了这家科技公司命运的惊人转变。

paras.en: The board had previously ruled out Huang's return after he admitted an affair with a woman who was alleged to be a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 在黄承认与一名被指控为中国间谍的女子有染后，董事会此前曾排除黄的回国可能性。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump praised the decision, telling CNBC he made it happen, while Nvidia's share price shot up by more than 30% after a week of poor performance in the wake of the initial scandal.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对这一决定表示赞赏，他告诉 CNBC，他做到了这一点，而英伟达的股价在最初的丑闻发生后一周表现不佳后，上涨了 30% 以上。

paras.en: Experts from across the techonology and business sector reacted to his unexpected return.
paras.zh: 来自技术和商业领域的专家对他的意外回归做出了反应。

articles.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war

paras.en: Anchored in a Mediterranean harbour nearly 2,000 miles from Moscow, the Captain of Russia's corvette Merkury might well have thought his ship was safe from attack. It wasn't.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯护卫舰“墨库里”号停泊在距莫斯科近 2,000 英里的地中海港口，船长很可能认为他的船不会受到攻击。事实并非如此。

paras.en: The audacious and successful night-time attack in Benghazi, co-ordinated by Ukraine's SBU intelligence agency and its armed forces, has raised the obvious question: is the Ukraine war spreading well beyond its borders?
paras.zh: 在乌克兰 SBU 情报机构及其武装部队的协调下，班加西发生的大胆而成功的夜间袭击提出了一个明显的问题：乌克兰战争是否已经蔓延到其边界之外？

paras.en: The answer is yes, in fact, it was already spreading. But this attack, which Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky called "an exemplary operation" will inevitably raise the stakes another notch.
paras.zh: 答案是肯定的，事实上，它已经在蔓延了。但这次被乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基称为“堪称典范的行动”的袭击将不可避免地使赌注再上一个台阶。

paras.en: Russia, which is currently engaged in a non-stop campaign to batter Ukraine's civilian population into submission with daily missile and drone strikes, has called it "a dangerous escalation".
paras.zh: 俄罗斯目前正在进行一场不间断的行动，通过每日导弹和无人机袭击来迫使乌克兰平民屈服，俄罗斯称这是“危险的升级”。

paras.en: It follows the suspected Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian dry-cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland at the weekend, which the Kremlin described as an act of terrorism.
paras.zh: 周末，乌克兰无人机疑似在芬兰湾袭击了一艘俄罗斯干货船，克里姆林宫将其描述为恐怖主义行为。

paras.en: Ukraine's long-range drones have also previously struck Russia's Baltic oil terminal at Ust-Luga.
paras.zh: 乌克兰的远程无人机此前还袭击了俄罗斯位于乌斯季卢加的波罗的海石油码头。

paras.en: Some of Ukraine's more audacious long-range drone attacks â what Zelensky likes to call "long-range sanctions" â have also struck targets thousands of kilometres beyond Ukraine's borders with Russia, deep inside Siberia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰的一些更大胆的远程无人机攻击——泽伦斯基喜欢称之为“远程制裁”——还袭击了距离乌克兰与俄罗斯边境数千公里、西伯利亚深处的目标。

paras.en: The most notable of these was last year's Operation Spider's Web, which involved a specially adapted lorry that drove close to a Russian strategic nuclear bomber airbase and released a "swarm" of explosive drones that damaged or destroyed several expensive bombers.
paras.zh: 其中最引人注目的是去年的“蜘蛛网行动”，其中涉及一辆经过特殊改造的卡车驶近俄罗斯战略核轰炸机空军基地，并释放了“一大群”爆炸性无人机，损坏或摧毁了几架昂贵的轰炸机。

paras.en: And Ukraine has also been active further south in Africa where its forces have targeted Russian mercenaries from the Africa Corps, the successor to the infamous Wagner Group that was accused of carrying out numerous human rights abuses.
paras.zh: 乌克兰在非洲南部也很活跃，其军队瞄准了来自非洲军团的俄罗斯雇佣兵，该军团是臭名昭著的瓦格纳集团的继承者，该集团被指控实施了多次侵犯人权行为。

paras.en: It's not just Russia that will be alarmed by this latest Ukrainian operation in Benghazi harbour. The United Nations mission in Libya has already expressed its "deep concern".
paras.zh: 不仅仅是俄罗斯会对乌克兰在班加西港的最新行动感到震惊。联合国驻利比亚特派团已表达“深切关注”。

paras.en: Libyan officials point out that their country is not a party to the Russia-Ukraine war, although the Merkury and an accompanying cargo ship that was also hit were berthed in the eastern part of Libya controlled by the pro-Moscow warlord and self-styled "Field Marshal" Khalifa Haftar.
paras.zh: 利比亚官员指出，利比亚不是俄罗斯-乌克兰战争的一方，尽管“水星”号和一艘同样被击中的随行货船停泊在亲莫斯科军阀、自封的“陆军元帅”哈利法·哈夫塔尔控制的利比亚东部地区。

paras.en: Throughout this year the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) has condemned all attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and today the global shipping community will be wondering whether this attack does indeed set a dangerous precedent.
paras.zh: 今年以来，国际海事组织 (IMO) 一直谴责霍尔木兹海峡发生的所有针对商业航运的袭击，而今天，全球航运界将怀疑这次袭击是否确实开创了一个危险的先例。

paras.en: If Ukraine can plan and execute such a bold attack on Russian ships in a nominally neutral harbour so far from home, where does this stop?
paras.zh: 如果乌克兰能够在远离家乡的名义上中立的港口策划并执行对俄罗斯船只的如此大胆的攻击，那么这会止于哪里呢？

paras.en: As the fifth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine approaches, this war has already been spreading, notably in other parts of Europe.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰五周年的临近，这场战争已经蔓延开来，尤其是在欧洲其他地区。

paras.en: On Friday, several Russian projectiles landed well inside Poland's borders, just 60 miles from an Anglo-French exercise of forces intended to be deployed following an eventual ceasefire in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 周五，几枚俄罗斯炮弹落在波兰境内，距乌克兰最终停火后打算部署的英法军演仅 60 英里。

paras.en: This, said Poland's PM Donald Tusk, was "a deliberate provocation" by Moscow.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克表示，这是莫斯科的“蓄意挑衅”。

paras.en: It's not the first time Russian munitions have landed inside Poland, and therefore inside Nato territory, but observers have pointed out that Russia's probing of Nato's borders is becoming ever more brazen and some are calling for a firmer response.
paras.zh: 这并不是俄罗斯弹药第一次落入波兰境内，因此也落入北约境内，但观察人士指出，俄罗斯对北约边界的探测正变得越来越无耻，一些人呼吁俄罗斯做出更坚决的回应。

paras.en: But Russia is already heavily sanctioned by the West, with Europe having reduced much â but not all â of its energy imports from Russia, so the options for retaliation are limited, short of military confrontation, which no one wants.
paras.zh: 但俄罗斯已经受到西方的严厉制裁，欧洲已经减少了大量（但不是全部）从俄罗斯的能源进口，因此报复的选择很有限，除了军事对抗之外，这是没有人想要的。

paras.en: Both Romania and Moldova have found themselves frequently struck by overflying Russian drones targeting Ukraine's Black Sea ports, while Bulgaria and Romania have suffered maritime drone attacks on commercial shipping just offshore in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦都经常遭到飞越乌克兰黑海港口的俄罗斯无人机袭击，而保加利亚和罗马尼亚则在黑海近海的商业航运上遭受海上无人机袭击。

paras.en: In the case of Romania, a Nato member, fast jets have had to be scrambled to intercept incoming Russian drones and there is a profound suspicion that these incursions are not all accidental.
paras.zh: 就北约成员国罗马尼亚而言，必须紧急出动快速喷气式飞机拦截来袭的俄罗斯无人机，人们深刻怀疑这些入侵并非都是意外。

paras.en: The three Baltic states â Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania â all have borders with Russia and all consider themselves right on the front lines in this war.
paras.zh: 波罗的海三个国家——爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛——都与俄罗斯接壤，并且都认为自己处于这场战争的前线。

paras.en: There have been a number of anonymous attacks on military industrial facilities in these countries, blamed on agents acting on Moscow's behalf.
paras.zh: 这些国家的军事工业设施遭受了多起匿名攻击，这些攻击被归咎于代表莫斯科行事的特工。

paras.en: Russia, for its part, suspects Estonia of being complicit in Ukrainian drone attacks on the Baltic involving overflights through Estonian airspace.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯则怀疑爱沙尼亚参与了乌克兰无人机对波罗的海的袭击，涉及飞越爱沙尼亚领空。

paras.en: Hybrid warfare isn't new but it is on the rise.
paras.zh: 混合战争并不新鲜，但它正在兴起。

paras.en: It refers to the practice, by either side, of carrying out largely anonymous and unattributable operations using methods like cyber attacks, the burning down of warehouses supplying military equipment and the dispatching of drones, both for surveillance and loaded with explosives.
paras.zh: 它指的是双方利用网络攻击、烧毁供应军事装备的仓库以及派遣无人机等方法进行基本上匿名和无法归属的行动的做法，这些无人机既用于监视又装载爆炸物。

paras.en: This autumn, Germany's Leipzig-Halle airport, which is used as a resupply hub by Ukraine's cargo aircraft, was targeted by three explosive drones that were discovered before anyone was hurt.
paras.zh: 今年秋天，德国莱比锡哈勒机场被三架爆炸性无人机袭击，该机场被用作乌克兰货机的补给中心，这三架爆炸性无人机是在人员受伤之前被发现的。

paras.en: There have been other incidents involving explosive packages sent across Europe targeting Germany, Poland and the UK. Moscow denies any involvement.
paras.zh: 欧洲各地还发生过其他针对德国、波兰和英国的爆炸物包裹事件。莫斯科否认有任何参与。

articles.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

paras.en: The US has said it intends to ban a Singaporean artificial intelligence (AI) company allegedly tied to the Nvidia scandal from doing business in America.
paras.zh: 美国表示打算禁止一家涉嫌与英伟达丑闻有关的新加坡人工智能公司在美国开展业务。

paras.en: The Department of Commerce announced it planned to add Megaspeed Ltd to a list of entities that are blacklisted from buying or selling goods in the US.
paras.zh: 美国商务部宣布计划将 Megaspeed Ltd 添加到禁止在美国买卖商品的实体名单中。

paras.en: The company is mainly a developer of data centres, but in recent weeks a former executive of Megaspeed was accused of working as spy for China while having a romantic relationship with Nvidia head Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 该公司主要是一家数据中心开发商，但最近几周，Megaspeed 的一名前高管被指控为中国充当间谍，同时与 Nvidia 负责人黄仁勋保持着浪漫关系。

paras.en: The relationship led to additional scrutiny by US officials and heightened concern that Megaspeed was funnelling Nvidia's advanced AI computer chips to China.
paras.zh: 这种关系引发了美国官员的额外审查，并加剧了人们对 Megaspeed 向中国输送 Nvidia 先进人工智能计算机芯片的担忧。

paras.en: When exactly the ban against Megaspeed will go into effect was not specified in the commerce department announcement. The BBC has asked the agency for comment, along with the White House and Megaspeed.
paras.zh: 商务部公告中并未具体说明针对Megaspeed的禁令具体何时生效。 BBC 已要求该机构以及白宫和 Megaspeed 发表评论。

paras.en: Megaspeed was not well known within the US until last month when media reports emerged that a former Megaspeed executive, Alice Huang, had an affair with Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 直到上个月，媒体报道称 Megaspeed 前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 与黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 有染时，Megaspeed 在美国并不为人所知。

paras.en: Alice Huang (no relation) was thought by US intelligence to be working as an asset for Beijing, creating national security concerns within the US.
paras.zh: 美国情报机构认为爱丽丝·黄（无亲属关系）是北京的资产，在美国国内引起国家安全担忧。

paras.en: China has denied that she is a spy and warned the US not to use the scandal as a "pretext for imposing a technological blockade" on AI technology.
paras.zh: 中国否认她是间谍，并警告美国不要利用该丑闻作为对人工智能技术实施技术封锁的借口。

paras.en: On 12 November, Jensen Huang resigned after allegations he had had another affair, this one with a Nvidia employee.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日，黄仁勋因被指控与 Nvidia 一名员工发生另一起婚外情而辞职。

paras.en: On Monday, Nvidia's board reinstated him after US President Donald Trump said he had "convinced" the company and "made the deal".
paras.zh: 周一，在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示他已经“说服”了该公司并“达成了交易”后，英伟达董事会恢复了他的职位。

paras.en: The commerce department has said it had been investigating Megaspeed for almost two years.
paras.zh: 美国商务部表示，近两年来一直在调查 Megaspeed。

paras.en: The department said it had suspected the company was violating US export controls by helping to get Nvidia's chips into the hands of companies within China.
paras.zh: 该部门表示，怀疑该公司帮助英伟达的芯片落入中国境内公司手中，从而违反了美国的出口管制。

paras.en: China has been blocked from buying such technology since 2022.
paras.zh: 自2022年以来，中国一直被禁止购买此类技术。

paras.en: Although based in Singapore, Megaspeed has significant business dealings in China.
paras.zh: 尽管总部位于新加坡，Megaspeed 在中国也有重要的业务往来。

paras.en: Alibaba, for instance, the major Chinese online retailer, has been reported to be one if its largest customers.
paras.zh: 例如，据报道，中国主要在线零售商阿里巴巴是其最大客户之一。

paras.en: Megaspeed was a known buyer of billions of dollars of Nvidia computer chips, including through its subsidiary Speedmatrix, which has also been added to the Commerce blacklist.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 是价值数十亿美元的 Nvidia 计算机芯片的知名买家，包括通过其子公司 Speedmatrix 购买，该公司也已被添加到商务部黑名单中。

paras.en: Nvidia's computer chips, originally designed for use in gaming consols, in recent years have become crucial to the continued growth of the AI industry.
paras.zh: 英伟达的计算机芯片最初设计用于游戏机，近年来已成为人工智能行业持续增长的关键。

paras.en: Without enough supply or access to computer chips that are capable of processing the huge amount of data needed to make things like AI chatbots and models run, AI companies will not be able to meet or grow demand from people using AI tools.
paras.zh: 如果没有足够的计算机芯片供应或访问能力来处理人工智能聊天机器人和模型运行所需的大量数据，人工智能公司将无法满足或增长使用人工智能工具的人们的需求。

paras.en: That has driven up the value of Nvidia on the stock market, as well as its influence in the AI industry and the White House.
paras.zh: 这推高了英伟达在股市的价值，以及它在人工智能行业和白宫的影响力。

paras.en: Although tech stocks have in recent months been volatile and trending lower, when Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia because of his affairs, the company's stock fell by more than 30%.
paras.zh: 尽管科技股近几个月来一直波动并呈走低趋势，但当黄仁勋因事务辞去英伟达首席执行官一职后，该公司股价跌幅超过30%。

paras.en: Anxiety about the company's influence and ability to operate within the AI ecosystem without its famed executive appeared to take down shares of other tech companies, too.
paras.zh: 在没有著名高管的情况下，对该公司的影响力和在人工智能生态系统中运营的能力的担忧似乎也导致了其他科技公司的股价下跌。

paras.en: Huang was reinstated on Monday to his position as head of Nvidia, a move that US President Donald Trump said he told the company's board to take.
paras.zh: 周一，黄仁勋恢复了英伟达首席执行官的职位，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他已指示该公司董事会采取这一举措。

paras.en: The company's stock rallied on his reinstatement, as did several other tech stocks, but shares of Nvidia did not climb to where the company had been before being immersed in scandal.
paras.zh: 在他复职后，该公司的股价上涨，其他几只科技股也是如此，但英伟达的股价并未攀升至该公司陷入丑闻之前的水平。

paras.en: In the weeks ahead, Huang and the company he now runs again are facing multiple government agency investigations.
paras.zh: 未来几周，黄和他现在再次经营的公司将面临多项政府机构的调查。

paras.en: Huang and the chief legal officer of Nvidia are set to appear next for a closed-door briefing with the House Foreign Affairs Committee.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋和英伟达首席法律官接下来将出席众议院外交事务委员会的闭门简报会。

articles.title: Visit Carlisle Brake & Friction at CONEXPO

paras.zh: 参观 CONEXPO 上的 Carlisle Brake & Friction

paras.zh: Carlisle CBF 将在 2026 年 CONEXPO 上加入我们的 CentroMotion 系列，位于南厅二楼的 #S82219 展位，我们将在这里重点展示我们在精密工程制动系统方面的最新进展。

paras.en: Visitors will learn about our integrated combo park and service brake designed to deliver secure, high‑performance stopping capability; our new CBA50 Series service brake engineered for improved durability, efficiency, and serviceability in modern construction‑equipment platforms; our latest 1100 Series power valve with an electrohydraulic module and pedal that enhances control responsiveness; and our full lineup of EPD and N680, advanced friction‑material technologies tailored for a wide range of construction applications.
paras.zh: 参观者将了解我们的集成式停车和行车制动器组合，旨在提供安全、高性能的停车能力；我们的新型 CBA50 系列行车制动器旨在提高现代建筑设备平台的耐用性、效率和适用性；我们最新的 1100 系列动力阀配有电动液压模块和踏板，可增强控制响应能力；以及我们的全系列 EPD 和 N680，这是专为各种建筑应用量身定制的先进摩擦材料技术。

articles.title: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 recap

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.
paras.zh: 在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 重申了其作为北美最大的建筑贸易展的地位，吸引了来自全球 128 个国家的超过 140,000 名建筑专业人士。对于 CentroMotion 品牌 Carlisle Brake & Friction 来说，本周是展示创新、加强合作伙伴关系以及获得对建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来的宝贵见解的绝佳机会。在忙碌的一周中，与会者有机会与我们的专家交谈并观看我们制动系统的现场演示，以及我们为建筑行业提供的先进制动和传动摩擦解决方案。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is more than a trade show, it’s a barometer for where the industry is headed. Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 不仅仅是一个贸易展，它还是行业发展方向的晴雨表。主要趋势包括集成自主设备、先进的数字工具和可持续技术。展览面积超过 300 万平方英尺，参展商超过 2,000 家，与会者覆盖了遍布室内和室外空间的数英里展品。

paras.en: At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. Check out this video https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8 for more detail about our booth and featured products serving the market.
paras.zh: 在展会上，卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司重点介绍了其先进的制动系统和摩擦技术，旨在承受极端的工作循环和苛刻的非公路应用。与会者亲身体验了 CarlisleCBF 品牌的性能、质量和工程专业知识。 CentroMotion 展位是活动中心，团队欢迎 OEM 领导者和售后市场专家。这些互动不仅仅是展示我们的产品，它们还增强了关系并增加了我们团队对行业不断变化的需求的了解。请观看此视频 https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8，了解有关我们的展位和服务于市场的特色产品的更多详细信息。

paras.zh: • 专注于生产力、车队管理和作业现场可视性的数字工具

paras.zh: • 旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性的解决方案

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿式摩擦摩擦片生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩大空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场要求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。

paras.en: Looking for a friction products partner for your next off-highway equipment build? Fill out the form below to connect with the Carlisle Brake & Friction India team and discuss your project needs.
paras.zh: 正在为您的下一个非公路设备制造寻找摩擦产品合作伙伴？填写下面的表格，与卡莱尔制动和摩擦印度团队联系并讨论您的项目需求。

articles.title: Why the Right Car Accident Lawyer Changes the Outcome of a Claim
articles.author: Tyrepress Advertorial

paras.en: Why the Right Car Accident Lawyer Changes the Outcome of a Claim
paras.zh: 为什么合适的车祸律师会改变索赔结果

paras.en: A car crash can turn an ordinary day into months of medical appointments, insurance calls, and difficult decisions. In 2025, Missouri recorded 909 traffic fatalities, a 4.8% decrease from 2024. In the St. Louis region, 157 people died in traffic crashes that year, with 25% of those fatalities involving pedestrians or bicyclists. These figures show that serious collisions remain a concern even as roadway deaths continue to decline.
paras.zh: 一场车祸可能会让平凡的一天变成几个月的医疗预约、保险电话和艰难的决定。 2025 年，密苏里州共发生 909 起交通事故，比 2024 年减少 4.8%。圣路易斯地区当年有 157 人死于交通事故，其中 25% 的死亡人数涉及行人或骑自行车的人。这些数字表明，尽管道路死亡人数持续下降，但严重碰撞事故仍然令人担忧。

paras.en: For people dealing with injuries, vehicle damage, lost income, or other consequences after a crash, the claims process can feel just as challenging as the recovery itself. A car accident lawyer in St. Louis can help assess the circumstances, identify potentially responsible parties, handle insurer communications, and pursue compensation supported by the available evidence. When injured parties know how legal decisions can shape a claim, they can take an important step in determining what comes next.
paras.zh: 对于在车祸后遭受伤害、车辆损坏、收入损失或其他后果的人们来说，索赔过程可能与恢复本身一样具有挑战性。圣路易斯的车祸律师可以帮助评估情况，确定潜在的责任方，处理保险公司的沟通，并根据现有证据寻求赔偿。当受害方知道法律判决如何影响索赔时，他们可以在确定接下来发生的事情方面迈出重要的一步。

paras.en: Early Decisions Affect Available Evidence
paras.zh: 早期决定会影响现有证据

paras.en: Evidence often determines whether an insurance dispute ends quickly or requires further action. A lawyer examines the crash report, photographs, traffic signals, road conditions, vehicle damage, and witness accounts.
paras.zh: 证据通常决定保险纠纷是否迅速结束或需要采取进一步行动。律师检查事故报告、照片、交通信号、道路状况、车辆损坏和目击者证词。

paras.en: Physical evidence can disappear after repairs, weather changes, or vehicle storage. Legal counsel can request records promptly and preserve information that supports the claimant’s account.
paras.zh: 物理证据可能会在维修、天气变化或车辆存放后消失。法律顾问可以立即索取记录并保存支持索赔人账户的信息。

paras.en: Insurance companies also review recorded statements and social media posts. A claimant who speaks publicly without legal guidance can minimize symptoms, accept blame, or create inconsistencies that damage credibility.
paras.zh: 保险公司还会审查记录的报表和社交媒体帖子。在没有法律指导的情况下公开发表言论的索赔人可能会最小化症状、接受指责或制造出不一致的内容，从而损害可信度。

paras.en: Liability Requires More Than a Police Report
paras.zh: 责任需要的不仅仅是警方报告

paras.en: A police report provides useful information, but it does not resolve every issue in a civil claim. The report might omit witnesses, overlook road conditions, or provide limited detail about the collision.
paras.zh: 警方报告提供了有用的信息，但它并不能解决民事索赔中的所有问题。该报告可能会忽略目击者、忽视道路状况或提供有关碰撞的有限细节。

paras.en: A lawyer compares the report with photographs, medical records, vehicle damage, and witness testimony. That review helps establish how each driver acted before the crash and whether another factor contributed.
paras.zh: 律师将该报告与照片、医疗记录、车辆损坏和证人证词进行比较。该审查有助于确定每位驾驶员在事故发生前的行为以及是否有其他因素造成。

paras.en: - Comparative Fault Rules Cannot Be Ignored
paras.zh: - 对比故障规律不容忽视

paras.en: Missouri uses comparative fault rules. If a claimant shares responsibility, the final recovery can decrease according to that percentage. A clear liability record therefore affects the amount the claimant eventually receives.
paras.zh: 密苏里州使用比较过错规则。如果索赔人分担责任，最终赔偿额可能会根据该百分比减少。因此，清晰的责任记录会影响索赔人最终收到的金额。

paras.en: Medical Records Connect Injuries to Financial Losses
paras.zh: 医疗记录将伤害与经济损失联系起来

paras.en: A claim needs medical proof connecting the crash to the reported injuries. Treatment records, diagnostic results, physician notes, and follow-up appointments show the following:
paras.zh: 索赔需要将事故与报告的伤害联系起来的医学证明。治疗记录、诊断结果、医生笔记和后续预约显示以下内容：

paras.en: Consistent treatment also creates a reliable timeline. Gaps in care can lead an insurer to argue that the injury was minor, unrelated, or resolved sooner than the records indicate.
paras.zh: 一致的治疗也创造了可靠的时间表。护理方面的差距可能会导致保险公司辩称伤害较轻、无关或比记录显示的更早得到解决。

paras.en: Damages include more than emergency bills. A complete claim accounts for ongoing treatment, lost income, reduced work capacity, medication costs, transportation, and pain-related limits on ordinary activities. Each category requires supporting documentation.
paras.zh: 损失不仅仅包括紧急费用。完整的索赔包括持续治疗、收入损失、工作能力下降、药物费用、交通以及与疼痛相关的日常活动限制。每个类别都需要支持文档。

paras.en: Insurance Tactics Can Shift the Claim’s Value
paras.zh: 保险策略可以改变索赔的价值

paras.en: An insurer’s first settlement proposal rarely reflects every documented loss. This is because a carrier may evaluate only the early information available at that stage, which often excludes future care and the full extent of lost earnings. However, a lawyer calculates damages after reviewing medical progress and employment records. This process prevents a claimant from accepting payment before doctors understand the likely course of recovery.
paras.zh: 保险公司的第一份和解建议很少反映每一项有记录的损失。这是因为承运人可能仅评估该阶段可用的早期信息，这通常排除未来的护理和收入损失的全部范围。然而，律师会在审查医疗进展和就业记录后计算损害赔偿金。这一过程可以防止索赔人在医生了解可能的康复过程之前接受付款。

paras.en: Insurance adjusters also seek statements about prior injuries, current symptoms, and work limitations. Accurate answers matter, but speculation creates avoidable disputes. Legal guidance keeps communications focused on documented facts.
paras.zh: 保险理算员还寻求有关先前受伤、当前症状和工作限制的陈述。准确的答案很重要，但猜测会产生本可以避免的争议。法律指导使沟通重点关注记录在案的事实。

paras.en: A claim must follow applicable filing deadlines and procedural requirements. Missing a deadline can prevent a claimant from pursuing compensation, even when the evidence supports fault.
paras.zh: 索赔必须遵循适用的提交截止日期和程序要求。错过最后期限可能会阻止索赔人寻求赔偿，即使有证据支持过错。

paras.en: A lawyer tracks those dates while handling communications, records requests, settlement discussions, and court filings. This organization lets the claimant focus on medical care instead of managing demands from several parties.
paras.zh: 律师在处理通信、记录请求、和解讨论和法庭文件时跟踪这些日期。该组织让索赔人专注于医疗护理，而不是管理多方的需求。

paras.en: Local knowledge also helps counsel assess road conditions, traffic patterns, reporting practices, and court procedures in the St. Louis area. These details provide useful context during liability analysis and settlement negotiations.
paras.zh: 当地知识还有助于律师评估圣路易斯地区的道路状况、交通模式、报告做法和法庭程序。这些细节在责任分析和和解谈判期间提供了有用的背景。

paras.en: Settlement or Trial Requires Careful Timing
paras.zh: 和解或审判需要谨慎选择时机

paras.en: Most injury claims resolve through negotiation, but a settlement should follow a complete review of liability and damages. A lawyer evaluates the insurer’s position, identifies missing damages, and explains the financial effects of accepting a settlement.
paras.zh: 大多数伤害索赔可以通过谈判解决，但和解应在对责任和损害进行全面审查之后进行。律师评估保险公司的立场，确定缺失的损害赔偿，并解释接受和解的财务影响。

paras.en: If negotiations fail, the evidence gathered during the claim can support a lawsuit. A prepared case helps the claimant choose between a fair resolution and asking a court to decide disputed issues.
paras.zh: 如果谈判失败，索赔期间收集的证据可以支持诉讼。准备好的案件可以帮助原告在公平解决方案和要求法院裁决争议问题之间做出选择。

paras.en: The right lawyer changes a car accident claim by preserving evidence, testing liability, documenting medical losses, and resisting premature settlement pressure. A claimant should save photographs and records, follow medical instructions, avoid detailed insurer statements, and arrange a case review promptly.
paras.zh: 合适的律师可以通过保留证据、检验责任、记录医疗损失以及抵制过早和解压力来改变车祸索赔。索赔人应保存照片和记录，遵循医疗指示，避免保险公司提供详细的陈述，并立即安排案件审查。

paras.en: Early legal analysis helps locate missing proof before it disappears and identifies deadlines before they become obstacles. These steps give the claim a documented foundation and help the claimant choose between settlement and litigation.
paras.zh: 早期的法律分析有助于在丢失的证据消失之前找到它，并在它们成为障碍之前确定最后期限。这些步骤为索赔提供了书面依据，并帮助索赔人在和解和诉讼之间进行选择。
