paras.en: “I want people to feel small when they step into the gasholder, as they would in a church,” Wessely says of the launch production “In ALEPH, music, choreography, light and sculpture surround the audience from every direction. Bringing these artists together in a single work makes it a ritual rather than a traditional concert.”
paras.zh: “我希望人们在踏入储气罐时感到自己的渺小，就像在教堂里一样，”韦瑟利谈到此次发布会时说道，“在《阿莱夫》中，音乐、编舞、灯光和雕塑从各个方向围绕着观众。将这些艺术家聚集在一件作品中，使其成为一种仪式，而不是传统的音乐会。”

paras.en: In Planté’s mind, Gasometer’s programming and building is incomparable to anywhere else in the world. “This is not simply a venue opening. It is a statement of what live performance can become,” he proudly says. For the venue’s first five years, the show will run annually, with new acts expected to perform each time. Alongside the Royal Swedish Opera’s regular performances, Planté will be in charge of 10 nights of programming a year, alongside an additional 10 nights of co-production with the Opera. “For each of those nights, I really want to make them count. I want to programme historic moments,” he says.
paras.zh: 在 Planté 看来，Gasometer 的规划和建设是世界上任何其他地方都无法比拟的。 “这不仅仅是一个场地的开放。这是现场表演的一个宣言，”他自豪地说。在该场馆的前五年，该演出将每年举办一次，预计每次都会有新的表演。除了瑞典皇家歌剧院的定期演出外，普兰特还将负责每年 10 个晚上的节目编排，以及另外 10 个晚上与歌剧院的联合制作。 “对于每一晚，我真的想让它们变得有价值。我想记录历史性的时刻，”他说。

paras.en: He intends to ensure all fans who walk through the venue’s doors remember the performance they witnessed for a long time to come. “I would love to develop a unique format to invite artists to perform with the backing of an orchestra, which is often their goal.” He points to performances by Portishead, Little Simz and Loyle Carner, where having a backing orchestra served to elevate their work. He says he considers Nick Cave as a dream booking, and he hopes some day artists will release live performances of their albums recorded at Gasometer. While the venue will not be a standard stop for touring artists, it will be a place for those who want to push their creativity and try something new.
paras.zh: 他打算确保所有走进场馆大门的球迷在未来很长一段时间内都记住他们目睹的表演。 “我很想开发一种独特的形式来邀请艺术家在管弦乐队的支持下表演，这通常是他们的目标。”他提到了波蒂斯黑德、小西姆兹和洛伊尔·卡纳的表演，他们的伴奏管弦乐队有助于提升他们的作品。他说他认为 Nick Cave 是一个理想的预订，他希望有一天艺术家们能够在 Gasometer 录制他们的专辑进行现场表演。虽然该场地不会成为巡演艺术家的标准站点，但它将成为那些想要发挥创造力并尝试新事物的人的地方。

paras.en: It adds up to a bold new frontier for Europe’s music scene. Come March, Plante says he knows that the Gasometer’s impact will be impossible to ignore: “This will have some waves far beyond here, for sure.”
paras.zh: 它为欧洲音乐界开辟了一个大胆的新领域。到了三月，普兰特说他知道储气罐的影响将无法忽视：“肯定会在远处产生一些影响。”

articles.title: Molly Meldrum to Receive State Funeral as Kylie Minogue, Jimmy Barnes Lead Tributes
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Ian “Molly” Meldrum will be honored with a state funeral, as tributes pour in from across the music world for the Australian broadcaster and record producer, who died Monday (Nov. 23) in Melbourne at 83.
paras.zh: 伊恩·“莫莉”·梅尔德鲁姆 (Ian “Molly” Meldrum) 将于周一（11 月 23 日）在墨尔本去世，享年 83 岁，世界各地音乐界纷纷向这位澳大利亚广播公司兼唱片制作人表示哀悼。

paras.en: Kylie Minogue, who appeared on Meldrum’s Countdown as a teenager at the start of her career, remembered him as one of her earliest inspirations.
paras.zh: 凯莉·米洛 (Kylie Minogue) 十几岁时在职业生涯初期就出现在《梅尔德鲁姆倒计时》中，她记得他是她最早的灵感来源之一。

paras.en: “He championed so many Aussie artists and welcomed international artists to Australia in his own wonderful and inimitable way,” she wrote. “I’m so grateful for his unwavering love and support. Vale Molly. I’m going to turn the music up in your honour.”
paras.zh: “他支持如此多的澳大利亚艺术家，并以他自己美妙而独特的方式欢迎国际艺术家来到澳大利亚，”她写道。 “我非常感谢他坚定不移的爱和支持。Vale Molly。我要把音乐调大，以纪念你。”

paras.en: Jimmy Barnes offered the most complicated tribute, recalling that Meldrum was initially an adversary — “running the best music TV show in the country but insisting that we had to mime.” The relationship changed. “Molly exposed us to a huge music audience we could never have reached, and we were always thankful to him for that,” Barnes wrote on Instagram.
paras.zh: 吉米·巴恩斯 (Jimmy Barnes) 表达了最复杂的敬意，他回忆说，梅尔德鲁姆最初是一个对手——“经营着全国最好的音乐电视节目，但坚持要求我们必须模仿。”关系发生了变化。巴恩斯在 Instagram 上写道：“莫莉让我们接触到了我们永远无法接触到的大量音乐观众，为此我们一直感谢他。”

paras.en: Tina Arena, a longtime friend, posted a gallery of images. “I’m deeply saddened by the passing of Molly Meldrum, a man who made an incredible contribution to the music industry in Australia and abroad,” she wrote. “My deepest condolences go out to his family and friends.”
paras.zh: 蒂娜·阿雷纳（Tina Arena）是我的老朋友，她发布了一组图片。她写道：“我对莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆的去世深感悲痛，他为澳大利亚和海外的音乐产业做出了令人难以置信的贡献。” “我向他的家人和朋友表示最深切的哀悼。”

paras.en: Iva Davies of Icehouse wrote on X that Meldrum “was such a bright, larger-than-life figure in our Australian music scene for so many years with positive influence on so many careers via his work on Countdown, as a journalist, producer, advocate and friend.” He added: “Like the rest of the music community that owed so much to his support, the band and I are so thankful that Molly was a part of our lives and music.”
paras.zh: Icehouse 的伊娃·戴维斯 (Iva Davies) 在 X 上写道，梅尔德鲁姆“多年来在澳大利亚音乐界一直是一位如此聪明、具有传奇色彩的人物，通过他在 Countdown 中的工作，作为一名记者、制作人、倡导者和朋友，对许多职业产生了积极影响。”他补充道：“就像音乐界的其他成员一样，我和乐队都非常感谢他的支持，莫莉是我们生活和音乐的一部分。”

paras.en: Darren Hayes of Savage Garden wrote that he doesn’t “remember a day in my life without Molly Meldrum being a part of it.”
paras.zh: Savage Garden 的达伦·海耶斯 (Darren Hayes) 写道，他“不记得我生命中的哪一天没有莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆 (Molly Meldrum) 参与其中”。

paras.en: Jason Donovan called him “a truly unique character, a great Australian and one of this country’s greatest pioneers and ambassadors for music and entertainment.” He added: “He was loved, recognised and respected around the world for the extraordinary contribution he made to Australian music and the artists he championed. There will never be another quite like him.”
paras.zh: 杰森·多诺万称他为“一个真正独特的人物，一个伟大的澳大利亚人，也是这个国家最伟大的音乐和娱乐先驱和大使之一。”他补充道：“他因对澳大利亚音乐和他所支持的艺术家做出的非凡贡献而受到世界各地的爱戴、认可和尊重。永远不会有另一个人像他一样。”

paras.en: Michael Bublé called Meldrum “one of a kind.” Marcia Hines wrote: “Can’t believe that he has gone. I thank him for everything that he did for us all in the Australian music industry, and worldwide. Rest in peace, my friend.” Leo Sayer bid “a fond farewell to the wonderful, fun, crazy, knowledgeable, influential and irrepressible soul who will live on in all our memories as long as Rock ‘n Roll will.”
paras.zh: 迈克尔·布布尔 (Michael Bublé) 称梅尔德鲁姆为“独一无二”。马西娅·海因斯写道：“不敢相信他已经离开了。我感谢他为澳大利亚音乐界乃至全世界音乐界所做的一切。安息吧，我的朋友。” Leo Sayer 向“这个美妙、有趣、疯狂、知识渊博、有影响力和不可抑制的灵魂深情告别，只要摇滚乐将永远存在，他就会永远活在我们的记忆中。”

paras.en: Skyhooks, whom Meldrum helped turn into household names, wrote: “So sad to get the call this morning that Ian (Molly) Meldrum had passed away. Skyhooks-Molly-Countdown [were] the perfect fit. His love of Aussie music will be his legacy.” Human Nature remembered him as “such a huge presence in the Australian music industry” and “a great friend and supporter of so many up-and-coming bands and artists — ourselves included.”
paras.zh: 梅尔德鲁姆 (Meldrum) 帮助 Skyhooks 成为家喻户晓的名字，他写道：“今天早上接到伊恩 (莫莉) 梅尔德鲁姆 (Ian (Molly) Meldrum) 去世的电话，我感到非常难过。Skyhooks-Molly-Countdown 是完美的组合。他对澳大利亚音乐的热爱将成为他的遗产。” Human Nature 记得他是“澳大利亚音乐界的重要人物”和“许多崭露头角的乐队和艺术家（包括我们自己）的好朋友和支持者”。

paras.en: Kate Ceberano was among the first to post. “They don’t make em like that anymore,” she wrote. “My heart is aching today at the loss.”
paras.zh: 凯特·塞贝拉诺 (Kate Ceberano) 是最早发帖的人之一。 “他们不再让他们变成那样了，”她写道。 “今天我的心因为失去而感到痛苦。”

paras.en: Richard Wilkins, the veteran Australian entertainment reporter who spent decades competing with Meldrum for the same interviews, called him “completely irreplaceable” on Nova 96.9 Sydney’s Ricki-Lee & Tim on Monday morning. “The word legend and the word icon are thrown around fairly loosely, but he was both of those things,” Wilkins said. “He could pick a hit, and he could make a hit.”
paras.zh: 澳大利亚资深娱乐记者理查德·威尔金斯 (Richard Wilkins) 几十年来一直与梅尔德鲁姆竞争同样的采访，周一早上，他在 Nova 96.9 Sydney 的 Ricki-Lee & Tim 节目中称他“完全不可替代”。 “传奇这个词和偶像这个词的使用相当松散，但他就是这两件事，”威尔金斯说。 “他可以击中目标，也可以击出目标。”

paras.en: Wilkins recalled record labels sending the pair around the world with a rep “to make sure Molly didn’t lose another passport” — Meldrum’s tally eventually reached 13. He also shared a story from one of those trips, when Meldrum, handed a bio for a new artist at a record company office in New York, asked aloud, “Who the f*** is Madonna?” — only for the singer herself to reply, “And who the f*** are you?”
paras.zh: 威尔金斯回忆说，唱片公司派了两人带着一名代表环游世界，“以确保莫莉不会丢失另一本护照”——梅尔德鲁姆的总数最终达到了 13 件。他还分享了其中一次旅行的故事，当时梅尔德鲁姆在纽约一家唱片公司办公室递给一位新艺术家的简历，大声问道：“麦当娜到底是谁？” ——结果歌手本人回答道：“你到底是谁？”

paras.en: The Australian Recording Industry Association said Meldrum had spent six decades convincing a country raised on British and American records that its own artists could stand alongside the greats. “All of us at ARIA are heartbroken,” chief executive Annabelle Herd said. “It is impossible to imagine what Australian music would look like without Molly’s long and storied career. He shaped the music taste of a generation of Australians and gave so much of himself for the good of Australian artists, for which our whole industry is eternally grateful.”
paras.zh: 澳大利亚唱片工业协会表示，梅尔德鲁姆花了六十年的时间说服这个以英国和美国唱片为基础的国家，相信自己的艺术家可以与伟大的艺术家并肩作战。 “ARIA 的所有人都心碎了，”首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 说道。 “很难想象如果没有莫莉漫长而传奇的职业生涯，澳大利亚音乐会是什么样子。他塑造了一代澳大利亚人的音乐品味，并为澳大利亚艺术家的利益付出了很多，我们整个行业对此永远感激不已。”

paras.en: Herd noted Meldrum had used his 2014 ARIA Hall of Fame induction speech to urge viewers to get behind Australian acts. “It is up to all of us to keep fighting the good fight in his honour,” she said.
paras.zh: 赫德指出，梅尔德鲁姆在 2014 年 ARIA 名人堂入职演讲中敦促观众支持澳大利亚的表演。她说：“我们所有人都有责任继续为他的荣誉而战。”

paras.en: Meldrum presented Countdown on the ABC from 1974 to 1987, giving ABBA, Madonna and Blondie their first Australian hits. He was inducted into the ARIA Hall of Fame alongside the show in 2014, the first inductees who were not recording artists.
paras.zh: Meldrum 从 1974 年到 1987 年在 ABC 播出了《Countdown》，为 ABBA、麦当娜和 Blondie 带来了他们在澳大利亚的第一首热门歌曲。 2014 年，他随演出一起入选 ARIA 名人堂，成为第一批非唱片艺术家入选者。

paras.en: He died at Epworth Hospital in Richmond after a long illness. “He was deeply loved by his long-term partner, Yan Wongngam, his family and all who knew him,” his family said in a statement. The family has requested privacy.
paras.zh: 他在长期患病后在里士满的埃普沃斯医院去世。他的家人在一份声明中表示：“他深受他的长期伴侣 Yan Wongngam、他的家人以及所有认识他的人的喜爱。”家人要求保密。

articles.title: Robert Eggers Says He’s “Eager” to Take a Break From Horror Genre After ‘Werwulf’
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: After more than five years of bringing monsters to life on screen, Robert Eggers admits he needs a break from the horror genre.
paras.zh: 在五年多的时间里，罗伯特·艾格斯将怪物搬上银幕，他承认自己需要从恐怖片中解脱出来。

paras.en: During a recent Q&A in Mexico, the filmmaker said, “I’m eager not to continue purposely doing Robert Eggers’ House of Horror.”
paras.zh: 最近在墨西哥举行的一次问答中，这位电影制片人表示，“我不想继续刻意地拍摄罗伯特·艾格斯的《恐怖屋》。”

paras.en: His comments come ahead of the release of Werwulf on Christmas Day. The film, starring Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Lily-Rose Depp and Willem Dafoe, is set in 14th-century England and follows a town haunted by a beast that threatens a man (Taylor-Johnson) and his family.
paras.zh: 他的评论是在《狼人杀》圣诞节上映之前发表的。这部电影由亚伦·泰勒-约翰逊、莉莉-罗丝·德普和威廉·达福主演，故事发生在 14 世纪的英国，讲述了一座被野兽出没的小镇，威胁着一名男子（泰勒-约翰逊饰）及其家人的故事。

paras.en: “I don’t need to do The Mummy or The Phantom of the Opera. Not to say that I won’t, but I think I need a break,” Eggers added. The director previously tackled witches in 2015’s The Witch, sea creatures in 2019’s The Lighthouse and vampires in 2024’s Nosferatu.
paras.zh: “我不需要演《木乃伊》或《歌剧魅影》。并不是说我不会，但我认为我需要休息一下，”艾格斯补充道。这位导演此前曾在 2015 年的《女巫》中处理过女巫，在 2019 年的《灯塔》中处理过海洋生物，在 2024 年的《诺斯费拉图》中处理过吸血鬼。

paras.en: Robert Eggers, who has been praised as a modern icon in horror filmmaking, also addressed the new-wave concept of “elevated horror” within cinema.
paras.zh: 被誉为恐怖电影制作现代偶像的罗伯特·艾格斯（Robert Eggers）也谈到了电影中“高度恐怖”的新浪潮概念。

paras.en: “There’s always been horror movies that don’t suck and there’s always been horror movies that are actually probing what darkness is in humankind, and even some of them that have been profound throughout the ages,” he explained. “But what you guys are talking about is something that I think really started with [2014’s] It Follows. Although Ti West was doing this kind of work before then.”
paras.zh: “总有一些恐怖电影并不糟糕，也总有一些恐怖电影实际上在探索人类的黑暗面，甚至其中一些在各个时代都具有深刻的意义，”他解释道。 “但我认为你们谈论的事情实际上是从 [2014 年]《It Follows》开始的。尽管 Ti West 在那之前就做过这类工作。”

paras.en: “There’s been a whole lot of filmmakers that have wanted to make personal films, really talented filmmakers with unique voices, and have realized that they can get financing if they do it as a genre film,” the filmmaker continued. “And I think that that’s kind of what this is: people who are telling personal stories with unique voices but are doing it through genre. Not to say that James Wan movies [Insidious, The Conjuring] haven’t worked. They’ve been great and also successful. There’s definitely a hunger for horror in general over the past 10 years. But does elevated horror exist? It does. It does because people say so.”
paras.zh: “有很多电影制作人想要制作个人电影，非常有才华的电影制作人具有独特的声音，并且已经意识到，如果他们将其作为类型电影来制作，他们可以获得融资，”电影制作人继续说道。 “我认为这就是这样的：人们用独特的声音讲述个人故事，但通过类型来讲述。并不是说温子仁的电影《潜伏》、《招魂》没有成功。它们很伟大，也很成功。在过去的十年里，人们普遍对恐怖有一定的渴望。但是高度恐怖存在吗？确实存在。它确实存在，因为人们这么说。”

paras.en: While enjoying his “break” from horror, Eggers is next taking on an adaptation of William Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet for Focus Features.
paras.zh: 在享受从恐怖中解脱出来的同时，埃格斯接下来将拍摄一部根据威廉·莎士比亚的《罗密欧与朱丽叶》改编的焦点电影。

paras.en: He previously shared during a post-screening Q&A at Beyond Fest in September, “I was doing something else. But what happened was, after Werwulf, I was writing another horror movie, and it got so dark again, and I was like, ‘I need a break. So, I’ll do something about two teenagers killing themselves.'”
paras.zh: 他之前在 9 月份 Beyond Fest 的映后问答中分享道，“我在做别的事情。但发生的事情是，在《狼人杀》之后，我正在写另一部恐怖电影，天又变得如此黑暗，我想，‘我需要休息一下。所以，我会做一些关于两个青少年自杀的事情。’”

articles.title: Delta Sets New Business Class Offerings With Collectible Missoni Kits, Wagyu Burgers and Blanton’s Bourbon on Board
articles.author: Tim Chan

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Missoni pillows, a dark chocolate square and a pour of Blanton’s single-barrel bourbon isn’t just reserved for hotel turn-down service anymore — it’s also the new standard for Delta travelers flying in the airline’s Delta One cabin.
paras.zh: 米索尼枕头、一块黑巧克力和一杯布兰顿单桶波本威士忌不再只是酒店夜床服务的专用品，它也是达美航空达美一号客舱乘客的新标准。

paras.en: The U.S. airline unveiled its so-called “next era” of Delta One last month, with food and hospitality offerings that aim to position Delta as the “industry’s most premium end-to-end travel experience,” according to a release.
paras.zh: 据一份新闻稿称，这家美国航空公司上个月推出了所谓的“下一个时代”的达美航空，提供食品和酒店服务，旨在将达美航空定位为“业界最优质的端到端旅行体验”。

paras.en: The new offerings include a reimagined Delta One menu, with a wagyu brioche burger among the highlights, along with a Hong Kong-style sea bass, Japanese grilled salmon and a “seasonally rotating” risotto dish, all served on new Delta-branded tableware. The airline is also touting its “fresh cracked pepper service,” with flight attendants coming by with a pepper grinder similar to top restaurants and steakhouses.
paras.zh: 新菜品包括重新设计的达美一号菜单，亮点包括和牛奶油蛋卷汉堡、港式鲈鱼、日式烤三文鱼和“季节性轮换”烩饭，所有菜肴均采用全新达美品牌餐具提供。该航空公司还宣传其“新鲜胡椒服务”，空乘人员会带着类似于顶级餐厅和牛排馆的胡椒研磨机过来。

paras.en: Dessert now includes the passenger-favorite ice cream cart, with the added option of a fruit sorbet paired with a splash of Taittinger Champagne. And the wines and spirits list has been fully updated with sommelier-approved bottles, including a Silver Oak Cabernet Sauvignon from Napa, which often retails for upwards of $200 in stores.
paras.zh: 甜点现在包括乘客最喜欢的冰淇淋车，还可以选择水果冰糕搭配泰亭哲香槟。葡萄酒和烈酒清单也已全面更新，加入了侍酒师认可的葡萄酒，其中包括来自纳帕的银橡树赤霞珠葡萄酒，该酒在商店的零售价通常高达 200 美元以上。

paras.en: Travelers can now also request Blanton’s Single Barrel Bourbon on board, with the beloved Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey served in mini versions of its iconic decanter-style glass bottles with horse and jockey stopper. New Delta One flights to and from Tokyo-Haneda airport, meantime, will have a sake program designed by renowned sake brewer Dassai 45 from Japan’s Yamaguchi Prefecture. The menu on the U.S. to Japan flights will also feature regional cuisine designed in collaboration with Michelin-starred chef, Norio Ueno.
paras.zh: 旅客现在还可以在机上享用布兰顿单桶波本威士忌，将深受喜爱的肯塔基纯波本威士忌装在其标志性醒酒器式玻璃瓶的迷你版本中，并配有马和骑师塞子。与此同时，达美一号往返东京羽田机场的新航班将提供由日本山口县著名清酒酿造商 Dassai 45 设计的清酒计划。美国飞往日本的航班上的菜单还将包括与米其林星级厨师 Norio Ueno 合作设计的当地美食。

paras.en: The most visible upgrades begin as Delta One customers arrive to their seats. While Delta’s next-generation Delta One suites will start rolling out next year, with longer lie-flat seats, larger TV screens and even a glasses hook, the current suites feature new amenity kits from Missoni along with a mini Missoni pillow and compression socks from Bombas. That’s in addition to the existing Missoni bedding and an over-the-seat mattress pad which adds about a quarter-inch of extra cushioning.
paras.zh: 最明显的升级从达美一号乘客到达座位时开始。达美航空的下一代达美一号套房将于明年开始推出，配备更长的平躺式座椅、更大的电视屏幕，甚至还有眼镜钩，但目前的套房配备了 Missoni 的全新洗漱用品套件、迷你 Missoni 枕头和 Bombas 的压缩袜。除此之外，现有的 Missoni 床上用品和座垫床垫还增加了约四分之一英寸的额外缓冲效果。

paras.en: The amenity kits have already drawn comparisons to KLM’s keepsake Delft Blue ceramic houses as “in the know” collectibles for frequent fliers. Delta says it’s working with Missoni to release different prints each season, following the vein of the Italian fashion house’s runway collections each year (the Missoni-print pillow is not a take-home accessory unfortunately).
paras.zh: 这些洗漱包已经被拿来与荷航的纪念品代尔夫特蓝陶瓷房子进行比较，作为常旅客的“知情”收藏品。达美航空表示，它正在与 Missoni 合作，每一季都会推出不同的印花，遵循这家意大利时装屋每年的秀场系列的脉络（不幸的是，Missoni 印花枕头不是带回家的配饰）。

paras.en: Delta says the new enhancements were “informed by two decades of customer insights” and part of the airline’s larger $1 billion investment into upgrading its fleet.
paras.zh: 达美航空表示，新的增强功能是“基于二十年的客户洞察”，也是该航空公司用于升级机队的 10 亿美元投资的一部分。

paras.en: Stephanie Laster, Delta’s Managing Director of Onboard Experience, likens it to a “hotel and restaurant [experience] in the sky,” noting that a number of hours were spent perfecting even the tiniest details, like “getting the hot towel right with the temperature and moisture and consistency,” to selecting the “right whipped cream at altitude for our ice cream sundaes.”
paras.zh: 达美航空机上体验董事总经理斯蒂芬妮·拉斯特(Stephanie Laster)将其比作“空中酒店和餐厅[体验]”，并指出，我们花了数小时来完善最微小的细节，例如“根据温度、湿度和稠度调整热毛巾”，以及“在高海拔地区为我们的冰淇淋圣代选择合适的生奶油”。

paras.en: The Delta One Wagyu burger, meantime, came from the success of the Delta One Burger in Delta One Lounges across the U.S., and from customers craving some “comfort food” in the air. And the Champagne Sorbet offers a lighter, dairy-free addition to the dessert cart. As for the Blanton’s offering: a Delta rep says whiskey is Delta’s top-consumed spirit category, and after doing customer research on various brands, Blanton’s was rated “most-premium” of all the bourbons surveyed.
paras.zh: 与此同时，达美一号和牛汉堡源自达美一号汉堡在美国各地达美一号休息室的​​成功，以及渴望在空中享用一些“舒适食物”的顾客。香槟冰糕为甜点车提供了更清淡、不含乳制品的补充。至于布兰顿的产品：达美航空的一位代表表示，威士忌是达美航空消费最多的烈酒类别，在对各种品牌进行客户研究后，布兰顿的威士忌被评为所有接受调查的波本威士忌中“最优质”的。

paras.en: Laster says non-drinkers will also have increased options, including new mocktail creations. And with flyers valuing flexibility more and more, Delta has rolled out a “Lighter Later” option, with the ability to pre-select meals that fit your diet (I.e. gluten-free dishes or protein-added salads) and even skip a full breakfast in favor of a to-go coffee and croissant, just before landing (all the better to get some extra shut eye).
paras.zh: 拉斯特表示，不喝酒的人也将有更多的选择，包括新的无酒精鸡尾酒。随着乘客越来越看重灵活性，达美航空推出了“稍后再清淡”选项，可以预先选择适合您饮食的餐食（即无麸质菜肴或添加蛋白质的沙拉），甚至可以在着陆前跳过全套早餐，转而享用外带咖啡和羊角面包（这样可以多睡一会儿）。

paras.en: ▶ Priority boarding and free checked bag
paras.zh: ▶ 优先登机和免费托运行李

paras.en: The new overhaul has launched on transoceanic Delta One routes departing from Los Angeles International Airport, and will expand across the full global network in 2027. As for what passengers in premium economy and economy can expect? Laster says the goal is to provide a “premium for all” experience when flying Delta, with the airline hoping to eventually unveil upgrades to the rear cabins as well.
paras.zh: 新的检修已在从洛杉矶国际机场出发的达美一号跨洋航线上启动，并将于 2027 年扩展到整个全球网络。至于豪华经济舱和经济舱的乘客可以期待什么？拉斯特表示，达美航空的目标是为所有人提供“优质”的飞行体验，该航空公司希望最终也能推出对后舱的升级。

paras.en: “Luxury is about having the experience designed around you — today’s premium traveler values choice as much as quality,” says Kristen Manion Taylor, SVP – Brand Experience, in a release. “These enhancements offer greater flexibility, ensuring every Delta One customer can enjoy the journey in the way that suits them best.”
paras.zh: 品牌体验高级副总裁克里斯汀·曼尼恩·泰勒 (Kristen Manion Taylor) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“奢华就是拥有为您量身打造的体验，当今的高端旅行者不仅重视品质，还重视选择。” “这些增强功能提供了更大的灵活性，确保每位达美一号客户都能以最适合他们的方式享受旅程。”

articles.title: ‘You Can See Everything’ Crosses $100M Globally, Becomes First Doc to Hit 1M Letterboxd Watches
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: You Can See Everything continues visualizing box office success at a level that puts it in elite company as a documentary.
paras.zh: 《你可以看到一切》继续以纪录片的形式将票房成功可视化，使其跻身精英公司之列。

paras.en: Focusing on disgraced Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes‘ life in the lead-up to her prison sentence, A24‘s film surpassed $100 million globally over the weekend, a rare feat for any documentary. After opening Oct. 16 in North America, directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim‘s three-hour feature has grossed $93.4 million domestically over its six weekends in release and has more recently been rolling out in international markets. The movie has continued to experience sellout screenings after hitting theaters this weekend in such territories as Australia, the U.K. and Scandinavia, with Sony Pictures handling distribution in some international markets.
paras.zh: A24 的这部影片聚焦于名誉扫地的 Theranos 创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯 (Elizabeth Holmes) 在入狱前的生活，周末全球票房突破 1 亿美元，这对于任何纪录片来说都是罕见的壮举。由内森·菲尔德 (Nathan Fielder) 和兰斯·奥本海姆 (Lance Oppenheim) 执导的这部时长三小时的故事片于 10 月 16 日在北美上映后，在上映的六个周末内已在国内获得了 9,340 万美元的票房收入，最近又在国际市场上推出。这部电影本周末在澳大利亚、英国和斯堪的纳维亚半岛等地区上映后，票房继续爆满，部分国际市场的发行由索尼影业负责。

paras.en: Over the weekend, You Can See Everything also became the first documentary film to have been watched by one million Letterboxd members. It becomes the 19th movie released in 2026 to join the “One Million Watched Club,” and with its 4.61 average Letterboxd rating, it is the second-highest-rated feature to hit the milestone, behind only 12 Angry Men with 4.63. You Can See Everything is the highest-rated 2026 film and the second-highest-rated documentary ever, trailing only Stop Making Sense on the social platform.
paras.zh: 上周末，《你可以看到一切》也成为第一部被 100 万 Letterboxd 会员观看的纪录片。它成为 2026 年上映的第 19 部加入“百万观看俱乐部”的电影，其 Letterboxd 平均评分为 4.61，是达到这一里程碑的第二高评分影片，仅次于《愤怒的十二人》的 4.63 分。 《你可以看到一切》是 2026 年收视率最高的电影，也是有史以来收视率第二高的纪录片，在社交平台上仅次于《Stop Making Sense》。

paras.en: Among the box office achievements for You Can See Everything include opening with $15.6 million in its debut frame to register the second-biggest domestic launch for a non-music documentary, behind 2004’s Fahrenheit 9/11. The Holmes documentary also scored the highest-grossing domestic opening weekend for a release in fewer than 1,000 theaters since 2006’s Borat. You Can See Everything went on become the first documentary to reach No. 1 domestically in its third weekend of release.
paras.zh: 《你可以看到一切》的票房成就包括首映票房 1,560 万美元，成为国内首映票房第二高的非音乐纪录片，仅次于 2004 年的《华氏 9/11》。这部福尔摩斯纪录片还创下了自 2006 年的《波拉特》以来在不到 1,000 家影院上映的国内首映周末票房最高的纪录。 《你可以看到一切》成为首部在上映第三周就登上国内排行榜第一名的纪录​​片。

paras.en: The movie remains the second-highest-grossing domestic non-music documentary, with only Fahrenheit 9/11 and its $119.1 million cume to beat.
paras.zh: 这部电影仍然是国内非音乐纪录片票房第二高的影片，仅次于《华氏 9/11》及其 1.191 亿美元的票房收入。

paras.en: You Can See Everything stands as a major Oscar contender as awards season heats up. The Hollywood Reporter critic Angie Han called it “smart, funny and full of surprises,” and it holds a 97 critics score on Rotten Tomatoes.
paras.zh: 随着颁奖季的升温，《你可以看到一切》成为奥斯卡的主要竞争者。 《好莱坞报道》评论家安吉·汉 (Angie Han) 称其“聪明、有趣且充满惊喜”，烂番茄评分为 97 分。

paras.en: “It was sometimes a tense environment,” cinematographer David Bolen recalled about the shoot during a recent screening at Camerimage. Bolen noted that he would exchange pleasantries with Holmes and partner Billy Evans, but that was generally the extent of their conversations: “I really tried to stay out of the situation as much as possible. Sometimes it would get tense, and you see in the office scene, it gets a little bit tense, and [I would] just try to be quiet and polite and get the cameras out.”
paras.zh: “有时环境很紧张，”电影摄影师 David Bolen 在 Camerimage 最近的一次放映中回忆起这次拍摄。博伦指出，他会与福尔摩斯和合伙人比利·埃文斯寒暄，但这通常是他们谈话的范围：“我真的试图尽可能地置身事外。有时会变得紧张，你在办公室场景中看到，它会变得有点紧张，[我会]只是尽量保持安静和礼貌，然后把摄像机拿出来。”

articles.title: How Asian countries are looking to prop up markets as AI downturn sinks stocks

paras.en: South Korea, China and Taiwan have introduced new measures aimed at supporting their respective markets, as a tech-fueled sell-off in the region spills into another week.
paras.zh: 韩国、中国和台湾推出了旨在支持各自市场的新措施，因为该地区科技股引发的抛售潮将持续到下周。

paras.en: On Sunday, South Korea's finance ministry said it would prepare its securities-market stabilization fund for immediate activation. The fund, reportedly established in 2020 during the Covid-19 pandemic by financial firms and other institutions seeks to support markets during sharp downturns and is valued at 10.76 trillion won (nearly $8 billion).
paras.zh: 周日，韩国财政部表示将准备立即启动证券市场稳定基金。据报道，该基金于 2020 年 Covid-19 大流行期间由金融公司和其他机构设立，旨在在市场急剧低迷时期为市场提供支持，估值为 10.76 万亿韩元（近 80 亿美元）。

paras.en: The government also plans to relax listed companies' daily share-buyback order limits for three months, starting Nov. 24 and start a "special intensive monitoring period" to prevent illegal short-selling. Regulators will also track margin lending and forced liquidations.
paras.zh: 政府还计划从11月24日起，放宽上市公司每日股票回购指令限制，为期三个月，并启动“特别密集监控期”，以防止非法卖空。监管机构还将跟踪保证金贷款和强制清算。

paras.en: South Korean stocks have seen wild swings over 2026 as investors piled into, then fled from its two tech heavyweights, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, both critical companies in the AI supply chain. The benchmark Kospi index is deep in bear territory, down more than 46% from its June high.
paras.zh: 韩国股市在 2026 年经历了剧烈波动，投资者纷纷买入然后逃离韩国两大科技巨头三星电子和 SK 海力士，这两家公司都是人工智能供应链中的关键公司。基准 Kospi 指数深陷熊市，较 6 月高点下跌逾 46%。

paras.en: The ministry said that it "assessed that volatility in domestic and international stock markets has significantly increased recently due to internal and external uncertainties surrounding the global AI and semiconductor industries, as well as U.S. interest rate hikes," according to a Google translation of the release in Korean.
paras.zh: 根据韩语版本的谷歌翻译，该部门表示，“由于全球人工智能和半导体行业的内部和外部不确定性以及美国加息，最近国内外股市的波动性显着增加”。

paras.en: However, Seoul also said that the mid-to-long-term growth expectations for the AI industry remain intact, and that "excessive anxiety is not a concern."
paras.zh: 不过，首尔也表示，对人工智能产业的中长期增长预期保持不变，“过度焦虑并不令人担忧”。

paras.en: Taiwan, which is also exposed to the AI industry through Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company and other tech firms, has also moved to rein in market volatility.
paras.zh: 台湾也通过台积电和其他科技公司涉足人工智能行业，也已采取措施控制市场波动。

paras.en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission announced Friday that short selling below the closing price was "completely prohibited," while making it an exception if used for hedging purposes by securities and futures firms.
paras.zh: 台湾金融监督管理委员会周五宣布，“完全禁止”低于收盘价的卖空行为，但证券和期货公司用于对冲目的的卖空行为除外。

paras.en: "Investors must not sell listed (OTC) stocks or Taiwan Depositary Receipts at a price lower than the closing price of the previous trading day," the FSC said, according to a Google translation of the statement in Chinese.
paras.zh: 根据该声明的谷歌中文翻译，金管会表示：“投资者不得以低于前一交易日收盘价的价格出售上市（OTC）股票或台湾存托凭证。”

paras.en: Margin requirements for short selling will also be increased, and applications from securities firms to issue warrants for listing will be suspended, as the regulator aims to curb speculative activity.
paras.zh: 由于监管机构旨在遏制投机活动，卖空的保证金要求也将提高，证券公司发行上市权证的申请将暂停。

paras.en: In a similar move to Seoul, Taipei encouraged firms to buy back stocks, adding that the purchases will be included in the companies' environmental, social and governance scores if completed between the fourth quarter of 2026 and the first quarter of 2027.
paras.zh: 与首尔类似，台北鼓励企业回购股票，并补充说，如果在 2026 年第四季度至 2027 年第一季度之间完成，回购将计入公司的环境、社会和治理评分中。

paras.en: The island's stock market is heavily dominated by its tech industry, most notably, chip manufacturing giant TSMC. The stock fell 15% last week, while the index dropped 17.5%.
paras.zh: 该岛的股市主要由科技行业主导，尤其是芯片制造巨头台积电。该股上周下跌 15%，而该指数下跌 17.5%。

paras.en: While South Korea and Taiwan are looking to curb speculative trading to arrest the slide in their markets, Beijing is looking to encourage more leverage-based buying.
paras.zh: 虽然韩国和台湾正在寻求遏制投机交易以阻止市场下滑，但北京方面正在寻求鼓励更多基于杠杆的购买。

paras.en: The Shanghai Stock Exchange said on Sunday that exchanges in Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing will cut the minimum margin ratio for margin-financed stock purchases to 80% from 100%, starting Nov. 30. That means investors will be able to borrow more for their stock market bets.
paras.zh: 上海证券交易所周日表示，自 11 月 30 日起，上海、深圳和北京的交易所将把融资融券购买股票的最低保证金比例从 100% 下调至 80%。这意味着投资者将能够借入更多资金来押注股市。

paras.en: The Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges also announced fee cuts, while Shenzhen proposed a market-making mechanism for its ChiNext board. The steps will help inject more liquidity into the market that has also born the brunt of the souring in tech and AI trade, with the benchmark CSI 300 index closing lower for 14 of the past 15 weeks.
paras.zh: 上海和深圳交易所也宣布降费，深圳交易所则提出了创业板做市机制。这些举措将有助于向市场注入更多流动性，该市场也首当其冲受到科技和人工智能贸易恶化的影响，基准沪深 300 指数在过去 15 周中有 14 周收低。

paras.en: Seoul's markets led losses in the region, with the Kospi down over 3.26%. Smaller losses were seen in mainland China's CSI 300, which declined 0.71%. The Taiwan Weighted Index, however, reversed earlier losses to gain over 2% on Monday.
paras.zh: 首尔股市领跌该地区，综合指数下跌超过 3.26%。中国大陆沪深300指数跌幅较小，下跌0.71%。然而，台湾加权指数周一扭转了早些时候的跌势，上涨超过 2%。

articles.title: Investors gives a thumbs down to Tata Steel-APL Apollo $1.67 billion deal, plunging shares

paras.en: Tata Steel, one of the world's leading steel producers, on Monday said it will buy a 26.4% stake in India's largest structural steel pipe and tube maker, APL Apollo, for 155.1 billion rupees ($1.67 billion).
paras.zh: 全球领先的钢铁生产商之一塔塔钢铁公司周一表示，将以 1551 亿卢比（16.7 亿美元）收购印度最大的结构钢管制造商 APL Apollo 26.4% 的股份。

paras.en: The acquisition will boost Tata Steel's downstream integration to around 53% from 35%, the company said in a stock exchange filing. That will lead to more value addition, improved product mix, and greater exposure to higher-margin downstream segments, it said.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份证券交易所文件中表示，此次收购将使塔塔钢铁的下游整合率从 35% 提高到 53% 左右。该公司表示，这将带来更多的附加值、改善的产品组合以及更多地接触利润率更高的下游领域。

paras.en: Investors reacted negatively to the deal, with shares of Tata Steel sliding over 9% on Monday, while APL Apollo's stock crashed more than 19%.
paras.zh: 投资者对该交易反应消极，周一塔塔钢铁公司股价下跌超过 9%，而 APL Apollo 股价则暴跌超过 19%。

paras.en: While the deal is likely to be positive in the long term, the complex structure and lack of clarity have rattled investors, Deven Choksey, founder and managing director of wealth management firm DRChoksey FinServ, told CNBC.
paras.zh: 财富管理公司 DRChoksey FinServ 的创始人兼董事总经理德文·乔克西 (Deven Choksey) 告诉 CNBC，虽然从长远来看，这笔交易可能是积极的，但其复杂的结构和缺乏清晰度让投资者感到不安。

paras.en: As per Tata Steel, before acquiring APL Apollo, it will sell its steel tubes business and Tata Steel Colors to APL Apollo for 280 billion rupees. "APL Apollo will initially fund the acquisition through a mix of acquisition financing and subsequently replace the debt with long-term capitalization," Tata Steel said.
paras.zh: 塔塔钢铁公司表示，在收购APL Apollo之前，塔塔钢铁公司将以2800亿卢比的价格将其钢管业务和塔塔钢铁颜色业务出售给APL Apollo。塔塔钢铁表示：“APL Apollo 最初将通过多种收购融资方式为此次收购提供资金，随后以长期资本化取代债务。”

paras.en: "The deal is appearing very complex," said Choksey, adding that minority investors have not been given any clarity or taken into consideration while signing this deal.
paras.zh: 乔克西说：“这笔交易看起来非常复杂。”他补充说，在签署这笔交易时，少数投资者没有得到任何明确说明或考虑在内。

paras.en: Tata Steel will hold an investor call, post-market hours on Monday.
paras.zh: 塔塔钢铁将于周一盘后时间举行投资者电话会议。

paras.en: APL Apollo said after the deal it plans to more than double the downstream capacity to 15.5 million tons from the current 7.5 million tons, making it a leading global downstream steel firm.
paras.zh: APL Apollo表示，交易完成后，计划将下游产能从目前的750万吨增加一倍以上，达到1550万吨，成为全球领先的下游钢铁公司。

paras.en: This capacity addition will be completed by 2035 and would include around 9 million tons per annum of steel tubes and around 6.5 million tons per annum of color-coated products, as per Tata Steel.
paras.zh: 据塔塔钢铁公司称，这一新增产能将于 2035 年完成，其中包括每年约 900 万吨钢管和每年约 650 万吨彩涂产品。

paras.en: Tata Steel will acquire a stake from existing shareholders of APL Apollo for 2,100 rupees per share and will also make an open offer to acquire an additional 26% stake for 2,301.40 rupees a piece.
paras.zh: 塔塔钢铁将以每股 2,100 卢比的价格从 APL Apollo 现有股东手中收购股份，并将提出公开要约，以每股 2,301.40 卢比的价格收购额外 26% 的股份。

paras.en: If the open offer is successful, Tata Steel would get a controlling stake of 52.38% in APL Apollo. World's second-largest steel maker ArcelorMittal was also reportedly in the fray to acquire APL Apollo.
paras.zh: 如果公开发售成功，塔塔钢铁将获得APL Apollo 52.38%的控股权。据报道，全球第二大钢铁制造商安赛乐米塔尔也参与了收购 APL Apollo 的竞争。

paras.en: The acquisition of APL Apollo would "create a downstream powerhouse for the future" that will serve the growing Indian market, T V Narendran, chief executive and managing director of Tata Steel, said in the release.
paras.zh: 塔塔钢铁公司首席执行官兼董事总经理T V Narendran在新闻稿中表示，收购APL Apollo将“为未来打造一个下游巨头”，为不断增长的印度市场提供服务。

paras.en: Tata Steel, which has an annual crude steel capacity of over 35 million tons per annum, is one of the world's most geographically diversified steel producers with presence across India, Europe and Thailand.
paras.zh: 塔塔钢铁公司的粗钢年产能超过 3500 万吨，是全球地域最多元化的钢铁生产商之一，业务遍及印度、欧洲和泰国。

articles.title: S&P 500 futures rebound sharply to rise 2%, kick-starting shortened week after tech rout: Live updates

paras.en: U.S. equity futures bounced on Monday, as a shortened week on Wall Street got underway after all three major averages ended Friday in correction territory.
paras.zh: 美国股指期货周一反弹，三大主要股指周五均收于回调区域后，华尔街开始缩短一周。

paras.en: Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 745 points, or 1.55%. S&P 500 futures added 2.16%, and Nasdaq-100 futures rose 3.03%.
paras.zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 745 点，即 1.55%。标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 2.16%，纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 3.03%。

paras.en: In Asia, markets closed mostly lower Monday, as the sell-off in the region's tech names extended from last week.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，周一市场收盘大多走低，该地区科技股的抛售延续上周。

paras.en: South Korea's Kospi fell 3.31% to 4,708.54, while Australia's S&P/ASX 200 dropped 0.26%, declining for an eighth straight session, to end at 8,570.6.
paras.zh: 韩国综合指数下跌 3.31%，至 4,708.54 点；澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.26%，连续第八个交易日下跌，收于 8,570.6 点。

paras.en: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index was down 0.15% in its final hour of trade, while mainland China's CSI 300 ended flat at 3,958.29.
paras.zh: 香港恒生指数在最后一小时下跌 0.15%，而中国内地沪深 300 指数则持平于 3,958.29 点。

paras.en: Japan's markets were closed for a public holiday.
paras.zh: 日本市场因公众假期休市。

paras.en: Last week, major indexes tumbled as worries about the artificial intelligence trade continued to spook investors, despite Anthropic's record debut on Thursday.
paras.zh: 上周，尽管 Anthropic 周四创纪录地首次亮相，但由于对人工智能交易的担忧继续令投资者感到不安，主要股指暴跌。

paras.en: By the end of the rout last week — which was the worst weekly decline for the Nasdaq Composite and Dow in more than six years, and the largest for the S&P 500 since April 2025 — all three of the major averages were in correction territory, and the Nasdaq turned negative for the year.
paras.zh: 上周的暴跌结束时——这是纳斯达克综合指数和道琼斯指数六年多来最严重的单周跌幅，也是标准普尔 500 指数自 2025 年 4 月以来最大的单周跌幅——所有三个主要股指均处于回调区域，纳斯达克指数今年转为负值。

paras.en: The Nasdaq-100 index ended Friday in bear market territory on an intraday basis, but was just shy of that mark based on the decline from its closing high on Oct. 6.
paras.zh: 周五，纳斯达克 100 指数盘中收于熊市区域，但从 10 月 6 日收盘高点的跌幅来看，略低于熊市区域。

paras.en: Investors this week will get a breather, no matter what price action looks like. Markets are closed on Thursday for the Thanksgiving holiday, and Friday's session will be shortened with the closing bell set to ring at 1:00 p.m.
paras.zh: 无论价格走势如何，本周投资者都将得到喘息的机会。周四因感恩节假期市场休市，周五交易时间将缩短，收盘钟定于下午 1:00 敲响。

paras.en: All eyes are set to be on the shaky tech trade, as investors examine if last week's sell-off represented the market finding a durable bottom, or if equities have more room to fall.
paras.zh: 所有的目光都将集中在摇摇欲坠的科技交易上，因为投资者正在审视上周的抛售是否代表市场找到了持久的底部，或者股市是否还有更大的下跌空间。

paras.en: Drew Pettit, chief investment strategist at Roundhill, said in an appearance on CNBC's "Closing Bell: Overtime" on Friday that the indiscriminate selling at the end of the week — which extended beyond just tech — is a sign the sell-off may be concluding. But, he said the burden of proof is on the bulls to undermine the bearish sentiment dominating the market.
paras.zh: Roundhill 首席投资策略师德鲁·佩蒂特 (Drew Pettit) 周五在 CNBC 节目《收盘钟声：加班》中表示，周末的不加区别的抛售——不仅限于科技股——是抛售可能即将结束的迹象。但他表示，多头有责任提供证据来削弱主导市场的看跌情绪。

paras.en: "Fundamentally, I think the floor is a lot higher," he said about how low equities could go. "Technically… you need a string of catalysts for the bulls to prove the long-term earnings story isn't broken."
paras.zh: “从根本上说，我认为下限要高得多，”他在谈到股市可能会跌到多低时说道。 “从技术上讲……你需要一系列催化剂来推动多头证明长期盈利故事并未破裂。”

articles.title: AI just solved the ‘real’ Navier-Stokes problem

paras.en: It looks like Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge was not satisfied with one blockbuster math proof today. Right after Alpöge’s announcement of a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis—math’s most famed open problem—has come the news that he and New York University professor Tristan Buckmaster believe they have closed a controversial loophole in OpenAI’s September solution of another million-dollar problem.
paras.zh: 看来 Anthropic 员工 Levent Alpöge 对今天的一项重大数学证明并不满意。就在 Alpöge 宣布黎曼猜想（数学最著名的开放问题）的证明得到证明后，有消息称，他和纽约大学教授 Tristan Buckmaster 相信他们已经堵住了 OpenAI 9 月份解决另一个百万美元问题的一个有争议的漏洞。

paras.en: The Navier-Stokes equations, dating back to the early- to mid-19th century, model how fluids swirl and eddy. In September OpenAI proved that the equations “blow up,” meaning they occasionally claim that a fluid’s speed becomes infinite—something real fluids cannot do.
paras.zh: 纳维-斯托克斯方程的历史可以追溯到 19 世纪早期到中期，它模拟了流体如何旋转和涡流。九月份，OpenAI 证明了这些方程“爆炸”，这意味着他们偶尔会声称流体的速度变得无限大——这是真实流体无法做到的。

paras.en: But while the September solution technically satisfied the conditions for the Clay Mathematics Institute’s $1-million prize, many experts were left unsatisfied with how it did so. OpenAI’s proof imagined an unrealistic, finely tuned force that “stirs” the liquid in just the right way to produce infinite velocity—an approach many consider a loophole in the wording of the problem.
paras.zh: 尽管 9 月份的解决方案在技术上满足了克莱数学研究所 100 万美元奖金的条件，但许多专家对其实现方式并不满意。 OpenAI 的证明设想了一种不切实际的、经过微调的力，以正确的方式“搅拌”液体以产生无限的速度——许多人认为这种方法是问题措辞中的漏洞。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The proof was also the subject of controversy because Buckmaster claimed it was a deliberate attempt on the part of OpenAI to scoop his and Alpöge’s progress on the problem. Buckmaster publicly aired his suspicions that the company even stole his user data in its mad race to beat him to the punch. (OpenAI denied allegations of foul play, and early reports suggest the company’s proof may have taken a different route to the solution than Buckmaster and Alpöge’s work.)
paras.zh: The proof was also the subject of controversy because Buckmaster claimed it was a deliberate attempt on the part of OpenAI to scoop his and Alpöge’s progress on the problem.巴克马斯特公开表示怀疑，该公司甚至在疯狂的竞赛中窃取了他的用户数据，以抢先一步。 (OpenAI denied allegations of foul play, and early reports suggest the company’s proof may have taken a different route to the solution than Buckmaster and Alpöge’s work.)

paras.en: Now the pair claims to have taken back the lead on the problem, closing the loophole OpenAI left open and providing the solution to Navier-Stokes that experts have long sought.
paras.zh: 现在，两人声称已经在这个问题上夺回了领先地位，堵住了 OpenAI 留下的漏洞，并为 Navier-Stokes 提供了专家们长期以来寻求的解决方案。

paras.en: On Mastodon at 8:37 A.M. EST this morning, Buckmaster posted a dense, artificial-intelligence-aided proof and noted that the write-up was unpolished because, “after last time,” he and Alpöge “couldn’t risk waiting” because of concerns over getting scooped. In the rush, the two also did not release the certificate of the result. In the report, they claimed it would be released soon.
paras.zh: 上午 8:37 在 Mastodon 上美国东部时间今天早上，巴克马斯特发布了一份密集的人工智能辅助证明，并指出该文章未经修饰，因为“在上次之后”，他和阿尔波格“不能冒险等待”，因为担心被抢先报道。仓促间，两人也没有公布成绩证明。他们在报告中声称很快就会发布。

articles.title: What the Riemann hypothesis proof really means about AI and the future

paras.en: In the latest “huge if true” news to come out of AI’s ongoing conquest of mathematics, earlier today American mathematician and Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge posted a claim on his personal website that is already reverberating around the globe.
paras.zh: 今天早些时候，美国数学家兼人类学家 Levent Alpöge 在他的个人网站上发布了人工智能不断征服数学的最新消息，该消息已经在全球引起反响。

paras.en: “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Alpöge wrote. He also included a Claude-generated proof written in Lean, a programming language used to confirm that the supporting math is logically consistent and correct; other mathematicians are racing to independently verify Alpöge’s work, with preliminary and informal responses already emerging that the proof is indeed correct.
paras.zh: “我相信我已经与克劳德合作，发现了黎曼猜想的证明，”阿尔波格写道。他还提供了克劳德用 Lean 编写的证明，Lean 是一种编程语言，用于确认支持的数学在逻辑上是一致且正确的；其他数学家正在竞相独立验证 Alpöge 的工作，初步和非正式的反应已经出现，证明证明确实是正确的。

paras.en: But what would this actually mean for the rest of us? Would proof of the Riemann hypothesis make our computers faster, our online transactions more or less secure or our digital lives fundamentally different? The answers are murkier than you might expect.
paras.zh: 但这对我们其他人来说实际上意味着什么呢？黎曼假设的证明会让我们的计算机变得更快，我们的在线交易或多或少安全，或者我们的数字生活从根本上不同吗？答案比你想象的更加模糊。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Proposed some 167 years ago by mathematician Bernhard Riemann, the Riemann hypothesis has been widely considered one of the greatest unsolved mysteries of math. It concerns the distribution of prime numbers (numbers divisible only by themselves and 1) and an unproven—apparently until today—assumption about the almost mystical layers of numerical order that underpin them. The question of its veracity is also one of seven “Millennium Prize Problems” posed in 2000 by the Clay Mathematics Institute—resolving it would net a $1-million prize.
paras.zh: 黎曼假设由数学家 Bernhard Riemann 于大约 167 年前提出，被广泛认为是数学中最大的未解之谜之一。它涉及素数（只能被自身和 1 整除的数字）的分布，以及一个未经证实的——显然直到今天——关于支撑它们的几乎神秘的数字顺序层的假设。其真实性问题也是克莱数学研究所 2000 年提出的七大“千年奖问题”之一——解决该问题将获得 100 万美元的奖金。

paras.en: But the biggest implications for a solution won’t be monetary. Alpöge’s proof is technically for the “generalized Riemann hypothesis,” or GRH, which is a bigger, broader and more powerful application of Riemann’s initial insight to a much wider class of mathematical functions related to the primes. Proving it true, as my colleague Joseph Howlett explains, would cascade through all of math, in a flash revealing that many of the elaborate interlocking assumptions built on its presumed bedrock veracity are, in fact, true. Algorithms used in arcane realms like computational number theory and the study of algebraic number fields could see immediate improvements. These gains could even, eventually, lead to potential benefits for practical applications, but such advances would be invisible to most people.
paras.zh: 但解决方案的最大影响并不是金钱方面的。从技术上讲，阿尔波格的证明是为了“广义黎曼假设”（GRH），它是黎曼最初洞察力对与素数相关的更广泛的数学函数的更大、更广泛和更强大的应用。正如我的同事约瑟夫·豪利特（Joseph Howlett）所解释的那样，证明这一点是正确的，将贯穿所有数学，瞬间揭示出许多建立在假定的基础准确性之上的精心设计的连锁假设实际上是正确的。用于计算数论和代数数域研究等神秘领域的算法可以立即得到改进。这些成果甚至可能最终为实际应用带来潜在的好处，但这种进步对大多数人来说是看不见的。

paras.en: Many have wondered how this could affect cryptography. Prime numbers are essential to RSA, a widely used public-key cryptographic scheme whose security depends on the difficulty of factoring enormous numbers into their original prime factors. Given this technology, you might think that proving GRH and being able to precisely map patterns of primes would threaten the security of online banking, encrypted communications and other digital infrastructure.
paras.zh: 许多人想知道这会如何影响密码学。素数对于 RSA 至关重要，RSA 是一种广泛使用的公钥加密方案，其安全性取决于将大量数字分解为其原始素数因子的难度。鉴于这项技术，您可能会认为证明 GRH 并能够精确映射素数模式将威胁到网上银行、加密通信和其他数字基础设施的安全。

paras.en: But it wouldn’t—not directly. Determining whether a number is prime—an obvious application of GRH—isn’t the same as finding which primes serve as factors for the gargantuanly unwieldy numbers underpinning RSA and other encryption systems. GRH would improve mathematicians’ understanding of the former but wouldn’t provide a known shortcut for the latter. So, for now, your encrypted financial transactions and online secrets are presumably safe from direct cracking via some GRH-derived method.
paras.zh: 但它不会——不会直接。确定一个数字是否是素数（GRH 的一个明显应用）与查找哪些素数充当支撑 RSA 和其他加密系统的庞大笨重数字的因子不同。 GRH 将提高数学家对前者的理解，但不会为后者提供已知的捷径。因此，目前，您的加密金融交易和在线机密可能不会通过某种 GRH 派生方法直接破解。

paras.en: In fact, the most consequential impacts of Alpöge’s claim (if verified) wouldn’t really concern prime numbers—or math—at all. Instead they would signal AI’s emerging capacity for profoundly superhuman scientific discoveries.
paras.zh: 事实上，阿尔波格的说法（如果得到证实）最重要的影响根本不会真正涉及素数或数学。相反，它们将标志着人工智能正在出现的超越人类科学发现的能力。

paras.en: For many experts, this milestone isn’t necessarily something to celebrate. As one prominent mathematician ominously told Howlett for a different story earlier this year, an AI that can prove the Riemann hypothesis would be something so powerful and potentially disruptive that he’d prefer to never meet it.
paras.zh: 对于许多专家来说，这个里程碑并不一定值得庆祝。正如今年早些时候一位著名数学家在另一则故事中不祥地告诉霍利特的那样，能够证明黎曼假设的人工智能将是一种非常强大且具有潜在破坏性的东西，以至于他宁愿永远不会遇到它。

paras.en: That’s because the problem, even in its nongeneralized form, is so ferociously complex that it’s resisted more than 150 years of effort to solve it by some of humanity’s best and brightest minds. “Proving” GRH doesn’t seem to be something that just takes more computation—novel techniques and ideas are probably required. So a large language model achieving it, even with considerable help and guidance from an expert such as Alpöge, would be the strongest evidence yet that the latest AI models can do much more than merely explain existing theorems or aid mathematicians in developing proofs. It would mean that they can, in fact, leverage the extant corpus of human thought to generate and rigorously establish genuinely new knowledge—in a manner that humans seemingly cannot.
paras.zh: 这是因为这个问题，即使是非一般化的形式，也非常复杂，以至于人类一些最优秀、最聪明的头脑花了 150 多年的时间才解决这个问题。 “证明”GRH 似乎并不只是需要更多的计算——可能需要新颖的技术和想法。因此，即使有像 Alpöge 这样的专家的大量帮助和指导，实现这一目标的大型语言模型也将成为迄今为止最有力的证据，证明最新的人工智能模型可以做的不仅仅是解释现有定理或帮助数学家开发证明。事实上，这意味着他们可以利用现有的人类思想库来生成并严格建立真正的新知识——以人类似乎无法做到的方式。

paras.en: The implications extend far beyond number theory. Mathematics underpins much of theoretical physics, engineering, computer science and other scientific disciplines, so an AI capable of proving GRH today could, tomorrow, help researchers tackle problems in those fields that might otherwise be beyond reach. This would be a new way of doing science, with AI systems moving from tools that assist in calculations and experiments to autonomous scientists capable of executing entire lines of theoretical investigation.
paras.zh: 其影响远远超出了数论。数学是理论物理、工程学、计算机科学和其他科学学科的基础，因此今天能够证明 GRH 的人工智能明天可以帮助研究人员解决这些领域中原本无法解决的问题。这将是一种新的科学研究方式，人工智能系统将从协助计算和实验的工具转变为能够执行整个理论研究的自主科学家。

paras.en: Whether humans could or would even understand the ultimate results of such potential AI-generated advances remains an open question.
paras.zh: 人类是否能够或什至会理解人工智能带来的这种潜在进步的最终结果仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paras.en: For ordinary people, then, today’s news isn’t really about prime numbers at all—or any sudden, wrenching shift in daily life. Instead it’s about a future, perhaps imminent, if not immediate, in which machines supersede the capacities of human beings for making fundamental intellectual discoveries.
paras.zh: 那么，对于普通人来说，今天的新闻根本不是关于质数的，也不是关于日常生活中任何突然的、痛苦的变化的。相反，它是关于一个未来，即使不是立即，也可能是迫在眉睫的，在这个未来中，机器将取代人类做出基本智力发现的能力。

articles.title: Earth just saw the most anomalously hot day ever on record

paras.en: Earth just saw the most anomalously hot day ever measured on the planet. According to preliminary data from the Europe-based Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S), Friday, November 20, 2026 was 2.12 degrees Celsius higher than the preindustrial average—or the time before human's began heating up the Earth by burning fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 地球刚刚经历了地球上有史以来最异常炎热的一天。根据欧洲哥白尼气候变化服务中心 (C3S) 的初步数据，2026 年 11 月 20 日星期五，气温比工业化前平均水平（即人类开始通过燃烧化石燃料使地球升温之前的时间）高出 2.12 摄氏度。

paras.en: The record stems from a combination of long-term, human-driven climate change and a blockbuster El Niño that is likely the strongest in the past 1,000 years. It come as international negotiations at the COP 31 climate summit fell apart, with no global agreement on how to rein in global warming.
paras.zh: 这一记录源于人类驱动的长期气候变化和可能是过去 1000 年来最强的厄尔尼诺现象的共同作用。在此之前，第 31 次缔约方会议气候峰会的国际谈判破裂，全球尚未就如何控制全球变暖达成一致。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: There are likely to be more days with an anomaly at or above 2 degrees C as this El Niño builds to its crescendo over roughly the next month. The next several months are also likely to be record hot. "I think we will likely see more days exceeding 2 degrees C over the next couple of months (possibly through March 2027)," says Zachary Labe, a scientist at Climate Central, a climate research nonprofit. "Though I still expect this to be more a rarity than the norm when comparing every day"
paras.zh: 随着厄尔尼诺现象在大约下个月逐渐增强，可能会有更多的日子出现 2 摄氏度或以上的异常现象。未来几个月也可能会创下历史新高。 “我认为，在接下来的几个月（可能到 2027 年 3 月），我们可能会看到更多超过 2 摄氏度的日子，”气候研究非营利组织气候中心的科学家扎卡里·拉贝 (Zachary Labe) 说。 “尽管每天进行比较时，我仍然认为这比常态更罕见”

paras.en: It's possible 2026 will be the hottest year on record, besting 2024, though it will be close and could end in a tie. Because it takes time for the heat released by El Niño in the Pacific to affect global temperatures, 2027 will likely see the biggest heat effect and will almost certainly become the hottest year on record. Both 2026 and 2027 will be more than 1.5 degrees C above preindustrial temperatures, a level so far only ever surpassed in 2024.
paras.zh: 2026 年可能会成为有记录以来最热的一年，超过 2024 年，尽管情况会很接近，并且可能会以平局结束。由于太平洋厄尔尼诺现象释放的热量需要一段时间才能影响全球气温，因此2027年可能会出现最大的热效应，并且几乎肯定会成为有记录以来最热的一年。 2026 年和 2027 年的气温都将比工业化前的气温高出 1.5 摄氏度以上，这一水平迄今为止只有 2024 年才能超过。

paras.en: Under the landmark 2015 Paris climate agreement, which came out of the COP 21 meeting, countries agreed to limit warming to "well below" 2 degrees C above preindustrial and to try to keep it under 1.5 degrees C. But the United Nations (UN) recently announced that the world will blow past the 1.5 degrees C mark, with global temperatures expected to hit 1.8 degrees C above preindustrial.
paras.zh: 根据 COP 21 会议达成的具有里程碑意义的 2015 年巴黎气候协议，各国同意将气温升高限制在“远低于”工业化前水平 2 摄氏度，并努力将其控制在 1.5 摄氏度以下。但联合国 (UN) 最近宣布，全球气温将突破 1.5 摄氏度大关，预计全球气温将比工业化前水平高出 1.8 摄氏度。

paras.en: Surpassing the 2 degrees C benchmark for a day—or even a year—doesn't mean the Paris agreement limit has been permanently breached, as that considers the average temperature over many years. By that measure, the world has warmed by nearly 1.4 degrees C above preindustrial, according to the UN.
paras.zh: 一天甚至一年超过 2 摄氏度基准并不意味着永久违反《巴黎协定》的限制，因为这考虑了多年的平均气温。据联合国称，按照这一标准，世界气温比工业化前高了近 1.4 摄氏度。

paras.en: The COP31 summit—to which the U.S. did not send an official delegation—ended without an agreement for a final deal. These documents nominally provide a blueprint for countries to follow in their efforts to lower greenhouse gas emissions and adapt to the changing climate.
paras.zh: 美国没有派出官方代表团参加的 COP31 峰会在没有达成最终协议的情况下结束。这些文件名义上为各国努力降低温室气体排放和适应气候变化提供了蓝图。

paras.en: In a statement, outgoing Secretary General Antonio Guterres, who has been a vocal supporter of phasing out fossil fuels, noted his "profound frustration" at the summit's outcome. "Temperatures keep shattering records. Climate extremes keep intensifying. Emissions remain far too high. And every delay makes our task harder and more costly," Guterres said. "The world is now poised to exceed the globally-agreed limit of a 1.5 degree temperature rise. The window to keep that overshoot as short and shallow as possible is rapidly closing."
paras.zh: 即将离任的秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯一直大力支持逐步淘汰化石燃料，他在一份声明中指出，他对峰会的结果“深感沮丧”。古特雷斯说：“气温不断打破记录。极端气候不断加剧。排放量仍然过高。每一次延误都使我们的任务更加艰巨，成本也更高。” “现在，世界气温有望超过全球商定的 1.5 度升温限制。使这种超调尽可能短且浅的窗口正在迅速关闭。”

articles.title: The Book Lover’s Gift Guide
articles.author: Science News Staff

paras.en: Science News staff devoured books of all kinds this year, on topics ranging from ecology and evolution to the human brain and mathematics. We covered it all — even a cookbook! These 10 titles rose to the top of our 2026 reading list and could make great gifts for the book lovers in your life. — Anna Mattson, Assistant Editor
paras.zh: 今年《科学新闻》的工作人员阅读了各种书籍，主题从生态学和进化论到人脑和数学。我们涵盖了这一切——甚至包括一本食谱！这 10 本书跻身我们 2026 年阅读清单的榜首，可以作为送给您生活中的图书爱好者的绝佳礼物。 — 安娜·马特森，助理编辑

paras.en: Big thinkers will love Huge Numbers, a fascinating look into the study of large numbers. “When I think of big numbers, I usually think of a 1 with a lot of zeroes tacked on the end. But the reality is much more complex than I ever imagined,” says senior physics writer Emily Conover. The book, among Conover’s favorites of the year, “provided me with a new appreciation of our number system and the creative ways mathematicians have expanded it to express ever-larger numbers,” she says. “Plus, contemplating unfathomably large figures makes my own concerns seem insignificant.”
paras.zh: 伟大的思想家一定会喜欢《巨数》，这是对大数研究的引人入胜的研究。 “当我想到大数字时，我通常会想到末尾有很多零的 1。但现实比我想象的要复杂得多，”资深物理作家 Emily Conover 说道。这本书是康诺弗今年最喜欢的书之一，“让我对我们的数字系统以及数学家扩展它以表达更大数字的创造性方式有了新的认识，”她说。 “此外，考虑到深不可测的大数字，我自己的担忧就显得微不足道了。”

paras.en: Staff writer Erin Garcia de Jesús’ favorite book of 2026, The Creatures’ Guide to Caring, will strike a chord with new parents. “Between sleepless nights and poopy diapers, there’s not much to laugh about in the early days of parenting. But I found plenty of humor (and plenty to be grossed out about) in The Creatures’ Guide to Caring,” Garcia de Jesús says. “It’s the perfect book to make anyone, parent or otherwise, feel better that we’re not the only animals struggling with our offspring.”
paras.zh: 专职作家艾琳·加西亚·德·赫苏斯 (Erin Garcia de Jesús) 2026 年最喜欢的书《生物关爱指南》将引起新父母的共鸣。 “在不眠之夜和大便尿布之间，在养育孩子的早期日子里，没有什么可笑的。但我在《生物护理指南》中发现了很多幽默（也有很多令人恶心的内容），”加西亚·德·赫苏斯说。 “这是一本完美的书，可以让任何人，无论是父母还是其他人，都感觉更好，因为我们不是唯一与我们的后代作斗争的动物。”

paras.en: Adventure seekers will lose themselves in the mesmerizing ecosystems at the heart of Bogland, biomedical sciences writer Aimee Cunningham’s favorite book of the year. Ecologist Merritt R. Turetsky immerses readers in these waterlogged landscapes that are often overlooked and underestimated. “I am firmly on team boglands after reading about the beauty and wonder of these ecosystems,” Cunningham says.
paras.zh: 寻求冒险的人将会迷失在博格兰中心迷人的生态系统中，博格兰是生物医学作家艾米·坎宁安 (Aimee Cunningham) 年度最喜欢的一本书。生态学家梅里特·R·图雷茨基 (Merritt R. Turetsky) 让读者沉浸在这些经常被忽视和低估的淹水景观中。 “在了解了这些生态系统的美丽和奇迹后，我坚定地支持沼泽地团队，”坎宁安说。

paras.en: Senior writer Meghan Rosen’s favorite book of 2026 is perfect for anyone interested in — or wary of — health and wellness culture. Morbid exposes the lack of science behind a lot of antiaging advice, such as eating like centenarians do and taking “antiaging” supplements. “Turns out, a lot of it is just plain bunk,” Rosen says. “Skeptical readers will enjoy Newman’s takedowns, which go down smoothly with a healthy dose of humor.”
paras.zh: 资深作家梅根·罗森 (Meghan Rosen) 在 2026 年最喜欢的一本书非常适合任何对健康和保健文化感兴趣或持谨慎态度的人。病态暴露了许多抗衰老建议背后缺乏科学依据，例如像百岁老人那样饮食和服用“抗衰老”补充剂。 “事实证明，其中很多只是纯粹的废话，”罗森说。 “持怀疑态度的读者会喜欢纽曼的驳斥，这些驳斥会带着健康的幽默顺利进行。”

paras.en: Senior neuroscience writer Laura Sanders’ pick for 2026 is a must-read for any expecting mother, new mother or person looking to learn about how pregnancy and motherhood impact the body. “A Mother’s Brain reads like a scientific love letter to moms, who all too often get overlooked,” she says. Author and neuroscientist Susana Carmona “covers the nascent field of matrescence in lively, vivid chapters. And along the way, she convincingly argues that the maternal brain is compelling, wondrous and still mysterious,” Sanders says.
paras.zh: 资深神经科学作家劳拉·桑德斯 (Laura Sanders) 为 2026 年所做的选择是任何准妈妈、新妈妈或想要了解怀孕和母性如何影响身体的人的必读之作。 “《母亲的大脑》读起来就像一封写给妈妈们的科学情书，她们经常被忽视，”她说。作家兼神经科学家苏珊娜·卡莫纳“以生动活泼的章节讲述了女性发育的新兴领域。一路走来，她令人信服地认为，母性大脑是引人注目的、奇妙的，而且仍然是神秘的，”桑德斯说。

paras.en: Those who listen to true crime podcasts or wish spooky season lasted all year long will enjoy Exhumed, an exploration of the lore and medical practices leading up to the 19th century New England vampire panic. “Thanks to Mahnke’s gripping prose, I felt like I was in the middle of the action. It was hard to lay the book down,” assistant editor Anna Mattson wrote in her online review. Mattson notes that Exhumed, her favorite read of 2026, is littered with bizarre facts that would be perfect for invigorating dull conversations.
paras.zh: 那些收听真实犯罪播客或希望全年持续幽灵季节的人会喜欢《Exhumed》，该剧探索了导致 19 世纪新英格兰吸血鬼恐慌的传说和医疗实践。 “多亏了马恩克扣人心弦的散文，我感觉自己就身处其中。很难放下这本书，”助理编辑安娜·马特森在她的在线评论中写道。马特森指出，《挖掘》是她 2026 年最喜欢的读物，书中充满了离奇的事实，非常适合激发枯燥的对话。

paras.en: For the anthropologist in your life, try The Story of Stories — a deep dive into how technological upheavals have shaped storytelling throughout history. The author provides what Sanders describes as scattershot history lessons in her online review: “Ashton has a knack for pulling out memorable bits from historical records, scientific studies and other sources for readers.”
paras.zh: 对于您生活中的人类学家，请尝试《故事中的故事》——深入探讨技术变革如何塑造历史上的故事讲述。作者在她的在线评论中提供了桑德斯所描述的漫无目的的历史教训：“阿什顿有能力从历史记录、科学研究和其他来源中为读者提取令人难忘的片段。”

paras.en: Conover couldn’t pick just one favorite. For people who enjoy getting creative in the kitchen, she recommends Happy Snacking, Don’t Die! “This cookbook provides such a joyful how-to on foraging and eating wild plants,” Conover says. “It helped me see my plant neighbors in a whole new light. And I got to make some tasty treats to share with my family as well.”
paras.zh: 科诺弗无法仅选出最喜欢的一项。 For people who enjoy getting creative in the kitchen, she recommends Happy Snacking, Don’t Die! “This cookbook provides such a joyful how-to on foraging and eating wild plants,” Conover says. “它帮助我以全新的视角看待我的植物邻居。而且我还必须制作一些美味佳肴与家人分享。”

paras.en: Tyrant Lizard Queen is the only work of fiction on our list. But it’s rooted in real science, and stars a Tyrannosaurus rex. Author Riley Black “offers an empathetic look at a real-life creature that experienced hunger and pain, much like the animals that surround us today,” says Science News Explores assistant editor Aaron Tremper, who chose the book as his favorite of 2026. “Black’s penchant for story makes for a thrilling read that fans of Jurassic Park and King Kong can get behind.”
paras.zh: 暴君蜥蜴女王是我们名单上唯一的小说作品。但它植根于真正的科学，主角是霸王龙。 《科学新闻探索》的助理编辑亚伦·特伦珀 (Aaron Tremper) 表示，作者莱利·布莱克“对经历过饥饿和痛苦的现实生物进行了感同身受的观察，就像我们今天周围的动物一样。”他选择这本书作为自己 2026 年的最爱。“布莱克对故事的偏爱使得这本惊心动魄的读物值得《侏罗纪公园》和《金刚》的粉丝们追捧。”

paras.en: And for those interested in bioethics, we suggest picking up Every Living Creature. Author and physician Joshua D. Mezrich offers a comprehensive look at the field of xenotransplantation, through the stories of courageous doctors and patients who helped make it possible. “At times, the story can feel like a whirlwind, whisking readers across decades and from lab to lab and surgery to surgery,” Rosen wrote in her online review. “But at its core, Every Living Creature is a book about hope.”
paras.zh: 对于那些对生物伦理​​学感兴趣的人，我们建议选择《每种生物》。作家兼医生约书亚·D·梅兹里奇 (Joshua D. Mezrich) 通过帮助异种移植成为可能的勇敢医生和患者的故事，全面介绍了异种移植领域。罗森在她的在线评论中写道：“有时，这个故事感觉就像一阵旋风，带读者穿越几十年，从一个实验室到另一个实验室，从一个手术到另一个手术。” “但从本质上讲，《每一个生物》都是一本关于希望的书。”

articles.title: An El Niño amped by climate change has California bracing for the worst
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: In parts of California, public officials are going door-to-door, warning residents to get ready. The state has strategically stockpiled sandbags, pumps and generators. Debris has been fished out to clear storm drains, seepage blankets shore up aging levees and dams, and wire mesh cages hold back precariously placed boulders.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州的部分地区，政府官员正在挨家挨户地警告居民做好准备。该州战略性地储备了沙袋、水泵和发电机。残骸被打捞出来以清理雨水沟，防渗毯支撑着老化的堤坝和水坝，铁丝网笼挡住了摇摇欲坠的巨石。

paras.en: What is expected to be the strongest El Niño on record is already pounding the state with giant waves. The fury of this year’s El Niño is being unleashed around the globe as well, from inundating Florida with floods to exacerbating drought in the Amazon. And much more is still to come, forecasts show, with the peak of the climate phenomenon expected to arrive between November 2026 and January 2027.
paras.zh: 预计有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象已经给该州带来巨浪。今年的厄尔尼诺现象也在全球范围内蔓延，佛罗里达州被洪水淹没，亚马逊地区干旱加剧。预测显示，还有更多的事情发生，气候现象的顶峰预计将在 2026 年 11 月至 2027 年 1 月之间到来。

paras.en: Californians know all too well the threat. El Niño has historically brought relentless rainfall to the state, flooding cities and triggering landslides.
paras.zh: 加州人非常清楚这一威胁。厄尔尼诺现象历来给该州带来了持续不断的降雨，淹没城市并引发山体滑坡。

paras.en: State officials learned a lot about preparedness and emergency water management from previous El Niños — particularly the strong event that spanned the winter of 1997–1998. But this year’s event is likely to be even more challenging, a “Super” El Niño superimposed on the backdrop of global climate change.
paras.zh: 州政府官员从之前的厄尔尼诺现象（尤其是 1997 年至 1998 年冬季的强烈厄尔尼诺现象）中学到了很多有关防备和紧急用水管理的知识。但今年的事件可能更具挑战性，在全球气候变化的背景下叠加了“超级”厄尔尼诺现象。

paras.en: Climate change has made water management in California more complicated than it was just 30 years ago — as it has elsewhere around the world, says environmental scientist Letitia Grenier, the director of water policy at the Public Policy Institute of California, a nonprofit, nonpartisan think tank based in San Francisco.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州公共政策研究所是一家位于旧金山的非营利性、无党派智库，环境科学家、水政策主任莱蒂蒂亚·格雷尼尔 (Letitia Grenier) 表示，气候变化使加利福尼亚州的水管理比 30 年前更加复杂，世界其他地方也是如此。

paras.en: In 1997, California’s overall climate was much drier; El Niño brought a big, long rainy season that spanned the state, Grenier says. But now, “it’s just so humid. The air is warmer, so it can hold more water.”
paras.zh: 1997年，加州整体气候更加干燥；格雷尼尔说，厄尔尼诺现象给全州带来了一场漫长而漫长的雨季。但现在，“太潮湿了。空气更温暖，所以可以容纳更多的水。”

paras.en: That waterlogged atmosphere means that even without El Niño, there’s been less of a distinct rainy season in California, and more rapid flip-flop between intense episodes of rain dumped on the ground followed by periods of heat and dryness. “It’s these strange, erratic patterns that we’ve never seen before,” she says. And the state is bracing for how the Super El Niño will clash with this new climate normal.
paras.zh: 这种浸水的气氛意味着，即使没有厄尔尼诺现象，加州也不会出现明显的雨季，并且在强降雨倾倒在地面上和随后的炎热和干燥时期之间的快速变化。 “这些奇怪、不稳定的模式是我们以前从未见过的，”她说。该州正在准备应对超级厄尔尼诺现象将如何与这种新的气候常态发生冲突。

paras.en: A climate event becomes a household name
paras.zh: 气候事件成为家喻户晓的名字

paras.en: 1997 was the year that the term “El Niño” shot to global fame. It was the most powerful El Niño in recorded history, and the first to be scientifically monitored in real time, continuously tracked by satellites and breathlessly reported on by news outlets. El Niño’s rise to household name status was even cemented in pop culture by an appearance on Saturday Night Live, in a classic sketch by comedian Chris Farley.
paras.zh: 1997年是“厄尔尼诺”一词蜚声全球的一年。这是有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，也是第一次受到科学实时监测、卫星持续跟踪和新闻媒体密切报道的厄尔尼诺现象。厄尔尼诺现象家喻户晓的地位甚至通过喜剧演员克里斯·法利在《周六夜现场》的经典小品中的出现而在流行文化中得到了巩固。

paras.en: But the event was no laughing matter. It caused global devastation during its brief reign. El Niño events form as westward-blowing trade winds over the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean weaken, allowing warm water to accumulate at the surface. Those waters can then release massive amounts of heat to the atmosphere, altering the position of the Pacific jet stream and helping to disrupt global weather patterns.
paras.zh: 但这件事可不是闹着玩的。它在其短暂的统治期间造成了全球性的破坏。厄尔尼诺现象是由于东部热带太平洋上空向西吹的信风减弱而形成的，使得温暖的海水在海面积聚。然后，这些水域会向大气释放大量热量，改变太平洋急流的位置，并有助于扰乱全球天气模式。

paras.en: In 1997–1998, global temperatures spiked by 1.5 degrees Celsius on average. Along with the torrential rains in California, the event brought brutal drought to Southeast Asia and deadly summer floods to central Europe and Peru. Record-breaking floods also hit East Africa, which in turn triggered a surge in mosquito-borne Rift Valley fever. The oceans were so warm that 16 percent of the world’s reefs died.
paras.zh: 1997年至1998年，全球气温平均上升1.5摄氏度。除了加利福尼亚州的暴雨之外，这一事件还给东南亚带来了严重的干旱，并给中欧和秘鲁带来了致命的夏季洪水。破纪录的洪水也袭击了东非，进而引发了蚊媒裂谷热的激增。海洋非常温暖，导致世界上 16% 的珊瑚礁死亡。

paras.en: In all, the El Niño–related weather extremes were linked to more than 22,000 fatalities around the world, including nearly 200 in the United States, and an estimated $5.7 trillion in global economic losses.
paras.zh: 总之，与厄尔尼诺现象相关的极端天气导致全球超过 22,000 人死亡，其中美国有近 200 人死亡，全球经济损失估计达 5.7 万亿美元。

paras.en: Not every El Niño is equally intense, or impacts weather in quite the same way. “There’s a lot of variability event to event,” says Washington, D.C.–based climate scientist Tom Di Liberto, of the nonprofit climate news organization Climate Central.
paras.zh: 并非每次厄尔尼诺现象都同样强烈，或者以完全相同的方式影响天气。 “事件与事件之间存在很多变化，”华盛顿特区非营利性气候新闻组织气候中心的气候科学家汤姆·迪·利伯托 (Tom Di Liberto) 说。

paras.en: But there is a general overall pattern to how El Niño tends to affect weather around the planet, Di Liberto says. For example, there tend to be more tropical cyclones in the Pacific Ocean, and fewer in the Atlantic — a pattern also observed in 2026.
paras.zh: 但迪·利伯托说，厄尔尼诺现象如何影响地球各地的天气有一个总体模式。例如，太平洋上的热带气旋往往较多，而大西洋上的热带气旋较少——2026 年也观察到了这种模式。

paras.en: El Niño also tends to flatten and accelerate the Pacific jet stream, shifting its flow southward, says Mike Anderson, California’s state climatologist for the Department of Water Resources, who is based in Sacramento. And that has historically meant that a conveyor belt of back-to-back moisture-loaded storms is set on a collision course with the U.S. West Coast.
paras.zh: 加州萨克拉门托水资源部气候学家迈克·安德森表示，厄尔尼诺现象还会使太平洋急流变平并加速，使其气流向南移动。从历史上看，这意味着连续的潮湿风暴传送带将与美国西海岸发生碰撞。

paras.en: The El Niño rapidly strengthened during the summer of 2026. As westerly trade winds weakened, warm waters accumulated in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean, raising both ocean temperatures and the sea level height (shown in this animation). Red and white colors indicate the highest sea level. Beginning in April and intensifying through November, the El Niño event generated Kelvin waves, massive swells that sweep eastward along the equator toward the Americas.
paras.zh: 2026 年夏季，厄尔尼诺现象迅速增强。随着西风信风减弱，东部热带太平洋积聚暖水，导致海洋温度和海平面高度升高（如动画所示）。红色和白色表示最高海平面。从 4 月开始，到 11 月，厄尔尼诺现象不断加剧，产生了开尔文波，即沿赤道向东席卷美洲的巨大海浪。

paras.en: The 1997–1998 El Niño revealed just how devastating that pattern could be in California.
paras.zh: 1997-1998 年的厄尔尼诺现象揭示了这种模式对加利福尼亚州的破坏力有多大。

paras.en: As much as 30 centimeters inundated parts of the state during the month of February 1998 alone. Storm winds and high surf pounded the coast, while rivers swelled and overtopped their banks. Flooding from the “Groundhog Day Storm” destroyed some 1,700 homes in Bay Area cities Palo Alto and Menlo Park. On February 6 near Rio Nido, about 100 kilometers from San Francisco, a forested hillside suddenly crumbled, sending a wall of mud rushing down the mountain. It destroyed about 30 homes.
paras.zh: 仅 1998 年 2 月，该州部分地区就被淹没了 30 厘米。暴风和巨浪冲击着海岸，河水上涨，淹没了河岸。 “土拨鼠日风暴”引发的洪水摧毁了湾区城市帕洛阿尔托和门洛帕克的约 1,700 所房屋。 2月6日，距离旧金山约100公里的里约尼多河附近，一片森林覆盖的山坡突然崩塌，一道泥墙从山上冲下。它摧毁了大约30所房屋。

paras.en: Landslides also threatened homes and lives in Southern California.
paras.zh: 山体滑坡还威胁到南加州的房屋和生命。

paras.en: On February 23, then 25-year-old Jenifer Segraves and her fiancé Glenn Flook were living in an apartment on Laguna Canyon Road, in the city of Laguna Beach. The heavy rains had saturated the neighborhood’s steep hillsides, making the terrain unstable.
paras.zh: 2月23日，当时25岁的詹妮弗·塞格雷夫斯和她的未婚夫格伦·弗洛克住在拉古纳海滩市拉古纳峡谷路的一套公寓里。大雨浸透了附近陡峭的山坡，使地形变得不稳定。

paras.en: “We lived up against a hill in the canyon, so there were stairs up to our apartment,” Segraves says now. “They became like a waterfall. I remember my fiancé carrying me up the stairs because there was so much water.” Segraves called her father, Gary Segraves, in a panic, asking for help. Then, the slope behind the building failed, the apartment flooded and she and Flook fled into the rushing mud.
paras.zh: “我们住在峡谷里的一座小山上，所以有楼梯通往我们的公寓，”塞格雷夫斯现在说。 “它们变得像瀑布一样。我记得我的未婚夫抱着我走上楼梯，因为水太多了。”塞格雷夫斯惊慌失措地打电话给她的父亲加里·塞格雷夫斯寻求帮助。然后，大楼后面的斜坡塌陷，公寓被淹，她和弗洛克逃进了汹涌的泥浆中。

paras.en: “We were strong enough to get out, but we were waist-high in mud,” Segraves said. “[My dad] almost drowned getting to us.” All three took shelter at a neighbor’s house, where they showered and hunkered down to wait out the rain.
paras.zh: 塞格雷夫斯说：“我们有足够的力气逃出去，但我们陷在齐腰高的泥浆里。” “[我爸爸]来找我们时差点被淹死。”三个人都在邻居家避难，在那里洗澡并蹲下来等待雨停。

paras.en: Around midnight on February 24, the second mudslide arrived.
paras.zh: 2月24日午夜左右，第二次泥石流到来。

paras.en: The neighbor’s “whole house went down,” Segraves says. She escaped through a second-floor window, but her fiancé fell through the floor and was knocked out. He didn’t make it out.
paras.zh: 塞格雷夫斯说，邻居的“整个房子都倒塌了”。她从二楼的窗户逃了出来，但她的未婚夫却从地板上掉了下来，被撞晕了。他没有弄清楚。

paras.en: Gary Segraves, meanwhile, was swept down the hillside and landed in a pile of rubble against a rocky cliff. Battered and missing his glasses, he looked around and saw what looked like a doll.
paras.zh: 与此同时，加里·塞格雷夫斯（Gary Segraves）被冲下山坡，落在岩石悬崖上的一堆瓦砾中。他的眼镜被打坏了，不见了，他环顾四周，看到了一个看起来像洋娃娃的东西。

paras.en: He reached for the little form — and discovered that it was a baby, very cold but alive. Somehow, the 9-month-old had survived being swept out of her crib from a nearby home. The little girl “wouldn’t have survived if he hadn’t picked her up,” Segraves says.
paras.zh: 他伸手去拿那个小东西——发现那是一个婴儿，很冷，但还活着。不知何故，这个9个月大的孩子从附近的婴儿床上被扫了出来，幸免于难。塞格雷夫斯说，如果他没有把这个小女孩抱起来，她就不会活下来。

paras.en: The havoc wreaked across California by the event 30 years ago cast a stark light on the desperate need to expand waterways, maintain infrastructure and coordinate emergency services, Grenier says. “An engineering system can only work as well as its capacity.”
paras.zh: 格雷尼尔说，30 年前的事件给加州造成了严重破坏，这清楚地表明了扩大水道、维护基础设施和协调紧急服务的迫切需要。 “工程系统只有发挥其能力才能发挥作用。”

paras.en: Much of the state’s infrastructure is deteriorating. An October 13 report by the California state auditor noted that the condition of dams and levees across the state “remains a high-risk issue,” with some 57 dams in the state in poor or unsatisfactory condition. “Poorly maintained dams and levees continue to pose a risk to public safety,” the report said.
paras.zh: 该州的大部分基础设施正在恶化。加州审计员 10 月 13 日的一份报告指出，全州水坝和堤坝的状况“仍然是一个高风险问题”，该州约有 57 座水坝状况不佳或不令人满意。报告称：“维护不善的水坝和堤坝继续对公共安全构成风险。”

paras.en: California’s water management system was also originally designed specifically to simply shunt excess water away from residential areas, rather than try to capture the water or help it infiltrate into aquifers, Grenier says. But that system worked for a different climate, one that wasn’t so prone to “weather whiplash” — wild, sudden swings between extremely wet and extremely dry conditions.
paras.zh: 格雷尼尔说，加州的水管理系统最初也是专门设计的，只是为了将多余的水从住宅区分流出去，而不是试图捕获水或帮助其渗入含水层。但该系统适用于不同的气候，这种气候不太容易出现“天气波动”——极端潮湿和极端干燥条件之间剧烈、突然的波动。

paras.en: Alongside punishing, drenching back-to-back storms called atmospheric rivers, the state has also experienced frequent episodes of drought, including two recent severe events, one lasting from 2012 to 2016 and another from 2021 to 2025.
paras.zh: 除了被称为“大气河流”的连续降雨风暴外，该州还频繁发生干旱，包括最近发生的两起严重干旱，一次持续时间为 2012 年至 2016 年，另一次持续时间为 2021 年至 2025 年。

paras.en: Those years of drought, dwindling snow and pumping too much water from aquifers have dramatically depleted the state’s subsurface water stores. And the heavy rains don’t necessarily help; the torrents of water mostly run off across the surface instead of infiltrating soils to reach the underground aquifer.
paras.zh: 那些年的干旱、积雪减少以及从含水层抽取过多的水已经严重耗尽了该州的地下水储备。大雨不一定有帮助；水流大多从地表流走，而不是渗入土壤到达地下含水层。

paras.en: Such hydroclimate whiplash isn’t unique to California by any means. It’s a global problem, and it’s becoming more common. A small increase in air temperatures can give a big boost to the atmosphere’s capacity to hold water vapor, increasing that capacity by about 7 percent for every 1 degree C of temperature increase. All of that water vapor has contributed to an increase in extreme precipitation events around the globe since the mid-20th century.
paras.zh: 无论如何，这种水文气候冲击并不是加州独有的。这是一个全球性问题，而且变得越来越普遍。气温的小幅上升可以大大提高大气容纳水蒸气的能力，温度每升高 1 摄氏度，水蒸气的容纳能力就会增加约 7%。自20世纪中叶以来，所有这些水蒸气都导致了全球极端降水事件的增加。

paras.en: Precipitation is just half of the problem. Rising air temperatures also make the air “thirstier,” causing it to draw even more moisture out of vegetation, soil and surface bodies of water during drier periods — which makes the land more vulnerable to severe drought and wildfire.
paras.zh: Precipitation is just half of the problem.气温上升也会使空气“更加干燥”，导致在干旱时期从植被、土壤和地表水体中吸收更多水分，从而使土地更容易遭受严重干旱和野火的影响。

paras.en: It’s now clear that these hydrodynamic shifts have been increasing the frequency of weather whiplash events around the world over the last 75 years or so, scientists reported in 2025. And that whiplash is likely to increase as the world warms more.
paras.zh: 科学家在 2025 年报告称，现在很明显，在过去 75 年左右的时间里，这些水动力变化一直在增加世界各地天气鞭打事件的频率。而且，随着世界变暖，这种鞭打事件可能会增加。

paras.en: Months before reaching peak intensity, the 2026–2027 Super El Niño has begun making its presence known. The Amazon is suffering under intense heat and drought, priming the region for wildfires and pushing the forest closer to a worrisome possible fate: a transition from tropical forest to savanna grasslands. Fires have also begun blazing across Southeast Asia, while heavy rains began inundating the Horn of Africa in October. Arriving on the heels of severe drought, that one-two punch could devastate the region’s crops and pasturelands.
paras.zh: 在达到峰值强度的几个月前，2026-2027 年的超级厄尔尼诺现象已经开始为人所知。亚马逊地区正遭受酷热和干旱，导致该地区发生野火，并使森林更接近令人担忧的可能命运：从热带森林过渡到稀树草原。东南亚地区也开始发生大火，十月份大雨开始淹没非洲之角。严重干旱之后到来的一两击可能会摧毁该地区的农作物和牧场。

paras.en: In California, the first harbingers of the arrival of the Super El Niño appeared in early September. Heavy surf pounded the coastline. Regions from San Francisco to Los Angeles saw record high tides by late October that flooded city streets and battered coastlines and seawalls, even as the skies remained clear.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，超级厄尔尼诺现象的第一个预兆出现在九月初。猛烈的海浪冲击着海岸线。十月底，从旧金山到洛杉矶的地区出现了创纪录的高潮，尽管天空仍然晴朗，但洪水淹没了城市街道，摧毁了海岸线和海堤。

paras.en: The waves were amped up by an unfortunate trifecta: higher sea levels due to climate change; a lunar cycle that exerted its maximum pull on the tides; and an El Niño–linked phenomenon called Kelvin waves.
paras.zh: 不幸的三重影响加剧了海浪：气候变化导致海平面上升；对潮汐产生最大拉力的月球周期；以及一种与厄尔尼诺现象有关的现象，称为开尔文波。

paras.en: Kelvin waves are massive, slow-moving swells of warm ocean water, part of the complicated interplay between wind and water that produces the El Niño Southern Oscillation, the overall weather pattern that includes El Niño and counterpart La Niña events, says Josh Willis, an oceanographer at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, Calif.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的海洋学家乔什·威利斯说，开尔文波是温暖海水中巨大、缓慢移动的波浪，是风和水之间复杂相互作用的一部分，产生了厄尔尼诺南方涛动，整体天气模式包括厄尔尼诺和对应的拉尼娜事件。

paras.en: As prevailing west-blowing winds weaken over the tropical eastern Pacific, Willis says, water normally pushed west by the winds instead sloshes back eastward. Kelvin waves have historically given a boost to sea levels along the U.S. West Coast of as much as 30 centimeters. This year, that impact could be larger, researchers reported September 30 in a preprint study posted on EarthArXiv.org. Computer model simulations suggest that the risk of the risk of extreme sea levels could be 10 times higher during this El Niño year than during previous events, for coastlines from Alaska all the way to Chile.
paras.zh: 威利斯说，随着热带东太平洋盛行的西吹风减弱，通常被风推向西面的海水反而会向东回流。历史上，开尔文波曾导致美国西海岸海平面上升多达 30 厘米。研究人员于 9 月 30 日在 EarthArXiv.org 上发布的预印本研究报告称，今年这种影响可能会更大。计算机模型模拟表明，从阿拉斯加一直到智利的海岸线，今年厄尔尼诺现象发生的极端海平面风险可能比以往事件高出十倍。

paras.en: Then, by late October, the Santa Ana winds arrived: Hot, dry gusts blowing down the mountains toward the coast, fanning wildfires in Southern California. The fires scarred the landscape, denuding it of vegetation, roots that helped stabilize and fortify the soil. Such loosened soil is more likely to become mobilized into a debris flow during heavy rains.
paras.zh: 然后，到了十月底，圣安娜风袭来：炎热、干燥的阵风从山上吹向海岸，助长了南加州的野火。大火烧毁了土地，剥夺了植被和有助于稳定和强化土壤的根系。在大雨期间，这种松散的土壤更有可能变成泥石流。

paras.en: Those rains are now on the way. By mid-November, researchers began tracking storms headed for California. The peak of El Niño is expected to arrive by late November or early December and persist through February or March.
paras.zh: 那些雨现在正在路上。到 11 月中旬，研究人员开始追踪前往加利福尼亚州的风暴。预计厄尔尼诺现象的高峰期将在11月底或12月初到来，并持续到2月或3月。

paras.en: Segraves, after surviving nearly 30 years ago, says she is aware that another El Niño is coming. But she hasn’t been following the news closely. She’s placed herself on a news diet since her ordeal. She refused to speak to media for years, or even read the coverage about her own story.
paras.zh: 塞格雷夫斯在近 30 年前幸存下来后说，她意识到另一场厄尔尼诺现象即将到来。但她并没有密切关注这一消息。自从经历了磨难之后，她就开始关注新闻。她多年来拒绝接受媒体采访，甚至拒绝阅读有关她自己故事的报道。

paras.en: “Everyone wanted to talk to me and I just wanted to be left alone,” she says. Staying away from the news “freed me from all that. It changed my view on life. I take each day as it comes.”
paras.zh: “每个人都想和我说话，而我只想一个人呆着，”她说。远离新闻“让我摆脱了这一切。它改变了我对生活的看法。我接受每一天。”

paras.en: But, she adds, one lesson has stayed with her. “I swore I would never live on a cliff again.”
paras.zh: 但是，她补充道，有一个教训让她铭记在心。 “我发誓我再也不会住在悬崖上了。”

articles.title: Motion under the ocean explains the depth of the world’s deepest spot
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: Challenger Deep is the deepest valley in the deepest trench in the ocean, plunging to roughly 11,000 meters below sea level.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊 (Challenger Deep) 是海洋最深海沟中最深的山谷，深度约低于海平面 11,000 米。

paras.en: Now, scientists have a new clue about how it got to be so … well, deep.
paras.zh: 现在，科学家们找到了关于它如何变得如此……嗯，深的新线索。

paras.en: Challenger Deep is found within the Mariana Trench, a crescent-shaped gouge in the seafloor east of the Philippines in the Pacific Ocean.
