paras.zh: 卡塔尔锦标赛的举办地位于多哈郊区亚洲城的中心，居住着在首都工业区工作的南亚移民。

paras.en: For several thousand workers, a tournament bringing their home nations to their neighbourhood is a welcome change from the everyday grind of their work lives.
paras.zh: 对于数千名工人来说，将自己的祖国带到自己的邻里举办锦标赛是他们摆脱日常工作生活的一个可喜的改变。

paras.en: To have these matches a short walk away from their accommodation is an added bonus.
paras.zh: 距离住所仅几步之遥就能观看这些比赛，这是一个额外的好处。

paras.en: However, the lure of an India-Pakistan cricket match brought fans from across the Gulf state.
paras.zh: 然而，印度与巴基斯坦板球比赛的诱惑吸引了来自海湾国家各地的球迷。

paras.en: Doha resident Avinash Daniel, originally from India’s capital New Delhi, brought along his young family and two friends after hearing about the fixture.
paras.zh: 来自印度首都新德里的多哈居民阿维纳什·丹尼尔（Avinash Daniel）在听说这场比赛后，带着他年轻的家人和两个朋友一起前来。

paras.en: “It’s our first time watching an India-Pakistan match at a stadium and it’s been a great experience,” Daniel said.
paras.zh: “这是我们第一次在体育场观看印度与巴基斯坦的比赛，这是一次很棒的经历，”丹尼尔说。

paras.en: Sweeping his gaze around the stand, he pointed out that a mix of Indian and Pakistani fans surrounded his group but they were happily mingling with each other.
paras.zh: 他扫视看台周围，指出他的团队周围有印度和巴基斯坦的球迷，但他们很高兴地互相交流。

paras.en: “There are no different sides in the stands,” he said with a shrug. “No Indian stands, no Pakistani stands. We are all mixed. It’s a wonderful cultural experience.”
paras.zh: “看台上没有不同的一面，”他耸耸肩说道。 “没有印度看台，没有巴基斯坦看台。我们都是混血儿。这是一次美妙的文化体验。”

paras.en: Daniel, a railway engineer, believed the politicisation of cricket only benefits politicians, not cricketers or fans, who only want to enjoy the sport that offers a brief respite to its billions of fans.
paras.zh: 铁路工程师丹尼尔认为，板球政治化只会让政客受益，而不是板球运动员或球迷，他们只想享受这项为数十亿球迷提供短暂喘息机会的运动。

paras.en: “At the end of this match, both Indians and Pakistanis will go out and eat the same mandi – a traditional Arab rice and meat dish – probably cooked and served by Indians and Pakistanis.”
paras.zh: “这场比赛结束时，印度人和巴基斯坦人都会出去吃同样的曼迪——一种传统的阿拉伯米饭和肉类菜肴——可能是由印度人和巴基斯坦人烹饪和服务的。”

articles.title: MotoGP maestro Marquez makes history with eighth premier-class world title

paras.en: Spaniard Marc Marquez has been crowned MotoGP world champion for a record-equalling eighth time, screaming with joy at the Portuguese Grand Prix after a remarkable comeback this season.
paras.zh: 西班牙人马克·马尔克斯第八次加冕 MotoGP 世界冠军，追平纪录，本赛季出色复出后，他在葡萄牙大奖赛上欢呼雀跃。

paras.en: Ducati rider Marquez finished eighth on Sunday as Italian Marco Bezzecchi rode to victory in southern Portugal, but it was enough to seal a second consecutive world title.
paras.zh: 周日，杜卡迪车手马克斯获得第八名，意大利车手马可·贝泽基 (Marco Bezzecchi) 在葡萄牙南部取得胜利，但这足以连续第二次获得世界冠军。

paras.en: On crossing the line, the 33-year-old Marquez leapt from his bike and was hoisted up by his team before he ran towards his fans screaming with his arms aloft.
paras.zh: 冲过终点线后，33 岁的马克斯从自行车上跳下来，被队友举起，然后高举双臂向尖叫着的球迷跑去。

paras.en: “We need to be happy. I know that we are here celebrating a historic moment. I know how I suffered,” said an emotional Marquez, who underwent double surgery midway through the season.
paras.zh: “我们需要快乐。我知道我们在这里庆祝一个历史性的时刻。我知道我承受了多大的痛苦，”情绪激动的马尔克斯说道，他在赛季中期接受了两次手术。

paras.en: “I know that in the middle of the season, the fans believed more than I did. My people believed more than I did. But I kept pushing; I kept doing my best.
paras.zh: “我知道在赛季中期，球迷们比我更相信。我的人民比我更相信。但我一直在努力；我一直在尽力而为。

paras.en: “I said last year that it was a championship where I was at peace with myself. This one is for all the fans that believed in me from 2020 until now. So thanks to all of you, this is for all of you.”
paras.zh: “我去年就说过，这是一场让我内心平静的冠军。这是为所有从2020年至今相信我的球迷准备的。所以感谢你们所有人，这是为你们所有人准备的。”

paras.en: His eighth success in the premier class of motorcycling pulled Marquez level with Italian great Giacomo Agostini, who won his titles between 1966 and 1975.
paras.zh: 他在顶级摩托车比赛中取得的第八次成功使马克斯与意大利伟大的贾科莫·阿戈斯蒂尼 (Giacomo Agostini) 并驾齐驱，贾科莫·阿戈斯蒂尼在 1966 年至 1975 年间赢得了冠军。

paras.en: As a final flourish, the Spaniard ascended a staircase accompanied by the silhouette of a goat on the screen, a nod to his growing ‘Greatest of All Time’ status, before receiving a golden commemorative helmet from Agostini himself.
paras.zh: 作为最后的华丽表演，这位西班牙人在屏幕上的山羊剪影的陪伴下登上了楼梯，这是对他日益增长的“有史以来最伟大”地位的认可，然后从阿戈斯蒂尼本人手中接过一顶金色纪念头盔。

paras.en: He then attached another plaque with his name engraved on it on the Tower of Champions before embracing and lifting it over his head.
paras.zh: 然后，他将另一块刻有他名字的牌匾贴在冠军之塔上，然后将其抱起并举过头顶。

paras.en: Marquez’s latest triumph is even more remarkable given the Spaniard’s injury- and crash-blighted campaign in which he had to wait until the eighth race in Hungary on June 7 before claiming his first win.
paras.zh: 考虑到西班牙人饱受伤病困扰的赛季，马尔克斯的最新胜利更加引人注目，他必须等到 6 月 7 日在匈牙利举行的第八场比赛才获得首场胜利。

paras.en: Marquez suffered a flat tyre in the season-opener in Thailand in March, fell at the Spanish GP in Jerez and again at the French GP where he picked up a foot fracture which ruled him out of the following race, the Catalan GP.
paras.zh: 马克斯在三月份泰国的赛季揭幕战中轮胎漏气，在赫雷斯举行的西班牙大奖赛上摔倒，并在法国大奖赛上再次遭遇脚部骨折，这使他无法参加接下来的加泰罗尼亚大奖赛。

paras.en: Making his comeback at the Italian GP in Mugello, he trailed Bezzecchi by 102 points in early June, just weeks after undergoing foot surgery on top of a previous operation on his injured shoulder.
paras.zh: 六月初，他在穆杰罗举行的意大利大奖赛上复出，落后贝泽奇 102 分，而就在几周前，他在受伤的肩膀上接受了足部手术。

paras.en: But the Spaniard managed to bounce back once again, defying those who had already written him off.
paras.zh: 但西班牙人再次成功反弹，无视那些已经对他不屑一顾的人。

paras.en: Once he got rolling, he roared into a regular winning run with seven Grands Prix and 10 sprint race victories in all this season.
paras.zh: 一旦他开始行动起来，他就在整个赛季中赢得了 7 场大奖赛和 10 场冲刺赛胜利，从而赢得了常规胜利。

paras.en: While not as obviously dominant as winning 11 GPs in the 2025 season, when an unexpected return to form following his 2024 switch to Ducati gave him a new lease of life, the latest win is as impressive.
paras.zh: 虽然不像 2025 赛季赢得 11 场大奖赛那样具有明显的统治力，但在 2024 年转投杜卡迪后意外恢复状态给了他新的生命，最新的胜利同样令人印象深刻。

paras.en: Marquez had been the youngest-ever premier-class champion in his debut season in 2013 for Honda and then went on to win the title in five of the next six seasons.
paras.zh: 马克斯在 2013 年代表本田车队的首个赛季中成为了有史以来最年轻的顶级冠军，并在接下来的六个赛季中的五个赛季中赢得了冠军。

paras.en: He also overtook his great rival Valentino Rossi, who won seven MotoGP titles, although the swashbuckling Italian has 89 individual race wins in the top category compared with Marquez’s 80.
paras.zh: 他还超越了他的劲敌瓦伦蒂诺·罗西（Valentino Rossi），后者赢得了 7 个 MotoGP 冠军，尽管这位虚张声势的意大利人在顶级类别中获得了 89 场个人比赛胜利，而马克斯则有 80 场。

paras.en: Having crashed during Saturday’s sprint race, Marquez rode out Sunday’s GP safely, needing only to finish in the top nine to secure his 10th title across all categories combined.
paras.zh: 马克斯在周六的冲刺赛中发生撞车事故后，在周日的大奖赛中安全出局，只需进入前九名即可获得他在所有类别中的第十个冠军头衔。

paras.en: Aprilia’s Bezzecchi won Sunday’s race to complete the double in Portugal, having also won the sprint, with his stablemate Jorge Martin of Spain crossing in second.
paras.zh: 阿普利亚车队的贝泽基在周日的葡萄牙比赛中获胜，完成了双冠王，同时还赢得了冲刺赛，他的西班牙队友豪尔赫·马丁获得第二名。

paras.en: With a total of 439 points and seven victories this year, this was enough for Marquez to keep his rivals at bay.
paras.zh: 今年，马克斯总共获得了 439 分并获得了 7 场胜利，这足以让他的对手望而却步。

paras.en: Martin is second with 396 points but only one win, and Bezzecchi, who has 394 points and seven first-place finishes, is third ahead of the season finale in Valencia, Spain, next weekend.
paras.zh: 马丁以 396 分排名第二，但只取得一场胜利，而贝泽基则以 394 分和七次第一名的成绩，在下周末于西班牙巴伦西亚举行的赛季决赛之前排名第三。

paras.en: “Thank you for this bike,” Marquez told his team Ducati during his victory lap.
paras.zh: “谢谢你的这辆自行车，”马克斯在他的胜利圈中告诉他的杜卡迪车队。

articles.title: Luxury development planned on land some Albanians say is theirs, not Jared Kushner's
articles.author: Rob Schmitz

paras.en: Luxury development planned on land some Albanians say is theirs, not Jared Kushner's
paras.zh: 一些阿尔巴尼亚人称土地上的豪华开发项目是他们的，而不是贾里德·库什纳的

paras.en: A company working for President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner purchased 300 acres of Albanian land for more than $130 million in April. But Albanians in the area tell NPR this is not Kushner's land — it's theirs.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统女婿贾里德·库什纳 (Jared Kushner) 的一家公司于 4 月份以超过 1.3 亿美元的价格购买了 300 英亩的阿尔巴尼亚土地。但该地区的阿尔巴尼亚人告诉美国公共广播电台，这不是库什纳的土地，而是他们的土地。

paras.en: In the summer of 2021, Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump boarded a yacht owned by Nat Rothschild, an heir to the European banking family. On the way from Montenegro to Greece, the yacht anchored off the coast of Albania, and as Kushner told an investment conference last year, that's when Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama arrived at the boat to tell them about his plan for the country.
paras.zh: 2021 年夏天，贾里德·库什纳 (Jared Kushner) 和伊万卡·特朗普 (Ivanka Trump) 登上了欧洲银行家族继承人纳特·罗斯柴尔德 (Nat Rothschild) 拥有的一艘游艇。在从黑山飞往希腊的途中，这艘游艇停泊在阿尔巴尼亚海岸，库什纳去年在一次投资会议上发表讲话时，阿尔巴尼亚总理埃迪·拉马抵达船上，向他们讲述了他对该国的计划。

paras.en: JARED KUSHNER: But I was very, very impressed with his vision for what he wanted to do with Albania. I really didn't know anything about the country. I didn't understand the history. And the darkness of the history with the communism and the terrible leadership actually led to it being fully undeveloped as a nation.
paras.zh: 贾里德·库什纳：但他对阿尔巴尼亚的愿景给我留下了非常非常深刻的印象。我真的对这个国家一无所知。我不明白历史。共产主义的黑暗历史和可怕的领导实际上导致了它作为一个国家的完全不发达。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: A year later, Kushner was looking for development opportunities in the Balkans. He returned to the Albanian coast to the city of Vlorë, which was finishing the construction of an airport atop a wetland near an undeveloped coastline.
paras.zh: 施密茨：一年后，库什纳在巴尔干地区寻找发展机会。他返回阿尔巴尼亚海岸发罗拉市，该市正在未开发的海岸线附近的湿地上完成机场建设。

paras.en: KUSHNER: Obviously, a country is going to build an airport by the coast in the place that they think is the most beautiful. So we went there, we looked for opportunities, and we were able to find some incredible, incredible opportunities.
paras.zh: 库什纳：显然，一个国家将在他们认为最美丽的地方建造一个沿海机场。所以我们去了那里，寻找机会，我们能够找到一些令人难以置信的机会。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: And this is where Kushner found these opportunities.
paras.zh: 施密茨：这就是库什纳发现这些机会的地方。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Hidrovor Beach is an expanse of caramel-colored sand with the gentle waves of the Adriatic lapping its perimeter. Albanian authorities say that a company working for Kushner purchased this land and hundreds of acres surrounding it for more than $130 million in April of this year. But several people in Albania tell NPR, this is not Kushner's land. They say it's theirs.
paras.zh: 施密茨：Hidrovor 海滩是一片焦糖色的沙滩，亚得里亚海的温柔海浪拍打着它的周边。阿尔巴尼亚当局表示，今年 4 月，一家为库什纳工作的公司以超过 1.3 亿美元的价格购买了这片土地及其周围的数百英亩土地。但阿尔巴尼亚的一些人告诉美国公共广播电台，这不是库什纳的土地。他们说这是他们的。

paras.en: GENTIAN MOÇKA: This land here belonged to my family for centuries.
paras.zh: 龙胆莫卡：这片土地几个世纪以来一直属于我的家族。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Gentian Moçka says his family has owned this strip of beach and wetlands since the time of the Ottoman Empire. He's provided NPR land titles that appear to prove this. After World War II, Albania's communist government seized it, along with all private land. When communism fell in 1991, families like Moçka's embarked on a yearslong process to get their land back.
paras.zh: 施密茨：龙胆莫卡说，自奥斯曼帝国时代以来，他的家族就拥有这片海滩和湿地。他提供的 NPR 土地所有权似乎证明了这一点。第二次世界大战后，阿尔巴尼亚共产党政府占领了它以及所有私人土地。 1991 年共产主义垮台后，像莫卡这样的家庭开始了长达数年的收回土地的过程。

paras.en: MOÇKA: But then our problems started with guys that were much more powerful than we were, had a lot of political support, were very rich and very well connected with the politics of that time.
paras.zh: 莫奇卡：但后来我们的问题开始于比我们强大得多的人，他们有很多政治支持，非常富有，并且与当时的政治关系密切。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: In 2006, Moçka learned that someone else was laying claim to his family's land, a man named Artur Shehu, who was a familiar name for those who lived here in the 1990s when the regional capital of Vlorë was outside the control of the country's government. It was instead run by Mafia-style gangs, as captured by news video from the AP at that time.
paras.zh: 施密茨：2006 年，莫卡得知有人对他家族的土地提出了所有权要求，这个人名叫阿图尔·谢胡 (Artur Shehu)，这个名字对于 20 世纪 90 年代住在这里的人来说是一个熟悉的名字，当时发罗拉地区首府不受该国政府的控制。正如美联社当时的新闻视频所记录的那样，它是由黑手党风格的团伙经营的。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Artur Shehu was well known to police in Vlorë for his alleged involvement in a crime syndicate that, according to Albanian prosecutors, smuggled drugs and migrants into Europe. He fled Albania in 1999 after what police say was a shootout with a rival gang. He ended up in the United States, where he received asylum in 2001 and later became a U.S. citizen. The 60-year-old Shehu now lives in a villa in Miami Beach.
paras.zh: 施密茨：阿图尔·谢胡因涉嫌参与犯罪集团而为发罗拉警方所熟知，据阿尔巴尼亚检察官称，该犯罪集团向欧洲走私毒品和移民。 1999年，警方称他与敌对帮派发生枪战后，他逃离了阿尔巴尼亚。他最终来到了美国，并于 2001 年获得庇护，后来成为美国公民。 60岁的谢胡现在住在迈阿密海滩的一栋别墅里。

paras.en: But he's continued to manage a growing real estate portfolio back in Albania through an associate in Vlorë named Pëllumb Petritaj. The pair has claimed plots of land, including Moçka's family plot on the beach, up and down the southern Albanian coast, and prosecutors have taken notice. In 2018, Petritaj served three years in prison for forging land titles on behalf of Shehu. And on Wednesday, Petritaj was sentenced to another seven years in prison for falsifying documents to $17 million worth of oceanfront property in the city of Vlorë on behalf of Shehu. The court ordered the land confiscated from Shehu last week.
paras.zh: 但他继续通过发罗拉的一位名叫 Pëllumb Petritaj 的合伙人管理阿尔巴尼亚不断增长的房地产投资组合。两人声称拥有阿尔巴尼亚南部海岸上的土地，包括莫奇卡家族在海滩上的土地，检察官已经注意到了这一点。 2018 年，Petritaj 因代表 Shehu 伪造土地所有权而入狱三年。周三，Petritaj 因代表 Shehu 伪造发罗拉市价值 1,700 万美元海滨房产的文件而被另外判处七年监禁。法院上周下令没收谢胡的土地。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: The pair has also claimed oceanfront farmland in the village of Zvërnec, adjacent to Moçka's beach.
paras.zh: 施密茨：两人还声称拥有 Zvërnec 村的海滨农田，毗邻 Moçka 的海滩。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: The quiet village has only a couple hundred residents. Most of them, like Minela Konomi (ph) and Natasha Kota are past the age of 70. I asked them if they know who Artur Shehu is.
paras.zh: 施密茨：这个安静的村庄只有几百名居民。他们中的大多数人，比如 Minela Konomi（博士）和 Natasha Kota 都已经超过 70 岁了。我问他们是否知道 Artur Shehu 是谁。

paras.en: MINELA KONOMI: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: MINELA KONOMI：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: "He is from the village of Kaninë, far from here up in the mountains," says Konomi, "but his family has never lived here. He's involved in shady dealings," Konomi says. Then Mrs. Kota speaks up.
paras.zh: 施密茨：“他来自卡尼内村，远离这里的山区，”科诺米说，“但他的家人从未住在这里。他参与了不正当的交易​​，”科诺米说。然后科塔夫人开口了。

paras.en: NATASHA KOTA: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: NATASHA KOTA：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: KOTA: "There wasn't a single soul of that family living here, going back to the Ottoman times," she says. "We've heard stories about him, and we're very scared of him."
paras.zh: KOTA：“可以追溯到奥斯曼帝国时代，那个家庭没有一个灵魂住在这里，”她说。 “我们听说过有关他的故事，我们非常害怕他。”

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Twenty years ago, Kota, Konomi and dozens of others in this village learned that Artur Shehu had somehow acquired their farmland. They filed suit in Albanian court to reclaim their land, a fight that escalated this past April when Shehu sold the parcel that includes what they say is their farmland to a company developing a luxury resort project for Kushner. That transaction, however, is under review. In court documents obtained by NPR, Albanian prosecutors argue that the land involved in Kushner's development is, quote, "suspected of having been illegally acquired through forgery."
paras.zh: 施密茨：二十年前，Kota、Konomi 和这个村子里的其他几十个人得知 Artur Shehu 以某种方式获得了他们的农田。他们向阿尔巴尼亚法院提起诉讼，要求收回自己的土地，今年 4 月，谢胡将包括他们所说的农田在内的地块卖给了一家为库什纳开发豪华度假村项目的公司，这场斗争进一步升级。不过，该交易正在接受审查。在美国公共广播电台获得的法庭文件中，阿尔巴尼亚检察官辩称，库什纳开发项目涉及的土地“涉嫌通过伪造手段非法获得”。

paras.en: For his part, Kushner issued a statement on his website saying his partnership purchased the land from a private party in a private transaction. Title, he wrote, was reviewed by counsel and verified. NPR has reached out to Artur Shehu, but he did not respond. He has previously denied any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 库什纳则在其网站上发表声明称，他的合伙企业通过私人交易从私人手中购买了这块土地。他写道，标题已由律师审查并核实。 NPR 已联系 Artur Shehu，但他没有回应。他此前否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: KUJTIM CAKRANI: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: KUJTIM CAKRANI：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: However, a former lawyer for Shehu, a man named Kujtim Cakrani, was willing to talk.
paras.zh: 施密茨：不过，谢胡的前律师库吉蒂姆·卡克拉尼 (Kujtim Cakrani) 愿意谈谈。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Cakrani, dressed in a black suit and tie with slicked back hair, admits that individuals who were authorized by Artur Shehu as his power of attorney did forge documents related to the land that is now tied to Jared Kushner. He says Shehu's associates forged an inheritance certificate that made it appear that Shehu's grandfather had owned the land, which was then passed to Artur Shehu himself. And then last April, he sold that land to a pair of Syrian-born brothers who are now billionaires living in Qatar, Moataz and Ramez Al Khayyat. They are financial partners of Jared Kushner.
paras.zh: 施密茨：卡克拉尼穿着黑色西装，打着领带，头发梳得光亮，承认阿图尔·谢胡授权的个人确实伪造了与现在与贾里德·库什纳有联系的土地有关的文件。他说，谢胡的同伙伪造了一份继承证明，使谢胡的祖父拥有这片土地，然后将土地传给了阿图尔谢胡本人。去年四月，他将这块土地卖给了一对出生在叙利亚的兄弟，莫阿塔兹和拉梅兹·阿尔·海亚特，他们现在是居住在卡塔尔的亿万富翁。他们是贾里德·库什纳的财务合作伙伴。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Cakrani says that when he discovered that Artur Shehu was involved in this forgery, he dropped him as his client. "It was too serious of a matter, and I can no longer defend him," Cakrani says. "And this is why," he says, "prosecutors have put Artur under investigation and have frozen his bank accounts." Cakrani says he is now representing a group of 30 relatives of Artur Shehu who he claims to be the rightful owners of this land.
paras.zh: 施密茨：卡克拉尼说，当他发现阿图尔谢胡参与了这起伪造事件时，他放弃了他的客户身份。 “事情太严重了，我无法再为他辩护，”卡克拉尼说。 “这就是为什么，”他说，“检察官对阿图尔进行调查并冻结了他的银行账户。”卡克拉尼表示，他现在代表阿图尔·谢胡 (Artur Shehu) 30 名亲属组成的团体，他声称这些人是这片土地的合法所有者。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Gentian Moçka as well as Minela Konomi and Natasha Kota in Zvërnec tell NPR that nobody by the name of Shehu - Artur nor his relatives - has any legal claim to what they say is their land, oceanfront land that has now been claimed by several parties, including the son-in-law of the president of the United States.
paras.zh: 施密茨：Zvërnec 的 Gentian Moçka 以及 Minela Konomi 和 Natasha Kota 告诉 NPR，没有任何一个名叫 Shehu 的人——Artur 和他的亲戚——对他们所说的他们的土地、海滨土地拥有任何合法的权利，现在已经有多个政党声称拥有权利，其中包括美国总统的女婿。

paras.en: RODEN HOXHA: Now that it's Kushner in it, everybody is freaking out.
paras.zh: 罗登·霍查：现在库什纳也参与其中，每个人都吓坏了。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Albanian real estate expert Roden Hoxha has seen this kind of land battle many times before. He says land ownership in Albania is complicated by decades under a Stalinist regime that stole all the land from private owners and collectivized it. And when communism fell in 1991, he says Albania became a land-grab free-for-all.
paras.zh: 施密茨：阿尔巴尼亚房地产专家罗登·霍查此前多次目睹过这种土地争夺战。他说，阿尔巴尼亚的土地所有权在斯大林主义政权统治下几十年来变得复杂，该政权从私人所有者手中窃取了所有土地并将其集体化。他说，当 1991 年共产主义垮台时，阿尔巴尼亚变成了一个混战的土地争夺地。

paras.en: HOXHA: And it was so disorganized - it was basically chaos - that people started claiming land wherever, you know, they threw a stone. It was basically the Albanian version of U.S.'s claiming of the West.
paras.zh: 霍查：事情非常混乱——基本上是一片混乱——人们开始在他们扔石头的地方索取土地。这基本上是美国对西方主张的阿尔巴尼亚版本。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Complete, Hoxha says, with wealthy speculators, keen to exploit the chaos of the moment and with multiple levels - locals whose families have farmed the land for generations, well-connected operators like Shehu who aggressively try to claim that land.
paras.zh: 施密茨：霍查说，已经完成了，富有的投机者热衷于利用当前的混乱局面，而且是多层次的——家族世世代代耕种土地的当地人，像谢胡这样人脉广泛的经营者，积极地试图夺取这片土地。

paras.en: HOXHA: And then on the international level, it exploded because it was Kushner and Trump and Arab money behind it.
paras.zh: 霍查：然后在国际层面上，它爆炸了，因为背后有库什纳、特朗普和阿拉伯资金。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: And Hoxha says, what at first appeared to be yet another Albanian land dispute now has ties all the way to the White House. In the end, an Albanian court will likely decide who the rightful owner of this property is. But for now, the corruption this deal suggests has sparked unprecedented public outrage in Albania.
paras.zh: 施密茨：霍查说，乍一看似乎是另一场阿尔巴尼亚土地纠纷，现在却与白宫有着千丝万缕的联系。最终，阿尔巴尼亚法院可能会决定谁是该财产的合法所有者。但就目前而言，这笔交易所暗示的腐败已经在阿尔巴尼亚引发了前所未有的公众愤怒。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Protesters have taken to the streets of the capital, Tirana, every day since May 31, calling on Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign, but Rama has only vowed to crack down harder on what have become increasingly violent demonstrations against his entire government. Rama has vowed that Kushner's resort project will go ahead as planned, but an ongoing investigation by Albania's state prosecutor into forged land titles could halt the project.
paras.zh: 施密茨：自5月31日以来，抗议者每天都走上首都地拉那的街头，呼吁总理埃迪·拉马辞职，但拉马只是发誓要更严厉地镇压针对他的整个政府的日益暴力的示威活动。拉玛誓言库什纳的度假村项目将按计划进行，但阿尔巴尼亚国家检察官正在进行的对伪造土地所有权的调查可能会阻止该项目。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: When contacted by NPR, a spokesperson for Prime Minister Edi Rama sent a statement which read that, quote, "if the seller does not have legitimate ownership of the property, the money will remain within the Republic of Albania. And certainly, it will be used for anyone who proves that his claim over the property is grounded." The statement went on to say that the ambition for Rama's government is to create a new benchmark for sustainable Mediterranean development, a goal that aligns with Jared Kushner's vision for a luxury resort, a five-star ecotourism site, as his wife, Ivanka Trump laid out in a podcast episode called "Ivanka Trump On Building The Authentic Life."
paras.zh: 施密茨：当国家公共广播电台联系时，总理埃迪·拉马的发言人发表了一份声明，其中援引，“如果卖方没有该财产的合法所有权，这笔钱将留在阿尔巴尼亚共和国境内。当然，这笔钱将用于任何证明他对该财产的主张是有根据的人。”声明接着说，拉玛政府的雄心是为地中海可持续发展建立一个新的基准，这一目标与贾里德·库什纳的豪华度假村、五星级生态旅游胜地的愿景相一致，正如他的妻子伊万卡·特朗普在名为“伊万卡·特朗普建设真实生活”的播客节目中所阐述的那样。

paras.en: IVANKA TRUMP: For me, it feels more like a challenge than anything else, the culmination of all of my experience in real estate, all of my travel, a lot of reflection on how I want to live.
paras.zh: 伊万卡·特朗普：对我来说，这感觉更像是一个挑战，而不是其他任何事情，是我所有房地产经验、我所有旅行、对我想要如何生活的大量反思的顶峰。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: In the podcast, Trump described both the Zvërnec beachfront property, as well as an island across from it, named Sazan, as part of a development project belonging to her and Kushner.
paras.zh: 施密茨：在播客中，特朗普描述了 Zvërnec 海滨房产以及对面的一座名为 Sazan 的岛屿，这是她和库什纳开发项目的一部分。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Getting to Sazan from the mainland takes about an hour by boat. Today, tour operator Sharif Durmichai (ph), who insists I call him by his nickname Capitan Bacchi (ph), takes me to the uninhabited island.
paras.zh: 施密茨：从大陆到萨赞乘船大约需要一个小时。今天，旅行社 Sharif Durmichai（博士）带我去了这座无人岛，他坚持要求我用他的昵称 Capitan Bacchi（博士）称呼他。

paras.en: SHARIF DURMICHAI: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: SHARIF DURMICHAI：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: When we get there, we hike up a trail past foxholes. Signs along the trail warn passersby to stick to the trail lest they step on a landmine. For years, this island was a fortified military outpost. I ask him what he thinks about Trump and Kushner's plans for the region and the protests that have followed them.
paras.zh: 施密茨：当我们到达那里时，我们沿着一条小路徒步经过散兵坑。沿途的标志警告路人要沿着小路走，以免踩到地雷。多年来，这座岛屿一直是一个戒备森严的军事前哨。我问他对特朗普和库什纳对该地区的计划以及随之而来的抗议活动有何看法。

paras.en: DURMICHAI: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: DURMICHAI：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: "I work in tourism," he says, "and I'm from here. If you've seen how local developers, along with the local Mafia, have built this region, it's a massacre," he says. "They've destroyed so much of what is a beautiful coastline. I support the Kushner project because it's going to be ecologically sustainable, and it will set a good benchmark for future projects. We are a small country," Capitan Bacchi says, "and Kushner and Trump are very big names." Big names that'll be in the crosshairs of an incoming Democratic Congress back in the U.S.
paras.zh: 施密茨：“我从事旅游业，”他说，“我来自这里。如果你看到当地开发商和当地黑手党如何建设这个地区，那简直就是一场屠杀，”他说。 “他们破坏了美丽海岸线的大部分。我支持库什纳项目，因为它将在生态上可持续，并且将为未来的项目树立良好的基准。我们是一个小国家，”巴基上尉说，“而库什纳和特朗普都是非常有名的人。”即将在美国召开的民主党国会将成为焦点的大人物

paras.en: JAMIE RASKIN: This is an individual in the Trump family who has essentially been two-timing on the American people.
paras.zh: 杰米·拉斯金：这是特朗普家族中的一个人，他基本上对美国人民进行了双重打击。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Democratic Maryland Congressman Jamie Raskin will soon head the House Judiciary Committee and will have power to investigate and subpoena members of the president's family. He says he'll be focusing on Jared Kushner, who he says has been splitting his time between foreign policy and making business deals on the side.
paras.zh: 施密茨：马里兰州民主党众议员杰米·拉斯金很快将担任众议院司法委员会主席，并将有权调查和传唤总统家人。他说他将把重点放在贾里德·库什纳身上，他说库什纳一直把时间花在外交政策和做商业交易上。

paras.en: RASKIN: American foreign policy has never seen anything like that before. And in this, of course, he is only imitating his father-in-law, who declared that he got $2.2 billion on the side in his first year in office. That's more than $1 million an hour.
paras.zh: 拉斯金：美国的外交政策以前从未出现过这样的情况。当然，他只是在模仿他的岳父，岳父宣称他在上任第一年就获得了 22 亿美元的额外收入。这相当于每小时超过 100 万美元。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Congressman Raskin says the luxury resort project in Albania is one of many Kushner-backed deals that have prompted investigative inquiries from his committee, and there could be more as the new Congress is sworn in.
paras.zh: 施密茨：拉斯金议员表示，阿尔巴尼亚的豪华度假村项目是库什纳支持的众多交易之一，这些交易引发了他的委员会的调查，随着新国会宣誓就职，可能还会有更多交易。

articles.title: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory
articles.author: Teri Schultz

paras.en: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory
paras.zh: 乌克兰战争蔓延至北约领土

paras.en: The war between Russia and Ukraine once again creeps onto European territory – from attacks on ships to missiles in Poland and fresh allegations of Russian operations inside Denmark.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争再次蔓延到欧洲领土——从波兰的船只袭击到导弹袭击，再到俄罗斯在丹麦境内行动的新指控。

paras.en: A Russian ship was set ablaze after it was struck by a drone in the Baltic Sea. Yet another sign that the war in Ukraine is, at times, spilling over into the rest of Europe. This comes just days after President Trump called Russian President Vladimir Putin his friend. Teri Schultz joins us now from Brussels. Teri, let's start in the Gulf of Finland. A Russian cargo ship was hit by a drone there Saturday and caught fire. What's the latest on that?
paras.zh: 一艘俄罗斯船只在波罗的海被无人机击中后起火。另一个迹象表明，乌克兰战争有时会蔓延到欧洲其他地区。就在几天前，特朗普总统称俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京为朋友。泰瑞·舒尔茨 (Teri Schultz) 现在从布鲁塞尔加入我们。泰瑞，我们从芬兰湾开始吧。周六，一艘俄罗斯货船在那里被一架无人机击中并起火。最新消息是什么？

paras.en: TERI SCHULTZ, BYLINE: Well, a few hours ago, Rob, Russia took control of this cargo ship, the Sparta II, and towed it out of Finnish waters a day after, as you mentioned, it was hit by a drone. The crew was rescued by another Russian vessel traveling nearby at the time of the strike. Now, the attack is presumed to have come from Ukraine, but Kyiv has not yet claimed responsibility. Finnish President Alexander Stubb referred to the incident as an unfortunate reminder that the, quote, "consequences of Russia's war of aggression are also visible in our region." Interestingly, teams from both Finland and neighboring Estonia came Saturday and helped Russian ships try to put out the fire on board. Stubb thanked all of those involved for what he called responsible and professional actions.
paras.zh: 泰瑞·舒尔茨连线：几个小时前，罗布，俄罗斯控制了这艘货船“斯巴达二号”，并在一天后将其拖离芬兰水域，正如您提到的，它被一架无人机击中。袭击发生时，船员被附近行驶的另一艘俄罗斯船只救起。现在，袭击被推测来自乌克兰，但基辅尚未声称对此负责。芬兰总统亚历山大·斯塔布称这一事件不幸地提醒人们，“俄罗斯侵略战争的后果在我们地区也显而易见”。有趣的是，来自芬兰和邻国爱沙尼亚的团队周六抵达，帮助俄罗斯船只试图扑灭船上的大火。斯塔布感谢所有相关人员采取的负责任和专业的行动。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So if the Sparta II was in the service of the Russian military, why didn't Finland seize the ship to put it out of business?
paras.zh: 施密茨：那么，如果斯巴达二号是为俄罗斯军队服务的，为什么芬兰没有扣押这艘船并使其停业呢？

paras.en: SCHULTZ: There was a lot of talk about this in Finland because this ship transports weapons and other supplies to Russia to use against Ukraine. And the vessel itself is under U.S. and U.K. sanctions, and its owner is under European Union sanctions. But the conclusion this time was that it would create too big an environmental hazard to keep it in Finnish waters. Here's how it was described in a press conference by Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti, the director of sea operations for the Finnish Border Guard.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：芬兰对此进行了很多讨论，因为这艘船向俄罗斯运送武器和其他物资，用于对抗乌克兰。该船本身受到美国和英国的制裁，其船东也受到欧盟的制裁。但这次的结论是，将其留在芬兰水域会造成太大的环境危害。芬兰边防卫队海上行动总监尤卡-佩卡·卢米拉蒂 (Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti) 在新闻发布会上是这样描述的。

paras.en: JUKKA-PEKKA LUMILAHTI: (Through interpreter) If we would let the vessel burn, it would most likely sink. And after that, it would cause a major environmental risk for Finland and Estonia.
paras.zh: JUKKA-PEKKA LUMILAHTI：（通过翻译）如果我们让船只燃烧，它很可能会沉没。此后，这将对芬兰和爱沙尼亚造成重大环境风险。

paras.en: SCHULTZ: So as much as Finland would be pleased to take a military cargo ship out of Moscow's arsenal, in this case, they were basically saying good riddance.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：尽管芬兰很乐意从莫斯科的军火库中取出一艘军用货船，但在这种情况下，他们基本上是在说好摆脱。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So Ukraine is not the only one launching far-reaching strikes. Last Friday, Russia launched missiles into Polish territory. And I understand that you were there covering a nearby military exercise involving nearly a dozen countries, and it was that that was suspected to be Russia's reason for doing this, right?
paras.zh: 施密茨：所以乌克兰并不是唯一发动影响深远的袭击的国家。上周五，俄罗斯向波兰境内发射了导弹。据我了解，你当时正在现场报道附近有近十几个国家参加的军事演习，这被怀疑是俄罗斯这样做的原因，对吗？

paras.en: SCHULTZ: Yeah, that's right. There were three Russian cruise missiles that landed between 30 and 60 miles from this military exercise, which was training forces for what's envisioned to eventually be a peace-monitoring mission in post-war Ukraine. At the time, all we knew on the ground was that there were multiple air alerts, at one time even telling us to take cover. And that happens often in Poland, especially at that location just over a hundred miles from the Ukrainian border. But this is particularly risky for the Russians, as they never know whether they'll kill people from a NATO country on the ground. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte was asked by a crowd of reporters in Warsaw whether the alliance can do anything to stop these Russian incursions.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：是的，没错。三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹落在距这次军事演习 30 至 60 英里的地方，此次演习旨在训练部队，以执行最终在战后乌克兰执行的和平监测任务。当时，我们只知道地面上有多次空中警报，甚至有一次告诉我们要隐蔽。这种情况在波兰经常发生，尤其是在距离乌克兰边境仅一百多英里的地方。但这对俄罗斯人来说尤其危险，因为他们永远不知道自己是否会杀死来自北约国家的人。北约秘书长马克·吕特在华沙被一群记者询问北约是否可以采取措施阻止俄罗斯的入侵。

paras.en: MARK RUTTE: I cannot guarantee you that it will not happen. But I can guarantee you is that NATO will defend every inch of Polish territory, that as a collective alliance, we impose immense costs on Russians.
paras.zh: 马克·鲁特：我不能向你保证这不会发生。但我可以向你们保证，北约将保卫每一寸波兰领土，作为一个集体联盟，我们给俄罗斯人带来了巨大的代价。

paras.en: SCHULTZ: Now, Rob, NATO ambassadors will meet Monday morning in a special session to discuss what more their countries may be able to do to protect Poland.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：现在，罗布，北约大使将于周一上午召开特别会议，讨论他们的国家可以采取哪些措施来保护波兰。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That is Teri Schultz in Brussels. Teri, thanks so much for your reporting.
paras.zh: 施密茨：那是布鲁塞尔的泰瑞·舒尔茨。泰瑞，非常感谢您的报告。

paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: San Francisco 49ers lineman Colton McKivitz suffers injury so gruesome players from both teams turn away

paras.en: NFL players are used to football's violence and the price that sometimes must be paid in the currency of pain and injuries. So, when a player is injured in such a manner that players refuse to look at their fallen teammate or opponent, you know it's terrible.
paras.zh: NFL 球员已经习惯了足球的暴力以及有时必须付出的痛苦和伤害的代价。所以，当一名球员受伤，以至于球员拒绝看倒下的队友或对手时，你就知道这是可怕的。

paras.en: That is exactly what played out with San Francisco 49ers right tackle Colton McKivitz during the 35-10 victory against the Minnesota Vikings in Mexico City on Sunday night.
paras.zh: 这正是旧金山 49 人队右截锋 Colton McKivitz 周日晚上在墨西哥城以 35-10 战胜明尼苏达维京人队的比赛中所上演的。

paras.en: During a second-quarter run to the right, McKivitz was caught in a pileup and his left leg was caught beneath other players.
paras.zh: 在第二节向右跑动时，麦基维茨陷入连环相撞，他的左腿被其他球员压在下面。

paras.en: When McKivitz freed his leg, his left ankle seemed to be dislocated and possibly fractured.
paras.zh: 当麦基维茨释放他的腿时，他的左脚踝似乎脱臼并可能骨折。

paras.en: And his leg was pointing in one direction and his foot was pointing in a different direction at a greater than 90-degree angle.
paras.zh: 他的腿指向一个方向，而他的脚则以大于 90 度的角度指向不同的方向。

paras.en: Players immediately sank to their knees or crouched, most facing away from the gruesome injury.
paras.zh: 球员们立即跪下或蹲下，大多数人背对着可怕的伤势。

paras.en: Even game officials looked away and shook their heads.
paras.zh: 就连比赛官员也移开了视线，摇摇头。

paras.en: San Francisco left tackle Trent Williams walked over to his fallen teammate, who was clutching at his lower leg. And when the injury came into focus, Williams took off his helmet and slammed it to the turf in frustration, empathy and perhaps pity.
paras.zh: 旧金山队左截锋特伦特·威廉姆斯走到倒地的队友身边，后者正抓着他的小腿。当伤势成为焦点时，威廉姆斯摘下头盔，将其摔在草坪上，带着沮丧、同情甚至怜悯。

paras.en: Trainers and other medical officials rushed to McKivitz and eventually loaded him on a cart to take him away to the locker room at Estadio Banorte.
paras.zh: 训练师和其他医疗官员赶到麦基维茨，最终将他装上一辆手推车，带他前往巴诺尔特球场的更衣室。

paras.en: By that time, the trainers had placed a compression brace on McKivitz and the injury was no longer visible. That's when teammates surrounded the cart McKivitz was on and paid their respects to their fallen teammate.
paras.zh: 那时，训练师已经给麦基维茨戴上了压缩支架，伤势已经不明显了。就在那时，队友们包围了麦基维茨所在的车，并向倒下的队友表示敬意。

paras.en: It was a horrible scene from start to finish.
paras.zh: 从始至终，这都是一个可怕的场景。

paras.en: There was nothing inspiring about it except for the brotherhood the Niners showed at the end. But stunningly, the 49ers soon regained their composure and got about their business.
paras.zh: 除了九人队最后表现出的兄弟情谊之外，没有什么鼓舞人心的。但令人惊讶的是，49 人队很快就恢复了冷静并开始做自己的事情。

paras.en: They scored a touchdown on a Mike Evans one-handed touchdown grab. And scored again on a Pick Six interception by Ji'Ayir Brown.
paras.zh: 他们通过迈克·埃文斯单手达阵抢球取得达阵。并在吉艾尔·布朗 (Ji'Ayir Brown) 的第六次拦截中再次得分。

paras.en: San Francisco never looked back, closing out a 35-10 win over the Vikings. The 49ers moved on even as it has become clear Colton McKivitz is not only done for this game but for the remainder of this season.
paras.zh: 旧金山队一往无前，最终以 35-10 战胜维京人队。尽管很明显科尔顿·麦基维茨不仅无法参加这场比赛，而且也无法参加本赛季剩余的比赛，但 49 人队仍继续前进。

articles.title: Lions' Jameson Williams does front flip touchdown celebration one week after Aidan Hutchinson's injury

paras.en: Aidan Hutchinson’s sack celebration, where he jumped in the air and threw his fist up in Germany in an ode to its soccer culture, unfortunately ended the Detroit Lions’ star’s season after suffering a knee injury.
paras.zh: 艾丹·哈钦森 (Aidan Hutchinson) 在德国举行的解雇庆祝活动中跳到空中并举起了拳头，以歌颂德国的足球文化，但不幸的是，他因膝盖受伤而结束了这位底特律雄狮队球星的赛季。

paras.en: So, surely Hutchinson’s injury would be a PSA on what not to do when celebrating a big play, right?
paras.zh: 那么，哈钦森的受伤肯定会成为一个公益广告，告诉人们在庆祝一场重大比赛时不应该做什么，对吗？

paras.en: Well, his Lions teammate, wide receiver Jameson Williams, might not have caught that memo when he decided to do a front flip while crossing the goal line for a 57-yard touchdown in the Lions’ win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers at home.
paras.zh: 好吧，他的雄狮队队友、外接手詹姆森·威廉姆斯（Jameson Williams）在雄狮队主场战胜坦帕湾海盗队的比赛中，在越过球门线并完成 57 码达阵时决定进行前空翻时，他可能没有注意到这一点。

paras.en: As you might expect, Williams caught flak from football fans for the celebration, which in usual times may look harmless.
paras.zh: 正如你所预料的那样，威廉姆斯的庆祝活动遭到了球迷的猛烈抨击，而在平时，这看起来似乎没什么害处。

paras.en: But considering what just happened to his team’s defensive captain just last week, and how it wasn’t a clean landing in the end zone, it wasn’t the best of decisions.
paras.zh: 但考虑到上周他球队的防守队长刚刚发生的事情，以及在达阵区的着陆不干净，这不是最好的决定。

paras.en: After the game, Williams spoke with ESPN’s Lindsey Thiry, who asked the veteran receiver if head coach Dan Campbell said anything about the celebration.
paras.zh: 赛后，威廉姆斯与 ESPN 的林赛·蒂里进行了交谈，林赛·蒂里询问这位经验丰富的接球手主教练丹·坎贝尔是否对庆祝活动说了些什么。

paras.en: "Yeah," he replied, "I tried to land it. I didn’t really know what to do, so I just did a front flip."
paras.zh: “是的，”他回答道，“我试图着陆。我真的不知道该怎么做，所以我只是做了一个前空翻。”

paras.en: "I’m going to try to land one later in the year for y’all, for sure" he added.
paras.zh: “我肯定会在今年晚些时候为大家争取到一个，”他补充道。

paras.en: Again, we’ve seen many flip celebrations throughout the NFL over the years. New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo, who promised he wouldn’t be doing his signature back flip anymore after seeing Hutchinson’s injury, couldn’t help himself when picking up the game-winning first down against the Jacksonville Jaguars hours after Williams’ own flip.
paras.zh: 多年来，我们在 NFL 中再次看到了许多翻转庆祝活动。纽约巨人队跑卫卡姆·斯卡特博在看到哈钦森受伤后承诺不会再做他标志性的后空翻，但在威廉姆斯自己空翻几个小时后，他在对阵杰克逊维尔美洲虎队的比赛中拿下了比赛的胜利。

paras.en: Emotions can take over in a game, and these elite athletes like to show off their skills when warranted.
paras.zh: 情绪可以在比赛中占据主导地位，这些精英运动员喜欢在必要时炫耀他们的技能。

paras.en: However, if you are deciding to jump, do a flip, or any other celebration that could have the potential for a freak injury, fans and media alike will be quick to judge as we’ve seen.
paras.zh: 然而，如果你决定跳跃、空翻或任何其他可能导致异常受伤的庆祝活动，球迷和媒体都会很快做出判断，就像我们所看到的那样。

articles.title: NFL replay booth wipes out Jaguars' Parker Washington touchdown in upset loss to Giants

paras.en: The New York Giants upset the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18 on Sunday, courtesy of a fourth-quarter goal-line stand from the NFL replay booth.
paras.zh: 纽约巨人队周日以 23-18 击败杰克逊维尔美洲虎队，得益于 NFL 重播室第四节球门线看台的帮助。

paras.en: Trailing 20-6 early in the fourth quarter, Jaguars QB Trevor Lawrence fired toward wide receiver Parker Washington in the back corner of the end zone.
paras.zh: 第四节初期，美洲虎队以 20-6 落后，美洲虎队四分卫特雷弗·劳伦斯 (Trevor Lawrence) 在达阵区后角向外接手帕克·华盛顿 (Parker Washington) 开枪。

paras.en: Washington went up, snagged the ball, switched hands midair and got both feet down before falling out of bounds. Officials waved it incomplete anyway. With a chance to make it a one-score game on the line, Jaguars coach Liam Coen threw the challenge flag.
paras.zh: 华盛顿起身，接住球，在半空中换手，双脚落地，然后摔出界外。无论如何，官员们认为它并不完整。由于有机会将比赛打成一分，美洲虎队主教练利亚姆·科恩抛出了挑战旗。

paras.en: The replay looked like six points to almost everyone watching, from fans at home to analysts in the booth. The league office saw it differently, letting the call stand and keeping Jacksonville out of the end zone.
paras.zh: 对于几乎每个观看比赛的人来说，从家里的球迷到展位上的分析师，重播看起来都是六分。联盟办公室对此有不同的看法，让判罚有效，并将杰克逊维尔排除在达阵区之外。

paras.en: Postgame, NFL replay vice president Mark Butterworth noted that the booth lacked clear and obvious evidence to overturn the call.
paras.zh: 赛后，NFL重播副总裁马克·巴特沃斯指出，展位缺乏明确、明显的证据来推翻这一决定。

paras.en: Because the ball shifted when Washington hit the turf, replay officials ruled he never established control until he was out of bounds.
paras.zh: 由于华盛顿击球时球发生了移动，重赛官员裁定他在出界之前从未建立过控制权。

paras.en: That conflicted with what Jacksonville heard on the sideline. Coen said officials blamed the call on Washington switching hands mid-catch.
paras.zh: 这与杰克逊维尔在场边听到的内容相矛盾。科恩表示，官员们将此归咎于华盛顿在捕捞过程中易手。

paras.en: Giants coach John Harbaugh kept it simple, saying the ball moved.
paras.zh: 巨人队教练约翰·哈博保持简单，说球移动了。

paras.en: Even Giants safety Jevon Holland admitted postgame he thought Washington had him beat:
paras.zh: 就连巨人队安全卫杰文·霍兰德也承认赛后他认为华盛顿击败了他：

paras.en: "The game's over ... that might have been a catch. That was a hell of a play. I thought he got his foot down, I was like, 'Damn.' But then they called it out and I was like, 'S--t, all right.' Shout-out Vegas. I don't know."
paras.zh: “比赛结束了……这可能是一个接球。那是一场精彩的比赛。我以为他已经站稳了脚跟，我当时想，‘该死。’”但后来他们大声喊道，我就说，‘好吧，好吧。’大声喊维加斯。我不知道。”

paras.en: Instead of cutting the deficit to seven, Jacksonville settled for a field goal to make it 20-9, a four-point swing in a five-point game.
paras.zh: 杰克逊维尔并没有将比分差距缩小到7分，而是通过投篮将比分追至20-9，在5分的比赛中领先4分。

paras.en: In the locker room, Jacksonville skipped the excuses.
paras.zh: 在更衣室里，杰克逊维尔没有找借口。

paras.en: "I felt good about it, but they said it wasn’t a catch, so had to move on and finish that game," Washington said after watching the replay on the stadium video board.
paras.zh: “我对此感觉很好，但他们说这不是一个接球，所以必须继续前进并完成那场比赛，”华盛顿在观看体育场视频板上的重播后说道。

paras.en: Replay drama aside, New York won this game up front. Giants linebacker Abdul Carter wrecked Jacksonville's protection, piling up two sacks, two tackles for loss, five QB hits and eight pressures.
paras.zh: 抛开重播戏剧不谈，纽约队领先赢得了这场比赛。巨人队线卫阿卜杜勒·卡特破坏了杰克逊维尔的保护，他两次擒杀、两次擒抱、五次四分卫击中和八次施压。

paras.en: The nonstop heat from the Giants' defensive line rattled Lawrence, who finished 25-of-47 for 301 yards and two picks. He took a beating, yet led a late touchdown drive to pull within five before time ran out.
paras.zh: 巨人队防守线的持续热度让劳伦斯感到不安，他47投25中，取得301码和2次选秀权。他遭受了打击，但在比赛结束前完成了一次达阵得分，将比分追至五分。

paras.en: New York escaped to protect its division lead.
paras.zh: 纽约逃脱以保护其分区领先地位。

paras.en: Between Carter wrecking the pocket and the replay booth wiping six points off the board, Jacksonville flew home empty-handed.
paras.zh: 在卡特击破口袋和重赛室抹去六分之间，杰克逊维尔空手飞回家。
