paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: NSW MP Alex Greenwich drops support for Fred Nile state funeral after blowback from LGBTQ+ community – as it happened
articles.author: Catie McLeod and Krishani Dhanji

paras.en: That’s where we’ll leave things for today. Thanks for reading. Here were our top stories:
paras.zh: 这就是我们今天要讨论的地方。感谢您的阅读。以下是我们的头条新闻：

paras.en: The treasurer warned Australians that “things will get a bit harder before they get easier” as he revealed next month’s budget update will show unemployment is expected to climb above 5% alongside slower economic growth for the next two years.
paras.zh: 财政部长警告澳大利亚人，“事情在变得容易之前会变得更困难”，他透露下个月的预算更新将显示，随着未来两年经济增长放缓，失业率预计将攀升至 5% 以上。

paras.en: The Liberal party confirmed a statement on Meldrum attributed to the Victorian opposition leader, Jess Wilson, was written using AI.
paras.zh: 自由党证实，维多利亚州反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊 (Jess Wilson) 发表的有关 Meldrum 的声明是使用人工智能撰写的。

paras.en: Separately, Albanese defended Chris Bowen from criticism the Cop31 climate summit was a “catastrophic diplomatic disaster” as the Coalition called for the minister to resign.
paras.zh: 另外，Albanese 为 Chris Bowen 辩护，反对批评 Cop31 气候峰会是一场“灾难性的外交灾难”，因为联盟要求部长辞职。

paras.en: Trade minister hopes EU trade deal will pass parliament early next year
paras.zh: 贸易部长希望欧盟贸易协议能在明年初通过议会

paras.en: The trade minister, Don Farrell, says he hopes Australia’s free trade deal with the European Union will pass parliament early in 2027.
paras.zh: 贸易部长唐·法雷尔 (Don Farrell) 表示，他希望澳大利亚与欧盟的自由贸易协定将于 2027 年初在议会获得通过。

paras.en: Farrell was interviewed on the ABC’s Afternoon Briefing program a short time ago, where he was asked about the deal.
paras.zh: 法雷尔不久前接受了美国广播公司下午简报节目的采访，被问及这笔交易。

paras.en: After almost a decade of negotiations, Labor hammered out a deal with the EU in March, expected to mean 98% of Australia’s goods exported to the EU will enter duty-free and be worth an initial $10bn a year.
paras.zh: 经过近十年的谈判，工党于 3 月份与欧盟敲定了一项协议，预计这意味着澳大利亚出口到欧盟的 98% 的商品将免税，最初价值每年 100 亿美元。

paras.en: The deal contains a commitment to respect the Paris climate agreement, which Australia is already a signatory to.
paras.zh: 该协议包含尊重巴黎气候协议的承诺，澳大利亚已经是该协议的签署国。

paras.en: Despite Farrell previously having warned there is no room to renegotiate the agreement, the Coalition has said it will not support the legislation required to enact the deal.
paras.zh: 尽管法雷尔此前警告称没有重新谈判该协议的空间，但联盟党表示不会支持实施该协议所需的立法。

paras.en: Today, Farrell said he had “not given up on anyone” supporting the legislation’s passage through parliament, which he hoped would occur “early in the new year”.
paras.zh: 今天，法雷尔表示，他“没有放弃任何人”支持该法案在议会获得通过，他希望这将在“新年伊始”实现。

paras.en: We’re just waiting for the final documentation to come to us from the Europeans.
paras.zh: 我们只是在等待欧洲人给我们提供最终文件。

paras.en: I’m increasingly confident that the majority of senators will support this agreement.
paras.zh: 我越来越有信心大多数参议员会支持这项协议。

paras.en: I’m discussing with everybody, every senator in the parliament … my door is open to all the senators who have questions
paras.zh: 我正在与每个人讨论，议会中的每一位参议员……我的大门向所有有疑问的参议员敞开

paras.en: Alastair Campbell, former Blair spin doctor, challenges Australian media to be braver
paras.zh: 前布莱尔旋转医生阿拉斯泰尔坎贝尔挑战澳大利亚媒体要更勇敢

paras.en: Australians shouldn’t sit easy with Pauline Hanson receiving millions in donations, a sweetheart real-estate deal and a private jet from the country’s richest person, according to one of the world’s most popular political pundits, AAP reports.
paras.zh: 据澳大利亚联社报道，世界上最受欢迎的政治专家之一表示，澳大利亚人不应该对宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 收到数百万美元的捐款、一份甜心房地产交易和该国首富的一架私人飞机坐视不理。

paras.en: Alastair Campbell, the arch spin doctor for former UK Labour prime minister Tony Blair turned co-host of the Rest is Politics podcast, has challenged the Australian media to be braver and improve their offering for young people.
paras.zh: 英国前工党首相托尼·布莱尔的首席舆论专家阿拉斯泰尔·坎贝尔 (Alastair Campbell) 现已成为“休息就是政治”播客的联合主持人，他要求澳大利亚媒体更加勇敢，改善为年轻人提供的服务。

paras.en: Speaking to an audience of reporters at Canberra’s National Press Club earlier today, Campbell said:
paras.zh: 今天早些时候，坎贝尔在堪培拉国家新闻俱乐部向记者发表讲话时说：

paras.en: I’m overwhelmingly critical of the media and what it’s become over my lifetime but ... my criticism comes from a place of love.
paras.zh: 我对媒体及其在我一生中所发生的事情持强烈的批评态度，但是……我的批评来自于爱。

paras.en: Campbell criticised what he said was journalists’ failure to properly scrutinise populists, and convince younger generations there was anything to gain from political involvement.
paras.zh: 坎贝尔批评他所说的记者未能正确审查民粹主义者，也未能说服年轻一代从政治参与中获益。

paras.en: When the politicians are driven by the populism of my definition – politics as problem exploitation, not problem solving – then the media should expose and challenge the populists, not ventriloquise.
paras.zh: 当政客们受到我所定义的民粹主义的驱动时——政治是问题利用，而不是解决问题——那么媒体就应该揭露和挑战民粹主义者，而不是口技。

paras.en: Is it too much to expect journalists to stand up for each other once in a while in defence of the legitimate role they play?
paras.zh: 期望记者偶尔站出来捍卫自己所扮演的合法角色是否太过分了？

paras.en: NSW Greens ask candidates not to interrupt opponents’ press conferences
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州绿党要求候选人不要打断对手的新闻发布会

paras.en: The NSW Greens have issued a statement reminding their candidates not to interrupt their political opponents’ press conferences after heckling by upper house candidate Shane Bazzi led to the premier, Chris Minns, cancelling an event this morning.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州绿党发表声明，提醒其候选人不要打断政治对手的新闻发布会，此前上议院候选人肖恩·巴齐(Shane Bazzi)的质问导致州长克里斯·明斯(Chris Minns)取消了今天早上的一场活动。

paras.en: Bazzi, who is fourth placed on the Greens ticket in the March ballot, crashed a media appearance in the marginal electorate of East Hills, shouting at Minns about making “captain’s calls” on Labor preselections, the war in Gaza and the government’s treatment of protesters.
paras.zh: 巴齐在三月份的绿党选票中排名第四，他在东山边缘选区的一次媒体露面中，向明尼苏达州大喊大叫，要求他们在工党预选、加沙战争和政府对待抗议者的问题上发出“队长的号召”。

paras.en: In a statement, a spokesperson for the NSW Greens said:
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州绿党发言人在一份声明中表示：

paras.en: As we enter the election period we will remind candidates that while we may sometimes strongly disagree with the views of our political opponents, we generally don’t interrupt their press conferences.
paras.zh: 当我们进入选举期时，我们会提醒候选人，虽然我们有时可能强烈不同意政治对手的观点，但我们通常不会打断他们的新闻发布会。

paras.en: At a reconvened press conference this morning, Minns said there was a difference between “a candidate and a regular punter, a member of the public”, saying:
paras.zh: 在今天早上重新召开的新闻发布会上，明斯表示，“候选人和普通赌客、公众”之间存在区别，他说：

paras.en: When you’re an MP and someone comes along in a media conference or on a street walk and has their say, you’ve got to take your hits, and that is part of the political process ... I just think there’s a distinction [with] political candidates getting their two cents in.
paras.zh: 当你是一名国会议员，有人在媒体会议或街头散步并发表意见时，你必须承受打击，这是政治进程的一部分......我只是认为政治候选人得到他们的两分钱是有区别的。

paras.en: Alex Greenwich backtracks after requesting state funeral for Fred Nile
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·格林威治在请求为弗雷德·尼罗举行国葬后反悔

paras.en: A gay New South Wales MP has backtracked on his request for the deeply conservative politician, the Rev Fred Nile, to be honoured with a state funeral, after blowback from the LGBTQ+ community, AAP reports.
paras.zh: 据澳联社报道，在 LGBTQ+ 群体的强烈反对下，新南威尔士州一名同性恋议员放弃了为极度保守的政客 Fred Nile 牧师举行国葬的请求。

paras.en: Nile, an ordained Christian minister who was a member of NSW parliament for more than 40 years, died aged 92 on Saturday.
paras.zh: 尼罗尔是一位被任命的基督教牧师，担任新南威尔士州议会议员 40 多年，于周六去世，享年 92 岁。

paras.en: He was known for his staunch opposition to drug use, gay marriage and abortion.
paras.zh: 他以坚决反对吸毒、同性婚姻和堕胎而闻名。

paras.en: Alex Greenwich, the member for Sydney, had praised the controversial politician on Sunday and suggested a state funeral.
paras.zh: 悉尼议员亚历克斯·格林威治(Alex Greenwich)周日赞扬了这位颇具争议的政治家，并建议举行国葬。

paras.en: But Greenwich, whose electorate takes in Australia’s gay heartland of Sydney’s Oxford St, backpedalled on Monday, saying that:
paras.zh: 但格林威治的选民占据了澳大利亚同性恋中心地带悉尼牛津街，周一却反悔了，他说：

paras.en: I’m sorry. I’ve listened, read your comments and emails, and recognise that my requests for a state service for Rev Fred Nile caused hurt and distress, particularly within the LGBTQ community.
paras.zh: 对不起。我倾听、阅读了你们的评论和电子邮件，并认识到我为 Fred Nile 牧师提供国家服务的请求造成了伤害和痛苦，特别是在 LGBTQ 群体中。

paras.en: While we worked constructively together towards the end of his life, and he apologised for past harm and supported LGBTQ reforms, this does not erase the pain and discrimination caused by his earlier campaigns.
paras.zh: 虽然我们在他生命的最后时刻进行了建设性的合作，他也为过去的伤害道歉并支持 LGBTQ 改革，但这并不能消除他早期的竞选活动所造成的痛苦和歧视。

paras.en: Angus Taylor was out for scalps today, calling for the resignation of Chris Bowen over his “Cop flop” and of treasurer Jim Chalmers.
paras.zh: 今天，安格斯·泰勒(Angus Taylor)大喊大叫，呼吁克里斯·鲍文(Chris Bowen)因“警察失败”和财务主管吉姆·查尔默斯(Jim Chalmers)辞职。

paras.en: Anthony Albanese and Chalmers retaliated, defending their budget and economic position, while acknowledging that times were tough.
paras.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯和查尔默斯进行了报复，捍卫了他们的预算和经济地位，同时承认当时的形势很艰难。

paras.en: Dan Tehan was the first and only MP to get kicked out of the chamber, after he tried to use a Molly Meldrum catchphrase against the government.
paras.zh: 丹·特汉 (Dan Tehan) 是第一位也是唯一一位因试图使用莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆 (Molly Meldrum) 的口号来反对政府而被赶出议会的议员。

paras.en: The $6m golf club grant in Albanese’s electorate was back in the spotlight – he wouldn’t answer a question about whether he misled over his claims his membership was only worth $5 and that the grant was for sewage works – both which were disputed by the club.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞选民的高尔夫俱乐部 600 万美元补助金再次成为人们关注的焦点——他没有回答关于他是否误导了他的会员资格仅值 5 美元以及这笔补助金用于污水处理工程的问题——这两点都受到了俱乐部的争议。

paras.en: Independent Andrew Wilkie called for more action to clear people needing an aged care bed or NDIS support from hospitals.
paras.zh: 独立人士安德鲁·威尔基 (Andrew Wilkie) 呼吁采取更多行动，清理需要老年护理床位或医院提供 NDIS 支持的人。

paras.en: And while Helen Haines wasn’t in parliament (and is not expected back until next year), the crossbench placed an orange cockatoo on her seat in her honour.
paras.zh: 虽然海伦·海恩斯没有进入议会（预计要到明年才会回来），但中立议员在她的座位上放了一只橙色凤头鹦鹉以示纪念。

paras.en: Things will get harder before they get easier, Chalmers warns
paras.zh: 查尔默斯警告说，事情在变得容易之前会变得更困难

paras.en: Jim Chalmers has warned Australians that “things will get a bit harder before they get easier”, revealing next month’s budget update will show unemployment climbing above 5% alongside slower economic growth for the next two years.
paras.zh: 吉姆·查默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 警告澳大利亚人，“事情在变得容易之前会变得更困难”，他透露下个月的预算更新将显示失业率将攀升至 5% 以上，同时未来两年的经济增长将放缓。

paras.en: The treasurer is making a ministerial address to the House now.
paras.zh: 财政部长现在正在众议院发表部长级讲话。

paras.en: My colleague, Patrick Commins, has it covered here:
paras.zh: 我的同事帕特里​​克·康明斯 (Patrick Commins) 对此进行了介绍：

paras.en: ‘It takes two to tango’: Coalition won’t rush gas reservation scheme negotiations
paras.zh: “探戈需要两个人”：联盟不会急于进行天然气预留计划谈判

paras.en: As deliberations between Labor and the Coalition continue on a gas reservation policy, Nationals leader, Matt Canavan, says the opposition won’t be pressured by “some artificial timeline”.
paras.zh: 随着工党和联盟党继续就天然气储备政策进行审议，国家党领袖马特·卡纳万表示，反对派不会受到“某些人为时间表”的压力。

paras.en: It takes two to tango. Here we’ve been very constructive.
paras.zh: 探戈需要两个人。在这里，我们非常有建设性。

paras.en: We put specific amendments to the government. We’ve written and drafted those. If the government doesn’t support them, we’ll move those and have the debate in the chamber.
paras.zh: 我们向政府提出了具体的修正案。我们已经编写并起草了这些内容。如果政府不支持他们，我们将提出这些建议并在众议院进行辩论。

paras.en: The two major parties remain locked in talks over a proposal to set up a federal scheme that would require Australia’s largest gas exporters to set aside up to 20% of their product for domestic use.
paras.zh: 两大党仍在就一项建立联邦计划的提案进行谈判，该计划要求澳大利亚最大的天然气出口商将其产品的最多 20% 留作国内使用。

paras.en: With only three parliamentary sitting days left, time is running out to pass legislation this year.
paras.zh: 距离议会开会仅剩三天，今年通过立法的时间已经不多了。

paras.en: The opposition remains the party of choice for Labor to negotiate a deal with, as the Greens demand a 25% tax on gas exports in return for their support.
paras.zh: 反对党仍然是工党谈判协议的首选政党，绿党要求对天然气出口征收 25% 的税，以换取他们的支持。

paras.en: The PM just called time on QT after a particularly heated dixer to Tanya Plibersek.
paras.zh: 在对坦尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 进行了一场特别激烈的辩论后，总理刚刚宣布 QT 时间到了。

paras.en: She was asked how the digital duty of care bill will “help tackle family, domestic and sexual violence”.
paras.zh: 她被问及数字护理义务法案将如何“帮助解决家庭暴力和性暴力”。

paras.en: She took the opportunity to accuse the Coalition of allowing online violence to continue because they won’t support the digital reforms.
paras.zh: 她借此机会指责联盟允许网络暴力继续存在，因为他们不支持数字改革。

paras.en: It had the Coalition in an absolute uproar.
paras.zh: 这让联盟党一片哗然。

paras.en: While we know that rates of sexual violence are exploding, we’ve got the Liberals, the Nationals and One Nation not prepared to vote to support a digital duty of care – particularly for our children. They’re continuing to say that young Australians should be exposed to things like violent pornography, including depictions of incest and strangulation, or content on how to get away with grooming.
paras.zh: 虽然我们知道性暴力发生率正在呈爆炸式增长，但自由党、国家党和一国党还不准备投票支持数字照顾义务——尤其是对我们的孩子。他们继续说，年轻的澳大利亚人应该接触暴力色情内容，包括乱伦和勒死的描述，或者关于如何摆脱打扮的内容。

paras.en: She’s told to “reflect on her language” by the speaker, but ends saying, “members opposite should be ashamed” for not supporting the bill.
paras.zh: 演讲者要求她“反思自己的语言”，但最后说，“反对派成员应该为不支持该法案而感到羞耻”。

paras.en: Wilkie calls for action to clear patients from hospital beds waiting for aged care and NDIS
paras.zh: 威尔基呼吁采取行动，清除等待老年护理和 NDIS 的病床患者

paras.en: Back to the crossbench, independent Andrew Wilkie asks the health, NDIS and aged care minister, Mark Butler, about the number of people in hospital beds who are waiting for an aged care or NDIS place.
paras.zh: 回到中立议员，独立议员安德鲁·威尔基 (Andrew Wilkie) 向卫生、NDIS 和老年护理部长马克·巴特勒 (Mark Butler) 询问医院病床上等待老年护理或 NDIS 席位的人数。

paras.en: He says in his state of Tasmania, nearly 10% of public hospital beds are occupied by people awaiting residential aged care placements or appropriate NDIS supports, and asks what the government will do to fix this.
paras.zh: 他说，在塔斯马尼亚州，近 10% 的公立医院床位都被等待住院老年护理安置或适当的 NDIS 支持的人占用，并询问政府将采取什么措施来解决这个问题。

paras.en: Butler starts by outlining the scope of the problem:
paras.zh: 巴特勒首先概述了问题的范围：

paras.en: 15 years ago, about 15,000 Australians turned 80 every year. Next year, it will be 90,000 – an increase of 500%.
paras.zh: 15 年前，每年约有 15,000 名澳大利亚人年满 80 岁。明年，这一数字将达到 90,000 人，增长 500%。

paras.en: Butler lists the $25bn of funding the federal government has provided the states to beef up the primary care system, as well as increased funding for aged care support at home places. He says that’s helping the situation but it’s still not ideal.
paras.zh: 巴特勒列出了联邦政府向各州提供的 250 亿美元资金，用于加强初级保健系统，并增加了对居家养老支持的资金。他说这对解决问题有所帮助，但仍然不理想。

paras.en: I think even the minister in Tasmania would accept that the work we’ve done – which started under Minister [Bill] Shorten – to put in place NDIS planners in hospitals have dramatically reduced the wait time for people ready for discharge into an NDIS place.
paras.zh: 我认为，即使是塔斯马尼亚州的部长也会承认，我们所做的工作（在 [Bill] Shorten 部长的领导下开始）在医院设立 NDIS 规划人员，大大减少了准备出院进入 NDIS 场所的人的等待时间。

paras.en: I accept the challenge really is in aged care. The numbers are increasing dramatically. Our ability to build aged care facilities not improving as quickly as I would like. I want to continue working with state governments, including Tasmania’s, to improve that.
paras.zh: 我接受老年护理领域确实存在的挑战。数字正在急剧增加。我们建设老年护理设施的能力并没有像我希望的那样迅速提高。我想继续与包括塔斯马尼亚州政府在内的州政府合作，以改善这一状况。

paras.en: We’re back to the Marrickville golf club grant, folks.
paras.zh: 伙计们，我们又回到了马里克维尔高尔夫俱乐部的拨款。

paras.en: The plot thickened recently after it was revealed by the general manager of the club that the prime minister’s honorary membership was not worth $5 as Anthony Albanese claimed, but $1,100, and that the $6m grant was not for sewerage works.
paras.zh: 最近，俱乐部总经理透露，首相的荣誉会员资格并不像安东尼·艾博尼斯声称的那样值 5 美元，而是 1,100 美元，而且 600 万美元的赠款不是用于污水处理工程，这使得情节变得更加复杂。

paras.en: Deputy Nationals leader, DarrenChester asks: “Isn’t this just another reason why Australians don’t trust this prime minister? I give the call to the prime minister.”
paras.zh: 国家党副领袖达伦切斯特问道：“这难道不是澳大利亚人不信任这位总理的另一个原因吗？我向总理发出了呼吁。”

paras.en: Albanese doesn’t answer the question, but instead defends his other prior claim that he had no idea about the honorary membership.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯没有回答这个问题，而是为他之前的另一个说法辩护，即他对荣誉会员一无所知。

paras.en: ‘I won’t be taking lectures from those opposite’: Chalmers rejects calls to resign
paras.zh: “我不会听相反的人的说教”：查尔默斯拒绝辞职呼吁

paras.en: I’m sensing a bit of a theme here: Liberal backbencher LeonRebello is next and he asks JimChalmers to “admit he’s run out of steam” and calls for him to resign.
paras.zh: 我在这里感觉到了一个主题：下一个是自由党后座议员莱昂雷贝洛，他要求吉姆查尔默斯“承认他已经失去了动力”并要求他辞职。

paras.en: He says Chalmers’ “out of control spending” is driving up inflation, interest rates, and accuses the government of tanking the housing market and killing small business.
paras.zh: 他表示，查尔默斯“失控的支出”正在推高通货膨胀和利率，并指责政府拖垮房地产市场并扼杀小企业。

paras.en: Chalmers comes back with a quick quip against his counterpart, Tim Wilson:
paras.zh: 查尔默斯回来后对他的对手蒂姆·威尔逊说了一句俏皮话：

paras.en: It should have rung alarm bells for the honourable member when not even a shadow Treasurer would ask that question, Mr Speaker.
paras.zh: 议长先生，即使是影子财长也不会问这个问题，这应该给尊敬的议员敲响警钟。

paras.en: When it comes to the trillion dollars of debt in the budget, let’s be really clear. Two-thirds of the debt in the budget was racked up by Coalition governments.
paras.zh: 当谈到预算中的数万亿美元债务时，我们要明确一点。预算中三分之二的债务是由联合政府承担的。

paras.en: “Rubbish!” Shouts a Coalition backbencher. Chalmers continues:
paras.zh: “垃圾！”一位联盟党后座议员大声喊道。查默斯继续说道：

paras.en: So of all of the people that I will be taking lectures from when it comes to responsible economic management, I won’t be taking lectures from those opposite. They are precisely the last place that I would go for advice on managing the budget.
paras.zh: 因此，在所有我将接受有关负责任经济管理的讲座的人中，我不会接受相反的人的讲座。他们恰恰是我最不会去寻求管理预算建议的地方。

paras.en: Tim Wilson continues Coalition attack on treasurer
paras.zh: 蒂姆·威尔逊继续联军攻击财政部长

paras.en: Shadow treasurer, Tim Wilson, is up next and has his go attacking JimChalmers.
paras.zh: 影子财务主管蒂姆·威尔逊(Tim Wilson) 下一个登场，他将攻击吉姆·查默斯(JimChalmers)。

paras.en: He has a long preamble citing job losses at large and small businesses and asks Anthony Albanese: “How many more Australians will lose their job before the treasurer loses his?”
paras.zh: 他用很长的序言列举了大大小小的企业失业的情况，并问安东尼·艾博尼斯：“在财长失业之前，还会有多少澳大利亚人失业？”

paras.en: The prime minister says the Australian economy is, in fact, pretty good compared with other nations.
paras.zh: 总理表示，事实上，与其他国家相比，澳大利亚经济相当不错。

paras.en: Annual economic growth is under pressure, but it’s still stronger than every major advanced economy except for the United States. Inflation is lower than what we inherited and global inflation is having an enormous impact.
paras.zh: 年度经济增长面临压力，但仍强于除美国以外的所有主要发达经济体。通货膨胀率低于我们继承的水平，全球通货膨胀正在产生巨大的影响。

paras.en: I’m [told] by those opposite ‘have a bit of honesty’. Here’s a bit of honesty. More than 1.2m jobs have been created on our watch. We still have the lowest average unemployment of any government in the last 50 years.
paras.zh: 那些反对者告诉我“要有一点诚实”。这里有一点诚实。我们观察到已经创造了超过 120 万个就业岗位。我们的平均失业率仍然是过去 50 年来所有政府中最低的。

paras.en: Crossbencher says EVs being dumped while companies farm carbon credits
paras.zh: Crossbencher 称电动汽车在公司耕种碳信用额时被倾销

paras.en: Over to the crossbench, where Rebekha Sharkie asks the government why carbon credits are given to companies for EVs at the point of importation to Australia, rather than when they’re sold.
paras.zh: 中立议员丽贝卡·沙基 (Rebekha Sharkie) 询问政府，为什么在电动汽车进口到澳大利亚时而不是在出售时向电动汽车公司提供碳信用额。

paras.en: She says this risks companies dumping EVs for financial incentive and leaves them sitting unsold.
paras.zh: 她表示，这可能会导致公司为了经济激励而抛弃电动汽车，导致电动汽车滞销。

paras.en: Thousands of Chinese-made EVs are sitting unsold around Australia, dumped at our ports and misused water parks. Many will likely never be sold. Yet many have attracted lucrative carbon credits for their maker.
paras.zh: 数千辆中国制造的电动汽车滞留在澳大利亚各地，被倾倒在我们的港口和滥用的水上公园。许多可能永远不会被出售。然而，许多人为其制造商吸引了利润丰厚的碳信用额。

paras.en: It’s not often we get a question taken on notice in question time, but Pat Conroy, representing Chris Bowen, says broadly that the government’s EV policy has been critical for decarbonisation:
paras.zh: 我们很少会在提问时间提出问题，但代表 Chris Bowen 的帕特·康罗伊 (Pat Conroy) 广泛表示，政府的电动汽车政策对于脱碳至关重要：

paras.en: [Our policy] has led to a very strong take-up of electric vehicles in this country, which is critical to de-carbonising our economy.
paras.zh: [我们的政策]导致电动汽车在这个国家的普及率非常高，这对于我们的经济脱碳至关重要。

articles.title: Monday briefing: What could Andy Burnham’s reset mean for the UK?
articles.author: Hettie O'Brien

paras.en: Good morning. Nobody really wants to think about Brexit any more, save for the original Brexiters, who seem delighted that Andy Burnham’s “reset” with the EU has given them an excuse to get the old gang back together. But arguments about whether the UK should rejoin the EU will reignite in parliament this week, as Burnham briefs MPs on the deal he agreed on Friday.
paras.zh: 早上好。除了最初的脱欧派之外，没有人真正愿意再考虑脱欧问题，他们似乎很高兴安迪·伯纳姆与欧盟的“重置”为他们提供了让老帮派重新团结起来的借口。但随着伯纳姆向国会议员介绍他周五同意的协议，有关英国是否应该重新加入欧盟的争论本周将在议会重新引发。

paras.en: That deal wasn’t so much a victory as the culmination of Keir Starmer’s incrementalist approach to UK-EU relations. Its core agreements haven’t been ratified by member states yet, and the EU won’t sign them off until Britain resolves a dispute over tuition fees for European students. Burnham is apparently “determined” to take the UK back into the EU, but don’t expect any progress on that before the next general election.
paras.zh: 与其说这项协议是一次胜利，不如说是凯尔·斯塔默对英欧关系渐进主义态度的顶峰。其核心协议尚未获得成员国批准，在英国解决欧洲学生学费纠纷之前，欧盟不会签署这些协议。伯纳姆显然“决心”让英国重返欧盟，但预计在下次大选之前不会取得任何进展。

paras.en: - Cop31 | The EU, the UK and allies in the developing world rejected what they called an unacceptable deal that “failed to meet the moment” in a dramatic finish to the UN talks in Turkey. The proposed deal failed to endorse a away from fossil fuels that more than 130 countries demanded.
paras.zh: - 第 31 届缔约方会议 |欧盟、英国和发展中国家的盟友拒绝了他们所说的一项不可接受的协议，该协议“未能赶上时机”，从而戏剧性地结束了在土耳其举行的联合国会谈。拟议的协议未能支持 130 多个国家要求的放弃化石燃料。

paras.en: - Russia | A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a dramatic night-time explosion and the sinking of the vessel.
paras.zh: - 俄罗斯 |一艘停靠在利比亚港口城市班加西的俄罗斯军舰在疑似乌克兰海上无人机袭击中被击中，导致夜间剧烈爆炸并沉没。

paras.en: - Weapons| The Red Cross and other rights groups have warned that it will soon be too late to properly regulate the development of autonomous weapons. The warning came as the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons concluded without an agreement on an instrument for regulating autonomous weapons.
paras.zh: - 武器|红十字会和其他人权组织警告说，适当监管自主武器的发展很快就为时已晚。这一警告发出之际，《联合国特定常规武器公约》尚未就监管自主武器的文书达成一致。

paras.en: - UK news | Dozens of hospitals are so short of money they may not be able to continue caring for patients and are being forced to make “unpalatable” cuts to services and staff, the Guardian can reveal.
paras.zh: - 英国新闻|据《卫报》透露，数十家医院资金严重短缺，可能无法继续照顾病人，并被迫对服务和人员进行“令人难以接受的”削减。

paras.en: - West Bank | Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot condemned arson attacks by militant Israeli settlers on Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank after dozens of settlers raided Palestinian communities overnight on Saturday.
paras.zh: - 约旦河西岸 |周六，数十名定居者连夜袭击了巴勒斯坦社区，以色列反对派领导人加迪·艾森科特谴责激进的以色列定居者对被占领约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦村庄的纵火袭击。

paras.en: In depth: The EU has changed. What does that mean for Burnham’s ambitions?
paras.zh: 深入：欧盟已经改变。这对伯纳姆的雄心意味着什么？

paras.en: Three separate deals were announced at Friday’s summit in Brussels: one on food and drink, another on emissions trading, and a third on youth mobility, which will allow British students to work, live, study and travel in the EU and give reciprocal access to EU students in Britain (for a full recap, read Jennifer Rankin and Alexandra Topping’s explainer). Burnham wants to go further, and both he and his foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, have used the near-identical phrase that all options are “on the table” for Britain’s future relationship with the EU.
paras.zh: 周五在布鲁塞尔举行的峰会上宣布了三项单独的协议：一项关于食品和饮料，另一项关于排放交易，第三项关于青年流动性，这将允许英国学生在欧盟工作、生活、学习和旅行，并为在英国的欧盟学生提供互惠机会（完整回顾，请阅读 Jennifer Rankin 和 Alexandra Topping 的解释）。伯纳姆希望走得更远，他和他的外交大臣埃德·米利班德都使用了几乎相同的措辞，即英国与欧盟未来关系的所有选择都“摆在桌面上”。

paras.en: You’d be forgiven for feeling weary about revisiting the last decade in British politics. As one Labour MP recently told the Financial Times (£), “nobody is asking for this.” Burnham seems to be testing the ground ahead of a general election, hoping that a campaign to rejoin, or at least move closer to, the EU could plausibly win over progressive defectors.
paras.zh: 如果你对回顾过去十年的英国政治感到厌倦，这是情有可原的。正如一位工党议员最近告诉英国《金融时报》（英镑），“没有人要求这样做。”伯纳姆似乎正在大选前进行测试，希望重新加入或至少接近欧盟的运动能够赢得进步的脱欧者的支持。

paras.en: Still, Friday’s agreement was a reminder of how difficult it is to negotiate with a club of 27. Member states, including France and Italy, issued a statement making it clear that the deal wouldn’t be implemented unless Burnham offered a deal on tuition fees for EU students at British universities. “There’s a fairly strong sense that we’ve reached the end of the incremental style of negotiating,” Mujtaba Rahman tells me. “There isn’t much more for the UK to do before it starts to resemble a cherrypicking state.” And there are other developments that will be on the minds of negotiators and ministers contemplating the UK’s future relationship with Europe.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，周五的协议还是提醒人们，与一个由 27 个成员组成的俱乐部进行谈判是多么困难。包括法国和意大利在内的成员国发表声明，明确表示，除非伯纳姆就英国大学的欧盟学生学费达成协议，否则该协议不会实施。 “有一种相当强烈的感觉，我们已经达到了渐进式谈判的终点，”穆吉塔巴·拉赫曼告诉我。 “在英国开始像一个精挑细选的国家之前，英国没有什么可做的了。”在考虑英国与欧洲未来关系的谈判代表和部长们的脑海中，还有其他事态发展。

paras.en: Has the far right made the idea of European Union membership less attractive?
paras.zh: 极右翼势力是否降低了加入欧盟的想法的吸引力？

paras.en: This is one of the major developments: Europe has become decidedly more right-wing since 2016. Though the European far right lost one of its key figureheads when Viktor Orbán was defeated in the Hungarian elections earlier this year, far-right parties govern in the Czech Republic and Italy, and support for them is rising in Austria and Germany. The proportion of voters in Europe who cast their ballots for far-right parties has grown more than five times since the 1990s, and has increased particularly sharply over the last three years.
paras.zh: 这是重大发展之一：自 2016 年以来，欧洲明显变得更加右翼。尽管今年早些时候欧尔班·维克多 (Viktor Orbán) 在匈牙利选举中被击败，欧洲极右翼失去了一位关键人物，但极右翼政党在捷克共和国和意大利执政，奥地利和德国对极右翼政党的支持正在上升。自 20 世纪 90 年代以来，欧洲选民投票给极右翼政党的比例增长了五倍多，并且在过去三年中增长尤其急剧。

paras.en: Whether this will make rejoining less appealing depends largely on what happens next year in the French elections. Marine Le Pen, who is now favoured to win, wants to slash France’s contribution to the EU budget and drastically downsize the union. It’s possible that a Le Pen presidency could embolden other EU member states to seek closer ties with a pro-European British government, but it’s also possible that Le Pen’s domestic policies, such as reducing the retirement age to 60, could trigger a domestic economic crisis and inflame a conflict between the EU and France, one of its founding member states. “If Marine Le Pen wins, and France tries to enforce a domestic programme that runs in opposition to the EU, then I think a lot of people in the UK will look at the resulting crisis and think, ‘Thank God we’re out of that’,” Mujtaba says.
paras.zh: 这是否会降低重新加入的吸引力很大程度上取决于明年法国选举的情况。现在有望获胜的马琳·勒庞希望削减法国对欧盟预算的贡献，并大幅缩小欧盟规模。勒庞担任总统可能会鼓励其他欧盟成员国寻求与亲欧洲的英国政府建立更密切的关系，但勒庞的国内政策（例如将退休年龄降低至60岁）也有可能引发国内经济危机，并加剧欧盟与其创始成员国之一法国之间的冲突。穆吉塔巴说：“如果玛丽娜·勒庞获胜，而法国试图执行一项与欧盟相反的国内计划，那么我认为很多英国人会看到由此产生的危机并想，‘感谢上帝，我们已经摆脱了困境’。”

paras.en: Is the EU’s new protectionism a reason to rejoin?
paras.zh: 欧盟新的保护主义是重新加入的理由吗？

paras.en: The EU’s Made in Europe strategy would have been almost unimaginable a decade ago, when progressives criticised the union for enforcing free-market globalisation on its members and forbidding state aid. The strategy, which uses public money to support goods made by companies in the single market, is a sign of both how isolated the UK has become and how much the world has changed. Burnham is now trying to make “reindustrialisation” part of his agenda at home, but the EU’s initiative is designed to disadvantage countries outside the EU. It risks scuppering his efforts by deindustrialising the UK car industry, which relies on European buyers.
paras.zh: 十年前，当进步人士批评欧盟对其成员国实行自由市场全球化并禁止国家援助时，欧盟的“欧洲制造”战略几乎是不可想象的。该战略利用公共资金来支持单一市场上的公司生产的商品，这既表明了英国已变得多么孤立，也表明了世界已经发生了多么大的变化。伯纳姆现在正试图将“再工业化”纳入其国内议程，但欧盟的举措旨在让欧盟以外的国家处于不利地位。由于依赖欧洲买家的英国汽车业去工业化，他的努力可能会失败。

paras.en: “It’s very hard for the government to influence this because the Made in Europe negotiations are internal to the EU. And it’s very hard for member states to provide any guarantees because there’s no UK guardian at the table,” Mujtaba says. The EU hasn’t included the UK in the scheme, though Friday’s summit promised closer cooperation on steel and electric vehicle supply chains. But that may require the UK to follow EU policies without having any ability to shape them, making the idea of full membership much more appealing.
paras.zh: “政府很难影响这一点，因为欧洲制造谈判是欧盟内部的。而且成员国也很难提供任何保证，因为谈判桌上没有英国监护人，”穆吉塔巴说。尽管周五的峰会承诺在钢铁和电动汽车供应链方面进行更密切的合作，但欧盟尚未将英国纳入该计划。但这可能要求英国遵循欧盟政策，但没有任何能力制定这些政策，从而使正式成员资格的想法更具吸引力。

paras.en: Would rejoining mean taking a different approach to defence?
paras.zh: 重新加入是否意味着采取不同的防守方法？

paras.en: This is perhaps the strongest reason of all for rejoining, but it’s also another area where the EU’s approach has evolved significantly over the last decade. “The geopolitical environment is forcing the EU to do a bunch of things the UK has historically taken issue with,” Mujtaba says. “It’s intervening in areas of policy that would have traditionally been the purview of nation states.” In particular, the EU’s Security Action for Europe facility (Safe), a new EU defence fund offering up to €150bn in loans to member states to fund defence investments, shifts defence from a national concern to one of wider European governance.
paras.zh: 这也许是重新加入的最强有力的原因，但这也是过去十年欧盟的做法发生重大变化的另一个领域。穆吉塔巴表示：“地缘政治环境正迫使欧盟做一系列英国历来反对的事情。” “它正在干预传统上属于民族国家权限的政策领域。”特别是欧盟的欧洲安全行动基金（Safe），这是一项新的欧盟国防基金，向成员国提供高达 1500 亿欧元的贷款，为国防投资提供资金，将国防从国家关注转向更广泛的欧洲治理之一。

paras.en: Britain refused to pay the financial contribution that Brussels wanted for it to participate in the Safe fund, though there are signs that the two sides may still reach a deal. But any campaign to rejoin would need to critically evaluate the deep ties and so-called “special relationship” between the UK and US in light of an EU that has grown to regard the US as an unreliable partner on security.
paras.zh: 英国拒绝支付布鲁塞尔希望其参与安全基金的财政捐款，尽管有迹象表明双方仍可能达成协议。但鉴于欧盟已逐渐将美国视为不可靠的安全伙伴，任何重新加入的运动都需要批判性地评估英国和美国之间的深厚关系和所谓的“特殊关系”。

paras.en: “The UK isn’t quite as far-reaching in its conclusions about the US,” Mujtaba says. “You don’t hear UK officials talking about the Americans in the same way that European officials are talking about the Americans.”
paras.zh: “英国对美国的结论并没有那么深远，”穆吉塔巴说。 “你听到英国官员谈论美国人的方式与欧洲官员谈论美国人的方式不同。”

paras.en: - Monday | FIFA is set to announce that the UK will host the 2035 Women’s World Cup.
paras.zh: - 星期一 |国际足联即将宣布英国将主办 2035 年女足世界杯。

paras.en: - Thursday | RMT will begin a series of eight 24-hour strikes on the London Underground over the next three months due to a dispute over a four-day week for its drivers.
paras.zh: - 星期四 |由于围绕司机每周工作四天的争议，RMT 将在未来三个月内对伦敦地铁进行八次 24 小时罢工。

paras.en: - Sunday | Spain will hold snap parliamentary elections in what will be the country’s sixth general election in 11 years.
paras.zh: - 周日 |西班牙将提前举行议会选举，这将是该国 11 年来的第六次大选。

paras.en: - Laura Barton’s brilliant interview with Rob Brydon and Steve Coogan is such a warm and wonderful read. Dipo
paras.zh: - 劳拉·巴顿 (Laura Barton) 对罗布·布莱登 (Rob Brydon) 和史蒂夫·库根 (Steve Coogan) 的精彩采访是一本温暖而精彩的读物。迪波

paras.en: Football | Mauricio Pochettino argued Leny Yoro was wrongly sent off after suffering the joint-heaviest debut defeat in Manchester United’s history, losing 4-0 to Liverpool.
paras.zh: 足球 |毛里西奥·波切蒂诺认为莱尼·约罗在遭遇曼联历史上最惨重的首秀失败（0-4输给利物浦）后被错误地罚下。

paras.en: Football | Manchester City suffered a second successive WSL defeat, and a first home defeat under Andrée Jeglertz, losing 3-1 to Tottenham.
paras.zh: 足球 |曼城遭遇 WSL 两连败，并在安德烈·耶格勒茨 (Andrée Jeglertz) 的带领下首次主场失利，以 3-1 输给托特纳姆热刺。

paras.en: Formula One | Max Verstappen escalated his feud with George Russell after a stunning victory at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, stating the British driver was barely worth consideration because he was “so far below my level”.
paras.zh: 一级方程式 |在拉斯维加斯大奖赛取得惊人胜利后，马克斯·维斯塔潘与乔治·拉塞尔的不和进一步升级，他表示这位英国车手几乎不值得考虑，因为他“远远低于我的水平”。

paras.en: “Climate conference ends without final deal after rift over fossil fuels”, is the Guardian’s front page today, while Metro calls it “Complete Cop-out”.
paras.zh: 今天《卫报》的头版是“在化石燃料问题上出现分歧后，气候会议没有达成最终协议”，而麦德龙称其为“彻底的逃避”。

paras.en: The Mail has “Now five ex-PMs warn Burnham: Don’t rejoin EU”, and the Express writes “PM’s ‘empty words’ for sex abuse victims”. The Times says “Disability benefits could be tailored for each claim”, and the i Paper has “Universal credit set for major overhaul to help people into work”. The FT leads with “FTSE 100 giant Compass deals blow to London with move to New York listing”.
paras.zh: 《邮报》写道“现在五位前总理警告伯纳姆：不要重新加入欧盟”，而《快报》则写道“总理对性虐待受害者的‘空话’”。 《泰晤士报》表示，“残疾福利可以针对每项索赔进行定制”，而 i Paper 则“为重大改革设置了普遍信用，以帮助人们找到工作”。英国《金融时报》以“富时 100 巨头 Compass 交易席卷伦敦并移至纽约上市”为先导。

paras.en: The Sun’s splash is “Paris: My Tyson’s schizophrenic”, while the Mirror has “My torment”.
paras.zh: 《太阳报》的头条是“巴黎：我的泰森的精神分裂”，而《镜报》的则是“我的折磨”。

paras.en: David Byrne on the great ideas that got away
paras.zh: 大卫·伯恩 (David Byrne) 谈那些被忽视的伟大想法

paras.en: David Byrne, the frontman of Talking Heads and then as a solo artist, has made some of the greatest albums of all time. He tells Nosheen Iqbal about his new book Sleeping Beauties, in which he explores why so many breakthroughs in science, economics and culture were lost on their initial audience and only later revived and acknowledged to be great.
paras.zh: 大卫·伯恩 (David Byrne) 是 Talking Heads 乐队的主唱，后来作为独唱艺术家，制作了一些有史以来最伟大的专辑。他向诺辛·伊克巴尔讲述了他的新书《睡美人》，在书中他探讨了为什么科学、经济和文化领域的许多突破在最初的读者中消失了，直到后来才被复兴并被承认是伟大的。

paras.en: A bit of good news to remind you that the world’s not all bad
paras.zh: 一个好消息提醒您世界并不全是坏事

paras.en: David Parr’s days were spent decorating wealthy homes with William Morris’s much-loved textile designs. But by candlelight at night, Parr, a Victorian working-class labourer, would turn to the interiors of his own home, decorating his walls with his own beautiful designs, work that went largely unnoticed during his life.
paras.zh: 大卫·帕尔 (David Parr) 一生都在用威廉·莫里斯 (William Morris) 深受喜爱的纺织品设计来装饰富裕的住宅。但在晚上的烛光下，维多利亚时代的工人阶级工人帕尔会转向自己家的内部装饰，用自己美丽的设计装饰墙壁，这些工作在他一生中基本上没有被注意到。

paras.en: After his death in 1927, those extraordinary walls in his home on Gwydir Street in Cambridge were thankfully preserved by his granddaughter, Elsie. Today, The David Parr House, as it is now known, is set to be honoured with a blue plaque, which is thought to be the first ever dedicated to a working-class Victorian art-workman.
paras.zh: 1927 年他去世后，他位于剑桥 Gwydir 街的家中那些非凡的墙壁被他的孙女 Elsie 保存了下来。如今，大卫·帕尔故居 (The David Parr House) 将被授予一块蓝色牌匾，这被认为是第一座献给维多利亚时代工人阶级艺术工作者的牌匾。

paras.en: And finally, the Guardian’s puzzles are here to keep you entertained throughout the day. Until tomorrow.
paras.zh: 最后，《卫报》的谜题可以让您全天享受乐趣。直到明天。

articles.title: Clubs and families revolt as Football Queensland charges $5 a head to watch children play
articles.author: Andrew Messenger

paras.en: Football clubs representing hundreds of thousands of players are preparing to break away from Football Queensland this week, saying the state governing body charges unreasonably high fees and is unaccountable.
paras.zh: 代表数十万球员的足球俱乐部本周准备脱离昆士兰足球协会，称州管理机构收取不合理的高额费用且不负责任。

paras.en: Some parents and siblings are charged a $5 gate fee to watch children’s matches in parts of regional Queensland.
paras.zh: 一些父母和兄弟姐妹需要支付 5 美元的入场费才能观看昆士兰部分地区的儿童比赛。

paras.en: The gate fee comes on top of an annual cost of between $300 and $700 per family, depending on player age, club and other factors, and a range of other fees, fines and charges. Many football club members say they see little in return for the thousands they pay in fees.
paras.zh: 除了门票费之外，每个家庭每年的费用在 300 至 700 美元之间，具体取决于球员年龄、俱乐部和其他因素，以及一系列其他费用、罚款和收费。许多足球俱乐部成员表示，他们支付的数千美元费用几乎没有得到什么回报。

paras.en: Jessy Mulla is president of Leichhardt Football Club Cairns Incorporated, which was recently disaffiliated from the statewide body.
paras.zh: 杰西·穆拉 (Jessy Mulla) 是凯恩斯莱卡特足球俱乐部 (Leichhardt Football Club Cairns Incorporated) 的总裁，该俱乐部最近脱离了该州机构。

paras.en: Football Queensland, which manages the club, introduced a gate fee in 2024 in order to pay for improvements to the ground, Endeavour Park, in Manunda, such as cleaning toilets, employing a full-time gardener, and “increased shade structures and grandstands”, at a quoted price of $20,000 each.
paras.zh: 管理该俱乐部的昆士兰足球协会于 2024 年引入了门票费，以支付马南达奋进公园球场的改善费用，例如清洁厕所、雇用全职园丁以及“增加遮阳结构和看台”，每个报价为 20,000 澳元。

paras.en: With a few hundred people attending most weekends, the amount raised through gate fees must be substantial, Mulla said.
paras.zh: 穆拉说，大多数周末都有数百人参加，通过入场费筹集的金额一定很大。

paras.en: But there had been “very, very” little improvement to the ground since, Mulla said.
paras.zh: 但穆拉说，自那以后，地面状况“非常非常”几乎没有改善。

paras.en: “That’s why everyone asks where’s the money being spent? Where’s the money that gets raised? Where is it going?”
paras.zh: “这就是为什么每个人都问钱花在哪里了？筹集到的钱在哪里？它去哪儿了？”

paras.en: Under Football Queensland’s policy, registered coaches and team managers, referees, volunteers and children under 15 enter free. Pensioners get a discount, paying $4.
paras.zh: 根据昆士兰足球协会的政策，注册教练和球队经理、裁判、志愿者和 15 岁以下儿童免费入场。养老金领取者可享受折扣，支付 4 美元。

paras.en: The sport’s governing body in the state is a member of the national football body, Football Australia. It provides a range of services for typically volunteer-run clubs, including managing competitions, governance, and developing player professional pathways, as well as managing some facilities.
paras.zh: 该州的这项运动的管理机构是国家足球机构澳大利亚足球协会的成员。它为典型的志愿者经营的俱乐部提供一系列服务，包括管理比赛、治理和开发球员职业道路，以及管理一些设施。

paras.en: Clubs have to pay an annual fee to affiliate with the central body, which they pass on to players.
paras.zh: 俱乐部必须缴纳年费才能加入中央机构，然后将费用转嫁给球员。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Football Queensland said the body was “continuing to progress the delivery and investment of long-term infrastructure projects and facility enhancements” in line with its regional facility master plan.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州足球协会的一位发言人表示，该机构正在根据其区域设施总体规划“继续推进长期基础设施项目和设施增强的交付和投资”。

paras.en: The spokesperson said three levels of government had invested $7.9m into regional Football Queensland facilities since 2023. The central body had also contributed $4.9m in operational costs and capital investment in regional Queensland during the same period, they said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，自 2023 年以来，三级政府已向昆士兰地区足球设施投资了 790 万澳元。他们表示，中央机构同期还为昆士兰地区的运营成本和资本投资贡献了 490 万澳元。

paras.en: “A $5 gate fee (or $80 season pass) is consistent with other sporting codes and contributes to FQ’s master plan delivery, helping to offset grounds maintenance and operational expenses,” they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“5 美元的门票费（或 80 美元的季票）与其他体育规则一致，有助于 FQ 总体规划的交付，有助于抵消场地维护和运营费用。”

paras.en: It recently created controversy by proposing to charge a $35 per player fee for summer competitions organised by the clubs themselves, and proposing other fee increases, which have since been dropped.
paras.zh: 最近，它提议对俱乐部自己组织的夏季比赛向每位球员收取 35 美元的费用，并提出其他费用上涨的提议，但后来这些提议被放弃，引发了争议。

paras.en: A rebel faction of football clubs is preparing to break away from Football Queensland this week, complaining of a lack of input and transparency of the central body.
paras.zh: 足球俱乐部的一个反叛派系本周准备脱离昆士兰足球协会，抱怨中央机构缺乏投入和透明度。

paras.en: Bardon Latrobe football club president, Gerard Doyle, said more than 100 clubs – a majority – had joined a movement pushing for reform.
paras.zh: 巴登·拉特罗布足球俱乐部主席杰拉德·多伊尔 (Gerard Doyle) 表示，超过 100 个俱乐部（其中大多数）已加入推动改革的运动。

paras.en: Doyle estimated that the breakaway clubs represented more than 100,000 football players.
paras.zh: 多伊尔估计，脱离的俱乐部代表了超过 100,000 名足球运动员。

paras.en: The group is now negotiating with the central body via a law firm. Others were on the fence, he said.
paras.zh: 该组织目前正在通过一家律师事务所与中央机构进行谈判。他说，其他人则持观望态度。

paras.en: According to its bylaws, Football Queensland’s governing committee must hold elections for new board members this month.
paras.zh: 根据其章程，昆士兰足球管理委员会必须在本月举行新董事会成员的选举。

paras.en: But the board has yet to call elections.
paras.zh: 但董事会尚未召集选举。

paras.en: Doyle said that it was now impossible for the board to meet its bylaws, given the need for a one-week period for people to nominate.
paras.zh: 多伊尔表示，鉴于人们需要一周的时间进行提名，董事会现在不可能遵守其章程。

paras.en: Meanwhile, clubs have been given until Wednesday, 25 November, to re-affiliate with the central authority, after an extension to the sign-up period.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在延长注册期后，俱乐部被要求在 11 月 25 日星期三之前重新与中央当局建立联系。

paras.en: “Number one is Football Australia comes in today or tomorrow, two days, and says we will facilitate open and free elections,” he said.
paras.zh: “第一件事是澳大利亚足球协会今天或明天，两天，并表示我们将促进公开和自由的选举，”他说。

paras.en: If that doesn’t happen, the clubs will refuse to affiliate and pay their fees and instead create their own rival central body, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，如果这种情况没有发生，俱乐部将拒绝加入并支付费用，而是创建自己的竞争对手中央机构。

paras.en: “I sound like I’m in a dictatorship in an African nation here, fighting for basic rights.
paras.zh: “我听起来就像是在一个非洲国家的独裁统治下，为基本权利而战。

paras.en: “To me, it just feels, I’m going to say un-Australian … it’s undemocratic.”
paras.zh: “对我来说，我只是觉得，我想说这不是澳大利亚的……这是不民主的。”

articles.title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed

paras.en: Countries have failed to reach a major new deal to tackle climate change after deep divisions over fossil fuels and money emerged at the UN COP31 talks in Turkey.
paras.zh: 在土耳其举行的联合国 COP31 会议上，各国在化石燃料和资金问题上出现了深刻分歧，但未能就应对气候变化达成重大新协议。

paras.en: Negotiations were due to finish on Friday but ran late into Sunday in search of common ground, becoming the longest UN climate conference in history.
paras.zh: 谈判原定于周五结束，但为了寻求共同点而拖延至周日，成为历史上最长的联合国气候会议。

paras.en: But the final deal proved unacceptable to the EU, Pacific island nations and others because it failed to directly mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.
paras.zh: 但最终的协议被证明是欧盟、太平洋岛国和其他国家无法接受的，因为它没有直接提及化石燃料，而化石燃料是全球变暖的主要原因。

paras.en: Meanwhile, many poorer countries objected to the absence of any clear financial commitments from richer nations to help them adapt to the impacts of rising temperatures.
paras.zh: 与此同时，许多较贫穷国家反对富裕国家没有做出任何明确的财政承诺来帮助它们适应气温上升的影响。

paras.en: The last time a COP's main political agreement collapsed like this was in 2009 in Copenhagen.
paras.zh: 上一次缔约方会议的主要政治协议像这样崩溃是在 2009 年的哥本哈根。

paras.en: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres, in his last COP before he steps down, said he was "deeply disappointed".
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在卸任前的最后一次缔约方会议上表示，他“深感失望”。

paras.en: He took aim at what he called "powerful fossil fuel interests" who he said were taking "a page from Big Tobacco's playbook: distorting the science, delaying policy, blocking action, and piling up huge profits while people everywhere pay the price".
paras.zh: 他把目标瞄准了他所谓的“强大的化石燃料利益集团”，他说这些利益集团正在“效仿大烟草公司的做法：歪曲科学、拖延政策、阻碍行动、积累巨额利润，而世界各地的人们却为此付出了代价”。

paras.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, whose country co-hosted the talks, attributed the failure to "difficult geopolitical times".
paras.zh: 共同主办此次会谈的澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯将此次失败归咎于“地缘政治困难时期”。

paras.en: "That is the reality," he said on Monday.
paras.zh: “这就是现实，”他周一表示。

paras.en: After two weeks of negotiations, exhausted delegates were presented with a new, draft deal in the early hours of Sunday to try to break the deadlock.
paras.zh: 经过两周的谈判，疲惫不堪的代表们在周日凌晨收到了一份新的协议草案，试图打破僵局。

paras.en: But the words "fossil fuels" did not appear anywhere in the text. The only indirect reference to coal, oil and gas was a nod to a deal agreed at COP28 in 2023, when countries agreed to "transition away" from fossil fuels in energy systems.
paras.zh: 但“化石燃料”一词并未出现在案文中的任何地方。唯一间接提到煤炭、石油和天然气的是对 2023 年 COP28 上达成的一项协议的认可，当时各国同意在能源系统中“放弃”化石燃料。

paras.en: The EU's representative, Irish Minister Darragh O'Brien, made it clear that the EU "strongly" objected, saying that the "decisions go nowhere near the level of ambition needed to tackle climate change".
paras.zh: 欧盟代表爱尔兰部长达拉·奥布莱恩明确表示欧盟“强烈”反对，并表示“这些决定远未达到应对气候变化所需的雄心水平”。

paras.en: "It is unconscionable that we would have a climate pact that makes no mention of fossil fuels," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们制定的气候协议中没有提及化石燃料，这是不合理的。”

paras.en: Other countries, such as Panama and the Marshall Islands, also criticised the deal for doing nowhere near enough to tackle the pace of climate change.
paras.zh: 巴拿马和马绍尔群岛等其他国家也批评该协议在应对气候变化方面做得还不够。

paras.en: A first draft of the deal on Monday mentioned "fossil fuel" or "fossil fuels" six times, but that was unacceptable to oil-producing nations.
paras.zh: 周一该协议的初稿六次提到“化石燃料”或“化石燃料”，但这对于产油国来说是不可接受的。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia's delegate Mohammad Ayoub said that Arab countries "continued to engage in good faith" but argued that they only accounted for a small proportion of historical greenhouse gas emissions.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯代表穆罕默德·阿尤布表示，阿拉伯国家“继续真诚地参与”，但辩称它们只占历史温室气体排放量的一小部分。

paras.en: Russia warned not to "turn to slogans" over coal, oil and gas, claiming that if countries moved away from fossil fuels too quickly it would lead to "fuel poverty".
paras.zh: 俄罗斯警告不要在煤炭、石油和天然气问题上“诉诸口号”，声称如果各国过快摆脱化石燃料，将导致“燃料贫困”。

paras.en: Climate advocates reacted with dismay at the failure of the talks.
paras.zh: 气候倡导者对谈判失败感到沮丧。

paras.en: Former US vice-president and climate advocate Al Gore said it was "outrageous that a handful of petro-states have veto power over any mention of fossil fuels".
paras.zh: 美国前副总统兼气候倡导者戈尔表示，“少数石油国家对任何提及化石燃料的行为拥有否决权，这是令人愤慨的”。

paras.en: The COP process was "in need of significant reform", Gore wrote on X, as most countries sought "to move forward in good faith."
paras.zh: 戈尔在 X 上写道，缔约方会议进程“需要重大改革”，因为大多数国家都寻求“真诚地向前迈进”。

paras.en: "It's time that we empower those leaders with a reinvigorated multilateral process that reflects the latest science and represents the will of the majority of the world," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“现在是我们向这些领导人赋予重振多边进程的时候了，该进程反映了最新科学并代表了世界大多数人的意愿。”

paras.en: Another major sticking point has been money for poorer countries to adapt to the impacts of climate change, such as more intense heatwaves and more severe droughts.
paras.zh: 另一个主要症结是为较贫穷国家提供资金以适应气候变化的影响，例如更强烈的热浪和更严重的干旱。

paras.en: Last year at COP30 in Brazil, nations agreed to triple the finance for that purpose.
paras.zh: 去年在巴西举行的第三十次缔约方会议上，各国同意将为此目的提供的资金增加两倍。

paras.en: But this year's deal contained no reference to concrete figures, nor the baseline against which that pledge would be measured. This raised fears it would give richer nations too much wriggle room.
paras.zh: 但今年的协议没有提及具体数字，也没有提及衡量这一承诺的基准。这引发了人们的担忧，这会给富裕国家带来太多的回旋余地。

paras.en: "Rich nations and polluting governments cannot keep arriving empty-handed," said Mohamed Adow of Power Shift Africa, an African climate and energy think tank.
paras.zh: 非洲气候与能源智库非洲权力转移组织的穆罕默德·阿多表示：“富裕国家和污染严重的政府不能总是空手而归。”

paras.en: The UK's Energy Secretary, Miatta Fahnbulleh, described the failure to reach a political agreement as "immensely disappointing".
paras.zh: 英国能源大臣米亚塔·法恩布拉 (Miatta Fahnbulleh) 表示，未能达成政治协议“非常令人失望”。

paras.en: "This only strengthens our resolve to work with partners around the world on the genuine progress made in Antalya on tackling the climate crisis," she said, adding that the UK's commitment was "unwavering".
paras.zh: 她说：“这只会增强我们与世界各地合作伙伴合作的决心，以在安塔利亚应对气候危机方面取得真正进展。”她补充说，英国的承诺是“坚定不移的”。

paras.en: While talks were hosted in Antalya in Turkey, Australia led the official negotiations - creating what some observers described as a chaotic dynamic.
paras.zh: 虽然会谈在土耳其安塔利亚举行，但澳大利亚主导了正式谈判 - 造成了一些观察家所说的混乱动态。

paras.en: Chris Bowen, Australian government minister and COP31 president of negotiations, said there were "unbridgeable red lines" in the discussions.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚政府部长兼 COP31 谈判主席克里斯·鲍文 (Chris Bowen) 表示，讨论中存在“不可逾越的红线”。

paras.en: He pointed to "the most complicated and fraught geopolitical environment in living memory". At the same time, "the impacts of climate change are getting worse", he said, raising the stakes.
paras.zh: 他指出“这是人们记忆中最复杂、最令人担忧的地缘政治环境”。与此同时，“气候变化的影响正在变得越来越严重”，他说，这增加了风险。

paras.en: The year 2026 could end as the hottest on record and has brought extreme weather and natural hazards to much of the world, from summer heat and drought in Europe to flash flooding in Nepal.
paras.zh: 2026 年可能会成为有记录以来最热的一年，并给世界大部分地区带来极端天气和自然灾害，从欧洲的夏季高温和干旱到尼泊尔的山洪暴发。

paras.en: And COP31 was the first annual UN conference to formally discuss how one of the key international targets for limiting climate change would be missed.
paras.zh: COP31 是第一次正式讨论如何实现限制气候变化的关键国际目标的联合国年度会议。

paras.en: In the Paris talks of 2015, nearly 200 countries agreed to try to limit global warming to 1.5C above pre-industrial levels of the late 1800s, aimed at avoiding some of the worst effects of climate change.
paras.zh: 在 2015 年的巴黎会谈中，近 200 个国家同意努力将全球变暖限制在比 1800 年代末工业化前水平高 1.5 摄氏度的范围内，旨在避免气候变化带来的一些最严重影响。

paras.en: The UN says the Paris deal has driven "near-universal" climate action. In the early 2010s, global warming of 4C or more was thought to be a serious possibility by the end of the century.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，《巴黎协定》推动了“近乎普遍”的气候行动。 2010 年代初，人们认为到本世纪末全球变暖极有可能达到 4 摄氏度或更高。

paras.en: Now, the world is likely to limit warming to about 2.8C by 2100 based on current government policies, the UN says.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，根据目前的政府政策，到 2100 年，世界可能会将气温升高限制在 2.8 摄氏度左右。

paras.en: But action has not been fast enough to meet that Paris goal, with the world likely to "overshoot" 1.5C of long-term warming in the next few years.
paras.zh: 但行动的速度还不够快，无法实现巴黎的目标，未来几年世界可能会“超过”长期升温 1.5 摄氏度。

paras.en: Many countries say they are committed to eventually bringing warming back down to 1.5C, but that will require an ambitious ramping up of technologies - which do not yet exist at scale - to remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 许多国家表示，他们致力于最终将气温升高回落至 1.5 摄氏度，但这需要雄心勃勃地提升技术水平（目前尚未大规模应用），以清除大气中的二氧化碳。

paras.en: Although the main deal fell through, some agreements were reached, including progress on a "just transition mechanism" - a framework to support workers and communities as economies shift towards clean energy.
paras.zh: 尽管主要协议未能达成，但仍达成了一些协议，包括在“公正过渡机制”方面取得进展，这是一个随着经济转向清洁能源而支持工人和社区的框架。

paras.en: The COP31 president also said more than 80 countries backed Turkey's target to increase the share of global energy use met by electricity to 35% by 2035.
paras.zh: 这位 COP31 主席还表示，80 多个国家支持土耳其的目标，即到 2035 年将电力占全球能源使用比例提高到 35%。

paras.en: But following the weekend's events, some have questioned whether the UN climate process - which relies on consensus - can succeed in a geopolitically divided world.
paras.zh: 但在周末的事件之后，一些人质疑依赖共识的联合国气候进程能否在地缘政治分裂的世界中取得成功。

paras.en: The UN's climate chief, Simon Stiell, said he would seek advice on potential reform to the process, with the next conference scheduled for November 2027, COP32 in Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔 (Simon Stiell) 表示，他将就这一进程的潜在改革寻求建议，下一次会议定于 2027 年 11 月在埃塞俄比亚举行，即 COP32。

paras.en: "[The consensus process] has worked to get us where we are," he told the BBC. "It got us through Paris... so it can work," but acknowledged it "fell short" on Sunday.
paras.zh: 他告诉英国广播公司：“[共识进程]使我们达到了现在的目标。” “它让我们通过了巴黎......所以它可以发挥作用，”但周日承认它“未能达到”。

paras.en: The UN climate process has "suffered setbacks before and come back stronger," Stiell told delegates. "It must do so again."
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔告诉代表们，联合国气候进程“之前遭遇过挫折，但后来变得更加强劲”。 “它必须再次这样做。”

articles.title: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say

paras.en: A seven-year-old boy has been rescued from the rubble of a residential building in Dymer, in the Kyiv region, after 14 hours. Overnight Russian strikes on the village killed 11 people, Ukrainian officials have said.
paras.zh: 14 小时后，一名 7 岁男孩从基辅地区代默一栋住宅楼的废墟中被救出。乌克兰官员称，俄罗斯夜间对该村庄的袭击造成 11 人死亡。

paras.en: The attack occurred in the early hours of Sunday. A 79-year-old woman was also rescued alive from the collapsed building, Kyiv's regional head Tymur Tkachenko said.
paras.zh: 袭击发生在周日凌晨。基辅地区负责人泰穆尔·特卡琴科 (Tymur Tkachenko) 表示，一名 79 岁的妇女也从倒塌的建筑物中被生还。

paras.en: A strike on a private home in Bila Tserkva killed one more person and set the building ablaze, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，白采尔科维一处私人住宅遭到袭击，造成一人死亡并导致建筑物起火。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky also said three people were killed and 13 wounded in a separate strike on Vyshneve, also in the Kyiv region, that hit a grocery store on Sunday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基还表示，周日，基辅地区维什尼韦市的一家杂货店遭到袭击，造成 3 人死亡、13 人受伤。

paras.en: Ukrainian authorities said the boy in Dymer is in stable condition and was taken to hospital, and have thanked everyone involved in saving his life.
paras.zh: 乌克兰当局表示，戴默的男孩情况稳定，已被送往医院，并感谢所有参与挽救他生命的人。

paras.en: Zelensky and Ukraine's national police also confirmed the rescue of the boy.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基和乌克兰国家警察也证实男孩获救。

paras.en: In a telegram post, Tkachenko said the 79-year-old woman rescued from the rubble was receiving treatment in hospital.
paras.zh: 特卡琴科在一份电报中表示，从废墟中救出的 79 岁妇女正在医院接受治疗。

paras.en: Earlier he said six people were injured in the attack, while others were still missing.
paras.zh: 早些时候他表示，袭击造成六人受伤，其他人仍下落不明。

paras.en: Zelensky said more than 130 people are involved in emergency operations at the scene, and that they will continue until they have "complete information about every single person".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，超过 130 人正在现场参与紧急行动，他们将继续行动，直到掌握“每个人的完整信息”。

paras.en: Sending his condolences to the families and loved ones of those killed, he said the strike struck the residential building, "practically blowing a section of it to smithereens".
paras.zh: 他向遇难者的家人和亲人表示哀悼，并表示袭击袭击了住宅楼，“实际上将其一部分炸成了碎片”。

paras.en: Zelensky added that "rescue efforts are complicated by constant new air raid alerts and renewed threats".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基补充说，“不断出现新的空袭警报和新的威胁，使救援工作变得更加复杂”。

paras.en: The strike hit the building at 05:00 local time, when families were still asleep, Ukraine's minister of internal affairs Ivan Vyhivskyi said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰内政部长伊万·维希夫斯基 (Ivan Vyhivskyi) 表示，袭击发生在当地时间 05:00，当时人们还在熟睡中。

paras.en: More than 70 strikes have been launched across 10 Ukrainian regions as of Sunday evening, Vyhivskyi added.
paras.zh: Vyhivskyi 补充说，截至周日晚间，乌克兰 10 个地区已发起 70 多次罢工。

paras.en: In his video address posted online, Zelensky also said three people were killed and 13 injured in a strike on an "ordinary grocery store" in Vyshneve.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在网上发布的视频讲话中还表示，维什尼韦一家“普通杂货店”遭到袭击，造成 3 人死亡、13 人受伤。

paras.en: Mayor Illya Dikov wrote on social media that three children were among the injured.
paras.zh: 市长伊利亚·迪科夫（Illya Dikov）在社交媒体上写道，伤者中包括三名儿童。

paras.en: Russia also struck a power substation in the Dnipropetrovsk region, Ukraine's Prime Minister Sergiy Koretsky said in a post on X., external
paras.zh: 乌克兰总理谢尔盖·科列茨基在 X. 上发帖称，俄罗斯还袭击了第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区的一座变电站。

paras.en: Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯于2022年对乌克兰发动全面入侵。

articles.title: Burnham to tell MPs 'landmark' EU deal could make next decade 'much better'

paras.en: The prime minister will tell Parliament on Monday the "landmark" deal struck with the EU means there is a "very real prospect" the next decade can be "much better" than the last one.
paras.zh: 首相将于周一告诉议会，与欧盟达成的“里程碑式”协议意味着未来十年“非常现实的前景”可能比上一个十年“好得多”。

paras.en: The deal is a "choice between a broken status quo or change", Andy Burnham will tell MPs.
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆将告诉国会议员，这项协议是“打破现状或改变之间的选择”。

paras.en: He will also call it "the single biggest growth measure to be delivered in this parliament" - repeating his claim it could add Â£17bn to the British economy.
paras.zh: 他还将称其为“本届议会将推出的一项最大的增长措施”——重申他的说法，这将为英国经济增加 170 亿英镑。

paras.en: The PM described it on Friday as a "win-win" deal with the EU on British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme. But since then a host of politicians have criticised the plan, with one former prime minister urging him to "move on" from Brexit.
paras.zh: 英国首相周五将其描述为与欧盟就英国食品出口、排放交易和青年体验计划达成的“双赢”协议。但自那以后，许多政界人士批评了该计划，一位前首相敦促他“继续”脱欧。

paras.en: Burnham believes the agreement reached in Brussels "holds out the very real prospect that the next decade can be a much better one for Britain than the one we have just lived through".
paras.zh: 伯纳姆认为，在布鲁塞尔达成的协议“展现了非常真实的前景，即下一个十年对英国来说可能比我们刚刚经历的十年要好得多”。

paras.en: "The ability to draw a line on a decade of drift and division is in our hands and I believe we should take it," he will say in his speech.
paras.zh: “划清十年的漂移和分裂界限的能力掌握在我们手中，我相信我们应该接受它，”他将在演讲中说。

paras.en: He will also paint the move as a choice "between easing pressure on the cost of living or allowing food prices to rise further" and "creating opportunities for young people or denying them".
paras.zh: 他还将此举描述为“在缓解生活成本压力或允许食品价格进一步上涨之间”和“为年轻人创造机会或拒绝他们”之间的选择。

paras.en: He believes polling suggests the UK public "want closer ties" with the EU and the deal "delivers that".
paras.zh: 他认为民意调查显示英国公众“希望与欧盟建立更紧密的联系”，而该协议“实现了这一目标”。

paras.en: But his announcement on Friday was greeted with a chorus of criticism from a number of opposing political figures.
paras.zh: 但他周五的声明遭到了一些反对派政治人物的齐声批评。

paras.en: Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch said the deal was unfair because UK farmers would now have to follow rules made by Brussels.
paras.zh: 保守党领袖凯米·巴德诺克表示，这项协议不公平，因为英国农民现在必须遵守布鲁塞尔制定的规则。

paras.en: She questioned the Treasury's analysis, which Burnham said suggested the deal "will add up to 0.5%" to UK gross domestic product and he described it as a "Â£17bn boost to the British economy".
paras.zh: 她对财政部的分析提出质疑，伯纳姆称该分析表明该交易“将为英国国内生产总值增加0.5%”，他将其描述为“为英国经济带来170亿英镑的提振”。

paras.en: Badenoch accused him of having "plucked that figure out of the air" before saying "the only modelling I've seen that even talks about that figure says it's actually 0.0%".
paras.zh: 巴德诺克指责他“凭空捏造了这个数字”，然后说“我见过的唯一一个甚至谈论这个数字的模型说它实际上是 0.0%”。

paras.en: Meanwhile Reform UK leader Farage called the deal a "very good day for the EU", before adding: "A good day to try and humiliate the one member state that actually had the courage to say, 'We don't need to be part of you, we can govern our own country'."
paras.zh: 与此同时，英国改革党领导人法拉奇称该协议“对欧盟来说是非常好的一天”，然后补充道：“这是一个试图羞辱真正有勇气说‘我们不需要成为你们的一部分，我们可以管理自己国家’的成员国的好日子。”

paras.en: Farage, who was a leading figure in the 2016 campaign to get Britain out of the EU, added in a social media post: "Like every prime minister before him, Burnham is a total fraud. Only Reform will stop the endless betrayal of the British people."
paras.zh: 法拉奇是2016年英国脱欧运动的主要人物，他在社交媒体帖子中补充道：“像他之前的每一位首相一样，伯纳姆完全是个骗子。只有改革才能制止对英国人民无休止的背叛。”

paras.en: Over the weekend former prime ministers including Theresa May, Sir Tony Blair and Rishi Sunak also criticised the EU-UK deal.
paras.zh: 周末，包括特蕾莎·梅、托尼·布莱尔爵士和里希·苏纳克在内的前首相也批评了欧盟与英国的协议。

paras.en: May, who presided over three years of Brexit negotiations during her premiership, said she was "aghast" by the deal and warned Andy Burnham should "move on".
paras.zh: 在担任首相期间主持了三年脱欧谈判的梅表示，她对该协议感到“震惊”，并警告安迪·伯纳姆应该“继续前进”。

paras.en: Sir Tony, who was a prominent opponent of leaving the EU, told The Sunday Times Britain should only rejoin the EU if it reforms, and allows more innovation on technology.
paras.zh: 托尼爵士是英国脱欧的著名反对者，他告诉《星期日泰晤士报》，英国只有在进行改革并允许更多技术创新的情况下才应该重新加入欧盟。

paras.en: Former PM Sunak warned that reopening the debate about rejoining the EU could become a "huge distraction" for the current Labour government.
paras.zh: 前首相苏纳克警告称，重新开启有关重新加入欧盟的辩论可能会成为现任工党政府的“巨大干扰”。

paras.en: "Obviously it's divisive. But we saw last time around, it was also all consuming", he told Sky News in an interview airing in full on Tuesday.
paras.zh: “显然，这是有分歧的。但我们上次看到，这也是非常消耗精力的”，他在周二完整播出的天空新闻采访中说道。

paras.en: Badenoch will use her speech at the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) annual conference on Monday to criticise Burnham's EU deal.
paras.zh: 巴德诺克将于周一在英国工业联合会（CBI）年会上发表讲话，批评伯纳姆的欧盟协议。

paras.en: She will accuse the prime minister of securing a "terrible" deal and will say he should be "aiming a lot higher" in terms of driving growth.
paras.zh: 她将指责总理达成了一项“糟糕”的协议，并表示他应该在推动经济增长方面“设定更高的目标”。

paras.en: Farage will tell the same conference that establishing closer ties with the EU would be a "disaster" for British businesses.
paras.zh: 法拉奇将在同一次会议上表示，与欧盟建立更紧密的关系对英国企业来说将是一场“灾难”。

paras.en: Rejoining the EU will hit the small firms that do not even trade with Europe with more red tape, more compliance costs, more Brussels rules they never asked for, he is expected to say.
paras.zh: 预计他将表示，重新加入欧盟将对那些甚至不与欧洲进行贸易的小企业造成更多的繁文缛节、更高的合规成本以及更多他们从未要求的布鲁塞尔规则。

paras.en: On Friday, the PM said that over the coming months both sides will "seek to conduct an informal brainstorming process" to look at the options for the UK's "long-term relationship" with the EU.
paras.zh: 周五，首相表示，未来几个月，双方将“寻求进行非正式的集思广益过程”，以研究英国与欧盟“长期关系”的选择。

paras.en: He was also clear that the deal he struck was "probably the limit of what we can achieve in this Parliament, given what needs to be done to implement it".
paras.zh: 他还明确表示，他达成的协议“可能是我们在本届议会所能实现的目标的极限，因为需要采取哪些措施来实施该协议”。

paras.en: He added: "But we want to inform the Parliament after this one, so that decisions can be taken about that long-term relationship."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“但我们希望在此之后通知议会，以便就长期关系做出决定。”

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，并且以人才发展为中心。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia
paras.zh: 资料来源：《晚邮报》——伦巴第版

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
